description: Medieval Trail Race is a mountain running competition held in Arad County, Romania, aiming to promote mountain running and the local natural and historical heritage. The routes cross the Zărand Mountains, linking two important medieval fortresses, Șoimoș and Șiria, and offering participants a unique experience amid nature and a medieval atmosphere. The event is open to both amateurs and professionals, with three moderately difficult races: a 9 km cross-country race, a 22 km half marathon, and a 44 km marathon. Participants can enjoy spring scenery and careful organization, with checkpoints, hydration, and medical assistance.
course_highlights: Routes run mainly along hiking trails, forest roads, and paved roads
Pass by historical sites: Șoimoș Fortress, Șiria Fortress, Feredeu Monastery, and Feredeu Hermitage
Significant elevation gains: 445 m (9 km), 1,026 m (22 km), 2,075 m (44 km)
additional: The start and finish for the cross-country race and half marathon are on the plateau behind Șiria Fortress; the marathon starts in Șoimoș and finishes on the plateau at Șiria Fortress. Participant kits are guaranteed for registrations made by April 12. Hydration and food stations are available along the routes. On-site registration is possible only for the cross-country race and half marathon, subject to availability, with no kit guaranteed.

name: Rtanj Vertikal 2026
description: Rtanj Vertical is a mountain race held on Mount Rtanj, starting in the settlement of Rtanj and finishing at the summit of Šiljak at 1,565 m above sea level. The race is a 4.6 km vertical kilometer with 950 m of elevation gain, following the southeastern Rtanj ridge. This challenge is part of the PSS National Mountain Running Series and is ITRA-certified. Competitors can enjoy fantastic views from the summit and are required to have a medical examination and a PSS competition booklet.
course_highlights: Course length: 4.6 km with 950 m of elevation gain
The route follows the southeastern Rtanj ridge to the summit of Šiljak (1,565 m above sea level)
Return along the marked trail on the southern side toward the village of Rtanj
additional: The start is in the settlement of Rtanj on the southern side. The only aid station is at the finish. The time limit for completing the race is 2 hours. A PSS competition booklet and a medical examination are required. The organizer is PK Šiljak Boljevac.

name: Vértés Terep Maraton
location: Szár, Sportcsarnok, Forrás utca . Ápr.25.-28. BACKYARD ULTRA ESZTERGOM - Franka Pálya - Gimnázium Sportpálya n*
distance_verbose: 221 km, 50 km, 41 km, 27 km, 20 km, 13 km, 9 km, 6.7 km
description: A Vértes Terep Maraton egy kihívásokkal teli terepfutó verseny a Vértes hegység festői ösvényein és erdészeti útjain. A verseny több távon kínál lehetőséget a futóknak, az ultramaratontól a minimaratonig, mindegyik változatos szintemelkedéssel és jól jelölt pályával. A rendezvény frissítőpontokkal, névre szóló rajtszámmal, időméréssel és gazdag célétellel várja a résztvevőket, akik a természet közelségét és a sportos élményt élvezhetik. A verseny családias hangulatú, és a szervezők külön figyelmet fordítanak a futók kényelmére és biztonságára.

name: Clear'97 Alpokalja Business Run
description: A Clear'97 Alpokalja Business Run egy közösségépítő, tavaszi futófesztivál Szombathelyen, amely céges, baráti és iskolai csapatok számára kínál különböző távokat egyéni és váltó kategóriákban. A verseny 2,5 km-es gyerekfutamtól indul, és 5 km, 10 km, valamint 20 km-es távokon zajlik, váltókkal kiegészítve. A rendezvény célja a sport és a mozgáskultúra népszerűsítése, egyedi befutóéremmel, elektronikus időméréssel és élő eredménykövetéssel. A versenyhez egészségnap is kapcsolódik, ahol mentálhigiénés szakemberek és terápiás bemutatók várják a résztvevőket. Ingyenes parkolás biztosított a Vasi Skanzen parkolójában.

name: Fuss a struccal 4 / 7 / 14 / 21
description: A Fuss a struccal jótékonysági futófesztivál Győrben, az Aranyparton kerül megrendezésre, ahol több távon - 4, 7, 14 és 21 kilométeren - várják a futókat. A rendezvény célja a gyermekellátás támogatása, különösen egy speciális EEG készülék beszerzése az epilepsziás és súlyos állapotú gyermekek diagnosztikájához. A futófesztiválon családok, gyermekek és négylábú kedvencek is részt vesznek, és a helyszínen szurkolók biztatják a résztvevőket. A programot ismert sportolók és helyi nagykövetek is támogatják, így egy igazán közösségi és jótékony eseményként várja a futókat.
course_highlights: Az Aranypart domboldaláról szurkolók biztatják a futókat
Több távon lehet indulni: 4, 7, 14 és 21 km
Családbarát esemény, ahol négylábú kedvencek is részt vehetnek
additional: A nevezési díjakból befolyt összegből gyermekintenzív terápiás eszközöket vásárolnak, különösen egy speciális EEG készüléket az epilepsziás gyermekek diagnosztikájához. A rendezvényen részt vesznek az Audi ETO KC csapatorvosai, valamint rendőrség és önkéntes tűzoltók is, akik bevetési öltözetben futnak és bemutatóval készülnek.

name: XXIII. Motherson Szigetköz Félmaraton 2 / 5 / 10 / 21
description: A Motherson Szigetköz Félmaraton egy hagyományos futóverseny Mosonmagyaróváron, amely több távon kínál lehetőséget a futni vágyóknak, köztük 2, 5, 10 és 21 kilométeres távokon. A verseny a Szigetköz természeti szépségei között zajlik, változatos útvonalakon, amelyek alkalmasak minden korosztály számára. A rendezvényt a Mosonmagyaróvári Strucc Futóklub SE szervezi, és minden évben sok futót vonz a régióból és azon túl is. A verseny barátságos hangulatú, családias esemény, amelyet a futók és a helyi közösség egyaránt várnak.
course_highlights: Változatos útvonalak a Szigetköz természeti környezetében
Távok: 2 km, 5 km, 10 km és félmaraton (21 km)
Mosonmagyaróvár központi helyszíne és környéke
additional: A verseny több távon zajlik, köztük 2 km, 5 km, 10 km és félmaraton (21 km). A verseny helyszíne Mosonmagyaróvár, Bokréta utca 26. A nevezés általában január első hetében indul. A szervező Mosonmagyaróvári Strucc Futóklub SE. A honlap térképeket és útvonalakat is biztosít a résztvevők számára.

name: ČSOB Bratislava marathon – desiatka, Minimaratón, deti, lezúni
distance_verbose: 50 km, Maratón, Polmaratón, 16 km, 11.6 km, 10 km, 5 km, 3.2 km
description: The ČSOB Bratislava Marathon is a family-friendly running event with a long-standing tradition, held in Bratislava and attracting runners from Slovakia and abroad. It offers a range of events, from the marathon, half marathon and relay races to the 10K, minimarathon, children’s races and crawling races. The atmosphere is filled with emotion, fair play and a sense of community, where everyone who takes the start and pushes beyond their limits is a winner. The event also supports charitable activities and emphasizes the value of helping one another and solidarity.

name: Národný beh Devín - Bratislava (5.kolo BP SAZ)
location: Devín Castle to Bratislava city centre, Bratislava, Slovakia
distance_verbose: 534 km, 50 km, Maratón, Polmaratón, 16 km, 11.6 km, 11.5 km, 11 km, 10 km, 7 km, 6 km, 5 km, 3.2 km, 2.6 km, 1 km
description: TIPOS National Run Devín–Bratislava is an iconic running event with a tradition spanning more than 100 years, taking runners from historic Devín Castle to the center of Bratislava. This road race is the oldest sporting event in Slovakia and attracts thousands of runners of all ages and abilities every year. The race has a unique atmosphere, with a rich accompanying program and a strong running community. It is suitable for recreational athletes as well as more competitive runners looking for a unique experience on a course of historical and cultural significance.
course_highlights: The route runs from Devín Castle to the center of Bratislava
A road race with a tradition spanning more than 100 years
More than 6,000 participants of all ages and abilities
additional: Individual registration is available via predpredaj.sk, while companies can register groups by emailing hromadne_prihlasky@starz.sk. Limited-edition T-shirts are available for EUR 17. The last day for issuing a group invoice is 14 April 2027; payment must be received by 15 April 2027.

name: Sačurovská pätnástka – 20. Memoriál Heleny Slukovej
location: Sačurov okr. Vranov n. Topľou, Sačurov okr. Vranov n. Topľou, pred budovou Zákl. školy v Sačurove
organizer: Obec Sačurov, OZ Sačurov, ZŠ Sačurov, MŠ Sačurov
description: Sačurov Fifteen – the 20th Helena Sluková Memorial is a traditional running race held in the village of Sačurov in the Vranov nad Topľou District. The race starts in front of the Sačurov primary school building and offers categories for various age groups, including children, youth and adults. The main category starts at 13:00, and the children’s race at 12:00. The organizers are the Municipality of Sačurov, OZ Sačurov, and Sačurov Primary and Nursery School. The race is suitable for local runners and beginner athletes.

name: Kajňanská desiatka – Memoriál Jána Osloviča
location: Slovenská Kajňa, Slovenská Kajňa, pred budovou Obecného úradu
organizer: Obec Slovenská Kajňa, MATORE s.r.o. Humenné, Bežecká akadémia Marcela Matanina
description: Kajňanská Desiatka – Ján Oslovič Memorial is a traditional running race held in the village of Slovenská Kajňa. The event offers three disciplines: a 10 km long run, a 3.66 km short run, and a 3.66 km short Nordic walking event, all starting simultaneously at 13:00. The competition is divided into several age categories for men and women, welcoming runners of different ages and ability levels. The organizer, MATORE s.r.o., ensures high-quality event organization and timekeeping.

name: Oslobodenie Likavka - Beh oslobodenia o Putovný pohár starostu obce Likavka
location: Likavka okr. Ružomberok, Likavka okr. Ružomberok, Futbalový štadión Obecného športového klubu v Likavke
description: The Liberation Run for the Likavka Mayor’s Traveling Cup is a traditional race organized by the Likavka Municipal Office and Likavka Primary School with Kindergarten. The race takes place at the Municipal Sports Club Football Stadium in Likavka and is part of the 2025 Liptov Running League. Children, pupils, juniors, women, and men can compete in various age categories. The start for pupils is at 10:05 and for adults at 11:40, according to the race regulations. The race is suitable for the general public and offers a chance to test your strength in the beautiful surroundings of Likavka.

name: Čadčianska desiatka
location: Čadca, Okres Čadca, Žilinský kraj, Slovakia
description: Čadčianska desiatka is a traditional running race organized by the Kysuce Marathon Club Čadca, the City of Čadca, and the Čadca Žarec Social Services Center. This 30th edition will start at 10 a.m. in the Žarec housing estate in Čadca. Runners can look forward to a well-prepared course and a friendly atmosphere at an event popular with the region’s running community. Online registration is available, and you can also register on race day for a higher entry fee.

name: Dălhăuți Trail Challenge
description: Dălhăuți Trail Challenge is a mountain running competition held in the village of Dălhăuți, Vrancea County. The event is organized by the Velopower Sports Association and promotes running on varied terrain, including forest trails and forestry roads. Participants can enjoy a well-marked course with checkpoints and a friendly atmosphere, rounded off with an awards ceremony and a traditional lunch. The start is scheduled for 10:00, following a technical briefing and a coffee-fueled warm-up. The event emphasizes socializing and promoting outdoor physical activity.

name: UCM Night Run
description: UCM Night Run is a charity evening run that starts at 20:00 at Trojičné Square in Trnava. Runners complete a 5-kilometre route through the historic streets of Trnava’s centre, offering the unique atmosphere of “Little Rome.” The event is open to everyone, regardless of ability, and brings the community together through exercise and support for those in need. Proceeds from the run will go towards rehabilitation and treatment for a child with a disability. The organisers are the City of Trnava, FMK UCM students and main partner CUKROVAR.

name: Bara Reva Trail 2026
description: Bara Reva Trail is a trail race in the natural area of Bara Reva in Belgrade. The course runs through a marshland area on the left bank of the Danube, offering runners the chance to discover one of the city’s green spaces. The race is intended for nature-running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: The natural surroundings of Bara Reva
Location on the left bank of the Danube
Marshland in Belgrade’s Palilula municipality

name: ULTRABALATON
distance_verbose: 221 km, 41 km, 27 km, 20 km, 13 km, 9 km
organizer: Balatonman Triatlon Kft & FULLCON IT Development Kft
description: Az Ultrabalaton 2026-ban immár 20. alkalommal kerül megrendezésre, Magyarország legnépszerűbb közösségi sporteseménye. A verseny a Balatont megkerülő egykörös futóverseny, amely Közép-Európa leghosszabb futóversenye, és egyéniben vagy csapatban, futva vagy kerékpárral is teljesíthető. A táv 209 kilométer, amely egyéni indulóknak és 2-6 fős csapatoknak is elérhető. A rendezvény barátságos, közösségi hangulatú, és a futók mellett a kísérők és kerékpárosok számára is vonzó programokat kínál.

name: Mozdulj Csepel!
location: Kolonics György Szabadidőközpont, Hollandi út 8-10, Csepel, Budapest, Hungary
description: A Mozdulj, Csepel! egy ingyenes családi futóverseny Budapest Csepel kerületében, a Kolonics György Szabadidőközpontból indulva. A verseny négy távon zajlik: 3,5 km, 7 km, 400 méteres gyerekfutam és egy speciális futam fogyatékkal élők számára. A futók a Duna-parti Kolonics sétányon haladnak, chipes időméréssel, és a célban tornazsákot, almát és műzlit kapnak. A rendezvény pohármentes, ezért a résztvevőknek saját kulacsot vagy poharat kell hozniuk a frissítéshez. A verseny célja a közösségépítés és a mozgás örömének megosztása minden korosztály számára.
course_highlights: A rajt és cél a Kolonics György Szabadidőközpontnál
A futamok nagy része a Duna-parti Kolonics sétányon halad
Speciális futam fogyatékkal élőknek, örömfutás jelleggel
additional: A nevezés ingyenes, de regisztrációhoz kötött, helyszíni regisztráció a szabad helyek függvényében lehetséges. A gyerekfutamon nincs időmérés és dobogó, ez egy örömfutás. A legkisebbeket befutóérem, a nagyobbakat tornazsák, alma és műzli várja a célban.

name: Galbicska Péter Emlékfutás Tata 7 / 14
organizer: Tatai Tömegsport és Tájfutó Honvéd Sportegyesület
description: A VI. Galbicska Péter Emlékfutás kerül megrendezésre Tata, a Tópart sétányon. A verseny két távon, 7 km (1 tókör) és 14 km (2 tókör) teljesítésével várja a futókat, akik korosztályonként és nemenként is nevezhetnek. A rendezvény családias hangulatú, a tóparti környezetben zajlik, és a résztvevők számára egyaránt kihívást és élményt nyújt. A rajt 10:00-kor kezdődik, a nevezés pedig április 23-án 18:00 óráig lehetséges.

name: BACKYARD ULTRA ESZTERGOM
description: A Backyard Ultra Esztergom 2026 egy különleges ultrafutó verseny, amely az utolsó emberig tart. A versenyzők egy 6706 méteres kört teljesítenek óránként, és csak azok maradnak versenyben, akik a következő rajtig beérnek. A verseny a Hungarian Backyard League része, korosztályos bajnokságként kerül megrendezésre, ahol 11 korosztályban díjazzák a legjobb női és férfi futókat. A verseny helyszíne a Franka Pálya - Gimnázium Sportpálya Esztergomban, és a résztvevők között akár 160 kilométeres távot is teljesítők is elismerést kapnak.

name: Ultramaratón Košice – Miskolc
organizer: Marathon Club Miskolc, Košice Marathon Club
description: The Košice–Miskolc Ultramarathon is a challenging international ultrarunning race. The route runs from the center of Košice to Miskolc, offering runners the challenge of a long and varied course. The event is part of a series of running events organized by the Košice Marathon Club and is intended for endurance runners seeking a unique experience that pushes them to their limits. The race starts on Hlavná Street in Košice, adding a historic atmosphere and support from local spectators.

name: Ultra Kras
location: Cieľ sa nachádza na parkovisku vedľa kina Hviezda v Turni nad Bodvou
description: Ultra Kras is a 57 km mountain ultramarathon with 2,400 metres of elevation gain, running through Slovak Karst National Park. Both the start and finish are in Turňa nad Bodvou, and the race has a 12-hour time limit. It is part of the Slovak Ultra Trail League and features a challenging route with several refreshment and checkpoint stations. Race registration takes place the day before the start and on race day, with a mass start at 7:00 a.m.

name: Demänovský Štvanec
location: Demänová Rezort, Demänová, Liptovský Mikuláš, Slovakia
description: Demänovský Štvanec is a running event set in the beautiful natural surroundings of Demänovská Valley, offering a sporting experience for recreational runners and competitive athletes alike. The races take place at Demänová Resort in Liptovský Mikuláš and include various disciplines, including children’s races and an inclusive run. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere and a rich programme for all age groups. The organisers provide convenient registration and timing to make the experience as enjoyable as possible for participants.
course_highlights: The courses run through the beautiful natural surroundings of Demänovská Valley
Disciplines for all age groups, including children’s races and an inclusive run
Start and finish at the Demänová Resort grounds
additional: Registration and race-bib collection are available on Friday, 23.4.2027, from 17:00 to 19:00, and on Saturday, 24.4.2027, from 8:00 to 10:00 for children and from 10:00 to 13:00 for adults. The time limit is 2 hours for the 10 km course and 1.5 hours for the 5 km course. Timing is provided by VOS-TPK.

name: Račiansky polmaratón, Račianska desiatka
location: Športový areál Tbiliská 4, Bratislava-Rača, Bratislava, Slovakia
description: The Rača Half Marathon and Rača Ten are traditional running events in the Bratislava-Rača borough, offering participants the choice of a half marathon or a 10K. Runners can enjoy a course through the Tbiliská 4 sports complex and the surrounding parts of Rača. The event is suitable for the general public, including recreational runners and more competitive athletes. It is organised by the Bratislava-Rača borough, which provides quality facilities and services for participants.
course_highlights: The course passes through the Tbiliská 4 sports complex in Bratislava-Rača
Choose between the half-marathon and 10K courses
The route passes through the Rača borough in a pleasant urban setting

name: Prešov Running Series 1. kolo
description: Prešov Running, o.z. warmly invites you to Prešov Stars Run 2026, taking place on 25 April in the centre of Prešov. This running evening will immerse you in the atmosphere of the 1990s, with music, retro sportswear and entertainment. Runners can choose from children’s races and 5 km and 10 km courses, accompanied along the way by DJs and a performance by MC Erik. Prešov Stars Run is the first event in the Prešov Running Series 2026, which consists of three separate races in different parts of the city and its surroundings.

name: Gavurky run 2026 + Backyard ultra
location: Dobrá Niva, Dobrá Niva, Námestie SNP
description: Gavurky Run 2026 is a running event in Dobrá Niva offering a variety of races, including the main race, a hobby run, Nordic walking, and a Backyard Ultra. Race registration and starts take place at SNP Square. The event is suitable for a wide range of participants, including children, recreational runners, and ultramarathon runners, with capacity limited to 400 participants. The event is organized by ŠPORTKLUB Dobrá Niva, o.z., which provides professional event management and timekeeping.

name: Agrotim Race
location: Zemplínska Nová Ves, Trebišov District, Košice Region, Slovakia

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: muži a ženy prihlásení do 22.04.2025 on-line

description: Agrotim Race is a running event held in Zemplínska Nová Ves, offering athletes the opportunity to take part in the beautiful surroundings of the Zemplín region. The race is organized by the municipality of Zemplínska Nová Ves and AGROTIM spol. s.r.o. Entry is open to men and women, and registration is available online or on site. The event is suitable for runners looking for a quality sporting event in the region.
course_highlights: The race takes place in Zemplínsky Klečenov, in Zemplínska Nová Ves, beneath the gazebo at the Oasis of Relaxation
Organized by the municipality of Zemplínska Nová Ves and AGROTIM spol. s.r.o.
Pleasant surroundings suitable for both recreational and competitive runners
additional: Registration is available online by email at o.ouznves@gmail.com or on site on race day. The entry fee is €8 for online registration by April 22 and €10 for registration on site.

name: 1000-ročný beh
location: Spišská Nová Ves, Spišská Nová Ves, Tenisové kurty pri nemocnici s poliklinikou v Spišskej Novej Vsi
description: The 1000-Year Run is a running competition organized by SPK Medveď in Spišská Nová Ves. It takes place on the tennis courts near the hospital with polyclinic. The route runs mainly along field and forest roads, with the main race covering approximately 9.6 km and an elevation gain of 267 m. The event also includes categories for children, youth, juniors, Nordic walking and a run for health. The start is at 10:00. Runners are provided with refreshments on the course and at the finish, including goulash or pierogi and a drink. Registration is available online or by email, and the entry fee is paid on-site on race day.

name: Beh oslobodenia Chtelnice
location: Chtelnica okr. Piešťany, Chtelnica okr. Piešťany, pri Obecnom úrade
description: The Chtelnica Liberation Run is a traditional race with an unchanged route. It starts at 1. mája Square and passes through the picturesque surroundings of the Little Carpathians. The course combines paved sections with a forest path alongside the Chtelnica Reservoir, the World War II memorial, and the Chapel of St. Roch. Runners can enjoy the natural scenery and challenges such as the legendary “steep climb” through the forest. The event is suitable for runners looking for a mix of paved roads and natural terrain in a peaceful mountain setting.

name: Čirov beh – Radobica
location: Radobica okr. Prievidza, Radobica okr. Prievidza, pred obecným úradom
description: Čirov Run - Radobica is a traditional village race, offering runners the chance to enjoy varied terrain on a 5.4 km course with 201 metres of elevation gain. The course runs along asphalt, village streets, field roads, hills, flat sections and through small woods, including a short, steep stretch. The event also includes 800-metre children’s races suitable for younger runners. It takes place in Radobica in front of the municipal office and is open to various age groups, including local runners. The organizers offer cash prizes for breaking course records.

name: Jablonická desiatka
description: The Jablonica Ten is the traditional Felix Rímeš Memorial Run, held in the village of Jablonica. The event is for the whole family, suitable for children, and offers wheelchair access. Runners can enjoy an active way to spend their free time in the pleasant surroundings of the village. The entry fee is nominal, and children and young people can take part for free.

name: NZ charitatívny beh pre OZ čiernouško
location: Nové Zámky, Nové Zámky, parkovisko pri reštaurácii Berek (ulica Tatranská)
organizer: Občianske združenie čiernouško, STG Nové Zámky
description: The NZ Charity Run for the Čiernouško Civic Association is a running event in Nové Zámky, held in the car park by the Berek restaurant on Tatranská Street. The course is mostly asphalt, flat, and off public roads. Proceeds from the run go to the Čiernouško Civic Association, which helps homeless, abused, and otherwise vulnerable animals. The event is organised by the Čiernouško Civic Association and STG Nové Zámky, and is suitable for animal lovers and runners who want to combine sport with charitable support.

name: Sereďský Horalky beh
description: The Seredský HORALKY Run 2026 is a running competition held in the beautiful surroundings of the Castle Park in Sereď. The race offers runners of different age groups and abilities the chance to enjoy a day of sport in nature. The course winds through the scenic park and surrounding countryside, making for an enjoyable experience for all participants. The organizers welcome all runners and sports fans to this traditional event.

name: Night run Nitra
location: Nitra, Okres Nitra, Nitriansky kraj, Slovakia
description: Nitra Night Run is a popular nighttime running event in the center of Nitra, bringing together sport, music, and an energetic atmosphere. Runners can choose between 5 km and 10 km races, and the program also includes a 5 km Nordic Walking event. The event also welcomes families with children, who can take part in the children’s races for free. The main program starts at 20:00, creating a unique evening experience in the city’s historic center.
course_highlights: Night run through the center of Nitra
5 km and 10 km courses with an atmosphere full of music and sporting energy
Free children’s races, with a medal for every participant
additional: The children’s races take place at 17:00 and are free, with no registration required. Check-in and race number collection take place from 09:00 to 19:30 in the registration area near the start. The event is limited to 1,000 participants.

name: Maratonul Vinului powered by OMV Petrom
description: Maratonul Vinului powered by OMV Petrom is Romania’s first charity mountain biking race, now in its 14th edition. The event takes place in Urlați, Prahova County, among the area’s hills, vineyards, and wineries. Participants can choose from several routes suited to their ability, from 4 km for children to 50 km for experienced cyclists. The race promotes cycling as a healthy lifestyle and supports important social causes.
course_highlights: 50 km route for experienced cyclists
30 km route for amateurs and juniors
18 km route recommended for less experienced cyclists
additional: The children’s races (4 and 8 km) start at 09:00, the 18, 30, and 50 km routes at 10:35, and the Family ride at 10:45. Race packs can be collected in Bucharest and at the venue during specified time slots. Family Ride participants do not receive a race kit and can go directly to the start. The awards ceremony is scheduled for 15:00, and the cut-off time is 16:30. The event also includes activities for families and children, as well as support for social and educational causes, promoting wine culture and local tourism.

name: Alergăraș în Făgăraș
description: Alergăraș în Făgăraș is a sporting event that brings together runners of all ages and performance levels to explore the natural and cultural beauty of the Făgăraș area. The courses offer a complete experience, with steep climbs, descents through spectacular scenery, and well-organized hydration points, while the start and finish take place near the historic fortress. The atmosphere is friendly and motivating, supported by an enthusiastic community and dedicated volunteers. The event promotes grassroots sport and respect for nature, offering a memorable day of running and socializing amid mountain scenery.
course_highlights: Steep climbs and descents through spectacular scenery
Start and finish in the area of Făgăraș Fortress
Well-stocked hydration points and excellent course marking
additional: Premium finisher medal, cash prizes for podium finishers, ITRA points and a UTMB Index for the Maratonu’ de pe Ardeal and Belvedere races, a voucher for a hot meal after the race, medical support with an ambulance, a massage tent, food and hydration points along the course and at the finish, and the option to purchase a technical running shirt. Multiple race categories, including marathon, trail, cross-country, and relays; the event includes cultural and tourist activities, promoting a healthy lifestyle and the natural beauty of the Făgăraș area.

name: RotaRun 2026
description: RotaRun for Charity is a sporting and charity event organized by Rotary Club Cluj-Napoca, combining running with community involvement to support children with cancer. The event aims to complete the renovation of the Pediatric Oncology Department at the “Prof. Dr. Ion Chiricuță” Oncology Institute in Cluj-Napoca. Participants can choose from several races, ranging from a 3 km run to a 2-hour race. All races take place along the Someș Promenade, starting and finishing near the “Horia Demian” Sports Hall. All funds raised from registration fees go directly to the charity project.

name: Maratonul Codrului
location: Popasul Codrenilor, Oțeloaia, Homoroade, Satu Mare County, Romania
description: Codrului Marathon is an MTB and trail running event organized by Pro Racers Sports Club and the Romanian Cycling Federation, for both amateurs and professionals. The spectacular routes cross forests and offer challenges for all fitness levels, with new and more appealing options for the MTB and trail running events. The event also includes races for children, race packs, hydration stations, medical assistance, timing, and a finisher medal for all participants. It is an event for the community and families, with a friendly atmosphere and comprehensive support for runners.
course_highlights: New, more challenging MTB routes, excluding the road section from the last 5 km
Varied trail running routes, with 6 km and 13 km hobby options
Significant climbs on routes with elevation gains ranging from 250 m to 1,150 m
additional: The event offers race packs with a race number and sponsor products (limited to 250 packs), photos from the course, hydration stations along the course and at the finish, medical assistance and Mountain Rescue, timing, a pasta party, and finisher medals. Official SPORT HG technical tops, model 2026, are available as an optional purchase. The schedule includes multiple category starts and a children’s race, with the awards ceremony at 14:30.

name: The Color Run București
description: The Color Run București is an untimed 5-kilometer race, known as the “Happiest 5k on the Planet,” celebrating health, joy, and originality through a colorful, energetic experience. Participants run, dance, and enjoy a festival atmosphere, getting covered in powder at every kilometer. The event ends with a vibrant party, where all runners are covered in colors and receive medals and temporary tattoos. It is a celebration of movement and community, open to all ages and fitness levels.
course_highlights: Approximately 5 km, untimed course
Powder color stations at every kilometer
Post-race party with a cloud of colored powder and music
additional: The event has several consecutive start waves, five minutes apart. Entry to the event area requires a race number and the T-shirt from the race kit. The participation kit includes a T-shirt, race number, temporary tattoos, bandana, medal, and colored powder. There is no baggage storage area. Children aged 0–6 can enter for free with a race number, medal, and powder, but without a T-shirt.

name: Forest Race Marghita
location: Forest near Marghita, Bihor County, Romania
description: Forest Race Marghita is a trail-running race of moderate difficulty, held in the deciduous forest near the town of Marghita. The event is organized by Run For Freedom Sports Club together with XTERRA Sport Bihor Sports Club and offers four routes suited to different levels of runners: Half Marathon (21.6 km), Cross (10.8 km), Speedy (5.4 km), and Mini (1 km). The start and finish are at Freedom Adventure Park, and the routes are appropriately marked for participants’ safety. The race promotes a healthy lifestyle and respect for the environment.
course_highlights: Routes on marked forest roads in the deciduous forest of Marghita
Moderate elevation gain: +460 m for the half marathon, +230 m for the cross, +20 m for the mini
Start and finish at Freedom Adventure Park
additional: The official T-shirt is not included in the price and cannot be ordered through the race. Participants under 18 must provide a medical certificate and written consent from a parent or guardian. The organizers may exclude participants who are intoxicated or do not have appropriate equipment. Registration is exclusively through the official webshop.

name: Fruškogorski maraton
distance_verbose: 134 km, 108 km, 59 km, Maraton, Polumaraton, 10 km
description: The Fruška Gora Marathon is a sporting competition and recreational event with a long tradition. It takes place in the hilly, forested area of Fruška Gora, near Novi Sad. The routes pass through natural beauty spots and numerous medieval Serbian monasteries, as well as historical and cultural landmarks. The competitive courses are ITRA-certified and serve as qualifiers for the Ultra-Trail du Mont-Blanc. In addition to the competitive courses, there are nine recreational routes that promote a healthy lifestyle and nature conservation.
course_highlights: The routes pass through 97% forested terrain on Fruška Gora
Pass through medieval Serbian monasteries such as Grgeteg, Staro Hopovo, Novo Hopovo, Jazak, and Bešenovo
Climb Fruška Gora’s highest peak (539 m) and descend past the Dombovački Stream waterfall
additional: The competitive courses are ITRA-certified and serve as qualifiers for the Ultra-Trail du Mont-Blanc. There are 14 different routes of varying distances and elevation gains, ranging from an ultra-extreme 134 km marathon to recreational routes. The routes include natural and cultural landmarks, as well as historical sites. The organizer also has a Viber group for registrations and communication. 14 routes of varying distances, ITRA-certified, including ultra and recreational distances, passing medieval monasteries and natural and cultural landmarks.

name: 49th Fruška Gora Trail
location: Planinarski dom Železničar, Fruška Gora, Serbia
description: Fruška Gora Trail is a traditional sporting and competitive event held on Fruška Gora, known for its old trails and new challenges. The race features a variety of courses and categories, from ultra-extreme to recreational, suited to different levels of runners. The event brings together nature and running enthusiasts, offering a unique experience through beautiful landscapes and demanding terrain. The organizers strive to provide quality logistics, including organized transport to the start and extensive support during the race.
course_highlights: A variety of trails with ITRA points ranging from 1 to 5
Courses ranging from mini distances to ultra-extreme marathons
Beautiful natural landscapes of Fruška Gora, with challenging climbs and descents
additional: The race includes courses with different ITRA point values, from 1 to 5, and distances suited to runners of all levels. The event includes multiple race categories, online registration, organized transport from Novi Sad, and a variety of courses for runners of all levels.

name: Šumadija Trejl Staza Snage (Gledićke Planine)
description: Šumadija Trail Strength Course is a challenging race through the unspoiled nature of the Gledić Mountains, with two courses that test runners’ strength and endurance. The longer course, Prkos, is 17.5 km long with 1,000 meters of elevation gain, while the shorter course, Zamah, is 8 km long with 450 meters of elevation gain. The race combines steep climbs and technical descents, offering a unique challenge and an opportunity to enjoy Šumadija hospitality. The start and finish are at Adžine Livade, and runners receive a generous race pack and a surprise lunch.

name: 4. Jablanik Trail
description: Jablanik Trail is a UTMB Index race held in Valjevo, Serbia. The race is 34 kilometers long with a total elevation gain of 1,837 meters, offering runners challenging and attractive terrain. The course provides a unique opportunity to experience the natural beauty of western Serbia through its mountainous landscapes. The race brings together experienced runners and trail-running enthusiasts, creating a competitive and friendly atmosphere.

name: IX. Miklósi Futónap
description: A IX. Miklósi Futónap egy családbarát futóverseny Szigetszentmiklóson, amely kerül megrendezésre. A verseny több távon kínál lehetőséget a futásra, 500 métertől egészen a félmaratonig (21 km). A rendezvény a Városi Sportcsarnok elől indul, és a Szebeni út, Petőfi út, Gerincút útvonalon halad, majd visszatér a sportcsarnokhoz. A futók számára öltöző, ruhatár és WC is biztosított a helyszínen. A verseny célja a sport és közösség népszerűsítése minden korosztály számára.

name: III. Strázsa-hegyi Trail Futóverseny 2 / 5 / 10 / 21
description: A III. Strázsa-hegyi Toyota Kovács Trail Futóverseny kerül megrendezésre Monoron, a Strázsahegyi dűlőben. A versenyen 500 méteres családi futam, valamint 2, 5, 10 kilométeres és félmaratoni távok közül választhatnak a résztvevők. A futók változatos terepen, természetközeli környezetben teljesíthetik a távokat, melyek között megtalálhatók a 10 km-es és félmaratoni útvonalak is. A rendezvény célja a sport és a természet szeretetének népszerűsítése, családbarát hangulatban.

name: ÍROTTKŐ HILLCLIMB
description: Az Írottkő Hillclimb egy változatos és emlékezetes hegyi futóverseny, amely Kőszeg Rőtfalva környékén kerül megrendezésre. A verseny új rajthelyszínnel, Bozsokról indul, és több távon kínál kihívást a futóknak, a 7 km-es bevezető terepfutástól a 102 km-es Alpokalja Ultráig. A pályák változatos terepen, szép panorámákkal és frissítőpontokkal várják a résztvevőket, akiknek kitartásra és jó fizikai felkészültségre lesz szükségük. A verseny családbarát programokat is kínál, így a legkisebbek is élvezhetik a természetvédelmi és interaktív kiállításokat.

name: FUTAPEST TEREPFUTÁS
description: A FUTAPEST Terepfutás egy izgalmas terepfutó verseny Bér, Virágospuszta festői környezetében. A verseny változatos terepen zajlik, amely kihívást jelent minden futónak, legyen kezdő vagy tapasztalt. A rendezvény célja a természetközeli futás élményének megosztása és a közösségépítés a terepfutók között. A Futapest Klub szervezésében zajlik, amely hosszú évek óta támogatja a crossfutás és terepfutás sportágát Magyarországon.
course_highlights: Természetközeli, változatos terep Virágospusztán
Kihívást jelentő dombos szakaszok
Festői környezet és erdei ösvények

name: Beh za A(tra)ktívny Bardejov
description: The Run for A(tra)ctive Bardejov is a charity run that brings the community in Bardejov and the surrounding area together every year. The event takes place in Town Hall Square and offers participants the chance to support four selected projects through their entry fees. Runners can compete in person or virtually from anywhere in the world. The event also features a musical performance and a family run for children up to 6 years old, making it suitable for all age groups.

name: Šamorínska bežecká liga 2026 – 2. kolo
description: The Šamorín Running League is a series of running races organized by 3klub Šamorín in the beautiful Pomlé forest park. The league is open to the general public, with no age or performance limits, and includes competitions for men, women, and children in various categories. The entry fee includes timekeeping, race numbers, and refreshments at the finish. Competitors earn points throughout the year, and at the end of the league the top runners are ranked using an age coefficient. The league is ideal for anyone who wants to compete regularly and improve their performance in a friendly atmosphere.

name: Beh oslobodenia obce Chocholná-Velčice
location: Chocholná-Velčice - Trenčín, Chocholná-Velčice - Trenčín, pred Materskou školou Chocholná-Velčice
description: The Chocholná-Velčice Liberation Run is a traditional sporting event, taking place for the 52nd time on Sunday. It is organized by the Municipality of Chocholná-Velčice, Jednota Sokol, DHZ Chocholná-Velčice, and SOŠ dopravná Trenčín. The race starts in front of the fire station in the village and is open to all sports enthusiasts. The event is also suitable for children and is wheelchair-accessible, ensuring access for all participants.

name: Beh oslobodenia Bodíc
location: Bodice - časť mesta Liptovský Mikuláš, Bodice - časť mesta Liptovský Mikuláš, Kultúrny dom Bodice
organizer: Bežecký klub Bodice, Olympijský klub Liptova
description: The Bodice Liberation Run is a traditional running race held in Bodice, a district of the city of Liptovský Mikuláš, with the Cultural Centre Bodice serving as its hub. The race also hosts the Slovak Championships in forest running and offers categories for children, youth, juniors, women and men across various age groups. The children’s race starts at 9:00, the youth and adult races at 10:25, and the men’s main race at 11:30. The event is organised by Bežecký klub Bodice and Olympijský klub Liptova, providing a high-quality sporting experience in a pleasant setting.

name: Semimaraton Iași
organizer: Rotary Club Iași Copou, Salvați Copiii Iași, Primăria Municipiului Iași
description: Iași Half Marathon is the largest running event in northeastern Romania, held annually in the Palace of Culture Square. The half-marathon course consists of two loops that pass through the start area, giving runners a unique experience on the city’s main streets, with road traffic stopped and refreshment points along the way. The event has a strong charitable component, supporting children from disadvantaged backgrounds through educational and social projects. Taking part in the half-marathon, cross-country races and fun runs is an opportunity to do good and join a community committed to positive change.
course_highlights: Route along main streets with road traffic stopped
Passes in front of the Palace of Culture
Refreshment points for hydration and medical assistance
additional: Participants in the half-marathon, 10 km cross-country and 5 km cross-country races receive a disposable timing chip and a technical event T-shirt. Registration is available online until the deadline; after that, subject to availability, participants can register in person at the Iași Half Marathon kiosk in Palas Mall. Registration is not available on race day. The event provides an ambulance for medical assistance and plenty of photos at the finish and along the course. Participation includes hydration points, medical assistance, a race kit, and the option to participate online or in person. The event is charitable, supporting projects for disadvantaged children.

name: Bucharest International Half Marathon
description: Bucharest International Half Marathon by Constantina Diță brings runners to the streets of Bucharest in a race initiated by Olympic marathon champion Constantina Diță. The event includes a half marathon and a 10 km race, open to both competitive and amateur runners. The course is flat and fast, suitable for those aiming for a good result or wanting to enjoy a run in the capital.
course_highlights: Flat and fast course
Running on the streets of Bucharest
Half marathon and 10 km races
additional: Individual, family, and friends registrations are mentioned, as well as the Team 3 Challenge.

name: URME PE PLAY
description: Urme pe Play is a mountain running competition held in the commune of Rășinari, at the foot of the Cindrel and Lotru Mountains. The routes are marked and include natural trails, forest roads, and paved roads, offering an authentic foothill experience. The event is open to both adults and children, with races for each age group. Participants can enjoy picturesque scenery and the friendly atmosphere of the local community at an event that combines sport with local culture and tradition.

name: Takovski grm
description: Takovski Grm is a 13.5 km road race starting in Takovo and finishing in Gornji Milanovac. The race runs through Takovo’s historic natural surroundings along a newly opened route, with plenty of climbs and descents, offering a challenge and a chance to enjoy the natural beauty. The organizers invite runners to take part and enjoy running together, the results, and socializing at the finish. All participants who complete the race receive a finisher’s medal, while the top finishers are awarded cash prizes and trophies.

name: Etyekrun
description: Az EtyekRUN egy különleges futóverseny Etyek lankáin, ahol a borvidék hangulata és a tavaszi táj, dűlők, szőlősorok kísérik a résztvevőket. A verseny május 1-jén kerül megrendezésre, és egyedülálló élményt nyújt a természet és a futás szerelmeseinek. A rendezvény családias hangulatú, és a futók számára inspiráló környezetet biztosít.
course_highlights: Etyek lankái és borvidék hangulata
Dűlők és szőlősorok között vezető útvonal
Tavaszi táj és természetközeli futás

name: XI. Ezerjó Félmaraton 5 / 10 / 21
description: Az XI. Ezerjó Félmaraton kerül megrendezésre Móron, a Szent István téren. A verseny három távon kínál kihívást: 5 km, 10 km és félmaraton (21 km). A futók gyönyörű szőlőhegyek között, változatos terepen, emelkedőkkel és panorámás kilátással teljesíthetik a távokat. A rendezvény családbarát, gyerekfutamokkal is várja a kisebbeket, és a célban frissítőkkel, befutóéremmel díjazza a résztvevőket. A verseny egyedi hangulatát a helyi borvidék és a közösségi élmény adja.

name: FUT AZ ÜLLŐ
description: A "Fut az Üllő" egy hagyományos városi futóverseny, amely Üllő városközpontjában kerül megrendezésre. A verseny célja a sport és a közösségi élet népszerűsítése, amely minden korosztály számára nyitott. A rendezvényen korlátozott számban helyszíni nevezés is lehetséges a verseny napján reggel 7 órától. A verseny szervezője Üllő Város Önkormányzata, amely a helyi közösség támogatásával biztosítja a rendezvény sikerét.

name: ETYEKRUN (1.)
distance_verbose: Félmaraton, 12 km, 10 km, 7 km, 5.5 km, 5 km, 0.2 km

name: Mintal Nemčiansky beh
organizer: Marathon Banska Bystrica, s.r.o., ON-POINT o.z.
description: Mintal Nemčiansky Run is a running event in the village of Nemce, offering races for both children and adults. The races cover various distances, from 1,000 m for children to 10.6 km for adults. The course follows a dirt road and a paved hiking trail, offering a pleasant running experience in nature. The event is organized by Marathon Banská Bystrica, s.r.o., ON-POINT o.z. and Nemciansky Beh OZ, and is suitable for runners across a wide range of age groups.

name: Podvihorlatský maratón, Michalovský polmaratón
location: Michalovce, Michalovce, pred MsÚ v Michalovciach
organizer: Mesto Michalovce, Atletický klub Michalovce, Obec Vinné
description: The Podvihorlatský Marathon and Michalovce Half Marathon are traditional running events held in the beautiful surroundings of Zemplínska šírava and the city of Michalovce. The races offer a marathon, a half marathon, and a half-marathon relay, making them suitable for a wide range of participants, from experienced runners to recreational athletes. The organizers provide quality services, including electronic timing, refreshments along the course and at the finish, stylish T-shirts, and participant medals. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and support for the region’s running community.

name: ETHOS Májový beh cyklotrasou
location: Krásno nad Kysucou, Krásno nad Kysucou, Námestie pred Kultúrnym domom
description: The ETHOS May Cycling Path Run is the fourth edition of a running competition taking place in Krásno nad Kysucou. The race follows a cycling path through beautiful natural mountain scenery with minimal traffic, ensuring a safe and enjoyable experience. Runners can compete on certified courses in men’s and women’s categories, with different age groups. The organizer encourages online registration and provides refreshments and medals for all participants.

name: Medzinárodný pouličný beh Komárom – Komárno
organizer: Bežecký spolok Komárom - Európa (KEFE), Komárom-Európa Futó Egyesület (KEFE)
description: The Komárom–Komárno International Street Run is a traditional race held in Komárno, starting near the Municipal Sports Hall. The event offers 5.5 km and 10 km courses, as well as a children’s race. The start is at the intersection of Arany János and Vág streets in Komárom. The event is organised by the Komárom–Európa Running Association (KEFE) and is suitable for runners of a wide range of ages. The atmosphere is international and friendly, with an emphasis on athletic performance and a shared community experience.

name: Pečovskonovoveský šľapák – prvomájový beh zdravia
location: Pečovská Nová Ves okr. Sabinov, Pečovská Nová Ves okr. Sabinov, Základná škola Pečovská Nová Ves
organizer: Obecný úrad Pečovská Nová Ves, základná škola s materskou školou Pečovská Nová Ves
description: The Pečovská Nová Ves Walking Run – May Day Health Run is a traditional running race organized by the Pečovská Nová Ves Municipal Office and the Pečovská Nová Ves Primary School and Kindergarten. The race is open to the general public, including children, juniors, and adults in various age categories. Competitors are divided by age and gender, including a 5 km race for the Mayor’s Prize. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and sporting activities in the community.

name: Primátorská desiatka
location: Poprad,, Poprad,, Poprad Kvetnica časť Strelnica
organizer: Mesto Poprad, MsÚ Poprad, Centrum voľného času Poprad, Mestské lesy Poprad, Triklub Poprad
description: The Mayor’s Ten is a traditional running race in Poprad, held in the Kvetnica - Strelnica area. The race is open to children, young people and adults, with categories divided by age and gender. The children’s and youth races start at 10:00, and the main category starts at 10:45. The organizers are the City of Poprad, Poprad Municipal Office, Poprad Leisure Centre, Poprad Municipal Forests and Triklub Poprad. The race offers a pleasant atmosphere and the opportunity to enjoy sport for all age groups.

name: Zay Cross
organizer: Čachtické podzemie o.z., PD Uhrovec, člen skupiny AGRAVITAL, RZP a.s.
description: Zay Cross is a running event held in the village of Žitná-Radiša, at the football pitch. Runners can choose between two courses: the main 14 km course with 550 m of elevation gain and the shorter 5 km course with 200 m of elevation gain. The routes combine paved roads, forest roads, trails and grassy meadows. They are well marked and have refreshment stations. The event also features children’s races and attractions in the safe start and finish area. It is organised by the Čachtické podzemie civic association, together with its partners and the village of Žitná-Radiša.

name: Charitatívny beh Liskovským chotárom
location: Lisková, Lisková, Základná škola, ul. Pod Chočom 550
description: The Lisková Countryside Charity Run is a running event in Lisková offering categories for children, youth, juniors, adults, and hobby runners, including Nordic Walking. The start is at the Primary School at 550 Pod Chočom Street. The schoolchildren’s race starts at 9:00, while the main and hobby races start at 10:45. The event is suitable for the general public and supports charitable causes. The organizer is Jozef Bukový, who provides information about the event.

name: II. Mohácsi Gőcze Trail
description: A II. Mohácsi Gőcze Trail egy szabadidős futóverseny, amely Mohácson, a Szőlőhegyi rendezvénytéren kerül megrendezésre. A verseny a Mohácsi-dombság ösvényein zajlik, és különböző távokat kínál minden korosztálynak, az 500 méteres gyerekfutamtól a 22 km-es távig. A rendezvény családbarát, egészségügyi biztosítással és díjazással várja a résztvevőket, akik chipes időméréssel mérhetik idejüket. A versenyzők közös bemelegítésen vehetnek részt a rajt előtt, és a részvétel saját felelősségre történik.

name: Behaj lesmi – Smolenice
description: Behaj lesmi Smolenice is part of a series of seven races set in beautiful Slovak countryside, offering routes mostly on soft surfaces and in fresh air. The race is included in the UTMB Index Races, which means that trail races are rated internationally. The routes pass below Smolenice Castle, where themed characters cheer on the runners and create a unique atmosphere. You can compete on two main routes—12 km and 19 km—and there is also a Conti Speed Section on the course, with a valuable prize.

name: Tlmačský polmaratón
location: Tlmače okr. Levice, Tlmače okr. Levice, Tlmače – Lipník, Nám. odborárov
description: The Tlmače Half Marathon and 10K is a traditional running race held in the town of Tlmače. This 43rd edition offers a 21 km half-marathon course and a 10K, as well as a 3.5 km fun run and Nordic walking event. The event is part of the Patriots Running League and is organized by the town of Tlmače together with local sports clubs. Runners can enjoy high-quality organization, electronic timekeeping, and race packs with promotional items and a meal voucher.

name: Jarný charitatívny beh Nitra
organizer: Mgr. Lukáš Čelinák, Rotary klub Nitra Harmony
description: The Nitra Spring Charity Run is a community sporting event that brings together exercise, solidarity, and support for healthcare in the city of Nitra. It raises funds for the emergency department of Nitra University Hospital and is organized by the Rotary Club Nitra Harmony together with the Oktoberfest Run Nitra team. The event offers various distances, including 10 km, 5 km, and 1.2 km, and participants can also take part as a team. Runners can contribute to a charitable cause while enjoying the sporting atmosphere in Nitra.

name: Sklené sa hýbe
location: Sklené (okr. Turčianske Teplice), Sklené (okr. Turčianske Teplice), futbalové ihrisko
description: Sklené sa hýbe is a running event held at the football pitch in Sklené, in the Turčianske Teplice District. The race features three courses of varying lengths and elevation gain: a half marathon (21.5 km, 740 m+), 14 km (420 m+) and 8 km (320 m+). Children’s activities are also planned alongside the main categories. The main races start at 10:30, and the children’s races begin at 10:45. The event is part of the Beh tromi krajmi and Beh dvomi krajmi series.

name: Plesnivec VerticalRun
location: Parkovisko chata Plesnivec - Tatranská Kotlina, Parkovisko chata Plesnivec - Tatranská Kotlina, Parkovisko chata Plesnivec - Tatranská Kotlina
description: Plesnivec VerticalRun is a mountain race covering 5 km with 530 metres of elevation gain. It takes place in Tatranská Kotlina, near Plesnivec Hut. Runners will enjoy a demanding vertical course profile that tests their fitness and endurance. Registration is online, and runners are added to the start list once the entry fee has been paid. The event is suitable for all mountain-running enthusiasts looking for a challenge in beautiful natural surroundings.

name: Beh oslobodenia obce Budča
location: Budča, okr. Zvolen, Budča, okr. Zvolen, pred Obecným úradom
description: The Budča Liberation Run is a traditional race held in the village of Budča to commemorate its liberation. The main race is 8.4 km long, with 232 metres of elevation gain, and loops around the village along forest roads and paved roads. The start and finish are by the municipal office. The event also includes children’s categories with shorter courses suited to the runners’ ages, and a “Ride for Health” category open to everyone, regardless of age or ability. The race is part of the Zvolen Running League and offers electronic timing, refreshments, and medals for participants.

name: Sălciua Trail Run
description: Sălciua Trail Run 2026 is an outdoor running competition held in the commune of Sălciua, situated between the Trascău Mountains and Muntele Mare, offering spectacular views. The event brings together people passionate about running, nature, culture, and fun, providing an opportunity to get away from everyday life and enjoy the beauty of nature in the company of loved ones. The competition includes four races: Cursa Zmeilor (28 km), Crosul Liliecilor (15 km), Family and Young Run (5 km), and Cursa Spiridușilor (400–800 m), open to all participants who meet the age and registration requirements. The organizers provide a complete experience, with race kits, an awards ceremony, and themed workshops for all ages.

name: Chindia City Race
description: Chindia City Race is a traditional run held in the heart of the Târgoviște Fortress, right next to the iconic Chindia Tower. The event takes place in Tricolorului Square and brings together participants of all ages in a festive atmosphere of friendly competition. The race starts at 10:00 and celebrates the spirit and history of the city, inviting runners to test their speed and endurance on an energetic urban course steeped in tradition.

name: Még egy kört / Încă o rundă - Trail challenge
location: Világlátó, Sfântu Gheorghe, Covasna County, Romania
description: Még egy kört este is a trail running challenge held on the outskirts of Sfântu Gheorghe, in a wooded, hilly area known as “Világlátó.” Participants can run or take part in Nordic walking for 2, 4, or 6 hours, aiming to complete as many 1.6 km laps as possible, each with 60 m of elevation gain. The event is designed as a mental and physical challenge, with a pleasant atmosphere, music, and an on-site bar. It’s a great opportunity for runners and others to test themselves in a friendly natural setting.

name: 24. Öntúlszárnyalás maraton
distance_verbose: Maraton, Félmaraton, 10.55 km, 10.4 km, 5.27 km, 5.2 km
description: A 24. Öntúlszárnyalás maraton a pécsi Malomvölgyi-tónál kerül megrendezésre. Ez a Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team által szervezett futóverseny családias hangulatú, körpályás, amely lehetőséget ad a maratoni és félmaratoni távok teljesítésére. A pálya erdei döngölt és zúzott köves, 30 méter szintkülönbséggel, így változatos terepen mérhetik össze erejüket a résztvevők. A versenyen chip-es időmérés biztosítja a pontos eredményeket, és a frissítőállomások bőséges ellátást nyújtanak.

name: Farkasmályi Dűlő és Pince futás
organizer: Gyöngyösi Triatlon Klub, Farkasmályi Borpincék Egyesület
description: A Farkasmályi Dűlő és Pince futás egy hangulatos terepfutó verseny Gyöngyös Farkasmály dűlősorán, amely a szőlőskertek és borospincék között zajlik. A verseny több távon kínál kihívást, köztük egy rövidebb, kevésbé szintes 3 km-es kört és egy hosszabb, 8,5 km-es emelkedőkkel tarkított kört. A futók élvezhetik a természet közelségét, a pincelátogatásokat és a változatos terepet, amely alkalmas kezdőknek és haladóknak egyaránt. A rendezvényt a GYÖTRI Klub szervezi, amely több évtizedes tapasztalattal bír a sportesemények lebonyolításában.

name: MÁSODSZOR IS CÉLBA ÉRÜNK!
description: A Koraszülöttfutás 2026 egy jótékonysági futóesemény, amely Zalaegerszegről indul és Keszthelyig tart, összesen 66 km-es távon. A futás során a résztvevők gyönyörű zalai tájakon haladnak át, tíz váltóponttal, és a teljes távot chip-es időméréssel követik nyomon. A rendezvény kiemelten támogatja a koraszülötteket, akiknek betétfutása is része az eseménynek. A célban a csapatok együtt érkezhetnek, hogy megosszák az élményt és a sikert. A rajt és a tészta party helyszíne a Zala Zone Járműipari Tesztpálya, a futás pedig május 3-án vasárnap kerül megrendezésre.

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 4. kolo
description: The 2 Miles Bratislava Run is a regular 2-mile (3.218 km) running race held at the Kuchajda swimming complex in Bratislava. It is organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team and is open to the general public, including children, juniors, women, men, and veterans. Registration takes place at the venue on race day from 9:30, with the start at 10:00. The race is part of a series in which runners earn points toward a traveling trophy based on their categories and performances.

name: Beh 2 míle
description: The 2-Mile Run in Bratislava at Kuchajda is a regular running race over 2 miles (3.218 km), organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team. Check-in and registration take place at the venue by the volleyball court from 9:30; the race starts at 10:00. The race is open to various age categories, including children, juniors, women, men, and veterans. It is part of the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team traveling cup, where finishing times are adjusted using age coefficients and runners earn points based on participation and performance.

name: Stropkovská dvadsiatka
description: The Stropkov Twenty is a traditional road race with a rich history dating back to 1977, held in the town of Stropkov. The course passes through several villages and gives runners the chance to compete over 20 km, with refreshments along the route and at the finish. The event is organized by Klub Bežcov Stropkov, which supports the development of running in the region. Runners can expect high-quality organization, race packs, and the chance to recover after the race at the indoor swimming pool. The race is part of the Michalovce–Sobrance Regional Running League.

name: Stropkovská desiatka a  I. ročník Barefoot
location: Stropkov, Stropkov, Námestie SNP v Stropkove
description: The Stropkov 10K and the 1st Barefoot edition are part of the traditional road races in Stropkov, which have a rich history dating back to 1977. The event is organized by the Stropkov Runners Club to support the running movement in the region and across Slovakia. Runners can look forward to well-prepared courses and an atmosphere created each year by hundreds of fans and runners. In addition to the main race, the program also includes a barefoot run, offering participants a new experience.

name: Šrégom nočným Zvolenom
location: Zvolen, Okres Zvolen, Banskobystrický kraj, Slovakia

name: 2. E.ON Business Run
description: Az E.ON Business Run egy különleges futóesemény, amelyet a Nemzeti Atlétikai Központban rendeznek meg Budapesten. A verseny célja, hogy összehozza a vállalati világ szereplőit és minden érdeklődőt egy közös mozgásélményre, ahol egyéni és csapatszellem is érvényesül. A futók három táv közül választhatnak: 5 km egyéni futás, 3 fős váltó (3x2,7 km) és egy 2 km-es stadiontúra gyaloglás. Az eseményt zene, buli és streetfood kíséri, így a futás után is felejthetetlen élmény várja a résztvevőket.

name: VSE City run Košice
description: VSE City Run in Košice is a 4 km charity run. The event is open to the general public, including children, students, seniors, and people with disabilities. Entry fees are donated to support the Platform of Families of Children with Disabilities. The run takes place in the centre of Košice and is known for its inclusive atmosphere and community spirit. The organisers work with the Košice Marathon Club and other partners. The aim is not only to promote sport, but also to support families with children with disabilities.

name: Columbia Sunset Trail
description: A Columbia Sunset Trail egy izgalmas, naplemente idején megrendezett terepfutó verseny a Naszály-hegy környékén. A versenyzők egyedi fa befutóérmet kapnak, és a távok első három női és férfi helyezettje külön díjazásban részesül. A rendezvény bőséges frissítőpontokkal, öltözőkkel és csomagmegőrzéssel várja a futókat, akiknek fejlámpa és ivózsák használata ajánlott. A verseny hangulata és a természet közelsége garantáltan felejthetetlen élményt nyújt.

name: COLUMBIA SUNSET TRAIL
description: A Columbia Sunset Trail egy izgalmas, naplementében zajló terepfutó verseny Naszály festői környezetében. A versenyzők egyedi fa befutóéremmel gazdagodnak minden távon, és a legjobbak külön érem díjazásban részesülnek. A rendezvény bőséges frissítőpontokkal, öltözőkkel és csomagmegőrzéssel várja a futókat, akiknek fejlámpa és ivózsák használata ajánlott a biztonságos teljesítéshez. A verseny hangulata és a természet közelsége garantáltan felejthetetlen élményt nyújt.

name: Varínsky lesný beh
organizer: Žilinský pedál, XIRIS, AUTOSKLO Stehlík, Obec Varín
description: The Varín Forest Run is a running event in the foothills of the Malá Fatra, offering beautiful routes with views of the Malá Fatra ridge. Competitors can choose between a longer route of 13.7 km with 600 m of elevation gain and a shorter route of 6.5 km with 120 m of elevation gain. The event is suitable for runners and nature lovers who want to enjoy a run in scenic surroundings. The program also includes children’s races, and a raffle takes place after the results are announced. The organizers are Žilinský pedál, XIRIS, AUTOSKLO Stehlík, and the municipality of Varín.

name: Memoriál brig. gen. Ľ. Kukorelliho
location: Hanušovce nad Topľou, Hanušovce nad Topľou, Mestský úrad
organizer: Mesto Hanušovce nad Topľou, Mestské kultúrne stredisko mesta Hanušovce nad Topľou, ZO SZPB Hanušovce nad Topľou, Hermanovský bežecký oddiel
description: The Brigadier General Ľ. Kukorelli Memorial is a running event in Hanušovce nad Topľou, offering categories for men, women, relays with varying numbers of members, and a fun run. The organizers are the Town of Hanušovce nad Topľou, the Municipal Cultural Centre, ZO SZPB, and the Hermanovce Running Club. There is no entry fee, allowing the general public to take part without financial burden. The start is at the Municipal Office in Hanušovce nad Topľou.

name: Charitatívny beh obcou Bukovec
organizer: Obec Bukovec a občianske združenie Oáza-nádej pre nový život
description: The Charity Run through the village of Bukovec is a traditional sporting event organized by the Municipality of Bukovec and its mayor, together with members of the municipal council. The run takes place in the picturesque surroundings of Bukovec, which is known for its recreational area with water reservoirs and natural beauty. Runners can enjoy a pleasant sporting experience near the local church while supporting charitable causes. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a community experience in a peaceful setting.

name: Crosul de noapte
description: Crosul de Noapte - Delonghi is a running race held in Cluj-Napoca, offering participants two distances: 4 km and 10 km. The event takes place at night and is suitable for runners of all levels who want to enjoy a nighttime sporting experience in the city. It is an excellent opportunity to run in an urban setting with a friendly and competitive atmosphere.
course_highlights: Distances of 4 km and 10 km
Night run in Cluj-Napoca
Urban course accessible to all levels
additional: The event includes well-marked routes, the option to register online, and a safe environment for participants.

name: Iron Ultra Trail
description: Iron Ultra Trail is a challenging trail race held in Valjevo, known for its demanding routes and beautiful landscapes of Western Serbia. The race brings together trail-running enthusiasts and adventurers, offering a unique experience through forest and mountain terrain. The organizers, West Serbia Trails, guarantee a great atmosphere and good organization for all participants.

name: Krones Charity Run
location: Krones Hungary, Hermann utca 1, Déli Ipari Park, Debrecen, Hungary

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Családi futam 1 km -> 2490 Ft / fő (érmet nem tartalmaz)

tiers.label: tier_3
tiers.description: Családi futam 1 km -> 3000 Ft / fő (érmet nem tartalmaz)
