description: A Krones Charity Run egy jótékonysági futóverseny, amelyet 2027. május 15-én rendeznek meg Debrecenben, a Déli Ipari Parkban. A verseny célja a sport és a testmozgás népszerűsítése, valamint a helyszín bemutatása, ahol a Krones Hungary volt az első beköltöző. A nevezési díjak teljes egészében egy közönségszavazás által kiválasztott alapítványnak kerülnek felajánlásra, amelyet a Krones Hungary megdupláz. A résztvevők több táv közül választhatnak, és minden szintidőn belül célba érkező futó egyedi befutóérmet kap. A verseny után az Athletes Garden várja a résztvevőket.
course_highlights: A verseny a Déli Ipari Park területén zajlik, amely ipari és zöld környezetet ötvöz
10 km-es egyéni versenyszám 4 körben
Frissítőpontokon teljes BioTechUSA frissítés biztosított
additional: A rajtcsomagban prémium nevezés esetén Mizuno eseménypóló található. A nevezési díjakból befolyt összeget a közönség által választott alapítvány kapja, a Krones Hungary pedig megduplázza a támogatást. A verseny helyszíne a Déli Ipari Park, amely ipari és zöld környezetet kínál.

name: SCHRÖDINGER DELUXE ULTRA
description: A verseny rajtja a Csemetekertnél lesz reggel 8 órakor. A futók változatos terepen haladnak, érintve több neves helyszínt és természeti pontot a Pilis hegységben. A verseny egyedülálló élményt kínál a természet és a kihívás kedvelőinek.

name: FARKASMÁLYI DŰLŐ- ÉS PINCEFUTÁS
description: A Farkasmályi Dűlő- és Pincefutás egy különleges futóverseny Gyöngyös Farkasmályi pincesorán, amely egyedülálló élményt kínál a résztvevőknek a természet és a helyi borvidék varázslatos környezetében. A versenyt a GYÖTRI Klub szervezi, amely 1991 óta támogatja a térség sportéletét. A futás során a résztvevők megismerhetik a Mátra környékének szépségeit és a helyi pincészeteket, miközben sportolnak és kikapcsolódnak. A rendezvény hagyományteremtő jelleggel bír, és minden évben várja a futás szerelmeseit.
course_highlights: Gyöngyös Farkasmályi pincesor festői környezete
Természetközeli futópálya a Mátra lábánál
Helyi borvidék és pincék érintése a futás során

name: SzalamandRUN futónap 3 / 5 / 11 / 21 / 42
distance_verbose: Maraton, Félmaraton, 11.4 km, 5 km, 1 km, 0.5 km
description: A SzalamandRUN futónap egy változatos távokat kínáló futóverseny Solymáron, amely 3, 5, 11, 21 és 42 km-es távokon várja a futókat. A rendezvény ideális mind a kezdők, mind a tapasztalt futók számára, akik szeretnék kipróbálni magukat különböző távokon. A verseny a természetközeli környezetben zajlik, amely élvezetes futást biztosít a résztvevőknek. A rendezvény szervezői professzionális időméréssel és kényelmes regisztrációs lehetőségekkel várják a nevezőket.

name: Előzd meg a Fogaskerekűt!
description: Az Előzd meg a Fogaskerekűt! egy hagyományos XII. kerületi sportrendezvény, amelynek célja, hogy a résztvevők előbb érjenek célba, mint a Fogaskerekű vasút. A verseny kb. 4 km-es, 325 méteres szintemelkedésű hegymenetet tartalmaz, amely komoly kihívást jelent még a jól edzetteknek is. A futás és kerékpár kategóriák mellett váltóban is lehet indulni családdal vagy kollégákkal, illetve túrázni a Budai-hegység festői környezetében. A rendezvényt a Hegyvidéki Szabadidősport Nonprofit Kft. és a Városmajori Tanuszoda szervezi.
course_highlights: Kb. 4 km-es táv 325 m szintemelkedéssel
Hegymenet a Budai-hegységben
Futás, kerékpár és váltó kategóriák
additional: A versenyen rajtszámviselési és chiphasználati szabályok vannak érvényben. A rendezvény helyszíne a Hegyvidéki Sportközpont és Tanuszoda, Budapest, Városmajor u. 29. A szervezők kérik a nevezők figyelmét a letölthető versenykiírás és adatkezelési tájékoztató dokumentumok alapos áttanulmányozására.

name: CSALÁDI FUTÓNAP
location: Bocskai István Általános Iskola, Páty, Hungary
description: A CSALÁDI FUTÓNAP egy családbarát futóesemény, amely Páty Bocskai István Általános Iskolánál kerül megrendezésre. A rendezvény célja, hogy minden korosztály számára élvezetes és közösségi mozgási lehetőséget biztosítson. A futás nem versenyjellegű, inkább az együttlét és a mozgás örömére helyezi a hangsúlyt. A résztvevők számára kellemes környezetben, biztonságos pályán kínál lehetőséget a sportolásra.
course_highlights: Biztonságos, családbarát futópálya Páty központjában
Közösségi, nem versenyjellegű futóesemény
Könnyen megközelíthető helyszín az általános iskola környékén

name: EDURACE
distance_verbose: Félmaraton, 10.5 km, 5.3 km, 3000 meter, 1 km, 0.5 km

price_tiers.distance: Csapatfutam (4x2 km) és Kutyás futam (2 km)

description: Az EDURACE egy családi terepfutó nap Gödöllőn, az Erzsébet parkban, amely változatos távokat kínál minden korosztálynak és futótípusnak. A verseny célja, hogy a mozgás örömét minél több családhoz eljuttassa, miközben aktív programok és szakértői támogatás segíti a résztvevőket. A rendezvényen a futás mellett közösségi élmények és kihívások várják a sportolókat, legyenek kezdők vagy haladók. A verseny hangulata családbarát, és a futók mellett kísérők számára is lehetőség van előzetes regisztrációra kedvezményes menüre.
course_highlights: Terepfutó útvonalak Gödöllő Erzsébet parkjában
Változatos távok 2 km-től félmaratonig, külön gyerekfutamokkal
Szintkülönbségek 24 m-től 340 m-ig, változatos terepen
additional: Kísérők előzetes regisztrációja kedvezményes menü rendelési lehetőséggel. Edzők, gyógytornászok és masszőrök segítik a sérülésmentes sportolást. A verseny után aktív programok várják a résztvevőket. Gyerekbarát, rövid és biztonságos pályák a legkisebbeknek is. Fotók és eredménylista minden esemény után elérhető.

name: FUT A VÁROS
description: A Szombathelyi Futóverseny, a Fut a város, egy családias és közösségépítő futóesemény, amely különböző távokon várja a résztvevőket, a gyermekek 400 métertől a felnőttek 10 km-es egyéni és váltó futamáig. A verseny a város szívében, a Fő téren zajlik, és célja a sport és az egészséges életmód népszerűsítése minden korosztály számára. A rendezvényen chipes időmérés és befutóérem várja a célba érkezőket, valamint frissítőpont a célban. A verseny hangulatát a közös bemelegítés és a családbarát programok teszik különlegessé.
course_highlights: Változatos távok: 400 m gyerekfutam, 2 km, 5 km, 10 km egyéni és 4×2,5 km váltó
A verseny Szombathely belvárosában, a Fő téren zajlik
Chipes időmérés és befutóérem minden célba érkezőnek
additional: Regisztráció és rajtcsomag átvétel 7:30-tól a verseny helyszínén. Limitált helyszíni nevezés kártyás fizetéssel. A versenyen mobiltelefon és audio eszközök fülhallgatóval történő használata tilos. A 14 év alatti versenyzők esetén szülői hozzájáruló nyilatkozat szükséges 2 km feletti távokon. A versenyen orvosi felügyelet és részlegesen zárt útvonalak biztosítottak.

name: ÚJPESTI FÉLMARATON
location: Halassy Olivér Sportközpont, Budapest IV. kerület, Hungary
description: Az Újpesti Félmaraton egy hagyományos futóverseny, amelyet Budapest IV. kerületében, a Halassy Olivér Sportközpont környékén rendeznek meg. A versenyzők félmaratoni távon mérhetik össze erejüket, egy kellemes városi környezetben. A rendezvény családias hangulatú, és a nevezés banki átutalással történik. A verseny támogatói között a helyi önkormányzat is szerepel, amely biztosítja a gördülékeny lebonyolítást.
course_highlights: Futás a Halassy Olivér Sportközpont környékén
Városi környezet, jól kijelölt útvonal
Családias, közösségi hangulat
additional: Nevezési díj kizárólag banki átutalással fizethető be a nevezés után 3 munkanapon belül. A közlemény rovatban kérik feltüntetni a nevező adóazonosítóját vagy a csapatnevet váltó esetén.

name: Košice Peace Half marathon
location: Dolná brána, Hlavná ulica, Košice, Slovakia
organizer: Maratónsky klub Košice, Progress Promotion Košice
description: The Košice Peace Half Marathon is a traditional half marathon held in the historic center of Košice. The course runs along the city’s picturesque streets, including Dolná brána and Hlavná ulica, offering runners a unique experience in an atmosphere of peace and sporting spirit. The event is part of a series of running events in Košice and is organized with an emphasis on quality and safety for all participants.

name: Strážovská 50
location: Trenčianske Teplice, Okres Trenčín, Trenčiansky kraj
description: Strážovská 50 is a mountain ultramarathon and long-distance hike covering 50 km, held in the beautiful surroundings of the Strážov Mountains. The start and finish are in the spa town of Trenčianske Teplice. The route follows marked hiking trails and is ITRA-certified at Mountain level 5. The event is part of the Slovak Ultratrail League 2026 and offers a challenging experience for both runners and hikers.

name: Beh oslobodenia Lietavskej Lúčky
location: Lietavská Lúčka, Lietavská Lúčka, dom kultúry
organizer: Obec Lietavská Lúčka v spolupráci s Bežeckou ligou Žilina
description: The Lietavská Lúčka Liberation Run is a running event organized by running enthusiasts and the municipality of Lietavská Lúčka. The race takes place by the cultural center in Lietavská Lúčka and features a course with asphalt and cooperative-farm surfaces. The 10 km race starts at 9:30, and the children’s race starts at 9:40. Categories are divided by age and gender, allowing runners of different age groups to participate.

name: Vertical Chopok
description: Vertical Chopok is a vertical running event held in the Low Tatras, on a route from Srdiečko to Chopok South. Runners face a challenging course with an elevation gain of almost 950 metres over a distance of 6.4 km. The event is part of the Slovak Skyrunning Association calendar and also serves as a qualifying race in the vertical category. The course runs mainly along the road to Kosodrevina and through Zadné Dereše, allowing runners to perform at their best. The Vlado Plulík Memorial, after which the event is named, has a long-standing tradition and commemorates an important figure in Slovak sport.

name: Podhájska Trail
location: Podhájska, Podhájska, areál termálneho kúpaliska Podhájska
description: Podhájska Trail is a community running event at the Podhájska Thermal Swimming Pool, bringing together exercise in nature, a healthy lifestyle, and the local community. The race offers two main courses—a long 18 km route with 353 m of elevation gain and a short 7 km route with 143 m—as well as children’s races of varying lengths based on age. The route runs mostly along forest roads and paved cycle paths, with the start and finish at the thermal swimming pool. The event also has a charitable aspect, supporting local young people by purchasing sports equipment.

name: Squarebizz Ultra maratón na 6 hodinovka a M-SR v behu na 50 km
location: Bratislava - Devínska Nová Ves, Bratislava - Devínska Nová Ves, Areál Squarebizz Business Center Bory
description: The Squarebizz Ultra 6-hour race and Slovak Championships in the 50 km run is a challenging running event held at the Squarebizz Business Center Bory in Bratislava–Devínska Nová Ves. The event offers two main disciplines: a 50 km run and a 6-hour run, with men and women competing in different age categories. It also serves as the Slovak Championships in the 50 km run, adding to its prestige and appeal for endurance runners. The organizer is Michal Šuľa, who also provides contact information for those interested in taking part. Entry fees vary by discipline and registration date, increasing gradually until the beginning of May.

name: Krupanská desiatka
location: Dolná Krupá, Dolná Krupá, areál OŠK Dolná Krupá
organizer: Bežecký klub Dolná Krupá a Obecný úrad Dolná Krupá
description: Krupanská Desiatka is a traditional running race organized by Bežecký klub Dolná Krupá, held at the OŠK Dolná Krupá grounds. The course is 10 km long with 107 metres of elevation gain; 85% of the route is on asphalt and 15% on forest road. In addition to the main 10 km race, the event also includes shorter runs and a 5 km Nordic walking route. The race is suitable for a wide range of participants and offers a pleasant outdoor sporting atmosphere.

name: BTK Run Fest
location: Veľký Biel, Veľký Biel, Areál kaštiela
organizer: Občianske združenie Bežecko Triatlonový klub Veľký Biel
description: BTK RUN FEST 2026 is a running event for everyone, taking place on May 9 in the grounds of the manor house in Veľký Biel. It offers a range of events, including 5 km and 10 km road races, children’s races, a parent + child relay, and an adrenaline-filled obstacle race for children and adults. The routes run mainly on asphalt and paved surfaces around a lake in picturesque surroundings. The event is suitable for recreational runners, families, and experienced athletes, with awards and medals for the top finishers and all finishers.

name: Fiľakovský cross
location: Fiľakovo okr. Lučenec, Fiľakovo okr. Lučenec, štadión FTC
description: The Fiľakovo Cross is a running event organized by OZ FTC Fiľakovo and the Sports and Physical Education Commission of the Municipal Council in Fiľakovo. The races take place at the FTC stadium in Fiľakovo and offer various categories, including children’s, hobby, and Nordic walking. The course combines dirt roads, asphalt, and grass, making the run varied and interesting. The children’s race starts at 10:00 and the adults’ race at 12:30. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant sporting atmosphere.

name: EuroPainClinics Horský beh Bardejov
location: Bardejov, Bardejov, Bardejovské kúpele, Reštaurácia Kúpeľná dvorana (vedľa hotela Alexander)
organizer: EPC Pro Health Team a BarRan Team
description: EuroPainClinics Bardejov Mountain Run is a mountain race held in the picturesque surroundings of Bardejov Spa. Runners can choose from three options: a cross-country half marathon with more than 1,000 metres of elevation gain, a seven-kilometre spa course, and accompanying children’s and youth categories. The event is suitable for all runners who enjoy challenging terrain and mountain running. The organizers provide refreshments along the course, medals, T-shirts, and other benefits for participants who register early.

name: Beh pre Labky
location: Košice, Košice, Košice - Kavečany, chata Hrešná
organizer: Únia vzájomnej pomoci ľudí a psov
description: Run for Paws 2026 is a charity run organized by the Union for Mutual Assistance of People and Dogs (UVP). It will take place in Košice, in the Kavečany area near the Hrešná cottage. The event’s 10th edition gives runners a chance to support a good cause while enjoying a pleasant run in nature. The course is 5 km long and suitable for all age groups, including children and runners with dogs. The event is open to the general public and offers various categories based on age and participant type.

name: DOBRObeh
description: DOBRObeh is a charity run in Čadca offering five courses of varying distances and elevation gains, suitable for a wide range of participants. Runners can choose from courses starting at 2 km for children to the more challenging Mária Marcibálová Run, which is 21.5 km long with 600 metres of elevation gain. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, with no winners ranked, plus an accompanying programme and raffle—everyone who supports a good cause is a winner. The courses are clearly marked and staffed by organisers, and the terrain combines forest trails, asphalt and meadow.
course_highlights: Mária Marcibálová Run: 21.5 km with +600 m elevation gain; 70% forest, 10% asphalt, 20% meadow
KERICross 10 km: 65% asphalt, 25% meadow, 10% gravel; +180 m elevation gain
Run through the city 4.5 km: 90% asphalt, 10% forest; +42 m elevation gain
additional: Refreshment stations are at 3.8 km and 13.8 km. Required equipment includes your own drinking cup, trail shoes, a clearly visible race number, a mobile phone with the organiser’s number, a watch or phone with the route, and folding running or hiking poles. The course is marked with arrows and ribbons, and organisers are stationed at ambiguous points.

name: Bucharest International Half Marathon
description: The Bucharest International Half Marathon by Constantina Diță is an international half marathon held on some of Bucharest’s most beautiful and fastest streets, offering both professional athletes and amateur runners the opportunity to achieve a competitive personal best. The event also includes 10 km races, races for people with mobility impairments, and a 3.5 km fun run for all ages. The race kit includes a bib with chip timing and a finisher’s medal, while the official T-shirt is optional. The organizer is the Constantina Diță Sports Club Association, and the event is supported by major partners such as Decathlon.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course on Bucharest’s main streets
World Athletics Label-certified half marathon course
Dedicated routes for the half marathon, 10 km, people with disabilities, and the fun run
additional: The race kit must be collected in person at the Expo, upon presentation of an ID document. The official T-shirt is optional and can be purchased separately for EUR 15. Participation for wheelchair users is free. The time limit is 3 hours for the half marathon and 1.5 hours for the 10 km race. Some streets will be closed during the event, so using public transport is recommended, especially the metro to Aviatorilor station. The course offers options for running and walking, with the opportunity to take part in record attempts; the event also includes other races, such as the 10 km and relay races.

name: Subcarpați Trail Run
location: Baza Sportivă „Stejarul”, Cocorăștii Mislii, Prahova, Romania
distance_verbose: 75 km, Maraton, 40 km, 23 km, Semimaraton, 4 km
description: Subcarpați Trail Run is a mountain running competition organized for trail running enthusiasts, offering a unique experience in the heart of Goruna Forest, in the Prahova Subcarpathians. The varied courses, from the Fun Race to the Ultramarathon, test runners’ endurance and perseverance in spectacular natural surroundings. The event brings together amateurs and professionals in a friendly, motivating atmosphere, with the start and finish at the „Stejarul” Sports Base in Cocorăștii Mislii. It is an excellent opportunity to discover the beauty of the area and enjoy running in nature.
course_highlights: Courses through Goruna Forest, with scenery of wooded hills
Distances and difficulty levels vary, from the 4 km Fun Race to the 75 km Ultramarathon with 2,800 m of elevation gain
Start and finish at the „Stejarul” Sports Base in Cocorăștii Mislii
additional: Race kits can be collected on Friday from 16:30 to 21:30 and on Saturday morning, depending on the race. The Ultramarathon starts at 06:00, the Marathon at 10:00, and the Half Marathon and Cross Country Race also at 10:00. The Fun Race starts after 11:45. Cash and product prizes are awarded to winners, including bonuses for course records. Varied courses, start and finish at the „Stejarul” Sports Base, on-site registration available, official photographers on the course.

name: Thermal Trail Race 2026
description: Thermal Trail Race is a trail running competition held in Betfia / Băile 1 Mai, along the scenic forest trails in the area. The event offers two races, one of 14 km and one of 7 km, suitable for different age categories and experience levels. The courses are well marked and offer a sporting experience in nature, with prizes for the top competitors. Participants receive electronic timing and an official event T-shirt.

name: Trascău Trail Run ~ 2026
description: Trascău Trail Run is a mountain race offering three events: marathon, half marathon, and cross-country race, set amid the picturesque landscapes around Rimetea, Alba. The routes pass spectacular places such as Piatra Secuiului, Colțești Fortress, Plaiului Gorges, and Huda lui Papară Cave, offering a mountain-running experience with significant elevation changes and impressive views. The event is organized by the Green & Wild Association and emphasizes adventure in nature and local heritage. Participants benefit from hydration and refreshment stations, medals, and prizes. Registration is limited and takes place online.

name: Ciudanovita in Miscare 2026
description: Ciudanovița in Motion is an event dedicated to promoting health, nature, and community, organized in the commune of Ciudanovița. The event takes place outdoors, giving participants the opportunity to enjoy the natural scenery and spend active time with the local community. It is an open invitation to everyone who wants to combine exercise with socializing and appreciating the surrounding environment.

name: Maraton Scaunul Domnului
location: Bistra Mureșului, Deda, Mureș County, Romania

name: TRAILRUN IN TARA NASAUDULUI
location: Valea Caselor, Năsăud, Bistrița-Năsăud County, Romania
description: Trail Run in Țara Năsăudului is a trail-running event for all age groups and experience levels, held around Casuțele din Plai, Valea Caselor, Năsăud. Participants can choose from three marked and signposted routes featuring mixed terrain, climbs and descents, adapted for children, families and experienced runners. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and a connection with nature, offering a supportive atmosphere focused on socializing and fair play. After the race, the fun continues with an afterparty and stories from the trails.
course_highlights: Marked and signposted routes with climbs, descents and mixed terrain
Picturesque scenery and spectacular views of the hills around Năsăud
Start and finish at Casuțele din Plai, with organized minibus transport from the parking area by the Năsăud town chapel
additional: Participants in the 10K Challenge receive the official T-shirt and a participation medal, while first-place winners in the 10K Challenge also receive two nights’ accommodation at Casuțele din Plai. The 2K route is intended for children and families and is approximately 1,700 metres long. Cars are not permitted at the start; transport is provided by minibus from the meeting point. After the race, there is a socializing area, a podcast, a BBQ and a chill zone.

name: Fox Trail Čardak 2026
description: Fox Trail Čardak is a race through the unique landscape of the Deliblato Sands, giving participants the opportunity to choose from three distances: a recreational 5 km, a challenging 12 km, and a 21 km trail half marathon. The event takes place in Čardak and is intended for all nature and running enthusiasts, whether beginners or experienced runners. The course has been carefully designed to offer an authentic trail-running experience, with the right mix of challenges and the natural beauty of the sands.

name: Garmin WTF BRZSNY
distance_verbose: 43 km, Maraton, 33 km, 23 km, 13 km, 10 km, 8 km
organizer: RUNaway Rekreációs Kft. és RUNaway Sportszervező Kft.
description: A Garmin WTF BRZSNY egy egyedülálló terepfutó verseny Szokolya és Királyrét környékén, amely kerül megrendezésre. A verseny több távon kínál kihívást, 8 km-től egészen a terepmaraton 42 km-ig, változatos szintemelkedéssel és gyönyörű erdei környezetben. A verseny különlegessége, hogy aszfaltos és terepfutók együtt rajtolnak, így mindenki a saját terepén teljesítheti a távot. A nevezési díj tartalmazza a rajtszámot, időmérést, frissítőpontokat, csomagmegőrzést, öltözőt és mentőszolgálatot, valamint a célban kürtőskalácsot és választható érmeket. A verseny a fenntarthatóságot és a közösségi élményt helyezi előtérbe, ahol minden teljesítmény értékes.

name: IX. Runbogárd Futóverseny és családi futónap
description: A IX. Runbogárd Futóverseny és családi futónap kerül megrendezésre Sárbogárdon, a Városi Sportcsarnoknál. A versenyen 1 km-es Mosolyfutam, valamint 5 km, 10 km és 20 km távok várják a futókat, akik egyszerre, tömegrajttal indulnak. A rendezvény célja a sport szeretetének népszerűsítése és egy közösségi esemény létrehozása, ahol minden korosztály megtalálhatja a számára megfelelő távot. A rajtszámokat előzetesen kell átvenni, helyszíni nevezés nincs, az időmérés chippel történik, amely a rajtszám hátuljára van ragasztva.

name: Fertőrákos félmaraton 6 / 16 / 21
description: A Fertőrákosi Félmaraton egy különleges panorámafutás a Fertő-tó felett, amely a Kőfejtő - Barlangszínháznál indul és ér véget. A pálya változatos, enyhén hullámzó, és a környék legszebb részeit érinti, a hosszabb távon Balfig is el lehet jutni, miközben a festői Fertő-tó és nádasok látványa kíséri a futókat. Ez a verseny nemcsak kihívás, hanem egy élményfutás, ahol minden kilométer új látványt és inspirációt nyújt. A rendezvény zöld versenyként is működik, kiemelve a környezetvédelem fontosságát.

name: EU-S FUTÁS 2026
organizer: Európai Bizottság Magyarországi Képviselete, Európai Parlament Magyarországi Kapcsolattartó Iroda, Nagy Sportágválasztó, BBU Nonprofit Kft.
description: Az EU félmaraton egy ingyenes, regisztrációhoz kötött futóverseny, amelyet Budapesten, a Szabadság téren rendeznek meg. A versenyen 21,1 kilométeres távot lehet teljesíteni egyéniben vagy 2-3 fős váltóban, amely a budapesti Európa-napi fesztivál része. A futók egy háromkörös útvonalon haladnak, amely Budapest ikonikus helyszínein vezet keresztül, és minden célba érkező egyedi emlékérmet kap. A rendezvényt az Európai Bizottság Magyarországi Képviselete és az Európai Parlament Magyarországi Kapcsolattartó Irodája szervezi, szakmai partnere a Nagy Sportágválasztó, BBU Nonprofit Kft.

name: FUSSUK LE! FÉLMARATON FESZTIVÁL
description: A Fussuk le! Félmaraton Fesztivál egy háromnapos futóesemény Csongrádon, amely kerül megrendezésre. A fesztiválon koncert, közösségi programok és versenyek várják a résztvevőket, ahol a félmaraton és negyedmaraton távok mellett gyerekfutamok is szerepelnek. A pálya lapos, aszfaltos, így ideális minden futó számára, aki egy jó hangulatú, támogató közösségben szeretne versenyezni. A rendezvény célja, hogy felejthetetlen élményt nyújtson, ahol mosolyogva lehet futni és célba érni.

name: UBM RED RUN FUTÓVERSENY
description: Az UBM RedRun futóverseny kerül megrendezésre Pilisvörösvár szívében, a Kacsa-tó környékén. Az esemény ötödik jubileumi alkalommal várja a futókat, akik 300 métertől 21 km-ig választhatnak távokat, egyéni vagy csapatos formában. A verseny új pályákkal, kibővített távokkal és egyedi futamokkal kínál élményt minden korosztálynak, különös hangsúlyt fektetve a családokra és amatőr sportolókra. A rendezvény célja a közös sportélmény megteremtése biztonságos és barátságos környezetben, Pilisvörösvár legszebb részein.

name: Wings for Life World APP RUN Bratislava
description: The Wings for Life World Run Bratislava is a unique event where runners and wheelchair participants start simultaneously and race against a virtual Catcher Car that gradually catches up with them. There is no finish line; runners keep going until the car passes them. The course runs through Sad Janka Kráľa, one of the oldest parks in Europe, and combines a variety of settings. The event supports spinal cord injury research, with 100% of registration fees going to this cause. The race starts at exactly 1:00 p.m.

name: Benefičný beh PRO AUTIS
location: Soblahov, Trenčín, Soblahov, Trenčín, Soblahov - bývalá horáreň
description: The PRO AUTIS Charity Run is a charitable running event whose proceeds go to the PRO AUTIS autism centre in Trenčín. The race takes place in Soblahov near Trenčín and offers a variety of courses, including children’s races and distances of 5 km, 10 km and 13.3 km. The event is open to runners of all ages, and the organisers emphasise personal performance and pushing your own limits. Registration is available online, with the option to register on site on race day.

name: Wings for Life World APP RUN Bystrica bez bariér
Stropkovská päťka a Nordic walking
location: Stropkov, Okres Stropkov, Prešovský kraj, Slovakia

name: Wings for Life World Run APP RUN Vysoke Tatry
location: Vysoké Tatry, Poprad District, Prešov Region, Slovakia

name: Wings for Life World APP RUN Veľké Rovné Drevicom
location: Veľké Rovné, Okres Bytča, Žilinský kraj, Slovakia

name: Stropkovská dvadsiatka
location: Stropkov, Okres Stropkov, Prešovský kraj, Slovakia

name: Wings for Life World APP RUN Nižná Myšľa
location: Nižná Myšľa, Okres Košice-okolie, Košický kraj
description: The Wings for Life World Run in Nižná Myšľa is a unique event where runners and wheelchair participants race against a virtual Catcher Car that gradually catches up with them. The course starts at the Nižná Myšľa archaeological open-air museum, a well-known archaeological site, and runs along forest and unpaved roads, through meadows and the village, combining asphalt and natural surfaces. The race starts at 13:00, and all registration fees go toward spinal cord injury research. Join runners around the world and push your limits in this global run with no finish line.

name: Wings for Life World App Run : Oradea
location: Timișoara, Sibiu, Brașov, and București, Romania
description: Wings for Life World Run is a global running event in which all participants start simultaneously around the world, running ahead of a pursuing vehicle called the Catcher Car. There is no fixed finish line; runners keep going until they are caught by the Catcher Car. All entry fees are donated to spinal cord injury research, supporting a worthy cause. The event is open to everyone, regardless of fitness level, and promotes solidarity and support for those who cannot run.
course_highlights: A simultaneous worldwide start for all participants
No fixed finish line; runners are pursued by the Catcher Car
100% of entry fees are donated to spinal cord injury research
additional: The event includes participation via a mobile app (App Run), which lets you run anywhere. The Catcher Car begins its pursuit 30 minutes after the start. The event is open to runners, wheelchair participants, and beginners. The app also offers audio support for an enhanced race experience.

name: VW Mureș Half Marathon
description: VW Mureș Half Marathon is a running race that takes you through the heart of Transylvania, crossing the center of Târgu Mureș and its prominent tourist attractions. The event offers a variety of races: 21 km, 10 km, 5 km, a 4×5 km relay, and a children’s race, all starting and finishing in the central area, ideal for support from family and friends. Participants receive medals, prizes, and a complete kit with a T-shirt, race number, and timing chip. It is a vibrant spring experience that marks the start of the running season in Mureș.
course_highlights: Routes through the center of Târgu Mureș and its prominent tourist attractions
Start and finish in Piața Teatrului, in the city center
A variety of events: half marathon 21 km, 10 km, 5 km, 4×5 km relay, and children’s race
additional: The entry package includes an official T-shirt, race number, single-use timing chip, finisher’s medal, sponsors’ brochures, diplomas downloadable online, official photos, and access to hydration and refreshment points. The T-shirt size is selected during registration but may vary depending on the manufacturer. Sportswear is mandatory, and the race number must be visible throughout the race.

name: Urbani polumaraton
description: The Urbana Desetka Sports Association invites you to take part in the Urbana Half Marathon in Smederevo. This event features the second edition of the 21 km half marathon and the third edition of the Danube Ten at 10 km. The races run along the banks of the Danube, through the city center, past the Obrenović Villa and through the Jugovo neighborhood. Runners will enjoy a combination of flat terrain and rolling vineyards, with the start at Republic Square in front of the courthouse. Each participant receives a race bib with a chip, a unique T-shirt and a medal, as well as refreshments during and after the race.

name: First Challenge Run
description: First Challenge Run is a charity race held at Ada Ciganlija in Belgrade. Runners will complete a 7.7 km loop around the lake, enjoying nature and a sporting challenge. The race is an opportunity to come together, socialize, and support a charitable cause, and is suitable for both experienced runners and beginners.

name: Ugrin run
description: Ugrin Run is a race held in Ugrinovci, with the start at 10 a.m. The race offers two distances, 5 km and 10 km, on a highly accessible, safe, and clearly marked course, with two water and fruit aid stations. In addition to the main races, fun children’s races are organized for different age groups. These are free of charge with parental consent. Participants receive a unique medal at the finish, while merchandise prizes and trophies are provided for the top finishers.

name: Kozomor 2026
description: The Kozomor Hiking and Running Association and the PSS Hiking Trekking Commission invite competitors to the second round of the Serbian Trekking and Trail League, which will take place in Kosjerić. This race brings together enthusiasts of mountain trekking and trail running, offering a challenging and attractive course through nature. Participants can expect a well-organized event supported by experienced hiking and running enthusiasts.

name: Crosul T.E.A.M.
description: The T.E.A.M. Run is a charity sporting event held in Timișoara, combining exercise with solidarity to support the children cared for by the “Inima Îți Vorbește” Association. The event is participatory, with no timing or rankings, and offers an enjoyable experience for all ages, with races for babies, children, and adults. The routes pass through central areas of the city, and the funds raised support the “Casa InimiiLor” project, a therapeutic refuge for children. Taking part is an expression of solidarity and hope for those in need.

name: Beh do Strečnianských hradných schodov
location: Strečno okr. Žilina, Strečno okr. Žilina, parkovisko pod hradom
description: The Run up the Strečno Castle Stairs is a challenging race in Strečno near Žilina, testing your fitness on a course with 151 steps and an elevation gain of 144 metres. The race is open to all youth categories, university students, women and men. The start is at the car park below Strečno Castle, with youth starting at 10:15 and students and adults at 11:45. The event is organised by the Institute of Physical Education at the University of Žilina and OK Žilina, who ensure the event runs smoothly. The registration deadline is, and late entries are possible only in exceptional cases.

name: SALOMON ULTRA TRAIL HUNGARY
location: Lázár cár tér, Szentendre, Pest County, Hungary
distance_verbose: 111 km, 84 km, 54 km, Maraton, 30 km, 22 km
description: A Salomon Ultra-Trail Hungary Magyarország legnagyobb rangú terepfutó versenye, amely hat különálló távból áll, összesen mintegy 1500 terepfutó részvételével. A verseny változatos terepen, sűrű és sötét erdőkben zajlik, és a résztvevőknek kihívást jelentő szintemelkedésekkel kell megküzdeniük. A leghosszabb táv 111 km, 4200 méter szintemelkedéssel, 9 frissítőponttal és 2 depó ponttal, 20 órás szintidővel. A verseny helyszíne Szentendre, a rajt és cél a Lázár cár téren található. A versenyzők és kísérőik számára részletes térkép és információs központ áll rendelkezésre a gördülékeny lebonyolítás érdekében.
course_highlights: 111 km táv 4200 méter szintemelkedéssel
9 frissítőpont és 2 depó pont a leghosszabb távon
Sűrű és sötét erdők, változatos terep
additional: A verseny maximális létszáma 1600 fő, a leghosszabb távon 300 fő indulhat. A verseny Google térképe tartalmazza a frissítőpontokat, rajt- és célhelyszíneket, valamint a verseny központot. Biztosított átkelések vannak a pályán, ahol a kísérők nem drukkolhatnak. A dömösi és pap-réti frissítőpontok autóval nem megközelíthetők, 30 perc gyaloglás szükséges.

name: 95. COLOPLAST Tatai Tófutás
distance_verbose: Maraton, Félmaraton, 14 km, 7 km, 3.5 km, 2 km, 0.5 km
description: A COLOPLAST Tatai Tófutás egy hagyományos, amatőr futóverseny, amelyet évente kétszer rendeznek meg Tata városában, az Öreg-tó körül. A verseny a futást szerető amatőrök számára biztosít lehetőséget, hogy egy szép természeti környezetben, a tatai tóparton mérjék össze erejüket. A rendezvényt a Tatai Tömegsport és Tájfutó Honvéd Sportegyesület szervezi, amely több sportágban is aktív, így a futóversenyek mellett tájfutó és egyéb sporteseményeket is kínál.
course_highlights: A verseny az Öreg-tó körül zajlik, festői tóparti környezetben
A futópálya változatos terepen halad, amely amatőr futók számára ideális
A rendezvény évente kétszer kerül megrendezésre, nagy létszámú részvétellel
additional: A verseny a Tatai Tömegsport és Tájfutó Honvéd Sportegyesület szervezésében zajlik, amely több szakosztállyal rendelkezik, így a futóverseny mellett tájfutó, íjász és egyéb sportágak is jelen vannak az egyesület életében.

name: COLOPLAST TATA TÓ FUTÁS

A verseny a futást szerető amatőrök számára biztosít lehetőséget, hogy egy szép természeti környezetben, változatos terepen mérjék össze erejüket. A rendezvényt a Tatai Tömegsport és Tájfutó Honvéd Sportegyesület szervezi, amely több sportágban is aktív, így a futóversenyek mellett tájfutó és triatlon eseményeket is kínál. A verseny helyszíne az Új kajakház környéke, amely ideális futóhelyszínként szolgál.

Természetközeli, változatos terep
Tatai Tömegsport és Tájfutó Honvéd Sportegyesület által szervezett esemény

name: Beh Gáňom
location: Gáň, okr. Galanta, Gáň, okr. Galanta, pred Kultúrnym domom
description: Beh Gáňom is a running event held in the village of Gáň, Galanta District, in front of the Cultural Centre. The race offers categories for children, adults and seniors, including the main race and the health run. Starts are scheduled for the children’s categories at 9:00, the health run at 9:45 and the main race at 10:45. The event is suitable for the general public, including village residents, who receive a discounted entry fee. The organizer is Tomáš Mrva, who also provides contact information for interested participants.

name: Horský beh Plejsy
organizer: Spartan Training Group Krompachy a Mesto Krompachy
description: Plejsy Mountain Run is a mountain running event in the area around Krompachy and the Plejsy resort. The route runs from Námestie slobody in Krompachy to the Relax Plejsy chalet. The event is organized by Spartan Training Group Krompachy and the City of Krompachy.
course_highlights: Start at Námestie slobody in Krompachy
Mountain route heading to the Plejsy resort
Finish by the Relax Plejsy chalet

name: VEREDA Night Run
location: Považská Bystrica, Okres Považská Bystrica, Trenčiansky kraj
organizer: VEREDA sport a OZ Dobrý pohyb
description: VEREDA Night Run is a night race in Považská Bystrica offering an 8 km course, with the option to compete in relay teams (2 x 4 km). The race is open to individuals, pairs, children, and corporate teams, with categories divided by age and gender. The event is organized by VEREDA sport and OZ Dobrý pohyb with the support of the city of Považská Bystrica and is known for its atmosphere and community spirit. The start is by the fountain near Kino Mier, with the children’s run starting at 17:00 and the main races at 20:30.

name: Strachan run
description: Strachan Run 2026 at Strednica is the second edition of the trail race, held in the picturesque Goral village of Ždiar beneath the Belianske Tatras. Runners can look forward to an unforgettable sporting experience in the surroundings of Strachankovo Family Park and Ski Centre Strednica. The event is suitable for running enthusiasts who want to enjoy nature and sport in one. The organizers invite all runners to this appealing event with a friendly atmosphere.

name: Beh revúckym chotárom – Memoriál Tomáša Kubeja
location: ZŠ J. A. Komenského, Revúca, Slovakia
description: Run through the Revúca Countryside – Tomáš Kubej Memorial is a running event in Revúca that honours the memory of local native Tomáš Kubej. The race is organised by the Vyšší level civic association and is intended for the running community and sports enthusiasts from the region. The event takes place at the grounds of J. A. Komenský Primary School and offers an opportunity to enjoy sport and remember a prominent figure in the town. The atmosphere is friendly and community-oriented, promoting a healthy lifestyle and sporting values.

name: O putovný pohár starostu obce Vlachy
location: Vlachy, okr. Liptovský Mikuláš, Vlachy, okr. Liptovský Mikuláš, Kultúrny dom Vlachy
description: The Race for the Mayor of Vlachy’s Challenge Cup is a running race with a 6,900-metre course and 150 metres of elevation gain. The race takes place at the cultural centre in Vlachy, in the Liptovský Mikuláš District. This traditional running event attracts runners from the surrounding area and offers a challenge in the form of a gentle uphill section. The organizers warmly welcome all runners who want to test themselves in the beautiful setting of the village of Vlachy.

name: RETRO Night Run
organizer: Športové centrum RETRO sport & wellness, SPORT RETRO, s.r.o.
description: RETRO Night Run is a running event in Bratislava offering a night run with various categories for children and adults. The race takes place at OC RETRO on Nevädzová Street and is organized by the RETRO sport & wellness sports center. Runners can choose between 5 km and 10 km routes. The children’s races start at 16:00 and the main races at 20:00. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant atmosphere for a night run in the city.

name: Detva behá, tak sa pridaj!
description: Detva Runs, So Join In! is a traditional running race in Detva, offering courses for children and adults. The event takes place near the 4th J.J. Thurzo Primary School and includes the main Hobby (6.2 km) and Main (10.7 km) courses, on forest roads and asphalt. The race is suitable for the general public, including various age categories, and features children’s races with no entry fee for children. Organized by ŠK Detva v pohybe, the event creates a friendly atmosphere and welcomes all runners and families.

name: Beh Jednoty
location: Nové Zámky, Nové Zámky, Hlavné námestie
description: Beh Jednoty 2026 in Nové Zámky is an event for everyone—from active athletes to families with children. The program includes children’s races divided by age group and a main 5-kilometer run through the town, suitable for recreational and more competitive runners. Activities for children, refreshments, and a raffle will be available throughout the day. By taking part, you will support the local community and a good cause, combining sport with helping others.

name: Behaj lesmi – Beckov
location: Beckov, Okres Nové Mesto nad Váhom, Trenčiansky kraj
description: Behaj lesmi Beckov is part of a series of seven races held in beautiful Slovak nature, offering routes mostly on soft terrain and fresh air. Runners can enjoy an unforgettable day beneath Beckov Castle, with support from the castle guard and views of the surrounding countryside. The routes pass through Beckov’s mysterious corners and are accompanied by legends, making the run an energetic adventure. The race is included in the UTMB Index Races, adding to its international significance and appeal for trail runners.

name: Babindolský májový kros
location: Babindol (okes Nitra), Babindol (okes Nitra), futbalové ihrisko
description: Babindol May Cross-Country Run is a sporting event for running enthusiasts of all ages, held amid the beautiful May countryside of the Lower Nitra region in the village of Babindol. The race offers two main courses of 8 km and 16 km, running mainly along farm roads and forest trails with moderate elevation gain. The event also includes a children’s course around the football field, an accompanying program, goulash for runners, and prizes for the winners in each category. It is organized by the Municipality of Babindol in cooperation with Zdeno Zamboj, with the start traditionally at 10:00 at the football field in Babindol.

name: Nočný beh Hlohovcom
description: Nočný beh Hlohovcom is a popular night run held in the Castle Park in Hlohovec. Runners enjoy an attractive 6 km loop through the park’s picturesque surroundings, featuring a pond and the largest plane tree grove in Central Europe, along the Váh River, through the city centre and past Hlohovec’s main landmarks. The event offers categories for children, a main race and Nordic walking, with the start in front of the amphitheatre in the Castle Garden. Organizers emphasize safety and recommend reflective accessories and headlamps. Finisher medals are prepared for the first 550 runners.

name: The Color Run Cluj-Napoca 2026
description: The Color Run Cluj-Napoca 2026 is a 5-kilometer race full of positive energy, color, and fun, perfect for all ages and fitness levels. The event is untimed, focusing on the joy of running and the vibrant experience of colors applied at every kilometer. The urban route starts and finishes in Piața Unirii, offering a festival atmosphere with multiple successive starts and an explosion of colored powder at the finish. Participants receive a kit with a T-shirt, bandana, temporary tattoos, medal, and colored powder, and the event promotes a healthy lifestyle and community.

name: EcoRun Moieciu ~ 2026
description: EcoRun Moieciu is a leading mountain running event in Romania, held in Moieciu de Sus. The competition includes Marathon, Half Marathon and Cross Country races, as well as a children’s race, EcoKids. The courses are made up of 90% forest roads and mountain trails, offering an authentic running experience in nature, with spectacular scenery and a passionate community. The event promotes sustainable practices and takes place annually in May, bringing together runners of all levels.

name: Turnu Roșu Challenge
description: Turnu Roșu Challenge is a trail running event held on marked paths in Turnu Roșu and on the hills at the foot of the Făgăraș Mountains, offering a spectacular natural setting and a challenge for all fitness levels. The event includes three races: a 21 km half marathon, an 11 km cross-country race, and a 7 km hike, each suited to different types of participants, from experienced athletes to those seeking a more relaxed experience. The organizers emphasize safety, recovery, and socializing, offering facilities such as stretching sessions, post-run massage, camping, and activities for children. It’s an excellent opportunity to enjoy nature, sport, and community in Sibiu County.

name: Crosul Cetăților Suceava
description: The Suceava Citadels Cross-Country Run is a popular running event held in the city of Suceava, offering participants an outdoor sporting experience with routes adapted for all ages and fitness levels. The event includes children’s races, a popular race, and a cross-country race, promoting exercise and community spirit. Participants can run along routes passing through historic and picturesque areas, surrounded by citadels and local scenery. The organizers provide a participation kit and prizes for competitors, encouraging involvement and athletic performance.

name: Run to the Hills
description: Run To The Hills is a mountain running race organized in Crasna, Sălaj County. The event invites running enthusiasts to explore the area’s picturesque hills, offering a sporting experience in nature. It is an excellent opportunity for runners of all levels to enjoy beautiful scenery and a friendly atmosphere.

name: Nebeski visovi – 4. kolo Nacionalne serije u planinskom trčanju
description: The Nebeski Visovi race in Zlatibor is the fourth round of the National Mountain Running Series, organized by the Tornik Mountaineering Club from Čajetina. Participants can choose between two loop courses: a longer 21 km red course with 1,400 meters of elevation gain for seniors, and a shorter 10 km blue course with 500 meters of elevation gain for juniors. The routes pass through Zlatibor’s unspoiled nature and over the peaks of Ljujaš, Orlić, Jelova Gora, Bandera-Tornik, and Liska, offering scenic, wild landscapes. The race brings together competitors from across Serbia and abroad. Scoring in the National Series follows the rules of the Mountaineering Association of Serbia, a member of the World Mountain Running Association.

name: 29. Kékes Csúcsfutás
description: A Kékes Csúcsfutás Magyarország egyik legszebb és legikonikusabb futóversenye, amely Mátrafüredről indulva 11,6 km-en keresztül vezet fel Magyarország legmagasabb pontjára, Kékestetőre. A verseny 671 méter szintemelkedéssel kihívást jelent minden futónak, miközben a Mátra természeti szépségeiben gyönyörködhetnek. A célban egyedi befutóérem várja a teljesítőket, és a verseny napján transzferbusz segíti a résztvevők oda- és visszautazását. A rendezvény családias hangulatú, több ezer futóval együtt élvezhető, és jótékonysági futásként is támogatja a résztvevőket.
course_highlights: 11,6 km táv 671 m szintemelkedéssel Mátrafüred és Kékestető között
Csodálatos természeti környezet, erdei ösvények és panorámás útvonal
Magyarország legmagasabb pontjának, Kékestetőnek a megfutása
additional: Az esemény napján transzferbusz indul Budapestről Mátrafüredre, amely a futók és hozzátartozóik számára biztosítja az oda-vissza utat, valamint ruhatárként is szolgál. A busz 8:15-kor indul Budapestről, és 10:30-kor indul vissza Kékestetőről. A nevezőknek egyedi befutóérem jár a célban.

name: KÉKES CSÚCSFUTÁS TRAIL
description: A Kékes Csúcsfutás egy ikonikus magyarországi futóverseny, amely Mátrafüredről indulva vezet fel Magyarország legmagasabb pontjára, Kékestetőre. A verseny két távon kínál kihívást: az országúti futás 11,6 km hosszú, 671 méter szintemelkedéssel, míg a Kékes Csúcsfutás Trail 11,3 km-es, erdei ösvényeken és meredek kaptatókon halad. A versenyzők csodálatos természeti környezetben, a Mátra lenyűgöző panorámája mellett teljesíthetik a távokat, egyedi befutóéremmel jutalmazva a sikeres teljesítőket. A rendezvényen több ezer futó vesz részt az ország számos településéről, és a verseny egyben jótékonysági esemény is.
course_highlights: 11,6 km országúti futás 671 m szintemelkedéssel Mátrafüredtől Kékestetőig
11,3 km terepfutás erdei ösvényeken és meredek kaptatókon
Csodálatos természeti környezet és panoráma a Mátrában
additional: Az esemény napján transzferbusz indul Budapestről Mátrafüredre, amely a futók és hozzátartozóik számára biztosítja az oda-vissza utat és ruhatárként is szolgál. A busz pontos indulási ideje 8:15, gyülekező 8:00-kor a Váci út 152-158. szám alatt. A versenyzők egyedi befutóérmet kapnak a célban.

name: Vertikál Martinky
location: Konečná autobusová zastávka Martin–Stráne, Martin, Slovakia

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: MUŽI / ŽENY: 25€, registrácia a platba na mieste v deň preteku

description: Vertikál Martinky is an extreme uphill race in Slovakia with a total elevation gain of 944 metres, and is part of the Slovak Skyrunning League. The event gives both professional and recreational runners the chance to test themselves on a challenging course. Competitors can earn ITRA Score points and enjoy high-quality organisation, including transport of personal belongings to the finish and refreshments there. There are also children’s categories with shorter courses and parental accompaniment. The atmosphere is enhanced by the resort mascot, Veverička Marta, and the pleasant surroundings of Martinky.
course_highlights: An extreme course with 944 metres of elevation gain
Start and finish in the Martinky area, with views
Children’s categories with parental accompaniment
additional: Race-day registration for competitors is from 8:30 to 9:30 at Hrdinov SNP Martin - Stráne. Children’s categories start at 11:00 by the Nová Ponorka restaurant. Free parking is available above the adult registration area and at Martinky for children. The entry fee includes transport of personal belongings to the finish, a drink and a meal at the restaurant. Competitors take part at their own risk, and participants under 18 need written consent from a legal guardian. Every participant must arrange their own insurance for HZS rescue operations.

name: Beh vďaky – Továrne – memoriál Františka Chmeľa
location: Tovarné okr. Vranov, Tovarné okr. Vranov, pred budovou Obecného úradu
description: The Thanksgiving Run – Tovarné – František Chmeľ Memorial is a running event organized by the municipality of Tovarné in Vranov nad Topľou District. The race takes place in front of the Municipal Office building in Tovarné and is open to runners across a wide range of age and gender categories. The event has a long-standing tradition and offers the opportunity to compete in various age categories for men and women. The organizers provide participants with complete information and support.

name: Beh Zabudišovou
location: Zabudišová, okres Nové Mesto nad Váhom, Zabudišová, okres Nové Mesto nad Váhom, Zabudišová (otoč)
description: The Zabudišová Run is a running event held in the village of Zabudišová, Nové Mesto nad Váhom District. It offers a 5,400-metre course with scenic views and 133 metres of elevation gain. The route combines asphalt, gravel and grassy paths. The event also includes fun races for children in various age groups. After the race, participants can enjoy game goulash, a raffle, medals and prizes for the winners. Runners take part at their own risk. Online registration is available, with a participant limit, and children run for free.

name: Timotion
price_range: Participație între 75 RON și 1.200 RON, în funcție de cursă

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Target minim donații Participă Target 1.200 RON

description: Timotion is the largest charitable sporting event in western Romania, bringing together thousands of participants, volunteers, and supporters each year to run, cycle, and do good for the community. The event offers a variety of races for all ages and fitness levels, from cycling and a half marathon to children’s races and fun races on wheels. By taking part, runners and cyclists support community projects and help foster solidarity and hope in the region. Timotion is a movement of hearts united for good, with a tradition spanning more than 10 years and a continuously growing community.
course_highlights: The timed 15 km SMW cycling race is for experienced participants
A 21 km half marathon and 10 km, 5 km, and 3 km fun runs for various age categories
Special races for children and fun races on wheels, also accessible to people with reduced mobility
additional: Races are timed and have specific time limits; children’s races require a legal guardian to accompany participants; the cycling race is for non-electric bicycles; accessible races are available for people with reduced mobility; races take place on Bd. Ion C. Brătianu; races start in waves between 08:00 and 17:30. Multiple races on May 10, including cycling, a half marathon, and recreational races; fundraising component; volunteering opportunities

name: SEMIMARATONUL SIRETULUI In memoriam Ilie Roșu
location: Adjudu Vechi, Adjud, Vrancea County, Romania
description: The Siret Half Marathon – In Memoriam Ilie Roșu is a running race held in Adjudu Vechi, Vrancea County, in memory of marathon runner Ilie Roșu. The half marathon invites runners to take part in a competition dedicated to running and remembrance. The start is announced at the church in Adjudu Vechi.
course_highlights: Start near the church in Adjudu Vechi.
Half marathon held in the Adjud area, in Vrancea County.
Race held in memory of marathon runner Ilie Roșu.
additional: The start is scheduled for 9:00.

name: Accenture Heroes Challenge
description: Accenture Heroes Challenge is an intense competition testing strength, speed, agility, and skills, held in Iuliu Hațieganu University Sports Park in Cluj-Napoca. The second edition challenges participants to push their limits on an obstacle course. The event offers two distances, 6 km and 12 km, to suit both experienced runners and those looking for a shorter challenge.

name: Crosul Sport4All
description: Sport 4 All Cross-Country Run is an annual running event held in Lugoj, open to all ages and fitness levels. The event features untimed races for children and a 2 km fun run, as well as timed 4 km and 6 km races for older participants. The routes are loops around the Drăgan European University and along the city’s central streets, offering a pleasant urban experience. Participants receive finisher medals, and the timed races have age categories. The event is supported by Lugoj City Hall and Drăgan European University, with 400 free places provided by sponsor Mondial S.A.

name: Prima Evadare
description: Prima Evadare is Romania’s largest cross-country cycling marathon, held annually on a classic route between Bucharest and Snagov. The race offers a friendly and accessible experience, covering approximately 55 km through forests and country roads, with no major elevation changes. The event brings together cycling enthusiasts from across the country, creating an energetic and welcoming atmosphere—ideal for kicking off the MTB marathon season.

name: Somborski polumaraton
description: The Sombor Half Marathon is a traditional race held in Sombor, with a new course passing through beautiful parts of the city. The event brings together a large number of runners from Serbia and abroad, promoting a healthy lifestyle and recreational running. The organizers strive to make the race well organized and enjoyable for all participants, with particular attention to the atmosphere and socializing. The race is part of the rich program of activities of the Somaraton Athletics and Recreation Club, which has nurtured Sombor’s long-standing running tradition.

name: Hegyre Megyek - Badacsonyi Futófesztivál 500m / 4 km / 8 km / 11 km / 21 km
LÉLEKFUTÁS ÉS PIKNIK
description: A Lélekfutás és Piknik egy szeretetteljes közösségi esemény Magyarpolányban, amely a test és lélek mozgásáról, feltöltődéséről szól. A futóversenyen kicsik és nagyok egyaránt részt vesznek, majd a napot finom ételek és meditatív programok, például labirintusjárás és gongos hangfürdő teszik teljessé. Ez az esemény nem csupán sport, hanem egy élő, lélegző közösségi ünnep, amely a természet ölelésében zajlik. A rendezvényt a Habitus Alapítvány szervezi, és a Polányi Pünkösdi rendezvénysorozat részeként kerül megrendezésre.

name: SALGÓTARJÁN – LOSONC MARATONVÁLTÓ
description: A Medzinárodný Novohradský Maratón - štafety egy váltóverseny Salgótarján és Lučenec között, amely 42,2 km-es távot ölel fel hat szakaszban, 4-6 fős csapatok számára. A verseny útvonala festői településeken halad át, és a futók a teljes távot váltva teljesítik. A rendezvény családias hangulatú, frissítőpontokkal és a célban gulyással várja a résztvevőket, miközben kulturális programok is színesítik a napot. A verseny kerül megrendezésre, és a nevezés online lehetséges, később csak helyszíni regisztrációval, ha van még hely.

name: SALOMON TWIN PEAKS TRAIL
description: A Salomon Twin Peaks Trail egy 22 kilométeres terepfutó verseny, amely a Salomon Ultra-Trail Hungary része. A pálya a Dömös és Szentfa-Kápolna környékén vezet, és magában foglalja a híres "két tüskét", amelyek különleges kihívást jelentenek a futóknak. Ez a verseny egyedülálló célbaérés élményt kínál Magyarországon, amelyet csak az UTH adhat meg. A verseny ideális azoknak, akik szeretnének belekóstolni az Ultra-Trail Hungary hangulatába és terepfutó kihívásaiba.

name: SALOMON VISEGRAD TRAIL
description: A Salomon Visegrád Trail egy 30 kilométeres terepfutó verseny, amely az egykori visegrádi római őrtoronytól indul és a szentendrei belvárosig vezet. A futók a Visegrádi-hegység legszebb és legnehezebben járható részein haladnak át, változatos és kihívást jelentő terepen. A verseny a természet szerelmeseinek és a terepfutás rajongóinak egyaránt felejthetetlen élményt nyújt. A rendezvény hagyományosan magas színvonalú, és a résztvevők számára jól szervezett támogatást biztosítanak a pálya mentén.

name: Memoriál Františka Daniša – cezpoľný beh
description: The František Daniš Memorial Cross-Country Run is a running event held at the football field in the village of Trstín, Trnava District. The course runs mainly along field and grassy paths, with a short section on an asphalt footpath. Men, women, juniors and residents of Trstín compete in different age categories, with some categories running two laps. The event is suitable for runners who enjoy natural surfaces and cross-country running in the pleasant surroundings of Trstín.
course_highlights: Three quarters of the course is on field and grassy paths
One quarter of the course is on an asphalt footpath
The race takes place at the football field in Trstín
additional: Categories are divided by age and gender; some categories run two laps, and residents of Trstín have their own category. Local contacts: Trstín Municipality, tel. 033/558 92 62, email outrstin@slovanet.sk; Mayor Peter Hlávek, tel. 0918 775 109, email starosta@trstin.sk. The event includes several categories and is part of the Spring Health Run. On-site registration is also possible. Registration is available by contacting the organizers.

name: Turčiansky beh
description: Turčiansky Run is a charity race held at the football stadium in Belá-Dulice. Runners can choose between a 5 km or 10 km route, which takes them over gently undulating terrain on farm tracks and gravel, with 40 to 80 metres of elevation gain. The event supports a good cause: all funds raised will go towards the treatment of a 4-year-old boy with autism and the “Children of My Heart” project. Participants receive gifts, raffle tickets and commemorative medals, and there are activities for children, so parents can run while their children are looked after. Refreshments and parking are available at the start and finish.
course_highlights: The route follows farm tracks and gravel
Gently undulating terrain, with 40 to 80 metres of elevation gain
Start and finish at the Belá-Dulice football stadium
additional: Registration takes place on race day from 8:00 to 11:00. Before the start, each participant receives a drink, a fitness bar and a gift from the partners. The entry fee includes one raffle ticket, with additional tickets available for purchase. Every finisher receives a commemorative medal. Activities with professional entertainers and attractions are available for children. Parking is available by the start/finish area. Refreshments and drinks can be purchased on site. Virtual runners will be sent a gift and medal to their address after the event. The terrain consists of farm tracks and asphalt. Parking is available at the start and finish, and changing rooms, showers and on-site refreshments are available. Registration is available online, including the option to participate virtually.

name: Night Run Trenčín
location: Trenčín, Trenčín, Klub Lúč – Mierové námestie 17
description: Night Run Trenčín is a running event held in Trenčín, at the Lúč club and, weather permitting, in Mierové Square. Runners can challenge themselves in the pleasant atmosphere of the city at night. Registration is available online or on site on race day, provided the participant limit has not been reached. The organizer provides electronic timing and refreshments along the course. The event is suitable for runners aged 12 and over; younger participants need consent from a legal guardian.

name: Dynasport beh na Vtáčnik
location: Kamenec pod Vtáčnikom, Kamenec pod Vtáčnikom, Farma pod Vtáčnikom
distance_verbose: 50 km, 27 km, 24 km, 10 km, 8.4 km, 5 km
description: The Dynasport Run on Vtáčnik is a challenging mountain race in the area around Kamenec pod Vtáčnikom, offering three courses of different lengths and elevation gains. Runners can choose from a 50 km course with 2,000 m of elevation gain, a 27 km course with 1,000 m of elevation gain, or an 8.4 km course with 380 m of elevation gain. Each course has its own time limit and categories for women and men under and over 40. The race starts at a farm below Vtáčnik, with refreshments available at several points along the route. The organizer emphasizes mandatory equipment and runner safety.

name: Petržalská 10
description: Petržalská 10 is a popular running race in Bratislava, held at Námestie Republiky in Petržalka. The race offers various categories, including a children’s run, a 10 km main race, Nordic walking, and a family run with a dog. The children’s races start at 10:00 and the main race at 11:30. The organizer, Športová Nadácia Kotrmelec, provides a welcoming atmosphere and high-quality organization for all participants.

name: Medzinárodný Novohradský Maratón štafety
location: Salgótarján (HU) - Lučenec, Salgótarján (HU) - Lučenec, Hlavné námestie
description: The International Novohrad Marathon Relay is a running relay marathon held along a route between the cities of Salgótarján in Hungary and Lučenec in Slovakia. The course is 42.2 km long and is divided into four legs, run by four relay team members. The race is open to men’s, women’s, and mixed teams, with mixed teams required to have at least 50% women and 50% men. Refreshment stations are provided along the course, and at the finish there is goulash, sports trophies, and cash prizes for the top relay teams. The race starts at 10:00, and registration is available online or on site if places remain.

name: Hlbocký boyard – extrémny beh s prekážkami
location: Hlboké nad Váhom, Hlboké nad Váhom, Areál pri futbalovom ihrisku
description: Hlbocký Boyard is an extreme individual race held in the village of Hlboké nad Váhom. This 6th edition features one lap with plenty of adrenaline-fueled obstacles and steep hills on a motocross track. Competitors will race in nine categories by age and gender, including children’s categories. Runners can enjoy the fresh air, challenges on the course, and, after the race, awards, refreshments, and commemorative items.

name: Jacovská dvadsiatka
description: Jacovská dvadsiatka is a running race held in Jacovce at the football stadium. The event offers two courses: the main 22 km race and an 8 km hobby run, both along asphalt and gravel farm roads. The 22 km race starts at 10:00 and the 8 km run at 10:15. The event is suitable for various age groups and genders and is organized by ATK Javorina Jacovce. Entry fees are affordable, making the event accessible to a wide running community.

name: Kostolanský májovec
location: Veľké Kostoľany, Veľké Kostoľany, futbalový štadión
description: Kostolanský májovec is a running event organized by run ForRest run o.z., held at the Michal Podolan Football Stadium in Veľké Kostoľany. Runners can choose between two courses, 10.90 km and 5.40 km long, both with 64 meters of elevation gain and a surface combining asphalt and meadow. The start is scheduled for 11:00. Competitors are divided into age categories, with awards for the fastest Kostolanec and Kostolanka. The event offers a refreshment station and is suitable for runners looking for a pleasant run with moderate elevation gain in a beautiful setting.

name: Sninský trailový polmaratón
description: The Snina Trail Half Marathon is a running event in Snina, Slovakia, offering two courses: the main 21 km course and a shorter 7.5 km course. The race is for all trail-running enthusiasts who want to enjoy the beauty of nature and the challenges of the terrain. The organizers welcome runners of all levels and offer the lively atmosphere of a quality sporting event.

name: Beh Soviou Poľanou
location: Podolínec - Podolínske lesy, Podolínec - Podolínske lesy, Kaplnka sv. Huberta
description: The Run Under Soviou Poľanou in Podolínec is a forest running race that offers quality training and a chance to test your abilities on mountain terrain. The race is suitable for runners who want to enjoy an exhilarating day in nature and prepare for important races in the season. The route passes through picturesque forests around Podolínec and offers a challenge even for experienced runners.

name: Mravenčárska míľa
location: Plavecký Štvrtok okr. Malacky, Plavecký Štvrtok okr. Malacky, futbalový štadión
description: The Ant Mile is a running event held at the football stadium in Plavecký Štvrtok. The races offer categories for men and women across various age groups, as well as for children, school-age participants, youth, juniors, Nordic walking, and canicross. The school-age race starts at 10:10 and the main category at 12:00. The event is organized by the Plavecký Štvrtok Municipal Office, which provides a pleasant atmosphere and quality organization for all participants.

name: Niže Linča
location: Zeleneč,, okr. rnava, Zeleneč,, okr. rnava, Vinohrady Zeleneč
organizer: Dobrovoľníci z obce Zeleneč, Obecný úrad Zeleneč, Vinársky spolok vinárov a vinohradníkov Zeleneč, DHZ Zeleneč, Zdravotnícka služba Zeleneč
description: Niže Linča is a running event in Zeleneč, organized by volunteers from the village together with local associations and the medical service. The race is open to men, women, and juniors under 18, with prizes also awarded to the fastest man and woman from Linč. The entry fee includes admission to a wine tasting during the St. Urban Festival, giving the event a unique atmosphere and bringing sport and culture together. Online registration will open and the race will take place.

name: Martinský offroad maratón a polmaratón
description: The Martin Off-Road Marathon and Half Marathon is a running event held in the beautiful natural surroundings of the Fatra region, in Tomčany near Martin. Runners can enjoy running across meadows, hills, and the foothills of the Fatra, with stunning views of the Lúčanská, Krivánska, and Veľká Fatra ranges. The course is off-road, with natural obstacles such as mud and fallen trees, adding to its appeal and challenge for runners. The event is intended for runners of different abilities, who can choose a trail that suits their skills and preferences.

name: AZ-Pneu Vertical – Dúbravský beh na Kobylu
location: Bratislava, Bratislava, Mestská časť Dúbravka, Ul. Pod záhradami (pri Lidli)
description: AZ-Pneu Vertical – Dúbravský beh na Kobylu is a running event in Bratislava offering races for children and adults. The race takes place in the Dúbravka district, starting on Pod záhradami Street (by Lidl). You can compete in the 10 km AZ-pneu Vertical, the 5 km Dôverun, or the children’s races. The event is organized by Beh si ty, o.z., together with the Dúbravka District Municipality. The race is suitable for the general public and offers categories by age and gender.

name: Beh s vlkmi pre život
description: Run with the Wolves for Life is a charity running event organized by the CHADIM’S CHARITY Foundation. It takes place in the picturesque surroundings of Čierne, at the tripoint of Slovakia, Czechia, and Poland. The event offers six different courses, including a half marathon, a 10K, a 5K, Nordic walking, and children’s races. The courses run mainly along paved and forest roads, with beautiful mountain views. Runners can expect well-organized routes with clear markings, refreshment stations, and a support vehicle carrying water. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes a healthy lifestyle and charitable causes.

name: Hutňanská šelma
location: Novoveská Huta, Novoveská Huta, Remeselný šenk za Holubnicou
description: Hutňanská šelma is a running event in Novoveská Huta, offering races for both children and adults. The races take place in the pleasant setting of Remeselný šenk za Holubnicou and are divided into several age categories, with awards for the top three finishers. The children’s races start at 10:00, and the races for adults and older children start at 13:00. The event is suitable for runners of different ages and ability levels.

name: Dac Warrior
description: Dac Warrior 2026 is a unique obstacle race in Romania, taking place on May 23 in Tohani, Gura Vadului, Prahova. The courses are challenging, with significant elevation changes and a variety of obstacles designed to test participants’ physical endurance and willpower. The event offers an experience of initiation and reconnection with the spirit of the Dacian ancestors, combining athletic effort with tradition and authentic nature. Participants can choose from several events, ranging from 6 km to 21 km, each with its own difficulties and obstacles. The atmosphere is one of camaraderie and determination, and after the race, participants are invited to discover the local culture and enjoy its traditions and rituals.
course_highlights: Ultimate Run: 21 km with 1,060 m of elevation gain and over 30 obstacles
Legend Run: 11.6 km with 690 m of elevation gain and 25 obstacles
Brave Run: 7.35 km with 348 m of elevation gain and 20 obstacles
additional: The courses feature a variety of obstacles, including small fences, log jumps, rings, sandbags, a log pyramid, ropes, parallel bars, monkey bars, a mud trench, a wall crossing, and a surprise obstacle. There are age- and gender-based prize categories, with cash prizes for the top finishers. The race is recommended for experienced participants, especially the Ultimate Run, which is a difficult OCR. The event includes different distance categories and courses and is open to both recreational and advanced runners.

name: Bârlad Hills Challenge ~ 2027
location: Cotu Negru, Bârlad, Vaslui County, Romania

name: Jidvei Weinland Trails - Running Edition ~ 2027
location: Castelul Bethlen-Haller, Cetatea de Baltă, Alba County, Romania

name: JIDVEI WINELAND TRAILS
location: Bethlen-Haller Castle, Cetatea de Baltă, Alba County, Romania
description: Jidvei Weinland Trails is a unique sporting event held on the Bethlen-Haller Castle estate, in the heart of Transylvania. The competition combines running and cycling on spectacular routes through vineyards and ancient forests, offering participants an authentic experience in Wine Country. The event includes races for all fitness levels, activities for children, and food and wine experiences, creating a memorable day for athletes and their companions alike. It is a celebration of sport, nature, and local culture, with a strong community spirit and support for cultural projects.
course_highlights: Running and cycling routes through the vineyards and forests of the Bethlen-Haller Castle estate
Stunning scenery in the heart of Transylvania, with varied routes for all fitness levels
The event includes trail races, MTB/XCM marathons, and children’s races, all set amid nature and local culture
additional: The event includes special activities for children, with games and creative workshops in a safe setting. Food and wine experiences and tours of Bethlen-Haller Castle and the Jidvei Winery are available for an additional fee. The MTB race offers family-team options and non-competitive E-BIKE races. Special prizes are awarded to the youngest runners in the 1 km and 2 km races.

name: Obciniada Night Run
description: Obciniada Night Run is a night-running competition in Bucovina, offering spectacular routes and a festival atmosphere under the stars. Participants can choose from several races, from a half marathon to children’s races, all held on mountain trails with impressive scenery. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and local community involvement, and is organized to support the education of disadvantaged children. Participants benefit from chip timing, cash prizes, access to hydration stations, and a hot meal at the finish.
course_highlights: Mountain trails with significant elevation gain (up to 1050m for the half marathon)
Checkpoints and aid stations along the route, including at Vârful Toaca
Festival atmosphere with general admission and related activities
additional: Online registration closes Thursday at 18:00, and on-site registration is available until Saturday at 20:00. Participants are required to carry specific equipment. Live rankings and an electronic certificate are provided. Cash prizes will be announced at the beginning of 2027. Participants receive a wristband granting access to the festival area and a hot meal at the finish.

name: Tour de Tur
location: Complex Mujdeni, Lacul Mujdeni, Orașu Nou, Satu Mare County, Romania
description: Tour de Tur is an annual mountain biking and trail running competition held in the area of Lake Mujdeni, Orașu Nou Commune, Satu Mare County. The event offers varied courses for all fitness levels, from short, recreational races to more demanding endurance events. Participants can enjoy beautiful natural scenery and a friendly atmosphere, and are warmly invited to take part in the competition’s 20th edition. The organizers emphasize safety and compliance with the rules specific to each event. Tour de Tur is an excellent opportunity for nature and sports enthusiasts to meet and compete in a remarkable natural setting.
course_highlights: Varied mountain bike courses: Fun Ride (13 km, 385 m elevation gain), Race (34 km, 930 m elevation gain), Marathon (44 km, 1,180 m elevation gain)
Trail running courses: Fun Run (6 km, 184 m elevation gain), Cross (12 km, 390 m elevation gain), Half Marathon (25 km, 990 m elevation gain)
The event takes place at Lake Mujdeni, providing a picturesque natural setting for the competition
additional: The event includes several categories and distances for both mountain biking and trail running, with varying elevation gains. The organizer is the Transylvanian Carpathian Society - Satu Mare. The exact location is Lake Mujdeni, Orașu Nou Commune, Satu Mare County. Contact phone: +40-743-419443.

name: 1. Tibužde Trail
description: 1. Tibužde Trail is a trail race held in Tibužde, Vranje. Runners can choose between two course distances, 27 km and 7 km, offering challenging terrain and beautiful scenery. The event starts in the morning and lasts all day, giving participants a unique trail-running experience.
course_highlights: A 27 km course with 3,000 metres of elevation gain
A shorter 7 km course with 3,000 metres of elevation gain
Natural terrain around Tibužde
additional: The event runs from 7 a.m. to 5 p.m. Terrain: mountainous; registration open; several categories, including a children’s race; shared lunch after the race.

name: Dragutin Tomašević
description: The Dragutin Tomašević Memorial Athletics Race is held in the village of Bistrica near Petrovac na Mlavi in memory of the first Serbian Olympian. This anniversary 21st race brings together runners of all ages and categories, offering opportunities to compete in men’s and women’s divisions as well as by age group. Participants receive chip-timed race bibs and “Joma” Dry Fit shirts, while the organizer provides transportation and a formal dinner. The race is known for its tradition and support from the local community, creating a welcoming atmosphere for all runners.

name: Ivanjica Trail
description: Ivanjica Trail is a unique trail race in Serbia, bringing together runners of different fitness levels across several courses of varying lengths and difficulty. The races take place in the beautiful natural surroundings of Ivanjica and Golija, with viewpoints, meadows, forests, and streams, offering an unforgettable running experience in nature. Special highlights include the Golija PREMIUM race, which starts at the summit of Golija, and the ULTRA 66K, a two-day stage race connecting three mountains and offering a challenge for experienced runners. The organizers provide race packs, refreshments, lunch, transport, and accommodation for participants, creating a friendly and supportive atmosphere.

name: ONERUN 2026
description: One Run is an international race taking place for the eighth consecutive year, simultaneously across multiple countries and continents. The event is known for being entered into the Guinness World Records twice as the world’s largest half marathon with a synchronized start. The race is open to everyone, with four distances available, and promotes health, accessibility, and togetherness through sport and outdoor activities.
