This year, we’re running in Veliko Gradište, Serbia, on May 23, aiming to become part of a new attempt at a Guinness World Record for the first time in Serbia.

name: ONERUN 2027
description: One Run is an international running event that has been held for eight years, bringing together runners from several countries and continents on the same day. The race is known for being entered twice in the Guinness World Records as the world's largest half marathon with a synchronized start. This year, the race is taking place in Serbia as well as several other countries, and participants can choose from four distances: 1 km, 5 km, 10 km, and 21 km. The event is open to everyone, whether they run or walk, and promotes health, accessibility, and community through sport.
course_highlights: Four distances available: 1 km, 5 km, 10 km, and 21 km
Synchronized start in several countries on the same day
Event entered twice in the Guinness World Records
additional: The start and registration are at Žitni trg in Veliko Gradište. Registration is open from 08:00 to 11:30. The warm-up for the 1 km race begins at 12:45, and the 5 km, 10 km, and 21 km races start at 13:30. The award ceremony and presentation of prizes follow the race at 15:30. The race packet includes a bib with a chip, sponsor gifts, and a medal.

name: SALOMON SZENTENDRE TRAIL
distance_verbose: 100 km, 80 km, 53.5 km, 50 km, Félmaraton, 11 km, 10 km, 6 km, 5.8 km, 5 km, 4 km, 3000 meter, 2.5 km, 1.7 km, 1500 meter, 0.85 km, 0.8 km, 0.3 km
description: A SALOMON SZENTENDRE TRAIL egy 54 kilométeres terepfutó verseny, amely 1.800 méter szintemelkedéssel várja a futókat. A verseny során átfutsz az ébredő Szentendrén, tizenkétszer átkelsz az Apátkúti-patakon, és eljutsz Visegrádra, ahol a déli harangszó köszönt. A Kálvárián elgondolkodhatsz az élet értelmén, majd délután 5 előtt visszaérsz Szentendrére, ahol a turisták tapsolnak a Főtéren és a sétálóutcákon, mielőtt elérnéd a célt a Duna korzón. Ez a verseny egyedülálló élményt kínál a természet és a városi környezet találkozásával.
course_highlights: 54 kilométer hosszú táv 1.800 méter szintemelkedéssel
Tizenkétszeri átkelés az Apátkúti-patakon
Visegrád déli harangszavának meghallgatása és a cél Szentendre Duna korzóján
additional: A versenyközpont és expo helyszíne Szentendre, Áprily Lajos tér 3, Ferences Sportcsarnok. Csomagmegőrző a Református Gimnáziumban. A verseny zöld rendezvényként kerül megrendezésre.

name: SALOMON SZENTLÁSZLÓ TRAIL
description: A Salomon Szentlászló Trail egy különleges terepfutó verseny Szentendrén, amely a Visegrádi-hegység legmeredekebb emelkedőit is magában foglalja. A verseny hajnalban indul, és a résztvevők a gomolygó párás Sikárosi-réten futnak át, miközben a kakukk üdvözli a pirkadatot. A célba érkezés este 7 előtt történik, ahol a turisták tapsolnak a Főtéren és a sétálóutcákon. Ez a futóélmény egyedülálló természeti környezetben zajlik, amely igazi kihívást és élményt nyújt a terepfutók számára.
course_highlights: A Visegrádi-hegység legmeredekebb emelkedőinek megmászása
Átjutás a gomolygó párás Sikárosi-réten hajnalban
Célba érkezés Szentendre Főterén, ahol a turisták tapsolnak
additional: A versenyközpont és expo Szentendrén, az Áprily Lajos tér 3. szám alatt található, a Ferences Sportcsarnokban. Csomagmegőrző a Református Gimnázium épületében. Elit terepfutók számára ingyenes indulási lehetőség biztosított ITRA pontszám alapján, regisztrációs időszakban a hello@ultratrail.hu címen lehet érdeklődni. A verseny több távon zajlik, köztük 111K, 84K, 54K, 42K, 30K, 22K és Kids-Trail távok.

name: VeganRun
description: VeganRun Slovakia is the first official Slovak vegan running event, organized by the Slovak Vegan Society. The event brings together sport, health, and compassion, offering more than just a run—it is a shared step toward a healthier body, a cleaner planet, and a more informed society. The routes start at the iconic Rača Amphitheatre and follow the boundary between the Carpathian forest and vineyards, offering forest therapy, varied terrain, and epic views of Bratislava. Runners can choose between 5 km, 10 km, and Canicross, which lets them run with their dog.

name: Bytčiansky Kros
organizer: Behači Bytča a okolie, v spolupráci s Mesto Bytča
description: Bytčiansky Kros is a traditional running race in Bytča, offering four courses of varying lengths and difficulty, including the 21 km Super Kros with 500 m of elevation gain. The course runs mostly over natural terrain, such as farm tracks, meadows and cycle paths, with 80% off-road and 20% paved surfaces. Runners can expect three refreshment stations on the longer courses and clearly marked routes. Competitions are divided into age categories for both men and women, with the top three in each category receiving awards.

name: Semimaraton Casa Bună Sânpetru
description: Casa Bună Sânpetru Half Marathon is a charity sporting event that gives participants the opportunity to run on varied and scenic routes in the Sânpetru area of Brașov. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, flawless organization, and support for disadvantaged families through Casa Bună Sânpetru. The routes offer different levels of difficulty, suitable for both beginners and experienced runners, with beautiful scenery and sporting challenges. Taking part in this half marathon means not only enjoying a sporting experience, but also supporting a noble cause.

name: Crosul Copiilor
description: Crosul Copiilor 2026 is a competition for children aged 0 to 14, held in Central Park in Baia Mare. The event offers races tailored to different age groups, from the Baby Run for children under 4 to timed competitive races for the older groups. It’s a race full of energy and joy, with parents cheering on the children. Every child is encouraged to take part and enjoy running. The organizers limit the number of participants to ensure a pleasant and safe experience for everyone.

name: Trail trka Tibuzde 2026
location: село Тибужде, 5 км од града Врање
description: 1. Tibužde Trail is a trail race held in the village of Tibužde, near Vranje. The race offers two different distances, 27 km and 7 km, giving participants the opportunity to enjoy challenging terrain and the beauty of nature. The race starts at 7 a.m., and the event runs until 5 p.m., creating a great atmosphere for all running and nature enthusiasts.

name: BUFF – GOMU 72H WC
distance_verbose: 100 km, 80 km, 50 km, Félmaraton, 10 km, 5 km
organizer: Central European Ultra Series /CEUS/, Balatonfüredi Atlétikai Club, Balatonfüredi Sport Club, Magyar Ultrafutó Liga /KAHU/, Bakonyország&Balcsipart Egyesület, Balatonfüred Város Önkormányzata
description: A BUFF-CEUS 72H World Cup egy nemzetközi ultrafutó verseny, amely Balatonfüreden, a Füred Kemping és Üdülőfalu területén kerül megrendezésre. A verseny több időtartamú futamra oszlik, köztük 72, 48, 24, 12 és 6 órás futamokra, amelyek a Central European Ultra Series részeként zajlanak. A pálya egy 898 méteres kör, minimális, 1 méteres szintemelkedéssel, így ideális a hosszútávú futók számára. A versenyzők egyéni és csapat kategóriákban is indulhatnak, és minden résztvevő emlékérmet kap. A rendezvény családias hangulatú, és a versenyközpontban központi frissítőasztal áll rendelkezésre.

name: Ružindolský víchor
location: Ružindol okr. Trnava, Ružindol okr. Trnava, športový areál Ružindol
description: Ružindolský Víchor Run is the 12th edition of a road race held at the Ružindol sports complex. The course runs on asphalt and dirt roads through the village and includes a grass loop around the stadium. Runners can choose between a 7 km run and 4 km Nordic Walking. The start is scheduled for 17:30, with categories for men, women, local runners and Nordic Walking. Participants receive a race number, a timing chip, refreshments and a participant medal.

name: Ultrabug
description: Ultrabug is a fully supported, 3-day ultramarathon held on scenic mountain trails in the Carpathian Mountains of Romania, in the Fundu Moldovei area. The main route covers 100 km through mountain trails, mineral-water streams and villages with a rich culture, and is suitable for all fitness levels, including first-time ultra runners. The event also includes shorter alternative races, such as the Marathon XFun, Ultra XFun and Fun Run, offering participants a range of options. After the race, participants are invited to an awards ceremony and a traditional party with local food. Ultrabug is internationally recognized, offers iTRA points and has been voted one of the 50 best ultramarathons abroad.
course_highlights: A 100 km route through mountain trails, mineral-water streams and traditional villages
Spectacular scenery with green meadows and the authentic sounds of bells and flowing water
Alternative routes of 42 km + 8 km, 50 km + 8 km, and an 8 km race open to all ages
additional: The event awards 3 iTRA points to finishers. After the race, there is an awards ceremony and a party with traditional food, including barbecue with polenta, cheese and homemade bread. The race is open to runners, hikers and walkers, with a minimum age of 18 for the 100 km race; the 8 km race is open to all ages. The event includes accommodation at Casa Ileana in Fundu Moldovei, offers iTRA points and attracts international participants.

name: Vártól Várig 1 / 5 / 12 / 25
description: A Vártól Várig futóverseny egy változatos távú esemény, amely 1, 5, 12 és 25 kilométeres távokon kínál lehetőséget a futás szerelmeseinek. A verseny helyszíne Simontornya, a Vár tér 10 környéke, amely festői környezetet biztosít a résztvevőknek. A Marathon Tömegsport és Környezetvédő Egyesület szervezésében zajlik, amely elkötelezett a sport és a környezetvédelem iránt. A rendezvény hagyományosan jó hangulatú, családbarát esemény, amely minden korosztály számára nyitott.
course_highlights: Távok: 1 km, 5 km, 12 km és 25 km
Festői környezet Simontornya városában
Változatos terep, amely kihívást jelent minden futónak

name: V. Tisza-tavi Sportpiknik, Tömegsport Hétvége
description: A V. Tisza-tavi Sportpiknik és Tömegsport Hétvége kerül megrendezésre Sarudon, a Tisza-tó partján. Ez a rendezvény egy közösségi sportesemény, amely a mozgás örömét és a természet közelségét kínálja a résztvevőknek. A programok között különféle sportesemények és családi programok is szerepelnek, így minden korosztály számára élményt nyújt. A helyszín a Tisza-tó gyönyörű környezete, amely ideális a kikapcsolódásra és aktív pihenésre.

name: Hegyen-Völgyön futás
description: A Hegyen-Völgyön futás egy terepfutó verseny, amely Tardos festői focipályáján kerül megrendezésre. A Sprint Futóklub szervezésében zajló esemény a természet közelségét és a változatos terepet kínálja a futás szerelmeseinek. A verseny a sport és a mozgás örömét hivatott népszerűsíteni, minden aktív életet kedvelőt szeretettel várnak. A szervezők fenntartják az időpont és programváltoztatás jogát.

name: Törökbálinti Hendikep
description: A Törökbálinti Hendikep helyi futóverseny Törökbálint Dióskertjében. A résztvevők a hendikep útvonalán futhatnak, a közös sportolás és a barátságos, közösségi hangulat jegyében.
course_highlights: A verseny útvonala Törökbálint Dióskertjében halad.
A hendikep útvonala körökből áll.
A szilveszteri félmaratonon négy kör teljesítésével jön ki a félmaratoni táv.

name: Beh v Raji – prológ
location: Stratená, okr. Rožňava, Stratená, okr. Rožňava, Dobšinská Ľadová Jaskyňa - parkovisko
description: The Run in Paradise is a traditional running race held in the beautiful surroundings of the Dobšinská Ice Cave and its vicinity. Participants can choose from several distances, including a prologue, half marathon, 10 km and 5 km races, which run mainly on asphalt roads with partial traffic closures. The prologue is a hilly 1 km run along a forest trail from the car park to the ice cave. The event is suitable for the general public and also offers Nordic walking.

name: Salibský polmaratón, Hornosalibská desiatka, Hornosalibská trojka
location: Horné Saliby okr. Galanta, Horné Saliby okr. Galanta, Areál futbalového ihriska TJ Horné Saliby
organizer: Obce Horné Saliby a Dolné Saliby
description: The Saliby Half Marathon, Hornosalibská 10 and Hornosalibská 3 are traditional running events organized by RoniRun Club in the village of Horné Saliby. The races offer certified courses of 21.1 km, 10 km and 3 km, running through a picturesque area, with refreshment stations and chip timing. The event is suitable for the general public, including children, who can take part in special kids’ races. Alongside the sporting experience, visitors can look forward to a varied accompanying program featuring music, martial arts demonstrations and a raffle.

name: Self-Transcendence 6/12h a 100km beh / Sri Chinmoy Self-Transcendence 100km beh
location: Šamorín, Okres Dunajská Streda, Trnavský kraj
description: The Sri Chinmoy Self-Transcendence 6/12-hour and 100 km Run in Šamorín is a traditional ultrarunning race held in Pomlé City Park. This is the 24th edition of the 6-hour run and the 15th edition of the 12-hour and 100 km runs, with categories for individuals and relay teams. Runners can compete in various age categories, including men’s and women’s veterans over 50. Relay teams may have up to three runners, who can take turns in any order, with each team member required to complete at least one lap after taking over. Results are measured by the actual distance covered, to the nearest metre.

name: Hore Lótom Dole Lótom
location: Veľké Lovce (okr. Nové Zámky), Veľké Lovce (okr. Nové Zámky), Športový areál
description: Hore Lótom Dole Lótom is the fourth edition of a running event held at the sports complex in Veľké Lovce. The races follow the village streets and surrounding countryside along asphalt and dirt roads. The event also includes children’s categories with different course distances according to age, as well as the main 5 km and 10 km races. The event is suitable for the general public and offers awards in age and gender categories. The organizers emphasize convenient online registration and accurate chip timing.

name: Memoriál Jozefa Gabčíka
location: Žilina - Poluvsie, Žilina - Poluvsie, rodný dom Jozefa Gabčíka
organizer: Žilinský pluk Jozefa Gabčíka, Klub vojenských výsadkárov Slovenskej republiky, Železničná spoločnosť Slovensko, Ministerstvo obrany SR
description: The Jozef Gabčík Memorial is an annual running race held in honour of paratrooper and hero Jozef Gabčík, a prominent figure in the anti-fascist resistance. This 11 km cross-country race over mixed terrain runs from Žilina–Poluvsie, the birthplace of Jozef Gabčík, to the sports complex of the 5th Special Forces Regiment in Žilina. The event brings together civilian and military runners and promotes physical fitness and community spirit. The entry fee includes a race pack, refreshments, a commemorative medal, and chip timing.

name: Kurimské pobehaňe
location: Kurima, (okres Bardejov), Kurima, (okres Bardejov), Pred kaštieľom
description: Kurimské pobehaňe is a running event organized by the Aktívna Kurima civic association, held in the village of Kurima in front of the manor house. The course follows asphalt and dirt roads, with dirt and gravel surfaces. The race is open to a range of age groups, from schoolchildren to veterans, with men and women competing in different age categories. Online registration is available, with different entry fees depending on when you register. A school run for children is also provided. The event is ideal for runners looking for an enjoyable, community-oriented running experience in nature.

name: Telekom Night Run Štrbské Pleso
location: Štrbské Pleso, Štrbské Pleso, na hlavnej ceste medzi hotelom FIS (adresa: k Vodopádom 26) a hotelom Patria
description: Telekom Night Run Štrbské Pleso is a traditional night run in the stunning surroundings of the High Tatras, now being held for the 14th year. Runners can choose between 5 km and 10 km routes that pass around Malé and Veľké Štrbské Pleso, Jazierka lásky, and through the Snow Cross-Country Skiing Area. The event is part of the Grand Prix series and offers an unmistakable atmosphere, with views of Rysy and a nighttime finish in the dark. In addition to the adult races, children’s runs and Nordic walking are also on offer. Telekom Night Run is a popular annual stop for runners who enjoy beautiful running experiences in a mountain setting.

name: Turbo TV detské behy Štrbské Pleso
location: Štrbské Pleso, Štrbské Pleso, na hlavnej ceste medzi hotelom FIS (adresa: k Vodopádom 26) a hotelom Patria
description: Telekom Night Run Štrbské Pleso is a traditional night run in the stunning surroundings of the High Tatras, taking place for the 14th time. Runners can choose between 5 km and 10 km routes leading around Malé Štrbské Pleso and Veľké Štrbské Pleso, with beautiful views of the Tatra peaks. The event also includes Turbo TV children’s races, with various distances for everyone from the youngest runners to teenagers, offering unforgettable experiences and medals. The atmosphere is exceptional, with spectators cheering along the route and runners crossing the finish line after dark, making this run a popular fixture in the season.

name: Fatranský Vĺčko
location: určianske Jaseno, určianske Jaseno, Lezecká stena Ovčín
description: Fatranský Vĺčko is a canine endurance sport that combines hiking and running with a dog in the beautiful surroundings of the Veľká Fatra mountains. The event will take place in Turčianske Jaseno and offers two routes: the longer MID, measuring 44 km with 2,350 m of elevation gain, and the shorter SHORT, measuring 14 km with 500 m of elevation gain. You can compete in the dog trekking category (person with a dog) or the trail category (running without a dog). Dogs must be kept on a leash or harness throughout the entire route; allowing a dog to roam freely results in disqualification. The organizers recommend the MID route for experienced participants and the SHORT route for beginners or those who are less trained.

name: Transylvania 100
location: Castelul Bran, Bran, Brașov County, Romania
description: Transylvania 100 is a mountain running event offering five different races, from a half marathon to a 100 km ultra-marathon, held in the Bucegi Mountains. The routes cross narrow trails, ancient forests, mountain plateaus, and exposed ridges, with numerous climbs and descents, all starting and finishing at Bran Castle, in the shadow of the legendary Dracula. The event is recognized as a UTMB Index race and promotes values such as respect, solidarity, and self-sufficiency in mountain running. Participants must have previous mountain-running experience for the longer races, and everyone who finishes within the time limits receives a special souvenir.
course_highlights: Routes through narrow trails and ancient forests
Course across mountain plateaus and exposed ridges
Start and finish in the Bran Castle area
additional: Participation limits apply, and previous experience is mandatory for races over 20 km. All races are solo, with strict self-sufficiency rules between checkpoints. The event includes races for different experience levels, with prizes for the winners and medals for all finishers. Participation requires trail-running experience, and registration is online, with limited places.

name: Maratonul Internațional Sibiu
location: Piața Mare, Sibiu, Sibiu County, Romania
description: The Sibiu International Marathon is Romania’s largest philanthropic running event, reaching its 15th edition in 2026. The event combines the joy of running with support for community projects, with runners able to choose to support various local causes through their registration fee. The event includes multiple races for all ages and levels, from a full marathon to children’s races, held in Sibiu’s Piața Mare and surrounding areas. It is a movement that brings communities together and inspires them, with a strong tradition and significant social impact.
course_highlights: Multiple races: marathon, half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, relay and children’s races
Start and finish in Piața Mare, Sibiu
Philanthropic event supporting local community projects
additional: Registration fees are considered donations to support community projects. The event includes races for all ages, including children’s races and a relay race.

name: BRASOV MARATHON Eveniment organizat de CPNT Brașov
description: Brașov Marathon is one of Romania’s largest mountain running events, held in the heart of the Carpathians, around the city of Brașov. The courses include the 10K Cross, Half Marathon, Marathon, and Ultra Marathon, crossing the Tâmpa, Postăvaru, and Piatra Mare massifs and offering impressive views and a unique combination of sport and nature. The event starts in Piața Sfatului, passes historic and natural landmarks, and is part of the Carpathian Circuit, offering ITRA and UTMB points. It is a celebration of health and sport, open to runners of all ages and experience levels.
course_highlights: Mountain routes across the Tâmpa, Postăvaru, and Piatra Mare massifs
Start and finish in Piața Sfatului, passing the Black Church and the Weavers’ Bastion
Panoramic views of Brașov and the surrounding area
additional: Race kits can be collected in Piața Sfatului, with specific hours for each race. The Ultra Marathon starts at 08:00, while the Half Marathon starts in two waves. Mandatory gear checks apply to the Ultra Marathon, Marathon, and Half Marathon. The event also includes races for children and teenagers, held over three days. The start area offers refreshments between 10:30 and 23:00. The event includes races for children and people with special abilities, and is dedicated to promoting running, nature, and the local community.

name: TRANSYLVANIA 100K
description: Transylvania 100 is a mountain ultramarathon event held in the wilderness of the Bucegi Mountains, crossing high-altitude trails. The event includes five different races, from a half marathon to a 100 km ultramarathon, all starting and finishing near Bran Castle, known as Dracula’s Castle. The routes offer a mix of narrow paths, ancient forests, mountain plateaus, and exposed ridges, providing a unique experience for runners passionate about the mountains. The races are open to solo competitors, with category prizes and special souvenirs for those who finish within the time limits.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.transylvania100k.com/): 2027-05-29 — "Transylvania 100 - 12th edition - May 29th 2027." (was estimated 2027-05-30)

name: Crosul Teiușului
description: Crosul Teiușului is a sporting event dedicated to promoting outdoor activity, mountain running, and a healthy lifestyle, for all ages and fitness levels. The event offers a variety of routes, from children’s races to a half marathon, in the authentic natural setting of Teiuș, Alba. It promotes inclusion, fair play, and active community participation, with free entry for all participants. A growing local tradition, it brings athletes and supporters together for a memorable experience.

name: Giarmata În Mișcare
description: Giarmata on the Move is an annual sporting event that brings together the communities of Giarmata and Cerneteaz to support social and educational causes and animal protection. In 2026, the event will take place on May 30 and will offer running races and cycling tours for all ages, from children to adults. Participants can choose from a half marathon, races of various distances, cycling tours, and children’s races, all helping to support local community projects. The event is organized by LOGS together with local partners and supported by major sponsors.
course_highlights: 21 km half marathon for adults (ages 16+)
10.5 km and 5 km races for adults and young people
Races and tours for children aged 4 to 12
additional: The event includes races for all ages, from young children (400 m) to the half marathon. Participation supports community projects for children with disabilities, education, and animal protection. Donations can also be made separately by bank transfer or PayPal to the LOGS Association. The organizers provide support and information by email for payment confirmations and registration questions. The event includes donations and social projects, is supported by several local partners, and aims to promote health and civic engagement.

name: Thermal Trail Race
location: Băile 1 Mai, Sânmartin, Bihor County, Romania
description: Thermal Trail Race is an outdoor running race that promotes a healthy lifestyle and respect for nature. The event takes place in Băile 1 Mai, with the start and finish in the parking lot at Avenul Betfia (Crater). Two races are available: the 14 km Cross and the 7 km Mini, offering a trail-running experience amid the natural scenery of the capital of thermal waters. This is the 13th edition of the event, bringing together running and nature enthusiasts in a friendly, active setting.

name: Mokra Gora Trail
description: Mokra Gora Trail is a new regional hiking trail that runs across Mount Mokra Gora, connecting Montenegro, Kosovo* and Serbia. The trail is part of the Via Dinarica network and offers a unique opportunity for adventure tourism and exploration of the Balkans’ unspoiled nature. It was developed with the support of the Institute for Territorial Economic Development and the Regional Cooperation Council, with the aim of promoting cross-border tourism and preserving the region’s natural beauty. The trail is known for its Via Ferrata attractions, which offer exciting experiences for hikers and nature lovers.
course_highlights: The trail runs across Mount Mokra Gora, connecting three countries: Montenegro, Kosovo* and Serbia
It is part of the Via Dinarica network, known for its unspoiled nature and mountain landscapes
Via Ferrata sections offer adventure opportunities for hikers
additional: The trail is part of the Via Dinarica cross-border project and was developed to promote sustainable tourism and improve infrastructure. No race price or registration details are listed, indicating that the focus is on the hiking trail rather than a competition. The contact organization is the Regional Cooperation Council, headquartered in Sarajevo. The project is linked to the development of regional hiking trails, including Via Ferrata, GPS mapping and the installation of signage, with the aim of promoting sustainable tourism and cooperation in the region.

name: Tour de Fruška
distance_verbose: 59 km, 39 km, 22 km, 15 km, 7 km, 2 km, 1 km
description: Tour de Fruška is one of the region’s most attractive sporting events, held in the beautiful surroundings of Fruška Gora, in Vrdnik. The event brings together sport, nature, and tourism, offering participants a unique experience of cycling through unspoiled nature and beautiful landscapes. It gathers cycling and active holiday enthusiasts, promoting a healthy lifestyle and the tourism potential of Vojvodina.

name: Ozren i Devica 2026
description: The Devica–Ozren hiking trip, organized by PSK Pobeda, takes participants on a climb up Mount Devica, one of the most beautiful and northernmost mountains in the Balkans. The route passes through lush vegetation and limestone formations dotted with numerous caves, including a climb to Soko Grad and the Golem Kamen viewpoint, and finishes along a forest trail toward Ozren and Ripaljka Waterfall. The trip lasts one day, departing from Belgrade in the early morning and returning in the evening. Participants must have a Planinarski savez Srbije membership booklet valid for 2026 and suitable hiking equipment.

name: Serbia EPIC MIONICA #3
description: Serbia EPIC MIONICA #3 is an exciting series of races held in Mionica, offering a range of distances for runners of different levels. The races include mountain and cycling marathons, as well as shorter courses, all set in the beautiful natural surroundings of Stara Planina. This event attracts nature and sports enthusiasts, offering challenging and scenic routes. You are welcome to take part and enjoy the unique atmosphere and sporting spirit.
course_highlights: A variety of courses from 7 km to 60 km
Mountain and cycling marathons on Stara Planina
Beautiful natural landscapes and challenging terrain

name: V. Kastélykör Flow 5 / 10 / 20
location: Károlyi-kastély, Gróf Károlyi Ede út 1, Füzérradvány, Hungary
description: A V. Kastélykör Flow egy változatos terepfutó verseny Füzérradvány festői környezetében, amely három távon kínál kihívást: 5, 10 és 20 kilométeren. A futók gyönyörű természeti környezetben, változatos terepen haladhatnak, élvezve a kastély környékének hangulatát és a természet közelségét. A rendezvény családias hangulatú, alkalmas mind kezdőknek, mind tapasztalt futóknak, akik szeretnének egy élménydús, jól szervezett versenyen részt venni. A verseny célja a mozgás örömének és a természet szeretetének népszerűsítése.
course_highlights: Változatos terep a kastély körül
Természetközeli futás Füzérradványban
Különböző távok minden szintnek

name: Zsámbékfutás 5 / 10 / 21
description: A Zsámbékfutás egy hangulatos futóverseny, amely Zsámbék és Tök településeken halad aszfaltos és murvás útvonalakon, beleértve a Nyakas-hegy terepviszonyait is. A verseny központja a piactér, ahonnan a futók indulnak és ide is érkeznek vissza. A pálya változatos terepet kínál enyhe emelkedőkkel, erdei szakaszokkal és gyönyörű panorámával a környező hegyekre. A verseny célja, hogy minden résztvevő egyedi befutóéremmel gazdagodjon, és a hangsúly a felkészülésen, a rendszeres testmozgáson van. A rendezvény a helyi közösség és az egészséges életmód támogatásának jegyében jött létre.
course_highlights: 21,2 km-es táv Zsámbék és Tök településeken aszfaltos és murvás útburkolaton
5 frissítőállomás vízzel, izotóniás itallal, szőlőcukorral, banánnal és kekszekkel
Nyakas-hegy terepfutó szakasz panorámával és erdei ösvényekkel
additional: A verseny szintideje 3,5 óra, de a szervezők mindenkit megvárnak, az utolsó versenyző mögött haladnak. A pályán teljes útzár lesz a rajt időszakára, és a szurkolók könnyen elérhetik az Önkormányzat előtti szakaszt. A frissítőpontokon kívül a pálya jól jelzett, és a segítők irányítják a futókat a helyes útvonalon.

name: SÜLYSÁPI FUTÓNAP
distance_verbose: Félmaraton, 11 km, 3.7 km, 2 km, 1500 meter, 0.3 km

name: Beh Rajeckým rínkom
description: The Run Around Rajec Square is a traditional running race organized by Maratón klub Rajec, held at SNP Square in Rajec. The race gives runners the opportunity to enjoy the natural beauty and surroundings of Rajec on a May day. The event is suitable for the general public, including children and minors, who must have the consent of a legal guardian. The organizers emphasize safety and thorough preparation for participants.

name: Beh na Zniev
location: Kláštor pod Znievom okr. Martin, Kláštor pod Znievom okr. Martin, areál bývalého Prvého slovenského gymnázia
description: Beh na Zniev is a championship uphill race held in Kláštor pod Znievom, offering a challenging 5,650-metre course with 475 metres of elevation gain. The race is open to a wide range of categories, from children to veterans, including men, women, juniors and youth. The main race starts at 14:00 in the grounds of the former grammar school. The organizers are the Kláštor pod Znievom Municipal Office, Strive sport, TRIMAT and the Slovak Athletics Association. The race is part of the Slovak Mountain Running Cup.

name: Pivovarsko-hradná sedemtisícovka
location: Veľký Šariš okr. Prešov, Veľký Šariš okr. Prešov, areál TJ Slavoj V. Šariš
description: The Brewery-Castle Seven-Thousander is a running event organized by the town of Veľký Šariš in cooperation with Šariš Brewery and the Sports Commission of the Municipal Council in Veľký Šariš. The race takes place at the TJ Slavoj Veľký Šariš grounds and offers categories for various age groups, as well as Nordic walking. The start is scheduled for 15:00 for the run and 15:05 for Nordic walking. The event is suitable for the general public, including adolescents, juniors, and women and men in various age categories.

name: Beh rajeckým rínkom
location: Rajec, Žilina District, Žilina Region, Slovakia
description: The Rajec Square Run is a traditional running race organized by the town of Rajec, held at SNP Square. The event is part of the town’s sporting and cultural life and offers an opportunity for runners of different age groups and ability levels. The course passes through the town’s scenic surroundings, combining sport with an enjoyable experience of the local area. The run is part of a broader program of sporting and cultural activities in Rajec.
course_highlights: The course runs through the center of Rajec
Scenic surroundings in the Žilina Region
An opportunity for runners of different age groups

name: Crosul Copiilor
location: Veneția de Jos, Brașov County, Romania

name: Senćanski polumaraton
description: The Senta Half Marathon is a half-marathon race held in Senta, on the main square. The race brings together running enthusiasts from the region and offers an opportunity for sports and friendly competition in a pleasant atmosphere. The course runs through the city center and surrounding areas, offering participants a unique experience and challenge.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the main square in Senta
Route through the city center and surrounding areas
Pleasant atmosphere and support from the local community

name: Stazama Vuka Karadžića
description: The Vuk Karadžić Trails is a 25 km loop race with a total elevation gain of 1,000 metres. The course starts at Vuk’s memorial house and runs through the shade of the centuries-old Monastery Forests, past woodland streams and waterfalls to the 13th-century Tronoša Monastery. It then continues across Mala Tronoša and Lisina to Zajača, from where the Monastery Candles Trail leads to Velika Bobija and the Miličin Konak ethno complex, before returning to Tršić and Vuk’s house, where the finish is located. This race offers a unique opportunity to enjoy the region’s natural beauty and cultural and historical landmarks.

name: Kros Trka Carica
description: The Carica Cross-Country Race is a traditional outdoor race held in Mali Stapar, bringing together runners of all ages, from children to competitors over seventy. The main race is 6.4 km long, preceded by children’s races with around forty participants. The event celebrates the traditions of sport, friendship, and spending time outdoors, and the organizers invite everyone to take part and enjoy this sporting event. The race is a prelude to the Friendship Race held in Kula, continuing the tradition of sport and community.

name: Humanitarna IT trka „Štafeta srcem”
description: The charity IT race “Relay with Heart” will take place at Niš Fortress. The event brings together the IT community and running enthusiasts in a charitable atmosphere, promoting solidarity and support through sport. The race is an opportunity to socialize, lead an active lifestyle, and contribute to the community in the beautiful setting of the fortress.

name: Ederics VAD szíve - max pulzus 2026
distance_verbose: 30 km, 27 km, 24 km, Félmaraton, 18 km, 15 km, 12 km, 9 km, 6 km, 3000 meter
description: Az Ederics VAD Szíve - max pulzus egy természetkedvelő futók találkozója és összejövetele egy gyönyörű helyszínen, Balatonederics közelében. A rajt és cél a Csodabogyós-barléknál van, ahol a résztvevők élvezhetik a természet közelségét és a közösségi élményt. A verseny nemcsak a teljesítményről szól, hanem a természet szeretetéről és a közös sportolás öröméről is. A rendezvény családbarát és minden szintű futó számára nyitott, akik szeretnék kipróbálni magukat egy különleges környezetben.
course_highlights: Rajtpont és cél a Csodabogyós-barléknál
Természetközeli futópálya Balatonederics környékén
Közösségi futóesemény természetkedvelőknek
additional: A verseny célja a természetkedvelő futók összegyűjtése és egy közös élmény megteremtése. A helyszín különleges természeti adottságokkal rendelkezik, amely ideális futóhelyszínként szolgál. A rendezvény családbarát, így a kísérők és szurkolók is szívesen látottak.

name: XXIV. Büchl Éjszakai Futóverseny
description: A XXIV. Büchl Éjszakai Futóverseny kerül megrendezésre Győrben, a Tulipános Általános Iskolánál. A verseny több távon kínál lehetőséget, köztük gyerekfutam, 7, 14 és 21 km-es egyéni futás, 3 fős félmaraton váltó, valamint 7 km-es Nordic Walking. A verseny egyedi befutóérmet, chipes időmérést, frissítést és orvosi ügyeletet biztosít, a pályák jól jelöltek és rendőri biztosítással ellátottak. A rajtcsomag a hosszabb távokon indulóknak jár, és a nevezés előzetes regisztrációval, banki utalással válik véglegessé.

name: Büchl Éjszakai Félmaraton
description: A Büchl Éjszakai Félmaraton egy hagyományos, éjszakai futóverseny Győrben, amely több távon kínál lehetőséget a futás szerelmeseinek, beleértve a gyerekfutamot, egyéni távokat és váltókat is. A verseny központja a Tulipános Általános Iskola, és a rendezvény jól szervezett, chipes időméréssel, frissítési pontokkal, orvosi ügyelettel és rendőri biztosítással várja a résztvevőket. A nevezők egyedi befutóérmet kapnak, és a 14 és 21 km-es távokon rajtcsomagot is biztosítanak. A verseny célja, hogy minden korosztály számára élvezetes és biztonságos futóélményt nyújtson.

name: Bükk Hegyi Maraton
description: A Bükki Hegyi Maraton-Kisgyörgy Ádám Emlékverseny Magyarország legrégebbi terepmaratonja, amely kerül megrendezésre Miskolc, Majális parkban. A verseny változatos távokat kínál, a maratontól a minimaratonig, így mindenki megtalálhatja a számára ideális kihívást. A futók a festői Bükk-hegység természeti szépségei között versenyeznek, miközben a versenyközpontban az „erdei stadionban” folyamatosan követhető a verseny alakulása. A rendezvény célja a sportbarátságok ápolása, az egészséges életmód népszerűsítése és a Bükk természeti értékeinek bemutatása.

name: Ceglédfürdő Futófesztivál
location: Ceglédi Gyógyfürdő és Szabadidőközpont, Cegléd, Hungary
distance_verbose: 28 km, Félmaraton, 14 km, 7 km, 3.5 km, 2 km
description: A Ceglédfürdő Futófesztivál egy családbarát futóverseny, amely a Ceglédi Gyógyfürdő és Szabadidőközpont varázslatos környezetében kerül megrendezésre. A versenyen a legkisebbektől a profi futókig mindenki megtalálhatja a számára megfelelő távot, legyen az gyerekfutam, élményséta, vagy akár hosszabb távok és váltók. A rendezvény célja, hogy minden résztvevő élvezze a futást, akár családdal, akár egyéni csúcsokat megdöntve. A verseny hagyományosan június első szombatján zajlik, és változatos távokat kínál a futók számára.
course_highlights: Távok 300 m-től 28 km-ig, valamint váltók (21 km duó és trió)
A verseny a Ceglédi Gyógyfürdő és Szabadidőközpont területén zajlik
Körpályás útvonalak 1-8 körrel a különböző távokhoz
additional: Rajtszám átvétel 2027.06.04-én 14:00-18:00 között Cegléd Szabadság téren, illetve 2027.06.05-én reggel 7:00-8:30 között a verseny helyszínén. Öltözési, zuhanyzási és ruhatári lehetőség a strand öltözőjében, mobil WC-k a rajt mellett. Nevezési díj befizetése online bankkártyával vagy banki utalással lehetséges.

name: Crazy5K
description: A CRAZY5K egy egyedi, 5 km-es akadályfutó verseny, amelyen 10 hatalmas, felfújható akadály várja a résztvevőket. A verseny nem a teljesítményről, hanem a szórakozásról szól, így barátokkal, családdal vagy kollégákkal együtt élvezhető egy felejthetetlen nap. Külön családi futam is elérhető, amely kifejezetten a 10 év alatti gyermekes családoknak szól, és a gyerekeknek meglepetéssel készülnek. A rendezvény helyszíne a Budaörsi Repülőtér, ahol parkolási lehetőség is biztosított. A nevezési díj tartalmaz rajtszámot, pólót, befutócsomagot, egyedi érmet, frissítést, ruhatárhasználatot és orvosi felügyeletet.

name: MOKÜ Run
location: Kismaros Focipálya, Liget utca, Kismaros, Hungary

name: Banskobystrický maratón
location: Banská Bystrica, Okres Banská Bystrica, Banskobystrický kraj
description: The Banská Bystrica Marathon is the largest recurring sporting event in central Slovakia, offering a magical evening atmosphere and a fast, certified course that delivers a memorable experience. Runners can choose from several events, including the marathon, half marathon, 10K, STEFE 5K and relay. The course is well supported, with refreshment stations and sound systems, ensuring a great experience for all participants. The event is suitable for both active runners and families looking to enjoy exercise and a sporting atmosphere.

name: Poludnica Run
description: Poludnica Run is a mountain race in the Low Tatras, with a 23 km course and 1,600 metres of elevation gain. The route runs mostly along marked hiking trails, through beautiful south-facing forest singletracks, a rock city and the summit of Poludnica, with panoramic views of the Liptov region and the Tatras. The event is part of the Slovak Skyrunning League and the Skyrunner® National Series Slovakia, and also serves as a qualifying race for the Skyrunning World Championships. The atmosphere is friendly, and the course is among the toughest in Slovakia in its category. The 2026 event will be the final edition.

name: Beh Vyšnou Myšľou
location: Vyšná Myšľa okr. Košice okolie, Vyšná Myšľa okr. Košice okolie, futbalové ihrisko
description: Beh Vyšnou Myšľou is a running event organized by the Vyšná Myšľa Running Club and the municipality of Vyšná Myšľa. The races take place at the football field in Vyšná Myšľa and offer categories for men, women, and children across different age groups. The event also includes a two-person relay of 2 x 3 km. The children’s races start at 14:00 and the adults’ races at 16:00. The event is suitable for the general public, including club members and residents of the municipality, who receive discounts on the entry fee.

name: Trail Run
location: Družstevná pri Hornáde, Družstevná pri Hornáde, Okružná ulica pri multifunkčnom ihrisku
description: Trail Run in Družstevná pri Hornáde is a running event featuring a route with a natural character and varied terrain. Participants can choose between 8 km and 15 km loops that follow asphalt, concrete, forest, and field roads, with elevation gain of up to 309 metres. The event also includes children’s categories with various route distances, making it suitable for runners of a wide range of ages. The start and finish are located by the multifunctional sports court on Okružná Street in Družstevná pri Hornáde.

name: Starostovská desiatka
location: Hôrka okr. Poprad, Hôrka okr. Poprad, futbalové ihrisko Kišovce
description: Starostovská desiatka is a running race held in the village of Hôrka, Poprad District, at the Kišovce football pitch. The race offers a 10 km course with age- and gender-based categories, as well as a 5 km hobby category and races for children and pupils. The main categories start at 16:30, and the children’s categories begin at 13:00. The organizers are the Hôrka Municipal Office and TJ Baník Hôrka, who welcome runners of all ages and abilities.

name: Beh pre dobrú vec
description: Run for a Good Cause is a running event in the village of Pača, offering a 4.4 km course. The race is open to a broad age range, from younger to older runners, with categories for men and women. This community run combines sport with a good cause, and participants can compete in various age groups. The event is part of the pretekaj.sk platform and offers simple online registration.

name: Beh na vrchol Minčola
location: Lipany okr. Sabinov, Lipany okr. Sabinov, Lúčka-nad obecným úradom
organizer: Turisti a priaznivci behu na Minčol v spolupráci s Mestom Lipany
description: The Run to the Summit of Minčol is a traditional running race in Lipany, offering a challenging 7,300-meter course with 649 meters of elevation gain. The race is open to a wide range of categories, from the youngest children to seniors, and also includes a competition in the 2025 Eastern Slovak Hill Running League. It is organized by Tourists and Running Enthusiasts of Minčol in cooperation with the City of Lipany. The race is suitable for anyone who enjoys hill running and wants to test their strength in a beautiful natural setting.

name: Single-Trail run 30
location: Ruská Nová Ves, Ruská Nová Ves, Hostinec pod zámkom (/budova obecného úradu)
description: Single-Trail Run 30 is a running race in Ruská Nová Ves, Hostinec pod zámkom, offering three distances: 25 km, 15 km, and 7 km. The race is open to men and women with no age restrictions and is organized by O.z. Single-Trail Run 30. Registration is available online and on site, and the event offers the chance to experience a challenging trail run in nature. The organizers provide contact information for anyone seeking further details.

name: XRun
description: X-Run is a running competition held in Oradea, organized by the Xterra Sport Bihor Sports Club Association. The 21 km course offers a complete experience, with refreshment stations providing still water, isotonic drinks, cola, ice, fresh fruit, and energy bars. Participants receive a race pack containing a personalized technical T-shirt, a race number, and an electronic chip for timing. Medical assistance is provided along the course by ambulances and specialized staff. Race pack collection takes place between 16:00 and 20:00.
course_highlights: 21 km course in Oradea, Bihor County
Refreshment stations with drinks and energy snacks
Medical assistance along the course, with ambulances and specialized staff
additional: The race pack includes an official personalized technical T-shirt, a race number, and an electronic chip for timing. Medical assistance is provided by specially equipped ambulances and medical staff at key points along the course. Participants must present a signed declaration of responsibility and their identity card or passport.

name: Bușteni Ultra Race
description: Bușteni Ultra Race is a mountain running competition held on spectacular routes in the Bucegi and Baiului Mountains, offering impressive panoramic views. The event features four distances with significant elevation gain, designed to test participants’ physical and mental limits. The atmosphere is one of community and mutual support, while careful organization ensures a safe and professional experience. Participants can reconnect with nature and take on the challenge of an authentic endurance race.
course_highlights: Alpine routes with impressive panoramic views
Significant elevation gain for each distance
Marked routes and well-stocked aid stations
additional: The race kit includes a personalized technical shirt for the first 800 participants, timing with a disposable chip, aid stations along the route and at the start/finish, a finisher medal for those who finish within the time limits, and products provided by sponsors. There are time limits for each distance and an awards ceremony at 18:00. The routes include aid and support points, with categories and prizes for different distances. The event promotes an authentic mountain trail experience and participant safety.

name: AROBS X-Man Romania 2026
description: The AROBS X-Man Romania 2026 competition invites competitors from Romania and abroad, amateurs and professionals alike, to test their limits over the Long, Middle and Olympic distances. The event takes place in Oradea, a vibrant Art Nouveau city with a rich cultural and architectural history. Participants can enjoy a unique urban setting, with numerous tourist attractions and modern amenities. The organizers offer attractive prizes to reward each participant’s determination and passion.

name: Maraton Apuseni ~ 2026
description: Maraton Apuseni is an iconic mountain-running event held in the heart of the Apuseni Mountains, offering a variety of routes for all preferences and experience levels. Participants can choose between an ultramarathon, marathon, half-marathon, cross-country race, and family race, enjoying picturesque scenery, shaded trails, spectacular ridges, and traditional villages. The event celebrates 15 years of tradition and community and is organized by the Romanian Alpine Club, Cluj Branch, with a friendly, festive atmosphere. It is a unique opportunity to run in nature, test your limits, and connect with other mountain-running enthusiasts.

name: Festivalul Sporturilor Iași
description: Iași Sports Festival is a sporting event for everyone, from beginners to advanced competitors, offering a variety of events such as trail running, mountain biking, orienteering, and road running. The event takes place on routes in the city of Iași and the surrounding areas, with starts and finishes at Hotel La Castel and the Palace of Culture. Participants can compete individually or in multiple events to receive discounts, and can take on the Multisport Trophy challenge, which includes four events over two days. The festival promotes physical activity for everyone, including families and people with special abilities, offering a complete and welcoming experience.
course_highlights: Varied routes in the city of Iași and surrounding areas, including trails through vineyards and Breazu Forest
Aid and hydration stations along the trail-running routes
Live electronic timing and cash prizes in the Open categories
additional: Start/finish at Hotel La Castel - Green View Salon (Saturday) and the Palace of Culture (Sunday). Participants must present their original identity card and sign a declaration of responsibility when collecting their race kit. The competition takes place regardless of weather conditions, except in extreme conditions. Timing is chip-free, and the standings are available live on the website during the race. There are Open categories with cash prizes and age categories detailed in the regulations. Time limits for events: 11 km trail run - 2 hours; 21 km half marathon - 3 hours.

name: MARATON APUSENI
description: Maraton Apuseni is a mountain running event offering varied courses for all fitness levels, set amid the picturesque landscapes of the Apuseni Mountains. Participants can choose from an ultramarathon, marathon, half marathon, cross-country race, and family events, running through dense forests, spectacular ridgelines, and traditional villages. The event is held annually at Buscat Resort, Cluj, and emphasizes an authentic nature experience with a festival atmosphere. The courses are carefully marked and equipped with aid stations, and each runner receives a participation kit with official gear and other benefits.
course_highlights: Courses through the dense forests and spectacular ridgelines of the Apuseni Mountains
Passing through the Scărița-Belioara Nature Reserve and the alpine area of Muntele Mare
Courses that include traditional villages and alpine meadows
additional: The participation kit includes official gear, a timing chip, a race bib, a finisher’s medal, access to aid stations and the afterparty, as well as energy drinks depending on the event. The ultramarathon has specific mandatory gear, and the courses are carefully marked and equipped with aid stations. There is a No Limits event dedicated to people with disabilities. The ultramarathon starts at 05:00, and cutoff times are set for checkpoints along the course.

name: ROMANAȚI Trail Run, editia a V-a ~ 6 iunie 2026
description: Romanați Trail Run is a vibrant trail-running race that transforms Caracal into the trail-running capital for a day. The event offers three challenging courses suitable for runners of all levels, with a friendly atmosphere and a community passionate about exercise. The event’s motto encourages competitors to run beyond their own limits and enjoy the course. The event is carefully organized, and participation also supports a charitable cause.
course_highlights: Three challenging courses for all levels
The half-marathon and 12 km race start in Constantin Poroineanu Park, near the 1848 Monument
The half-marathon course is approximately 22.9 km long
additional: Registration for the children’s race takes place on site on race day between 07:00 and 09:30 by completing a form provided by the organizer. The contribution must be paid by bank transfer within 3 business days of registration; failure to pay will result in cancellation of the registration. The half-marathon and 12 km race share a start in Constantin Poroineanu Park, near the 1848 Monument.

name: Dušan Milošević Memorial Trail
description: The Dušan Milošević Memorial Trail is a race held in honor of Serbia’s first Olympian, Dušan Milošević, and takes runners along the most beautiful trails of Rudnik. The race is dedicated to his courage and perseverance, and aims to honor his legacy and the Serbian spirit through running. Three courses are available: the fast, shorter Vihor course; the more challenging Rudnik course, with steep climbs and descents; and the non-competitive Domaćinska course for those who want to enjoy nature. The race is an opportunity to celebrate history, courage, and community.

name: Kup Fruške Gore 2026
description: The Fruška Gora Cup 2026 is a traditional sports, competition and recreation event held on Fruška Gora. The races cover a range of trails, including the ultra-extreme marathon, ultra marathon, middle eastern marathon and beginner trails, with varying levels of difficulty and distance. The event brings together runners from Serbia and abroad, offering challenges on Fruška Gora’s old trails and a chance to enjoy nature and the spirit of sport. The organizers also provide transportation to the start and extensive support throughout the event.

name: Serbia EPIC VRNJAČKA BANJA #4
description: The UCI XCO race in Andrevlje is an exciting competition that brings together elite and junior riders in the men's and women's categories. Held in front of the Ceptor Hotel amid the beautiful surroundings of Andrevlje, it lasts four days and offers an outstanding atmosphere and intense competition. Riders can expect electronic timing, fully marked trails, and a comprehensive race pack with a T-shirt, medal, and refreshments on the course. This is an event that combines a passion for sport with the natural beauty of Serbia.

name: Tara Ultra Trail
description: Tara Ultra Trail is a running adventure in the heart of Tara National Park, held in Mitrovac. The race offers three distances: 12 km, 21 km, and 69 km, taking runners through the mountain’s most beautiful and appealing areas, including Banjska Stena and lesser-known places. The courses are designed for runners of different levels, from beginners to experienced trail runners. All races are ITRA-certified and count toward the ITRA National League. Alongside the race, an all-day outdoor festival for all ages and fitness levels is held in Mitrovac.
course_highlights: The courses pass through the most beautiful parts of Tara National Park, including Banjska Stena
The longest distance, 69 km, features 3,036 m of cumulative elevation gain and spectacular ridges and peaks
The 21 km course leads to Serbia’s best-known viewpoint, Banjska Stena, and the ridge of Aluška Mountain
additional: Time limits are 3 hours for TUT 12, 6 hours for TUT 21, and 17 hours for TUT 69. The start and finish are in Mitrovac. The organizer reserves the right to change the courses according to conditions on the ground. The children’s race for ages 4–12 is free and is part of the outdoor festival. A fee is charged for vehicles entering Tara National Park at the entrance gates, and there is no public transport to Mitrovac. An all-day outdoor festival is planned at the finish. A free children’s race for ages 4 to 12 will also be held. Participants under 18 may not run TUT 69; parental or guardian consent is required for the other distances, and participants under 14 must be accompanied by a parent.

name: 31. ALDI Női Futógála
description: A 31. ALDI Női Futógála egy különleges futóesemény, amely a budapesti Városligetben kerül megrendezésre. A versenyen több táv közül választhatnak a résztvevők, így mindenki megtalálhatja a számára megfelelő kihívást, legyen az 2,5 km, 5 km vagy 10 km. A futógála célja, hogy a résztvevők kiszakadjanak a mindennapokból, élvezzék a mozgás szabadságát, és egy közösségi élmény részesei legyenek. A célban egyedi befutóérem és futópóló várja a futókat, hogy emlékezetessé tegye ezt a napot.

name: Pécs-Orfű-Abaliget Futás 9 / 21
description: A Pécs-Orfű-Abaliget Futás egy aszfaltos futóverseny, amely Pécs, Orfű és Abaliget településeket köti össze, 465 méter szintemelkedéssel. A verseny célja a helyi futóközösségek összekapcsolása és a futás népszerűsítése a dombok és tavak között. A rendezvény hagyományosan június elején kerül megrendezésre, és több távon kínál lehetőséget a részvételre, beleértve a gyerekfutamot is. A szervezők szeretettel várják a futókat, hogy együtt élvezzék a természetet és a közösségi élményt.

name: PÉCS -> ORFŰ -> ABALIGET FÉLMARATON
description: A Pécs-Orfű-Abaliget Futás egy aszfaltos félmaraton, amely Pécs, Orfű és Abaliget településeket köti össze, 465 méter szintemelkedéssel. A verseny célja a helyi futóközösségek összekapcsolása és a futás népszerűsítése a dombok és tavak között. A rendezvény hagyományosan június elején kerül megrendezésre, és családbarát programokat is kínál, például gyerekfutamot. A szervezők a helyi közösségek és az egyetem támogatásával várják a futókat, hogy együtt élvezzék a természetet és a sportot.

name: Bathory Run
location: Sedliska, (okr. Vranov nad Topľou), Sedliska, (okr. Vranov nad Topľou), futbalové ihrisko
organizer: Obec Sedliska a MV Running team Sedliska
description: Bathory Run is a running event in the village of Sedliska near Vranov nad Topľou, offering courses for children, juniors and adults. Runners follow a varied route through an orchard, giving the race a pleasant natural character. The children’s categories start at 10:30, while the men’s and women’s races start at 13:00. The event is organized by the Municipality of Sedliska and MV Running team Sedliska, who ensure a high-quality race experience for all age groups.

name: Spoznaj Trebišov behom – Charity Run
location: Trebišov, Trebišov, námestie pod OD Billa
organizer: Mesto Trebišov, Stredná odborná škola služieb a priemyslu sv. Jozafáta
description: The Charity Run in Trebišov is a traditional event that brings together running, walking, Nordic walking and cycling. This charity run offers an opportunity to discover the city of Trebišov while supporting a good cause. The event is organised by Majcher-Production s.r.o. and is suitable for the general public who want to spend time actively and contribute to charity.

name: Šamorínska bežecká liga 2026 – 4. kolo
description: The Šamorín Running League (ŠBL) is a series of races organized by 3klub Šamorín, open to the general public with no age or performance limits. Runners compete in the men’s, women’s, boys’ and girls’ categories, with shorter distances for children’s races. The league runs throughout the year and includes the traditional Pomlé Run. The entry fee covers race bibs, timekeeping, refreshments and league scoring. The overall league standings are officially announced and the top runners are awarded in the final round.

name: Šebešská pätnástka
location: Vyšná Šebastová okr. Prešov, Vyšná Šebastová okr. Prešov, futbalové ihrisko Vyšná Šebastová
description: Šebešská Pätnástka is a running race organized by the MTC Vyšná Šebastová club in cooperation with the Vyšná Šebastová municipal office and sports associations. The main course is 15.5 km long and includes a climb to Nevická chata, complemented by a recreational 3 km course and children’s events for various age groups. The race takes place every year on the Sunday of the first weekend in June, with a morning start and a rich cultural and social program that attracts hundreds of visitors. The event is part of several running competitions and a league, and the organizers emphasize promoting sport and building the village’s reputation. Šebešská Pätnástka received the Running Diamond award in 2011 and 2012.

name: Tinca Cross
description: Tinca Cross is a running race organized by ACS Bihorul Oradea in partnership with Tinca Town Hall and the Local Council. The event includes 5 km and 10 km cross-country races, suitable for endurance runners aged 14 and over. The course starts at Tinca Community Stadium and follows a 2.5 km loop through the forest next to the stadium, finishing at the stadium. Participants under 18 need written consent from a parent or guardian. Cash prizes and diplomas are awarded to the top finishers.

name: Color Run Arilje
description: Color Run Arilje is a sports and recreational race that combines running and fun, with participants passing through color zones. The course runs through Arilje and along the Rzav River, and the event brings together participants from different parts of Serbia. Everyone is welcome to experience the town and its surroundings in a cheerful, active atmosphere.
course_highlights: Around seven kilometers through Arilje and alongside the Rzav River.
Cross three bridges and pass through color zones.
Varied terrain with climbs, descents, and a water crossing.

name: Village Trail
description: The race offers a blend of sport, nature, and adventure, with two courses winding through beautiful landscapes, including a viewpoint overlooking the Danube and Belgrade. The start and finish are at the Dunavska Terasa restaurant, and the event is suitable for both experienced runners and beginners. In addition to the race, an entertainment program is provided for children and families, while runners can look forward to support from volunteers and an after-run party.

name: Angličák night run Pezinok
description: Angličák Night Run Pezinok is a 5-kilometre night race held at the Rozálka Sports and Recreation Area in Pezinok. Runners can enjoy a fast, dynamic run along a route through the Malé Karpaty region, illuminated by artificial lights to create a unique atmosphere. The event is open to everyone aged 15 and over, with starting corrals divided according to ability. The organizers prioritize safety, so headphones are prohibited, and reflective gear or headlamps are recommended. Registration is available online and is tied to the runner’s name; preregistration is also possible.

name: Runway Run
location: Kamenica nad Cirochou Airport, Kamenica nad Cirochou, Slovakia
description: Runway Run is a unique running race held at the airport in Kamenica nad Cirochou, giving runners the chance to experience an unusual course directly on the airport runway. The race is suitable for the general public and creates a welcoming atmosphere with race instructions and accompanying activities. The event is known for its security check and opening of the runway entrance to runners, ensuring the race runs professionally.
course_highlights: The course runs directly along the airport runway
Security check before entering the runway
An atmosphere featuring partner presentations and accompanying competitions
additional: The program includes the opening and partner presentations at 18:00, a competition for runners with Rádio Košice at 18:30, opening of the runway entrance and a security check at 18:30, and the announcement of results at 20:45. Registration is available by bank transfer or in person during late registration at the venue.

name: The Run Slovakia
location: naprieč Slovenskom, naprieč Slovenskom, Košice, ul. Hlavná, resp. Teplička nad Váhom
description: THE RUN SLOVAKIA 2026 is a national relay race across Slovakia, held over three days. Runners cover more than 530 km together from Košice to Bratislava, passing through beautiful natural scenery, historic landmarks and picturesque towns. The event offers a unique sporting atmosphere, teamwork and many unforgettable experiences. The route passes notable sites such as Spiš Castle, the High Tatras, Orava Castle and the Little Carpathians, and runners can also enjoy a varied programme of accompanying activities.

name: SepsiRun
description: SepsiRun is a running festival held in the city of Sfântu Gheorghe and its surroundings. Its goal is to become the largest running event in the area, attracting over 1,000 participants from across the country. The event features several races on urban and trail routes, suitable for all experience levels, with distances ranging from 5 km to 23 km. SepsiRun offers a complete running experience, combining nature and the city with varied routes and a welcoming atmosphere for runners.

name: Pedală în Bănie ~ 2026
distance_verbose: 43 km, 24 km, 14 km, 3000 metri, 1.53 km, 0.6 km
description: Pedală în Bănie is a longstanding sporting event in the Dolj region, dedicated to mountain biking and trail running enthusiasts. Held in the Palilula area of Craiova, the event offers routes inspired by the “JURASSIC” theme, with challenges that test participants’ strength, speed, and endurance. With a variety of races for all ages and ability levels, Pedală în Bănie promotes health, community spirit, and environmental protection, offering a complete experience of competition and adventure in nature. Its friendly atmosphere and thoughtful organization make it a celebration of sport and outdoor activity.

name: Brutálfutás 15.0
description: A Brutálfutás 15.0 egy könnyed akadályfutó verseny Nyáregyházán, ahol a résztvevők 2,3 vagy 7 kilométeres távokon teljesíthetnek egy katonai kiképzőpálya és akadályverseny keverékét. A verseny nem a teljesítményről, hanem a jó hangulatról és a felejthetetlen élményekről szól, ahol a sár és a víz garantált. Egyedi befutóéremmel és sok sárral várják a futókat, akik akár jótékony futóként is nevezhetnek. A rendezvény az ország több száz településéről vonzza a résztvevőket, és egy igazán szórakoztató, családias hangulatú esemény.

name: Bábolna Bio Sunset Run
location: Bábolna Strand- és Termálfürdő, Bábolna, Hungary

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Ovis futam -> ingyenes, de regisztrációhoz kötött

description: A Bábolna Bio Sunset Run egy hangulatos, naplementében induló futóverseny, amelyet 2027. június 12-én rendeznek meg Bábolna központjában, a Bábolna Strand- és Termálfürdő előtt. A verseny útvonala érinti a lovardát, valamint a híres Bábolnai Arborétumot és Állatparkot, így a futók egy különleges természeti környezetben élvezhetik a futást. A résztvevők három táv közül választhatnak, a félmaratoni táv váltóban is teljesíthető. A verseny különlegessége az esti rajt és az extra hangulatvilágítás, valamint a BioTechUSA frissítések a frissítőpontokon. Minden szintidőn belül célba érkező futót egyedi befutóéremmel jutalmaznak, az estét pedig a Thermálfürdőben lehet zárni.
course_highlights: A futókör érinti a lovardát és a Bábolnai Arborétumot és Állatparkot
Naplementében induló verseny extra hangulatvilágítással
5,25 km egy kör, 10,5 km két kör, félmaraton négy kör a pályán
additional: A versenyen prémium rajtcsomagként MIZUNO eseménypólót kapnak a résztvevők. A frissítőpontokon teljes BioTechUSA frissítést biztosítanak. A versenyiroda Budapesten, a Tüzér utca 9-11 alatt található, ahol személyes nevezés is lehetséges. A verseny végén az Athletes Gardenben várják a futókat a befutóéremmel, az estét pedig a Thermálfürdőben lehet zárni.

name: Edelényi Kastélysziget Esti Körök 3 / 7 / 14 / 21
location: Edelény, L'Huillier-Coburg kastély, Borsodi út 7, 3780 Magyarország
description: Az Edelényi Kastélysziget Esti Körök egy hangulatos futóverseny, amely a L'Huillier-Coburg kastély környékén kerül megrendezésre. A verseny több távon kínál lehetőséget a futóknak, így mindenki megtalálhatja a számára megfelelő kihívást. A rendezvény ideális választás azoknak, akik szeretik a kastélypark különleges atmoszféráját és az esti futás élményét. A verseny szervezői professzionális időméréssel és kényelmes regisztrációs felülettel várják a résztvevőket.

name: Kecskeméti Sport Fesztivál
description: A Kecskeméti Sport Fesztivál egy hagyományos, közösségi sportesemény Kecskeméten, a Benkó domb környékén. A rendezvény változatos futóversenyeket és túrákat kínál, amelyek között ultrafutás és rövidebb távok is megtalálhatók. A futók élvezhetik a természet közelségét, a szép időjárást és a jó hangulatot, miközben a helyi közösség támogatásával sportolnak. A fesztivál célja a sport és a szabadidős tevékenységek népszerűsítése a térség lakói között.
course_highlights: Benkó Zoltán Park és környéke festői természeti környezetben
Változatos távok 300 métertől akár 68 kilométerig
Ultrafutás és klasszikus dombfutás a Benkó domb körül
additional: A versenyeken többféle táv és kategória érhető el, az ultrafutók akár 6 órán át is teljesíthetnek köröket. A rendezvényekhez kapcsolódóan jótékonysági akciók is zajlanak, például a Trizoli Jótifuti Egyesület támogatására. A futók a célba érkezéskor csomagot kapnak, amelyben helyi pékség süteményei is megtalálhatók. A rendezvények jó hangulatát a helyi támogatók és civil szervezetek segítik.

name: UTBT (Ultra Tokaj-Bodrogkeresztúr-Tarcal)
description: Az Ultra Tokaj - Bodrogkeresztúr - Tarcal egy 63 km-es futóverseny, amely a Tokaj-hegyalja festői tájain, szőlőültetvények és dombok között vezet. A verseny három különböző távon kerül megrendezésre, így kezdő és tapasztalt futók egyaránt megtalálhatják a számukra megfelelő kihívást. A rendezvény nem csupán egy verseny, hanem egy különleges élmény Magyarország egyik legszebb borvidékén. A rajtok tömegrajttal indulnak, és egyéni vagy csapat kategóriákban is lehet nevezni.
course_highlights: 63 km-es táv Tokaj-hegyalja legendás útvonalán
Szőlőültetvények és dombok között vezető festői táj
Útvonal követése track formájában, táblákkal és aszfaltfestéssel segítve
additional: A versenyen egyéni és 2-3-4 fős csapatok is indulhatnak. A rajtok tömegrajttal történnek, a csapatok rajtidejét legkésőbb június 5-ig teszik közzé. A versenyzők frissítést kapnak az útvonalon és a célban, valamint letölthető elektronikus oklevelet és fotókat a versenyről. A szintidők: Ultra 8 óra, Maraton 6 óra, Félmaraton 3 óra. A 18 év alatti versenyzőknek szülői hozzájáruló nyilatkozatot kell leadniuk.

name: BRUTÁLFUTÁS
description: A Brutálfutás egy könnyed akadályfutó verseny Nyáregyházán, ahol a résztvevők 2,3 vagy 7 kilométeres távokon, sárban és változatos akadályok között teljesíthetnek. A verseny hangulata bulis, vidám, és nem a teljesítményen, hanem az élményen van a hangsúly. A helyszín egy motocross pálya, ahol katonai kiképzőpálya és akadályverseny elemek keverednek, így garantált a felejthetetlen kaland. Minden résztvevőt egyedi befutóérem és sok-sok sár vár. A rendezvényt a Budapest Sportiroda (BSI) szervezi, és több ezer futó vesz részt az ország számos településéről.
course_highlights: Katonai kiképzőpálya és akadályverseny elemek keveréke
Sárban és vízben teljesítendő akadályok
Nyáregyházi motocross pálya változatos terepe
additional: A versenyen több rajtidőpont is van mindkét távon, a rövidtáv rajtjai 9:30-tól 11:00-ig, a hosszútáv rajtjai 12:00-tól 15:30-ig indulnak. A nevezés kizárólag online történik, bankkártyával vagy SZÉP kártyával fizetve. Minden résztvevő egyedi malackás befutóérmet kap. A helyszín könnyen megközelíthető az M5-ös autópályáról, a motocross pálya a 405-ös út 9-es kilométerénél található.

name: Ultra Nízke Tatry
description: Ultra Nízke Tatry is the inaugural edition of a mountain running event that follows the ridge of the Low Tatras from west to east. The course is 49.7 km long with 2,650 metres of elevation gain, following marked hiking trails from Donovaly to Srdiečko. The event is part of the Slovak Skyrunning Association calendar and also serves as the Milan Styko Memorial, honouring a prominent runner and mountaineer who tragically died in 2025. The start is scheduled for 7:00 in Donovaly, by the Donovaly Brewery.

name: Strečnianska mašľa
description: Strečnianska mašľa is a mountain ultramarathon and long-distance hike around Strečno. The race offers two routes: a challenging 50 km route with approximately 2,985 metres of elevation gain, and a shorter 25 km route, which is also suitable for runners with dogs. The routes follow marked hiking trails through both parts of the Malá Fatra and part of the national park, with the start and finish at the Radinové football field in Strečno. The organizers provide race packs, prizes for the top finishers, and quality conditions for participants.

name: Krosak pod hradom
location: Trnava pri Laborci, okr. Michalovce, Trnava pri Laborci, okr. Michalovce, Obecný úrad
organizer: Mgr. Ján Podstavský, Vladimír Adam, Ing. Ladislav Ondrik, Vladimír Sikorai, Gabriel Sabo, Štefan Karafa
description: Krosák pod hradom is a running race in Trnava pri Laborci, offering various categories, including the 10 km Big Cross, the 5 km Small Cross, a health run, and Nordic walking. The course follows farm and forest roads with asphalt surfaces, and the Big Cross consists of two 5 km loops. The race is part of the Michalovce–Sobrance Running League and is suitable for a wide range of runners, from juniors to veterans. The race starts at the Municipal Office in Trnava pri Laborci, with children’s categories starting at 9:00 and the main race at 11:00.

name: Kysucký maratón
location: Čadca, Čadca, Matičné námestie - pred Domom kultúry Čadca
description: The Kysuce Marathon is the second-oldest marathon in Slovakia and a major sporting and social event in the Kysuce region. The course follows the picturesque Kysuce Valley along the Kysuca River, with a safer and more attractive route on the cycling path for runners from 2025. In addition to the marathon, the event includes a half marathon, a marathon relay, and a minimarathon for children. The start and finish are at Matičné Square in Čadca, in front of the House of Culture. Runners compete in various age categories and have access to aid stations and facilities including changing rooms and wellness services.

name: Beh Hodkovským parkom
location: Žehra časť Hodkovce, Žehra časť Hodkovce, Kaštieľ Hodkovce 1, Žehra, areál DSS DOMOVINA no.
description: The Run Through Hodkovce Park is a running event held in the grounds of Hodkovce Manor in Žehra. The course runs mainly along field and forest roads with an asphalt surface. The event is divided into categories: an 8 km competitive run for men and women in various age groups, and non-competitive 4 km categories for Run for Health and Nordic walking, with no age limit. The organizer, DOMOVINA n.o., ensures a welcoming atmosphere and quality organization for all participants. Online entry is available at a discounted price, encouraging early registration.

name: Beh Kalváriou
description: The Kalvária Run is a charity race held in the beautiful surroundings of Kalvária in Považská Bystrica. The event offers courses for both adults and children, with forest roads making up the course surface. This fourth edition is an opportunity to experience community, exercise and joy, while the proceeds from the run go to children in need. The organizers emphasize high-quality organization and support for charitable causes.

name: Lemešanská bežecká liga 2. Letné kolo
location: Lemešany, Lemešany, Lúka nad obcou Lemešany
organizer: Obec Lemešany, Športová komisia obce Lemešany, Záhrada pohybu
description: The 2nd Summer Round of the Lemešany Running League is a running event held in Lemešany, on the meadow above the village. The race is divided into several categories by age and gender, including children’s categories and Nordic walking. The main categories start at 17:00, and the children’s categories start at 17:10. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant atmosphere for a summer race.

name: Beh na chatu pri Zelenom plese – Memoriál K. Jakeša
location: Tatranské Matliare, Tatranské Matliare, Kežmarská Biela voda, pri zastávke SAD
description: The Run to the Green Lake Hut is a mountain race for sports and nature enthusiasts, suitable for both amateur and professional athletes. The event has been held regularly since 2005 on the second weekend of June and commemorates Karel Jakeš, a prominent Czechoslovak mountaineer. The route crosses challenging mountain terrain with significant elevation gain, making the race a test for all participants. The aim is to bring together different sporting groups and offer them a unique experience in the beautiful surroundings of the High Tatras.

name: Maratonul Nordului
description: The Northern Marathon is a sporting event that brings together nature and spirit in northern Romania, offering spectacular routes for runners of all levels. The event promotes health, community, and adventure, taking place amid the impressive natural landscapes of Botoșani and its surroundings. Participants can choose from several races, including marathon, trail, and MTB, enjoying a complete experience that combines sport with tourism and local culture.
course_highlights: Spectacular routes through northern Romania
A variety of races: marathon, trail, and MTB
Natural landscapes and authentic local communities
additional: Registrations validated by April 10 guarantee the official race T-shirt. After June 20, the technical T-shirt or personalized items in the race kit are not guaranteed. The organizer will decide whether race-day registrations will be allowed and will announce this in advance. Spectacular routes, outdoor event, community participation

name: Retezat Sky Race
description: Retezat SkyRace is a skyrunning race held in the spectacular landscape of Romania’s Retezat Mountains, offering runners a challenging experience on varied, technical mountain trails. The event combines the challenges of rugged terrain with the natural beauty of ridges, valleys, and alpine lakes, and is designed for mountain-running and adventure enthusiasts. Organized with careful attention to safety and respect for the environment, the race offers a passionate community and opportunities to connect with others and push personal limits. Participants can experience a true mountain adventure in the heart of the Retezat Mountains.

name: Maraton Maramureș
description: Maramureș Marathon is a mountain race set amid the picturesque landscapes of Baia Mare and its surroundings. The routes include a 13 km run and hike, a 21 km mountain half marathon, and a full 42 km marathon, each offering challenges and spectacular views. Participants will tackle sustained climbs, trails along the shore of the Firiza Reservoir, and areas with impressive panoramas of the local peaks. The event is suitable both for experienced mountain runners and for those seeking a trail-running experience in nature.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://maratonmaramures.ro/): 2027-06-12 — "12 iunie 2027" (was estimated 2027-06-19)

name: Maratonul Sării
description: The Salt Marathon is a sporting event that combines running and mountain biking, set in the natural and historic landscape of Târgu Ocna, Bacău County. Participants can choose between 10 km and 21 km trail-running races, as well as a 30 km mountain-bike race, all starting and finishing in the Town Hall Square. A unique feature of the competition is a 7 km section through the underground galleries of the Târgu Ocna Salt Mine, offering an unusual experience and health benefits thanks to the ionized air. The event promotes an active lifestyle and responsible stewardship of nature, and includes plogging activities to clean up the routes.

name: Maraton Tarcău
location: Mănăstirea Tarcău, comuna Tarcău, jud. Neamţ
description: Tarcău Marathon is an annual competition held in the natural landscape of the Tarcău area in Neamț, offering marathon, half-marathon, and cross-country races. The event emphasizes physical preparation and suitable equipment, ensuring a complete and safe sporting experience.
