Participants can collect their race kit the day before the competition and must follow the official race rules. Cutoff times are clearly set for each race, ensuring a competitive and well-organized event.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://maraton-tarcau.ro/): 2027-06-12 — "Maraton Tarcau 12 IUNIE 2027" (was estimated 2027-06-19)

name: Atinge OMU
description: Atinge Omu is a mountain running race held in the first ten days of June, along the Peștera–Omu Peak route and back. The event offers runners an intense experience amid the spectacular scenery of the Bucegi Mountains, when the ridges are tinged red with rhododendron. At the finish, participants are rewarded with bulz grilled over embers and jintiță, in a friendly, traditional atmosphere.
course_highlights: Mountain route: Peștera–Omu Peak–Peștera
Spectacular views of rhododendron flowers on the ridges of the Bucegi Mountains
The race starts at the Peștera Cable Car
additional: The start area is at the Peștera Cable Car. At the finish, bulz grilled over embers and jintiță are served to all participants.

name: Semimaratonul Eroilor Invictus
description: The Invictus Heroes Half Marathon is an annual sporting event held in Bistrița, dedicated to commemorating Heroes’ Day and promoting health through sport. The event brings together amateur and elite athletes, offering a running experience on a specially designed city course. The organizers emphasize honoring the memory of the heroes and involving the local community. Participants receive a race kit with a bib number and timing chip.
course_highlights: Urban course in the city of Bistrița
Start and finish in Piața Centrală
Event dedicated to Heroes’ Day, June 10
additional: Participants receive a race bib and timing chip. The event is organized under the High Patronage of Prince Radu and involves numerous local partners and collaborators. Participants can obtain the official Invictus T-shirt and other merchandise.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://semimaratonuleroilor.ro/regulament/): 2027-06-12 — "Evenimentul are loc în orașul Bistrița, în data de 12 iunie 2027" (was estimated 2027-05-29)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Evenimentul are loc în orașul Bistrița, în data de 12 iunie 2027

name: Maraton Scaunul Domnului
location: Bistra Mureșului, Deda, Mureș County, Romania
distance_verbose: 100 km, 50 km, Maraton, 25 km, Semimaraton, 15 km
description: Scaunul Domnului Marathon is a challenging mountain race held in the Scaunul Domnului Nature Reserve, offering 42 km, 21 km, and 10 km routes. Participants can discover spectacular volcanic landscapes and experience running on varied trails with significant elevation changes. The event is organized with a focus on runner safety, with well-placed checkpoints and hydration stations. The atmosphere is rounded out by an awards ceremony and post-race social activities.
course_highlights: 42 km route with 2,100 m of positive elevation gain
Spectacular views towards the Călimani Ridge and lookout areas with a risk of falling
Multiple checkpoints, hydration stations, and refreshment points along the route
additional: Race kits can be picked up on Friday, June 12, from 17:00 to 23:00 and Saturday, June 13, from 6:00 to 8:00 for the main races. Mandatory equipment checks take place before the start. Each race has time limits and intermediate checkpoints. Competitor parking is arranged in a designated area beside the Blidăreasa forest road, accessible from the Bistra Valley.

name: The Color Run Iași
description: The Color Run Iași is an untimed 5-kilometer race, known as the “Happiest 5k on the Planet,” celebrating health, joy, and originality through a colorful, high-energy experience. Participants run, dance, and enjoy a festive atmosphere, getting covered in vibrant powder at every kilometer. The event is open to all ages and promotes an active, fun lifestyle, culminating in a colorful post-race party. The Color Run is a celebration of community and movement, offering a memorable day for all participants.
course_highlights: Untimed 5 km race with colored powder at every kilometer
Festive atmosphere with music and a post-race party featuring a cloud of colored powder
Open to all ages, with no minimum or maximum age limit
additional: Children aged 0 to 6 can participate for free and receive a race bib, medal, and colored powder, but must be accompanied by an adult. The standard kit includes a T-shirt, race bib, temporary tattoos, bandana, medal, and colored powder. Participants with disabilities and their companions receive free access in accordance with the law. Registration is online, and the entry fee varies depending on the registration period. The event promotes respect for the environment and sportsmanship throughout the race.

name: PENIEL TRAIL RUN
description: Peniel Trail Run is a nature running event held on trail routes in the Bistrița area, promoting health through movement, community, and truth. The event combines physical effort with a profound message about living life to the fullest in body, mind, and spirit. It is for those seeking more than a competition: an authentic experience that brings people together and points them toward Christ. The name Peniel means “place of meeting,” symbolizing a living connection with God and personal transformation. The routes offer a varied, runnable, and beautiful experience, suitable for both beginners and advanced runners.
course_highlights: The half-marathon route (21 km) has approximately 650 m of elevation gain, shares sections with the 10 km route, and includes a scenic loop in the Tărpiu area.
The 10 km route is fast, easy, and very runnable, with approximately 270 m of elevation gain, on a route rarely used for competitions.
The accessible 5 km route has two short climbs, including one through a fir forest, and is suitable for beginners and competitive runners.
additional: The event includes a Kids Cross race for children, promoting fun and exercise for the little ones. The official event T-shirt is provided to participants. Routes may undergo minor changes before the event, and the organizers promote a healthy, balanced lifestyle centered on community and faith.

name: Stara Planina 2026
description: Stara Planina Skiing 2026 is a four-day winter program offering skiing, sledding, walks, and socializing amid the unspoiled nature of Stara Planina. Enjoy the thrills and beautiful scenery at the Babin Zub ski resort, with over 13 kilometers of groomed runs of varying difficulty, including a freeride run and an artificial snowmaking system. The program is for skiers and winter sports enthusiasts, with departures from Belgrade and Niš and accommodation at Ždrma Inn. If there is not enough snow, hiking tours are organized, making the event accessible to nature lovers and those seeking an active holiday.

name: Vidra Gradac Trail
description: Vidra Gradac Trail offers a unique running experience along the Gradac River, known for its unspoiled nature and crystal-clear water. The course winds through a canyon rich in wildlife and varied terrain, including forest trails, rocky riverbanks, and stream crossings. This race combines natural beauty and adventure, making it ideal for runners who want to experience trail running at its most scenic. It takes place in Valjevo, Serbia, and is part of the West Serbia Trails series, which connects the mountains, rivers, and valleys of western Serbia.

name: X. Sopron Trail 5 / 10 / 25
organizer: Sopron Város Polgármesteri Hivatal Sportfelügyeleti Csoportja, SMAFC Tájfutó Szakosztálya, SMAFC Tájfutó Sportjáért Alapítvány, Sopron-Trail
description: A verseny célja a terepfutás népszerűsítése és a Soproni-hegység vadregényes részeinek bemutatása. Több táv közül választhatnak a résztvevők, köztük 5.9 km, 10.7 km és 25.9 km, melyek között az Alpokalja Terepkirály futósorozat része is megtalálható. A verseny különleges extra kihívást is kínál egy időméréses emelkedő szakaszon, ahol a legjobb férfi és női futó különdíjat kap. A versenyközpont a Brennbergbánya Kultúrházában található, ahol mosdó és zuhanyzó is rendelkezésre áll.

name: CROSSKOVÁCSI Dockyard Terepfutó verseny
description: A Crosskovácsi Dockyard Terepfutó verseny egy változatos terepfutó esemény Nagykovácsi festői környezetében, a Teleki-Tisza kastély parkjában. A verseny több távon kínál kihívást, melyek mindegyike egy 1 km-es felvezető körrel kezdődik a kastélyparkon belül. A Hegyi Félmaraton távját teljesítők befutó emlékérmet kapnak, a verseny során pedig több frissítőpont áll a futók rendelkezésére. A verseny elektronikus időméréssel zajlik, és a szervezők kiemelt figyelmet fordítanak a résztvevők biztonságára, orvosi ellátás biztosításával.
course_highlights: Felvezető kör a kastélyparkon belül minden távon (1 km)
Két frissítőpont a pályán, valamint frissítők a célban
Hegyi Félmaraton távján három frissítőpont és befutó emlékérem
additional: Rajtszámátvétel és helyszíni nevezés 2027. június 13-án 7:45 és 9:00 között. A Hegyi Félmaraton távon indulók saját "soft-cup" poharat hozzanak a frissítőpontokhoz. A verseny mentési rendszerében terepjárók és orvosi személyzet áll rendelkezésre. A nevezési díj átutalható az Erste Banknál vezetett számlára.

name: SRI CHINMOY FUTÓFESZTIVÁL
location: Széchenyi István University Hegedűs Gyula Dormitory playground, Győr, Hungary
description: A Sri Chinmoy Futófesztivál egy változatos távokat kínáló futóverseny Győrben, amely lehetőséget ad minden futónak, hogy megtalálja a számára megfelelő kihívást. A versenyen 5 km-től egészen ultramaratoni távokig lehet nevezni, egyénileg vagy csapatban. A rendezvény célja, hogy a résztvevők túlszárnyalják önmagukat egy barátságos és támogató közegben. A helyszín a Széchenyi István Egyetem Hegedűs Gyula Kollégiumának udvara, amely ideális környezetet biztosít a futáshoz.
course_highlights: Távok 5 km-től 50 km-ig egyéni és csapat kategóriában
Győr Püspökerdő és egyetemi kollégium környéke
Változatos terep és lehetőség félmaraton, maraton és ultramaraton teljesítésére
additional: A versenyen egyéni és csapat nevezés is lehetséges. A rendezvény hagyományosan reggel 8 órakor kezdődik. A versenyzők többféle táv közül választhatnak, így mindenki megtalálhatja a számára megfelelő kihívást. A korábbi rajt- és célterület a Széchenyi István Egyetem Hegedűs Gyula Kollégiuma mögötti játszótérnél volt.

name: Račiansky kros – leto
description: Račiansky kros LETO is a running race held in Bratislava-Rača, offering three courses of varying distances and elevation gains. The route runs mostly through forest terrain, with some asphalt sections, and is well marked with colored ribbons and arrows on the ground and on trees. Runners can compete on the 16 km and 9.5 km courses, as well as children’s courses. The start and finish are in Knižkova dolina. The event is suitable for the general public and offers age- and gender-based categories, with prizes for the top finishers.
course_highlights: 16 km course with +503 m elevation gain and a 3-hour time limit
9.5 km course with +335 m elevation gain and a 2-hour time limit
The course surface is 80% forest and 20% asphalt
additional: The route is marked with pink ribbons, white flour arrows on the ground, and laminated arrows on trees in blue, pink, and orange. The required gear is a race bib, visibly fastened to the chest. The race results are scheduled to be announced shortly after the last runners finish.

name: Vranovská desiatka
location: Vranov nad Topľou, Vranov nad Topľou, Dom kultúry vo Vranove nad Topľou, M. R. Štefánika 875
organizer: Mesto Vranov nad Topľou, Mestský športový klub Vranov nad Topľou, Mestský dom kultúry
description: Vranovská desiatka is a traditional running race in the town of Vranov nad Topľou, offering 10 km and 5 km courses. The race is organized by the Town of Vranov nad Topľou, the Municipal Sports Club, and the Municipal Cultural Centre. Categories are divided by age and gender, and the top three runners from Vranov are also recognized. The start and finish are at the Cultural Centre in Vranov nad Topľou. The race is suitable for the general public, from recreational runners to competitors.

name: Čeľovská sedmička
location: Čeľovce, okr. Trebišov, Čeľovce, okr. Trebišov, pred Kultúrnym domom
description: Čeľovská sedmička is a running event held in the village of Čeľovce, Trebišov District, in front of the Cultural Centre. The race is open to various categories, including men, women, families and children, and also offers a summer walk and a competition for the youngest runners. The event is part of the Beh.sk running community and promotes an active lifestyle in the pleasant setting of the village.

name: Tatranská 15
organizer: Obecný úrad Mlynčeky, Športoví nadšenci z Mlynčekov
description: Tatranská 15 is a running race organized by the Mlynčeky Municipal Office and sports enthusiasts from Mlynčeky. The race takes place at the football field in Mlynčeky and offers runners the chance to experience the atmosphere of a sporting event in beautiful surroundings. A discounted entry fee is available for early registration, and it is also possible to register on race day. The organizers welcome all runners and sports enthusiasts to this traditional event.

name: Crosul Supereroilor
description: The Superheroes Run is an energizing race that brings together thousands of participants in Cluj-Napoca as part of Sports Festival. The event promotes team spirit and fun, offering a unique sporting experience in the heart of the city. Participants can enjoy a vibrant atmosphere and challenges on routes suited to all ages and fitness levels.
course_highlights: Urban route in the Cluj Arena area
Event part of Sports Festival
Friendly, energizing atmosphere for all ages
additional: The 2025 edition took place at Cluj Arena, and half of the registration fee went to the Via Transilvanica project by the Tășuleasa Social Association.

name: SPORTS FESTIVAL Alergăm pentru Cluj!
description: Sports Festival is the largest multisport event in Romania, held in Cluj-Napoca. The festival combines sports competitions, introductory activities, demonstrations, concerts, and educational events, offering a unique sports and entertainment experience for all ages. Crosul Supereroilor, a 5 km and 10 km race, is an important part of the festival, motivating participants to run for a social cause in support of the Via Transilvanica community. The event brings together champions, supporters, and sports enthusiasts in a festive and welcoming setting.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.sportsfestival.com/crosul-supereroilor/): 2027-06-13 — "Supereroii se aliniază din nou la start, în 13 iunie 2027!" (was estimated 2027-06-20)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Supereroii se aliniază din nou la start, în 13 iunie 2027!

name: Topoloveni Summer Tour ~ 2026
description: Topoloveni Summer Tour is an event for amateur cyclists in Romania, organized by Riders Club. Participants can choose to enjoy an outdoor ride or compete for a place in the national amateur cycling rankings. The route is carefully prepared to protect the natural environment, and course markings will be kept to a minimum to respect the forests and natural areas. The event offers opportunities for all ages, including children’s races and options for families with special discounts. In the event of unfavorable weather conditions, the race may be rescheduled to a backup date.

name: Run for Heroes
description: Run for Heroes is an annual charity race that brings together runners of all ages and their families, including pets, to support free psychotherapy services. The event takes place in Herăstrău Park in Bucharest and offers accessible, dynamic courses suitable for amateurs, families, and people with disabilities. Participants receive superhero costumes and themed kits, and every kilometer run contributes to a noble cause. The atmosphere is full of energy, fun, and community solidarity.
course_highlights: Flat, fully marked urban courses suitable for runners of all levels
A special course accessible to people with disabilities
Pets are welcome, with dedicated areas for families and children
additional: Participants receive the official T-shirt, a superhero cape, themed accessories, a surprise bag, a race number, and a medal. Hydration stations, medical assistance, security, and secure baggage storage are provided. The event includes prizes for the top 3 finishers in the 7 km and 3 km races.

name: Sunrise Marathon
description: The Sunrise Marathon in Bačka Palanka supports the mission of the Sunrise Association, an organization that provides free summer day camps for children with cancer and their siblings. Runners are invited to join Team Sunrise and help bring joy and happiness back to children battling this disease through running and fundraising. By taking part in the race, participants have the opportunity to support unique programs and camps that bring smiles and hope to children around the world.

name: I. Szentivánéji Futótűz 5 / 10 / 21
description: Az I. Szentivánéji Futótűz egy éjszakai futófesztivál Balatonszárszón, a Tóparti parkban, amely Szent Iván éjjelén, az év legrövidebb éjszakáján kerül megrendezésre. A versenyen több táv közül választhatnak a résztvevők, beleértve a félmaratont és rövidebb fesztiváltávokat, valamint gyerekfutamokat is. A rendezvény célja a balatoni nyár megnyitása egy hangulatos, közösségi sporteseménnyel, amely családbarát és minden korosztály számára nyitott. A verseny a RUNTIME Balaton szervezésében zajlik, amely a Balaton környékén több sporteseményt is lebonyolít. A nevezési díj tartalmazza a részvételt, frissítést és egy rövidujjú technikai pólót is megvásárolhatnak a résztvevők.
course_highlights: Éjszakai futófesztivál Balatonszárszón, a Tóparti parkban
5,25 km-es körök, félmaraton és rövidebb fesztiváltávok
Gyermekfutamok 400 m és 1000 m távokon a Balaton-parti utcákon
additional: A váltás a célkapunál kialakított váltóponton történik chipes rajtszám átadásával, javasolt rajtszámtartó öv használata. A nevezési díj befizetése online bankkártyás, átutalásos vagy KH SZÉP kártyás fizetéssel lehetséges. A versenyközpont 18:30-kor nyit, a helyszíni nevezés a rajt előtt 10 perccel zár. Balatonszárszói lakosoknak 30% kedvezmény jár a nevezési díjból. A rendezvény az Ötpróba program része, ahol pontokat lehet gyűjteni.

name: SZENT LÁSZLÓ TEREPFUTÁS
description: A Szent László terepfutás egy hagyományos terepfutó verseny, amelyet a lövész és gyalogság fegyvernem védőszentjének tiszteletére rendeznek meg Baj környékén, a Gerecse hegységben. A versenyt a Tatai Tömegsport és Tájfutó Honvéd Sportegyesület szervezi 2010 óta, és a futók változatos, természetközeli terepen mérhetik össze erejüket. A rendezvény családias hangulatú, és a terepviszonyok miatt igazi kihívást jelent a résztvevőknek. A verseny a sport és a természet szeretetét ötvözi, így minden futó számára élménydús esemény.
course_highlights: Természetközeli terep a Gerecse hegységben
Változatos domborzati viszonyok és erdei ösvények
A lövész és gyalogság fegyvernem védőszentjének tiszteletére rendezett verseny
additional: A versenyt a Tatai Tömegsport és Tájfutó Honvéd Sportegyesület szervezi, amely több szakosztállyal működik, köztük atlétika és triatlon, tájfutás, természetjárás és sportlövészet. A verseny hagyományosan júniusban kerül megrendezésre, és a terepfutás mellett teljesítménytúra is kapcsolódik hozzá. A verseny történetében csak 2013-ban maradt el árvíz miatt.

name: BALATON BAJNOKSÁG
distance_verbose: 100 km, 50 km, 24 km, 12 km, 6 km, 5 km

name: Beh Ludrovskou dolinou
organizer: Obec Ludrová, OŠK Ludrová, Ružomberskie Strely o.z.
description: The Run Through Ludrovská Valley is a running event held in Ludrovská Valley near the football stadium in Ludrová. The races offer starts for children’s categories on grass and adult categories on forest trails and asphalt. The event is suitable for a wide range of ages, from children to seniors, with categories divided by age. The organizers are the Municipality of Ludrová, OŠK Ludrová, and Ružomberskie Strely o.z., who ensure a welcoming atmosphere and quality organization.

name: Prešov Running Series 2. kolo
description: The 2nd round of the Prešov Running Series, known as Šariš Run, is a running event held on the banks of the ponds in Veľký Šariš, beneath the historic Šariš Castle. This venue is new to the series and has become very popular with runners. The event is full of sporting spirit, community, and a love of nature, and also offers a rich program of activities, including musical performances, health booths, a relaxation zone, and activities for children. The friendly, family atmosphere makes the run an unforgettable experience for all participants.

name: Beh cez Zalužické poľa
location: Zalužice, okr. Michalovce, Zalužice, okr. Michalovce,
description: Run through the Zalužice Fields is the second edition of a running event held in the Zalužice area. This race gives runners the opportunity to experience the nature and beauty of Zemplín in summer. The event is part of the Zemplín Extreme series, which offers a range of running challenges in the region.

name: toRunská vrtuľa
location: Stará Turá, Stará Turá, ATC Dubník (KEMP53 - reštaurácia)
organizer: Zuzana Jankovičová, Lívia Skurská, Monika Tomisová
description: toRunská vrtuľa is a charity running and community day in the beautiful surroundings of the Dubník Reservoir in Stará Turá. The event focuses on exercise and helping others, with all proceeds from entry fees donated to fund rehabilitation for Simonka Zigová. Running pairs have 8 hours to complete as many laps around Dubník as possible, in a friendly and supportive atmosphere. The organizers and volunteers run the event without compensation, emphasizing its community and charitable spirit.

name: Ruskovská deviatka
location: Športový areál, Nový Ruskov, Trebišov District, Slovakia
description: Ruskovská 9ka is a running race held at the sports complex in the village of Nový Ruskov. This traditional event gives runners the opportunity to test themselves on a course approximately 9 kilometres long. The race is suitable for the general public and promotes an active lifestyle in the pleasant setting of the village.
course_highlights: The course runs through the sports complex in the village of Nový Ruskov
The course is approximately 9 kilometres long
The race is suitable for both recreational and competitive runners

name: Tatry charity run
location: Tatranská Lomnica, Tatranská Lomnica, Relax Park Jazierko
organizer: Športová Nadácia Kotrmelec, mesto Vysoké Tatry, TANAP
description: Tatry Charity Run is a running event held in Tatranská Lomnica at Relax Park Jazierko. The course is mainly on asphalt and hard-packed terrain, ensuring a comfortable run for all participants. The race is open to the general public and offers categories for men and women in different age groups. It is organized by the Kotrmelec Sports Foundation, the town of Vysoké Tatry, and TANAP, who ensure the event runs smoothly. Online registration is available, with a limit of 300 runners. On-site registration is also available on race day.

name: Beh k Iliašovskej kapličke
description: The Run to the Chapel of Iliašovce is a running event held in Iliašovce at the FK56 football pitch. The race offers two main routes, 5.6 km and 10.8 km long, which run mainly along farm and forest roads. The main category starts at 10:00, and the children’s race starts at 13:00. The event is suitable for runners of a wide range of ages, including children, and offers a pleasant atmosphere in nature.

name: Doby vežu – extrémny prekážkový beh a trail
location: Brezno, Brezno, Lidl Brezno, Československej Armády 2612/68
description: Doby vežu is an extreme obstacle race and trail run held in Brezno, Slovakia. Racers must tackle challenging obstacles and complete a course leading to the top of Slovakia’s second-highest observation tower, which stands 40 metres tall and offers beautiful views. The course runs mainly along forest paths, meadows and a stream, with very little asphalt, and includes steep climbs and descents. In addition to the sporting experience, a fun program of activities is planned for all age groups. The organizer is M.Š.K Jašterice Brezno o.z., and the race director is Marek Janoštiak.

name: Roșia Montană Marathon
description: Roșia Montană Marathon is a sports, eco and socio-cultural event held in the Apuseni Mountains, in the commune of Roșia Montană, Alba County. The 13th edition in 2026 celebrates the area’s nature, history and cultural heritage, offering varied routes for runners of all levels. The event includes marathon, half-marathon, cross-country and children’s races, on routes combining mountain trails, local roads and sections of paved road. Along the way, participants can admire natural landscapes and historic architecture in a setting that promotes a healthy lifestyle and respect for the environment.
course_highlights: Routes with elevation changes along mountain trails and local roads
A combination of mountain and road running
Natural landscapes and centuries-old architectural heritage
additional: The program also includes cultural and social activities, such as creative workshops and concerts. The routes are suitable for both mountain runners and road runners. The event features cultural and environmental activities, community projects and educational initiatives, offering an opportunity to support the area’s natural and cultural heritage.

name: Maratonul Roșia Montană - Cursa Copiilor ~ 2026
description: The Roșia Montană Marathon is a celebration of nature, history, and cultural heritage, held in the heart of the Apuseni Mountains, in the commune of Roșia Montană. The varied routes, which include mountain trails, local roads, and paved sections, offer a unique experience for both mountain runners and road runners. The event includes races for all ages, including the Children’s Race, which follows age-group routes in the historic center of the village. Along the way, participants can admire the natural scenery and centuries-old architectural heritage.

name: Crosul Hoia
description: The Hoia GlobalLogic Cross-Country Run is a running race held in Cluj-Napoca, giving participants the opportunity to run along the cool trails of Hoia Forest. The event includes 15 km, 7 km and 3 km races, as well as a race dedicated to families, making it suitable for runners of all ages and levels. The organizers, Runners Club, promote a friendly atmosphere and support the local running community. The race takes place in June, swapping urban asphalt for nature and offering an outdoor running experience.

name: Urlea Super Vertical
description: Urlea Super Vertical is an extreme and innovative mountain race held in the Breaza area of the Făgăraș Mountains. It is Romania’s most challenging vertical race, covering a distance of 12 km with 1,833 m of elevation gain and reaching an altitude of 2,474 m. Its unique format includes an up-and-down relay, where one partner climbs and the other descends, offering an intense and spectacular experience. The race focuses on vertical adrenaline and mountain spectacle, and is a first for Romanian mountain running.
course_highlights: 12 km with 1,833 m of elevation gain, reaching an altitude of 2,474 m
UP + DOWN relay format, with one partner climbing and the other descending
Route along a forest road and logging road, through deciduous and coniferous forests, and across alpine pasture
additional: Payment is accepted exclusively by bank card, and registration is valid only after full payment. Participants receive a personalized race bib (those who register after 15 July receive a non-personalized bib). Engraved stone finisher medals and an HG superlight technical T-shirt are provided to the first 300 registrants. Aid and hydration stations along the route, a hot meal on the route, medical assistance, photo albums with selfie identification, parking for 360 cars, and Q&A sessions and themed workshops are provided.

name: Maratonul Târnavei
description: The Târnava Marathon is a trail running event held in Târnăveni, Mureș County, promoting a healthy lifestyle and respect for nature. Now in its 10th edition, the marathon offers an outdoor experience surrounded by the natural landscapes of the Transylvania region. The start and finish take place on the premises of Ruck Ventilatoare, and the competition includes several running routes for all ages and fitness levels. The event brings together a community of passionate athletes and supports environmental education and the benefits of running in nature.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the premises of Ruck Ventilatoare
A variety of trail running routes: half marathon 21 km, cross-country 10 km, cross-country 4 km, and Kids Trail Running
Natural landscapes in the Transylvania region, in Mureș County
additional: Race kits can be picked up the day before the event between 18:00 and 21:00 and on race day between 07:00 and 09:30. A fitness instructor leads a warm-up before the start. Races for children are organized by age group. After the competition, there is a Goulash Party, a concert, and the awards ceremony.

name: Cros Montan Traversare Igniș
description: Traversare Igniș is a traditional mountain running competition, now in its 17th edition, bringing together runners and mountain lovers from across the region. The event offers two races in an authentic mountain setting, with substantial elevation gain and spectacular scenery. The routes are marked and have hydration points, and the finish is at Pensiunea Mountain Pearl, the event’s main partner. Participants receive a race kit with a race bib, a T-shirt (if registered by June 2), a medal, access to refreshment points, and medical assistance.
course_highlights: Cross route: 14 km with 1,000 m of positive elevation gain, featuring sustained climbs and technical descents
Half Marathon route: approx. 23 km with 1,450 m of positive elevation gain, for an extra challenge
Hydration points are set up along the routes (2 for the Cross, 4 for the Half Marathon)
additional: The start is at Podul Berdu, in the Ferneziu neighborhood, at the foot of Lake Firiza, accessible by bus no. 1. The race kit includes a chip-timed bib, a T-shirt (available only until June 2), a medal, access to refreshment points, and medical assistance. The finish is at Pensiunea Mountain Pearl. The routes are marked with ribbons and arrows.

name: Ultramaraton Palić
description: The Palić Ultramarathon is a national and international ultramarathon championship held in Palić and organized by the Ultramarathon Association of Serbia. The race includes several disciplines: 6-, 12- and 24-hour races, as well as 50 km and 100 km races, starting and finishing at the Great Terrace. The competition is open to all ultramarathon runners who follow the rules, with participants competing in the overall and age categories. Alongside the competitive spirit, the race offers a well-stocked aid station, a communal lunch and prizes for the top finishers, as well as special prizes for the youngest and oldest participants.

name: Trka prijateljstva Kula
description: The Friendship Race in Kula is a traditional event held since 2009 that promotes sport, friendship, family values, and recreation. The race brings together amateur, recreational, and professional runners from the region and beyond, creating a unique running community. Over the years, it has become the largest sporting event in the municipality of Kula, with more than 6,000 participants and a total of 34,000 kilometers run. The organizers continually improve the event, prizes, and organization to make the race even better and more appealing to all participants.

name: Grobský Runfest
location: Chorvátsky Grob – Čierna Voda, Chorvátsky Grob – Čierna Voda, Areál za MŠ a ZŠ Javorová Alej
organizer: SBT Spid.com, s.r.o., Susedský Hi o.z., PavúčikSport Team o.z., obec Chorvátsky Grob
description: Grobský Runfest is a two-day sports festival in Chorvátsky Grob, bringing together professional athletes and recreational enthusiasts of all ages. It offers running courses of various distances, children’s races, cycling races, and a rich cultural and entertainment program, including a food zone and musical performances. The event promotes community and a healthy lifestyle in a pleasant setting, with a variety of activities for all visitors.

name: Tvrďák – Bratislava
description: Tvrďák Bratislava is Slovakia’s largest obstacle race, held at the Divoká Voda complex in Čunovo. Competitors tackle more than 20 obstacles on a course of approximately 5 km, with different participation options, including a non-competitive fitness mode and timed racing. After the race, participants can relax by the pool, enjoy refreshments and watch strength competitions. The race is also suitable for children aged 8 to 14 and includes a medal, photos and a race video as keepsakes.

name: Behu ulicami mesta Veľký Krtíš
location: Veľký Krtíš, Veľký Krtíš, Veľký Krtíš
description: The Run Through the Streets of Veľký Krtíš is a traditional running race organized by the Bežci VK civic association. It offers various categories, including children, recreational runners, and Nordic Walking. The race takes place in the town of Veľký Krtíš, with distances ranging from 3,000 m to the main 11,000 m race. The children’s race starts at 09:45, and the main category and Nordic Walking start at 11:00. The event is suitable for the general public and offers discounts for seniors over 60.

name: Moldavský pohár Bodvy
location: Moldava nad Bodvou, Moldava nad Bodvou, Hlavné námestie
description: The Moldava Cup of the Bodva is an international road race, cycling and inline skating event held in Moldava nad Bodvou. The event offers various categories for runners, cyclists and inline skaters, with routes passing through the surrounding countryside and villages. It is known for its tradition and high-quality organization, with the start and finish on the Main Square in Moldava nad Bodvou. It also includes a mass run for health, which is open to the general public.

name: ISKRA Trail Kosmaj
description: Iskra Kosmaj Trail is a trail race held on the beautiful Mount Kosmaj, giving participants the chance to enjoy dense forests and stunning views. The race is a great opportunity for a day out and socializing in the race village, located in the start and finish area. Three distances are available, and the race is open to runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers of all ages, with parental consent required for participants under 18. The organizer guarantees safety and a great atmosphere, and participants receive a race pack with a T-shirt if they register on time.

name: COLUMBIA SUNSET TRAIL
description: A Columbia Sunset Trail egy izgalmas, naplementében zajló terepfutó verseny a Naszály-hegyen, amelyet a Trailrun.hu csapata szervez. A verseny különböző távokon kínál kihívást, gyönyörű természeti környezetben, bőséges frissítőpontokkal és egyedi fa befutóéremmel minden résztvevőnek. A rendezvényen díjazásban részesülnek a legjobb férfi és női futók is. A verseny hangulata barátságos, családias, és a szervezők gondoskodnak a kényelmes öltözési és csomagmegőrzési lehetőségekről.
course_highlights: Naplementében zajló futás a Naszály-hegyen
Bőséges ellátás a frissítőpontokon és a célban
Egyedi fa befutóérem minden távon
additional: Ingyenes, menő fotók már a verseny másnapján. Külön érem díjazás távonként az első három női és férfi célbaérkezőnek. Öltözők és csomagmegőrzés a bázison. Kötelező felszerelés: működő, feltöltött fejlámpa és mobiltelefon, valamint ivózsák, kulacs vagy pohár, mivel egyszer használatos pohár nem lesz a frissítőpontokon és a célban. Személyi igazolvány vagy olvasható másolat szükséges. A versenyhez bőséges frissítőponti és célbeli ellátás, egyedi fa befutóérem, öltöző és csomagmegőrzés tartozik. Kötelező felszerelés a fejlámpa, a feltöltött mobiltelefon, ivózsák vagy kulacs, pohár, valamint személyazonosító okmány.

name: 32. DECATHLON Futóest
description: A 32. Decathlon Futóest egy különleges éjszakai futóverseny Budapest szívében, a kivilágított Hősök terén és az Andrássy úton. A futók negyedmaratoni, félmaratoni, páros és trió távokon mérhetik össze erejüket, miközben élvezhetik a város varázslatos éjszakai atmoszféráját. Az eseményen több ezer futó vesz részt az ország számos településéről, és minden résztvevőt egyedi befutóérem és befutócsomag vár. A verseny este 21:00-kor kezdődik, így a futók a város fényei között élhetik át a futás élményét.

name: SZUFLA VÉGTELEN
distance_verbose: 24 km, Félmaraton, 18 km, 15 km, 12 km, 9 km

name: KIPRUN FUTÓEST
description: A KIPRUN FUTÓEST egy különleges éjszakai futóverseny Budapest szívében, a kivilágított Hősök terén és az Andrássy úton. A résztvevők negyedmaratoni, félmaratoni, páros és trió távokon mérhetik össze erejüket, miközben élvezhetik a város esti fényeit és a történelmi környezetet. A verseny hangulata egyedülálló, ahol a sport és a kultúra találkozik, és minden futót egyedi befutóérem vár. A rendezvényt a Budapest Sportiroda (BSI) szervezi, amely több ezer futót vonz az ország számos településéről.
course_highlights: Futás Budapest ikonikus Hősök terén és az Andrássy úton
Éjszakai futás a kivilágított városi környezetben
Történelmi szobrok és hangulatos nyári esték
additional: A versenyen több táv közül választhatnak a futók: Félmaraton (21,1 km), Negyedmaraton (10,5 km), Félmaraton Páros (2 × 10,5 km), Félmaraton Trió (3 futó, távok: 7,3 + 7,6 + 6,2 km) és 5 km. A rajt előtt bemelegítés is van 20:20 és 20:30 között. A nevezés kizárólag online történik a nevezes.futanet.hu oldalon, fizetés bankkártyával vagy SZÉP kártyával lehetséges. Limitált technikai futópóló is elérhető a versenyhez.

name: TÖRÖKBÁLINTI HENDIKEP
description: A Törökbálinti Hendikep egy izgalmas futóverseny, amely Törökbálinton, a Dióskertben kerül megrendezésre. A verseny változatos távokon kínál kihívást a futóknak, és barátságos, közösségi hangulatban várja a résztvevőket. A rendezvény célja a sport és az aktív életmód népszerűsítése, miközben a természet közelségét is élvezhetik a futók.
course_highlights: Természetközeli futópálya a Dióskertben
Különböző távok minden korosztálynak
Barátságos, közösségi hangulat

name: Holló a Kövön, Várfutás - Palóc TM Kupa
Malofatranská stovka
description: The Malofatranská Stovka is a mountain ultramarathon in the Malá Fatra range, featuring demanding routes with significant climbs and descents. The race is intended for experienced runners in excellent physical condition and crosses the entire range, including Krivánska Fatra and Lúčanská Fatra. The event is a registered ITRA member and serves as a qualifying race for other prestigious ultratrails. It is organized by Slovak Ultra Trail in cooperation with volunteers and partners.

name: Svätojánsky beh na Domaši
location: Domaša, Domaša, Domaša rekreačné stredisko Dobra , parkovisko pri Bogárke
description: The St. John’s Run at Domaša is a traditional running race held at the Domaša Dobrá recreational resort. Runners can choose between two courses—a short 5 km course and a long 13 km course—which run mostly along forest roads and trails with varied elevation. The event is suitable for the general public, with categories by age and gender. The organizers provide refreshment stations, changing rooms, toilets, and medical services. The atmosphere is friendly and competitive, with valuable prizes in kind for the winners.

name: Beh za zdravie – Záhorská Bystrica
location: Záhorská Bystrica, Záhorská Bystrica, pri BYS3T PARK-u, na ulici Ota Holúsku - Krče
description: The Run for Health in Záhorská Bystrica is a charity running event that brings sport together with support for health and the community. It takes place in BYS3T PARK and offers a chance to enjoy a great atmosphere and inspiring stories, while every participant contributes to a good cause. The event is open to all ages and fitness levels, promoting a healthy lifestyle and support for disadvantaged people. Run for Health was established in 2023 and each year supports selected individuals or foundations through movement.

name: Velvet Run Košice
location: Košice, Košice, pri Urbanovej veži na Hlavnej ulici.
organizer: Progres Promotion Košice, s.r.o., Maratónsky klub Košice
description: Velvet Run in Košice is a running event taking place by Urban Tower on Hlavná Street. Participants can choose from the 5 km, 10 km, and 5 km Velvet Nordic Walking events. The event is exclusively for women and offers valuable prizes to winners in various categories. The organizers provide timekeeping using the MyLaps system, and results will be published on the official websites.

name: Čergovský umirak
location: Drienica, okr. Sabinov, Drienica, okr. Sabinov, Chata Ride pub
organizer: Marián Gargalovič, Ondrej Janiga, Slavomír Uličný
description: Čergovský Umirak is a mountain race of approximately 30 km with around 1,000 metres of elevation gain, intended for trained runners. The race takes place at the Drienica recreation centre, where refreshments and additional activities for families are available. The course follows a marked hiking trail, and runners are required to wear their bib visibly attached to their chest. Safety on the course is provided by the Čergov Mountain Rescue Service, and each participant takes part at their own risk. After the last runners finish, there is a ceremony to announce the results and award prizes to the top men and women.

name: Beh cez Hornoorešanské vŕšky – Memoriál Františka Hečka
location: Horné Orešany okr. Trnava, Horné Orešany okr. Trnava, futbalový štadión
organizer: Bežecký klub Viktoria, Obecný úrad Horné Orešany
description: The Run through the Hornoorešanské Hills – František Hečko Memorial is a running race in Horné Orešany, featuring a 10,300-metre course with 100 metres of elevation gain. The course is 50% asphalt and 50% trail, making the race interesting and challenging. The race is open to all age groups, from children aged 1 and up to seniors, with categories for men, women, juniors and local runners. It is organised by Bežecký klub Viktoria together with the Municipal Office in Horné Orešany. The start for schoolchildren is at 15:35, and for everyone else at 17:00.

name: Rajec RunTour Bratislava
description: Rajec RunTour Bratislava is a family-friendly running festival offering courses for all ages and fitness levels. Participants can choose from 3, 5 and 10 km races, as well as children’s races of 500 and 1,000 metres. The event takes place at two locations and offers a race pack with everything runners need. In addition to the races, there is a varied programme of activities, refreshments on the course and at the finish, medical and driving services, and facilities including changing rooms and baggage storage. The whole day is designed as an experience for runners and their families, with a raffle and the option to have personal details engraved on medals.

name: Behaj lesmi Bachledová dolina
location: Bachledová dolina, Bachledová dolina, Bachledka Ski & Sun
description: Behaj lesmi Bachledová dolina is a trail run in the stunning natural surroundings of the High Tatras, offering runners a unique experience on soft terrain with fresh mountain air. The route passes through the Treetop Walk, Monkova dolina and the ridge of Spišská Magura, with the start accessed by cable car. The race is part of the Behaj lesmi series, which combines sporting achievement with support for local families and charitable causes. Behaj lesmi Bachledová dolina is a challenge for experienced runners and newcomers alike who want to experience mountain nature and unforgettable views.

name: Skyrun Kubínska
location: Kubínska hoľa, Okres Dolný Kubín, Žilinský kraj
description: Skyrun Kubínska is a mountain run in the beautiful natural surroundings of Orava, offering 24 km and 11 km courses. The race is dedicated to the memory of Barnabáš Üvegeš, and runners can enjoy challenging terrain with views of the surrounding countryside. Participants will experience a combination of mountain trails and natural scenery that makes this event a unique experience.

name: Rodnei Sky Race
description: Rodnei Sky Race is a mountain running competition held in the Rodna Mountains, near Borșa, Maramureș. The event offers three distinct routes suited to different experience levels: the Puzdrelor route, the most difficult, for experienced runners; the Gărgălău route, a moderate challenge for well-prepared runners; and the Musceta route, a fast course with a large elevation drop. The race is part of the Carpathians Circuit and emphasizes the experience of running in nature amid spectacular mountain scenery. The organizers invite families and mountain sports enthusiasts to take part in an active weekend outdoors.

name: Sinaia Mountain Run
description: Sinaia Mountain Run by Constantina Diță is a spectacular mountain race starting and finishing in Sinaia Town Hall Square. The routes pass through scenic areas such as Cota 1000 and Cota 1400, giving runners an authentic and challenging mountain experience. The event is open to both elite runners and mountain-running enthusiasts, with 10K and 21K races. Participants receive a race kit with a bib, timing chip, and medal, and the organizers provide free digital photo galleries.

name: Cluj Running Festival
description: Cluj Running Festival is an international road-running event held in the heart of Cluj, bringing together elite athletes, thousands of amateur runners, and children at the starting line. The festival combines competitive sport with the joy of movement and the city’s energy, offering a flat, fast course ideal for runners of all levels. The event includes races for children, open 5 km and 10 km races, and an elite race featuring top international athletes. Cluj-Napoca, a young and active city, provides the perfect setting for this celebration of running.

name: CROSUL ORASULUI MIOVENI 1485
description: Mioveni City Run is an annual sporting event organized by the Invictus Mioveni Association in partnership with Mioveni City Hall and the city’s Cultural Center. The event brings together runners of all ages, from 3-year-old children to 78-year-old seniors, on varied 2.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km routes, as well as special races for the little ones. The atmosphere is vibrant, with music, applause, SMURD demonstrations, and artistic performances, offering a day dedicated to health, community, and sporting fun. The run is a celebration of movement and community spirit, supported by major sponsors such as TEMAD, WD-40 Romania, and UHU Romania.

name: Crosul Oraşului Mioveni 1485 - Ed. a - IV - a ~ 2026
description: The Mioveni City Run is a sporting event organized by Invictus Romania, dedicated to promoting a spirit of solidarity and courage, especially among wounded military personnel. The event takes place in the civic center of Mioveni and is part of a series of charitable and commemorative sporting competitions. Participants are encouraged to join in and support the values of honor and respect in a friendly and motivating setting.

name: Noćni maraton
organizer: Tletsko rekreativni klub “Fruška gora” – Novi Sad
description: The Novi Sad Night Marathon is one of the most popular races in Serbia and a unique nighttime athletics and recreational event. The main race is a 42 km marathon that requires dedication and mental strength, while the half marathon attracts the most participants and brings a special nighttime race atmosphere. There is also a mini marathon for children and Nordic walking, making the event accessible to all ages and fitness levels. The race has become a tradition and a source of pride for Novi Sad, with carefully organized race packages and a rich program on the course and after the race.

name: Mala Sveta Gora
description: The Mala Sveta Gora running race takes place in the beautiful setting of Ovčar Banja and offers three running categories: 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon (21 km). The race is known for its challenging course through nature, offering runners a unique experience and the chance to compete over different distances. The organizers invite all running enthusiasts to take advantage of promotional prices and take part in this sporting event, which brings together runners from across the region.

name: TORNIK RACE 2026
description: Tornik Race is a unique running adventure on Zlatibor that combines adrenaline-fueled challenges with nature conservation. The races are suited to all ages and ability levels, with 6 km, 15 km and 25 km courses, as well as children’s races. Participants can enjoy the natural beauty of Tornik, test their endurance and contribute to environmental protection through the Plogging Race. The organizers aim to build a community of passionate runners and nature lovers, offering an unforgettable experience and a healthy sporting spirit.

name: Rácalmás Szigetfutás
description: A Rácalmási Szigetfutás egy családias jellegű terepfutó verseny, amely Rácalmás festői környezetében, a természetvédelmi oltalom alatt álló Nagy-szigeten és a Duna partján zajlik. A változatos terep árnyas erdei ösvényeket, szántóföldi szakaszokat, folyóparti útvonalakat és aszfaltos részeket foglal magában, minimális szintemelkedéssel. A rendezvény minden korosztálynak és sportolási szintnek kínál távokat, így kezdők és profik, futók, gyaloglók és kerékpárosok is megtalálják a számukra megfelelőt. A verseny központja a történelmi Jankovich Kúria, amely ideális helyszín a rajtnak és a célba érkezésnek, valamint a kísérő programoknak.
course_highlights: Természetvédelmi oltalom alatt álló Nagy-sziget változatos terepe
Futás a Duna partján és árnyas erdei ösvényeken
Minimális szintemelkedés, könnyen teljesíthető pályák
additional: A versenyen 3-4 km-enként frissítőpontok várják a résztvevőket korlátlan fogyasztással, izotóniás itallal. A nagyobbaknak fröccspont is van az erdőben. A rendezvényen ingyenes ruhatár és értékmegőrző szolgáltatás működik. Egész napos profi műsorvezetés és tombolasorsolás is színesíti a programot. Az időmérést eldobható HuTag-es chipekkel végzik. A verseny az Ötpróba programsorozat része, ahol pontokat lehet gyűjteni. A rendezvény központjában étel- és italárusok, valamint sport játszótér várja a családokat.

name: Mistrovství světa veteránů v běhu do vrchu – nahoru
location: Janské Lázně, Janské Lázně, nám. Svobody – kolonáda Janské Lázně
description: The 2026 World Masters Mountain Running Championships is a prestigious international mountain running event for masters athletes, held in the picturesque surroundings of Janské Lázně. The races feature several challenging courses with significant elevation gain, testing the endurance and strength of runners from more than 30 countries. The event is organized by TJ Maratonstav Úpice under the auspices of the towns of Janské Lázně and Úpice. Registration is open, and runners can look forward to professional event organization and sponsor support.

name: Beh údolím Idy
description: The Run through the Ida Valley is a traditional race organized by the Košice-Šaca City District and the municipality of Malá Ida. The race takes place in the pleasant surroundings of the cultural center in Košice-Šaca and offers the opportunity to compete in various age categories. The entry fee is symbolic, while local runners can take part for free. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes an active lifestyle in the region.

name: Beh na Poludňový Grúň
location: Terchová okr. Žilina, Terchová okr. Žilina, Vrátna Paseky o 10,00 hod. na údolnej stanici štvorsedačky
organizer: Občianske združenie Grúň, Chata na Grúni
description: The Run to Poludňový Grúň is a mountain running race in the picturesque Vrátna Valley, in the Malá Fatra mountain range. The course crosses challenging mountain terrain, with beautiful views of peaks such as Poludňový Grúň, Stoh, and Veľký Rozsutec. The race is ideal for nature lovers and mountain runners who want to experience a unique atmosphere and challenge in the heart of Malá Fatra. The organizers warmly invite you to enjoy this sporting event in the beautiful surroundings of Terchová.

name: OK Trip Trail
description: OK Trip Trail is a race held in the beautiful setting of Ovčar Banja, known for its natural beauty and healthy lifestyle. The race brings together sports and nature enthusiasts, offering a unique opportunity to enjoy a challenging course through forested areas and mountain terrain. The Festival of a Healthy Spirit, under whose auspices the race is organized, promotes an active and healthy lifestyle in the heart of Serbia.

name: 10. Ócsai Pincesorfutás Radics József emlékére 4 / 12 / 24
description: Az Ócsai Pincesorfutás Radics József emlékére egy közösségi terepfutó esemény, amely Ócsa városának nevezetességein vezet keresztül. A verseny 10,5 km-es távon zajlik, amelyet többször is meg lehet ismételni a hosszabb távokon, így 21 km és 42 km is választható. A futás egyedi chipes időméréssel történik, és a verseny célja a sport és a közösség összekapcsolása Radics József emlékének tiszteletére. A rajt és cél az Egressy Gábor Szabadidőközpont előtt van, és a pálya változatos aszfaltos és földes útvonalakat tartalmaz.

name: UTT - ULTRA TISZA TÓ
distance_verbose: 130 km, 65 km, Maraton, 28 km, Félmaraton, 15 km, 10 km, 5 km

name: TRAIL RELAY BANSKÁ ŠTIAVNICA – VISEGRÁD
description: A TRAIL RELAY BANSKÁ ŠTIAVNICA - VISEGRÁD egy 220 km-es terep váltóverseny, amely összeköti a történelmi Selmecbányát és Visegrádot. A verseny 18 szakaszból áll, melyek a Selmeci-hegységen és a Duna-Ipoly Nemzeti Parkon keresztül vezetnek, gazdag természeti és kulturális látnivalókkal. A futók különböző csapatméretekben és egyéni kategóriákban indulhatnak, így mindenki megtalálhatja a számára megfelelő kihívást. A verseny célja a két királyi város összekapcsolása, valamint a régió természeti és történelmi értékeinek bemutatása.

name: UTT – ULTRA TISZA TÓ
distance_verbose: 130 km, 65 km, Maraton, 28 km, Félmaraton, 15 km, 10 km, 5 km

name: TOKAJ NIGHT RUN
distance_verbose: 220 km, 130 km, 65 km, Maraton, 28 km, Félmaraton, 15 km, 10 km, 5 km, 2 km
description: A DRK Tokaj Night Run a nyár egyik legnépszerűbb futóeseménye Tokajban és környékén, amelyet a Tetterő Egyesület szervez. A közel ezer indulót vonzó futófesztiválon ismert művészek és közszereplők is részt vesznek, így a verseny nemcsak sportélményt, hanem közösségi élményt is nyújt. A rendezvény célja, hogy a profi futók mellett a családokat, hobbi futókat és futóközösségeket is megszólítsa, miközben a futás mellett a kikapcsolódás és a közös élmények is hangsúlyt kapnak. A verseny helyszíne a Tokaj-Fesztiválkatlan, amely különleges hangulatot biztosít az eseménynek.
course_highlights: Éjszakai futás Tokaj festői környezetében
Közösségi és családbarát futófesztivál
Ismert művészek és közszereplők részvétele
additional: A verseny szervezője a Tetterő Egyesület, amely szabadidős programokat és színvonalas futóversenyeket szervez országszerte. A rendezvények célja a futás népszerűsítése minden korosztály és szint számára, különös hangsúlyt fektetve a közösségi élményekre és a sport mellett a kikapcsolódásra.

name: Tara Ultra Trail 2026
organizer: Udruženje Tara Ultra i PK Tara
description: Tara Ultra Trail 2026 is a mountain trail race held in Tara National Park, Bajina Bašta, on the first weekend of July. The race offers several distances suited to different fitness levels, from a vertical climb to an ultra-long 62 km course with significant elevation gain. The routes pass through hidden and scenic parts of Tara, giving runners an unforgettable experience of nature and a challenge for body and mind. In addition to the races, an all-day outdoor festival and accompanying cultural events take place at the finish, creating a unique atmosphere for participants and visitors alike.

name: Balkan Mountain and Trail Running Championships
organizer: Balkan Mountaineering Union (BMU), Planinarski savez Srbije (PSS), Tara Ultra Trail, Planinarski klub Tara
description: The first Balkan Mountain and Trail Running Championships will be held in Tara National Park and Bajina Bašta, Serbia. The competition features four races: Mountain Uphill, Mountain Classic, Mountain Trail, and U18 Mountain Classic, bringing together the best mountain runners in the Balkans. The courses are varied and challenging, with spectacular scenery and technical climbs, offering a true challenge and the chance to enjoy nature. The organizers are the Balkan Mountaineering Union, Mountaineering Association of Serbia, Tara Ultra Trail, and Tara Mountaineering Club. We invite all runners to join us and celebrate mountain and trail running in the heart of Serbia.

name: VI. Tapolca Rockwool Trail 8 /  14 km / 22 / 33 / 45
description: A VI. Tapolca Rockwool Trail egy festői futóverseny a Balaton-felvidék csodálatos tájain, Tapolca-Diszel környékén. Az útvonal 80%-ban földútból, szekérútból és ösvényből áll, változatos tereppel és páratlan panorámával várja a futókat. Öt különböző távon lehet indulni, melyek közül a 22 km-ig terjedő távok túrázva is teljesíthetők. A verseny egyedi befutóérmekkel, frissítőpontokkal és meleg étellel várja a résztvevőket, miközben a szervezők környezettudatos, zöld rendezvényt tartanak.

name: TELIHOLDFUTAM
description: A Teliholdfutam egy éjszakai futóverseny Esztergomban, amely a Várhegy, Víziváros és a dunaparti kerékpárút festői útvonalán zajlik. A verseny három távon kínál kihívást: 4 km, 10 km és 15 km, melyek változatos terepen, köztük kockaköves és kivilágítatlan szakaszokon vezetnek. A rendezvényt az Esztergomi Futóművek Amatőr Sportegyesület szervezi, és a versenyzőknek kötelező a fejlámpa használata. A futam része az Ötpróba programnak, így pontokat is gyűjthetnek a résztvevők.
course_highlights: Várhegy, Víziváros és dunaparti kerékpárút útvonal
Kockaköves és kivilágítatlan pályarészek
Éjszakai futás fejlámpa kötelező használatával
additional: A versenyen létszámlimit van: 4 km és 10 km távon 200 fő, 15 km távon 100 fő. A nevezés online és helyszíni formában is lehetséges a verseny napján, a szabad helyek függvényében. A verseny része az Ötpróba programnak, ahol a távok teljesítésével pontokat lehet gyűjteni. A nevezéshez kötelező a fejlámpa vagy egyéb világító eszköz használata.

name: IX. Holdfény Éjszakai Félmaraton és Családi Sportnap
description: A IX. Holdfény Éjszakai Félmaraton és Családi Sportnap egy jótékonysági futóverseny Szegeden, az Erzsébet Ligetben. A rendezvény éjszakai félmaraton futásból és családi sportprogramokból áll, amelyeket több mint 1100 résztvevő támogatott. A verseny hangulatos, közösségi esemény, amely a sport és a jótékonyság összekapcsolására fókuszál.
course_highlights: Éjszakai félmaraton futás Szeged Erzsébet Ligetben
Családi sportnap kíséri a versenyt
Jótékonysági esemény több mint 1100 résztvevővel
additional: A verseny eredményei a Facebook oldalon megtekinthetők. A rendezvény közösségi és jótékonysági jellegű, családi programokkal kiegészítve.

name: Na hoľu
description: Na hoľu is an ITRA-certified vertical kilometer event held on Kráľova hoľa in the Horehronie region. Runners start from the main square in the village of Šumiac, and the route follows the blue hiking trail directly to the summit of Kráľova hoľa. The event is a qualifying race for the 2024 Skyrunning World Championships and offers quality support, including refreshments and medical services. Registration is open, with a participant limit, and the entry fee includes a souvenir and refreshments.

name: Špačinský trojuholník
location: Špačince, okr. Trnava, Špačince, okr. Trnava, Základná škola s materskou školou
organizer: Obec Špačince, Bežecký klub 2001 Špačince, Základná škola s materskou školou v Špačinciach, Dobrovoľný hasičský zbor Špačince
description: The Špačinský Triangle is a running race held in the village of Špačince in the Trnava District. The race starts at 17:00 in the centre of the village, by the Primary School with Kindergarten. Men compete in the overall category regardless of age, and women aged 40 and over compete. The organizers are the Municipality of Špačince, Bežecký klub 2001 Špačince, the Primary School with Kindergarten in Špačince, and JDS Špačince. The entry fee is €10, except for village residents, who can enter for free.

name: Trail Relay Banská Štiavnica – Visegrád – štafety
location: Banská Štiavnica, Banská Štiavnica, Atletická dráha
description: The Banská Štiavnica–Visegrád Trail Relay is a unique 220 km relay race connecting two historic royal towns through the natural beauty of the Štiavnica Mountains and the Danube–Ipoly National Park. The race is open to teams of 3, 4 to 8, and 6 runners, with categories for experienced runners and larger teams. The route runs mainly along hiking trails and through nature reserves, offering a chance to discover the region’s cultural and historical landmarks and natural beauty in Slovakia and Hungary. The organizers emphasize building good neighborly relations and promoting the region.

name: Carpathia Trails
distance_verbose: 102 km, 58 km, 57 km, 45 km, 44 km, 36 km, 23 km, 6 km
description: Carpathia Trails is a mountain running race held at Complex Cheile Grădiștei in Fundata, crossing three mountain ranges: the Bucegi Mountains, the Leaota Mountains, and Piatra Craiului. The event offers six individual race options, with distances ranging from 6 km to a 102 km ultramarathon, suitable for all experience levels. Participants can enjoy spectacular scenery and a unique experience in nature, in a friendly and well-organized setting. Registration is limited and takes place online.
course_highlights: Routes crossing three mountain ranges: Bucegi, Leaota, and Piatra Craiului
A range of distances from 6 km to a 102 km ultramarathon
Spectacular natural scenery in the Cheile Grădiștei area
additional: Registration is limited and can be completed online. The organizer may award wildcards to recognized athletes. The event is supported by donations from participants, sponsors, and partners. The code of conduct is mandatory for all participants to protect the trails and ensure safety. Participation requires an online form; registration is limited, and wildcards may be available to recognized athletes.

name: Carpathia Trails ~ 2027
distance_verbose: 102 km, 57 km, 45 km, 36 km, 23 km, 6 km

name: Cozia Mountain Run
description: Cozia Mountain Run is a mountain running competition held in the Cozia Massif, on the left bank of the Olt River, in the Călimănești-Căciulata spa resort. The event, organized by the Pegas Triathlon Club Association with the support of local authorities, promotes mountain running, local traditions, and humanitarian fundraising. Participants take on three challenging, unmarked mountain routes that require experience and mountain skills. The atmosphere is friendly and energizing, and after the race all runners are invited to lunch at Turnu Monastery.

name: Siriu Open Water JOY ~ 2027
location: Barajul Siriu, Siriu, Buzău County, Romania

name: Legendele Nemirei
description: Legendele Nemirei is a mountain running race held in Slănic Moldova, Bacău, offering spectacular routes through cool forests and along the ridges of the Nemira massif. Participants can choose between a half marathon and a cross-country race, both featuring significant elevation gain and well-marked routes. The event emphasizes the mountain experience and promotes active tourism and ecotourism in the area, amid beautiful, unspoiled nature. The event is praised for its clear markings, dedicated volunteers, and friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Routes through shady forests and alpine areas with unspoiled natural scenery
Approximately 25 km half marathon with 1,100 m of positive elevation gain
Approximately 14 km cross-country race with 700 m of positive elevation gain, including sections of asphalt and runnable forest road
additional: The routes are marked 90% with hiking trail markings, supplemented by plastic tape and signs where needed. Participants should have mountain experience and be prepared for difficult sections, including passages with fixed ropes. The start is in the Central Park of the Slănic Moldova resort. The organizers recommend booking accommodation early, as the resort has limited capacity during peak season.

name: HAAS MARATON VÁLTÓ
organizer: Tatai Tömegsport és Tájfutó Honvéd Sportegyesület
description: A HAAS Maraton Váltó egy hagyományos váltóverseny, amelyet a Tatai Tömegsport és Tájfutó Honvéd Sportegyesület szervez. A verseny a váltófutás izgalmát és a természet közelségét ötvözi, a résztvevők változatos terepen, Tata környékén mérhetik össze erejüket. A rendezvény családias hangulatú, és a futók mellett a szurkolók számára is élménydús programot kínál. A verseny a sportbarátok és amatőr futók számára egyaránt nyitott, és a helyi sportélet fontos eseménye.

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 6. kolo
description: The Bratislava 2 Miles Run is a regular 2-mile race organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team at the Kuchajda swimming pool complex in Bratislava. The race is open to a wide range of categories, including children, juniors, women, men, and veterans. Registration takes place at the venue from 9:30, and the start is at 10:00. The event also includes a competition for the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team Perpetual Trophy, with runners scored according to their performances and participation in individual rounds.

name: Žaškovský minimaratón
location: Žaškov okr. Dolný Kubín, Žaškov okr. Dolný Kubín, Žaškov na začiatku obce pri rieke Orava
description: The Žaškov Mini Marathon is a traditional running race, now being held for the 55th year in the village of Žaškov in Orava. The course runs mostly along forest roads and village streets, covering approximately 12.4 km with around 600 m of elevation gain. Runners are warmly welcomed by local residents of all ages, creating a pleasant, family-friendly atmosphere. This mini marathon is part of the Šípsko–Fatranské Runs series and is suitable for all running enthusiasts who want to enjoy the beauty of Orava’s nature and the spirit of sport.

name: Cyrilometodský beh Kolonickým vrchom – Memoriál Jozefa Chomaniča
location: Kolonica, okr. Snina, Kolonica, okr. Snina, športovo-rekreačný areál Bejvoč
description: The Cyril and Methodius Run over Kolonický vrch – Jozef Chomanič Memorial is a running event held at the Bejvoč sports and recreation complex in Kolonica, Snina District. The race offers categories for children and adults, including several age groups for men and women. The children’s races start at 13:30 and the adults’ race at 15:00. The event is held in memory of Jozef Chomanič and gives runners of all ages the chance to compete in a beautiful natural setting.

name: Domašská desiatka na Eve
location: Vranov nad Topľou, Vranov nad Topľou, rekreačná oblasť Domaša, Eva, pizzeria Palermo
description: Domašská Desiatka na Eve is a traditional running race held in the Domaša recreational area, Eva, near Vranov nad Topľou. The race offers 5 km and 10 km courses, which are part of the Vranov nad Topľou District Road Running Championships. Runners can enjoy a course with refreshment stations, and after finishing they receive a race pack with a medal, food, and a drink. The organizers provide medical services. The race takes place on roads open to traffic, and each participant runs at their own risk.

name: Treska Trail
description: Join an adventurous hiking tour with Kežman Mountain Houses to the summit of Treska on Kopaonik. This short 650-meter trail leads to an impressive peak at 1,622 meters above sea level, offering beautiful panoramic views of the surrounding mountains and valleys. The trail is well marked and suitable for all guests. The ascent takes about 30 minutes, giving you the chance to enjoy nature and take photos. Organized tours are available to all accommodation guests, with transportation to the trailhead.

name: 48. Trka oko Avale
distance_verbose: 5 km, 3000 metara, 2 km, 1 km, 0.5 km, 0.3 km, 0.2 km
description: The Race Around Avala is a traditional event organized by the Serbian Masters Athletics Association. The race takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Avala and brings together runners of different ages and fitness levels. It is an opportunity for sporting camaraderie and for promoting athletics among masters and recreational runners. The start and finish are at an attractive location, and the course offers both challenges and enjoyment of nature.

name: Zalău Ultra Trail
description: Zalău Ultra Trail is a mountain running competition held over three days in the heart of the Sălaj Mountains. The event offers a variety of races for all levels, from children to experienced runners, including a 103 km ultra race with over 5,000 m of elevation gain. ZUT is more than a competition: it is a platform that brings together athletes, the local community, and nature, promoting a spirit of adventure and respect for the environment. The routes are challenging and spectacular, offering an authentic trail-running experience amid impressive natural landscapes.
course_highlights: 103 km ULTRA course with 5,255 m of elevation gain
Well-equipped aid and checkpoint stations along the route
A variety of races, from a 2.5 km children’s race to a 103 km ultra
additional: The event takes place over 3 days, with multiple races suited to different levels of fitness. The Last Man Standing race is a special endurance competition with 6.7 km laps every hour, eliminating participants who do not finish in time. There are prize categories for children and Cross races. Mandatory equipment is specified in the regulations, and aid stations provide water, isotonic drinks, fruit, and hot food along the ultra course. Multiple race distances, including races for children and charity events; an emphasis on promoting local values and community spirit; the event also includes an environmental awareness component.

name: Stâna de Vale Trail Race
description: Stâna de Vale Trail Race is a mountain running competition held amid the spectacular scenery of the Carpathian Mountains, at the Stâna de Vale resort in Bihor County. The event is part of the EMA Off-Road Running 2026 series and offers races for all levels, from beginner routes to challenging mountain ultramarathons. Participants can enjoy well-marked routes, full support along the course, and a friendly post-race atmosphere. The race weekend also includes an 8 km vertical race, a classic 11 km race, and a long 33 km race with significant elevation gain.
course_highlights: A 33 km mountain course with 1,500 m of positive elevation gain, featuring technical sections and panoramic views
An 11 km course suitable for beginner and intermediate runners, through forests and rolling hills
An 8 km vertical race with 1,100 m of elevation gain, featuring a continuous, challenging climb
additional: The Vertical 8K starts on Friday at 10:00, and the 33 km and 11 km races start on Saturday at 08:30 and 09:30. The organizers provide a post-race meal and a party after the awards ceremony. Participation in the EMA series is conditional on holding a valid license for the 35–79 age category. The courses are on mountain terrain, and the event includes timing. Participants can choose between two distances to suit their fitness level.

name: Jadovnički Ultramaraton 2026
description: The Jadovnik Ultramarathon 2026 is a unique trail event in western Serbia, bringing together lovers of nature, endurance, and extreme races. It takes place on July 10 and 11 in Prijepolje, with the start and finish at the Cultural Center Plaza. All the courses are new and do not repeat those from the previous edition, and the races are suited to different fitness levels and runner categories. Participants receive a race pack with a T-shirt, promotional materials, and a finisher’s medal, while the organizers also provide support with accommodation and meals.

name: VII. Csillagok útján… éjszakai futás
description: A VII. Csillagok útján… éjszakai futás egy különleges nyári élményfutás a Balaton déli partján, Balatonboglár Platán strandon. A verseny új helyszínén széles rajt-cél folyosó és végig szilárd útburkolat várja a futókat, az útvonal teljes hosszában közvilágítással. A futók 3,5, 7 és 10,5 kilométeres távok közül választhatnak, de gyaloglásra is van lehetőség a balatoni naplementében. A rendezvény családbarát, gyermekeknek 500 méteres táv is elérhető, és minden résztvevőt egyedi befutóéremmel jutalmaznak.
course_highlights: Útvonal végig szilárd útburkolaton, teljes hosszában közvilágítással
Balatonboglári Platán strand gyönyörű, balatoni környezetében
3,5 km-es kör, a hosszabb távok több kört futnak
additional: A versenyközpont 09:00-kor nyit, rajtszámfelvétel elérhető. Minden táv rajtja előtt közös, zenés, profi bemelegítés van. A versenyközpontban színpad, fotófal, rajtszámátvételi és regisztrációs sátor, csomagmegőrző, valamint kiállítói standok találhatók. Mosdó és büfé sor 50 méterre a versenyközponttól. Minden kör végén frissítési lehetőség biztosított. A gyermek táv rajtja 20:45-kor, a felnőtt távok rajtja 21:30-kor indul. A rajtok előtt 15 perccel zár a rajtcsomagfelvétel.

name: DRÁVA FÉLMARATON
description: A Dráva Félmaraton egy hagyományos, Barcs és Heresznye közötti 21 kilométeres futóverseny, amelyet ötödik alkalommal rendeznek meg. A versenyen több megye futói vesznek részt, és a távot férfiak és nők külön kategóriában teljesítik. A verseny útvonala változatos, és a korábbi években rekordidők is születtek, ami a verseny komolyságát és népszerűségét mutatja. A rendezvényt a helyi Dráva Futóklub és a heresznyei önkormányzat szervezi, barátságos és versenyképes légkört biztosítva a résztvevőknek.

name: KÖCSI-TÓ FUTÓVERSENY
description: A Köcsi-tó futóverseny egy hagyományos, családias hangulatú futóesemény Balatonalmádi-Káptalanfüred közelében, a festői szépségű Köcsi-tó környékén. A versenyen minden futni vagy gyalogolni vágyót szeretettel várnak, akik élvezhetik a természet közelségét és a közösségi sportélményt. A rendezvényt a Marathon Tömegsport és Környezetvédő Egyesület szervezi, amely elkötelezett a sport és a környezetvédelem iránt. A verseny több távon kínál lehetőséget, így mindenki megtalálhatja a számára megfelelő kihívást.

name: Nízkotatranská stíhačka
description: Nízkotatranská stíhačka (NTS) is an individual ultra-trail race with a 98 km main loop from Telgárt to Donovaly, crossing the main ridge of the Low Tatras, and a half-distance route finishing at Čertovica. The race is a qualifying event for the Ultra-Trail du Mont-Blanc and is ITRA-certified. It is organized by the civic association Time Out - OZ in cooperation with STS HIKING and Slovak Ultratrail. NTS offers a challenging mountain course with beautiful views and challenges for experienced mountain runners.

name: Rozbehni Majerovce
location: Majerovce, okr. Vranov nad Topľou, Majerovce, okr. Vranov nad Topľou, pred Obecným úradom
description: Rozbehni Majerovce is a running event held in the village of Majerovce, in Vranov nad Topľou District, in front of the Municipal Office. The race offers categories for children and adults, with main races of 5 and 10 km. The children’s races start at 09:15 and the main race at 10:15. Organizer Martin Folenta and the Municipality of Majerovce warmly invite runners of all ages to enjoy a pleasant day of sport.

name: Beh Rajeckou dolinou KL Auto
location: Rajecké Teplice, Rajecké Teplice, Námestie SNP Rajecké Teplice
description: The KL Auto Run through the Rajec Valley is a running event set in the scenic Rajec Valley, offering a combination of paved and country roads. The course runs mostly along country roads, with approximately 20% paved surface, creating an enjoyable and varied running experience. The event is known for its excellent organization and friendly atmosphere, attracting runners of all levels. The start is at SNP Square in Rajecké Teplice. The organizer is Ján Valúch Jr., who is available for information and support.

name: Beh malý Caesar
location: Rajecké Teplice, Rajecké Teplice, Námestie SNP
description: The St. Andrew’s Run and the Little Caesar Children’s Run are traditional events in Rajecké Teplice, bringing a sporting and family-friendly atmosphere to SNP Square. The St. Andrew’s Run is a 4.5 km road race with online registration, while the Little Caesar Children’s Run is for children aged 1 to 9 and is free of charge. The event also includes a competition for the best-decorated children’s stroller, adding to the experience for participants and spectators alike. The event takes place in the afternoon, with registration and the start on the square.

name: Beh zvrchovanosti Chrenovec – Brusno
location: Chrenovec-Brusno, Prievidza District, Trenčín Region, Slovakia

name: Predeal Forest Run
description: Predeal Forest Run is a mountain running event held in Predeal, Brașov. The event offers five trail-running routes suitable for all fitness levels, from beginners to experienced runners, with distances ranging from 13 km to 38 km. The routes pass through forests, mountain trails, and areas with spectacular scenery, providing a complete mountain-running experience. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and active running community, and is a great opportunity to discover the beauty of the Piatra Mare Mountains.
course_highlights: 100% trail-running routes through forests and along mountain trails
Challenging climbs, including over 500 m of elevation gain in 4 km on K24
Spectacular views from Poiana Stanei Pietricica, Vf. Piatra Mare, and Cabana Garbova
additional: The event includes five races: K13 Cros, K24 Semimaraton, K32 Piatra Mare, K38 Maraton, and Family Run (non-competitive). The start is at the base of the Clăbucet ski slopes. Routes are marked with yellow tape featuring the red Predeal Forest Run logo and are supported by volunteers. Cutoff times and aid stations are set for the competitive races. The race kit will be announced later. Participants can enter various race categories, and the event supports a social cause. Details about registration and rules are available on the official website.

name: Crosul Aleargă TU pentru EI powered by Flashnet – CURSA VIRTUALA ~ 2027
Jadovnički ultramaraton
description: The Jadovnik Ultramarathon was first organized by the Jadovnik Citizens’ Association on the mountain of the same name. The race aims to showcase the beauty and rich flora and fauna of Mount Jadovnik, which has so far been little known to the public. This ultramarathon offers runners a unique opportunity to experience the challenge and special appeal of running in unspoiled nature. The organizers aim to preserve and promote the mountain through sport and community.

name: Sova Night Trail
description: Sova Night Trail is a night race held on Mount Divčibare, known for its clean air and beautiful viewpoints. The race offers a unique opportunity to enjoy adventure tourism and the natural beauty of the area, with trails winding through forest scenery and mountain landscapes. The event brings together running and nature enthusiasts, offering an unforgettable experience beneath the starry sky.
course_highlights: The race takes place on the mountain trails of Divčibare
A night race with a distinctive atmosphere and lighting
Beautiful viewpoints and unspoiled nature along the route
additional: The race package includes a bib number, refreshments on the course, and a finisher’s medal. An accompanying program is planned after the race.

name: LÁZBÉRCI SRI CHINMOY MARATON
