description: A Lázbérci Sri Chinmoy Maraton egy országos rendezésű futóverseny Magyarországon, amely Sri Chinmoy békefilozófus szellemiségében zajlik. A verseny hagyományosan a természetközeli futás élményét kínálja, és a résztvevők számára egyedülálló lehetőséget nyújt a testi-lelki harmónia megélésére. A futók változatos terepen, festői környezetben mérhetik össze erejüket és kitartásukat. A verseny családias hangulatú, és minden futóbarátot szeretettel várnak.

name: Malý Štrbský maratón
location: Štrba okr. Poprad, Štrba okr. Poprad, Nám. pred Kultúrnym domom
organizer: Obec Štrba, Obec Liptovská Teplička, Športový klub Štrba
description: The Malý Štrbský Marathon is a traditional running race held every year on the second Sunday in July in the village of Štrba in the Tatras. Runners can choose between two main distances—31 km and 10 km—which follow an asphalt road between Štrba and Liptovská Teplička. The event is part of the Tatry v pohybe project and attracts runners from several countries. The atmosphere in the square in front of the Cultural Centre is always lively and full of sporting spirit. The organizers are the Municipality of Štrba, the Municipality of Liptovská Teplička, and Športový klub Štrba.

name: ALEARGĂ TU PENTRU EI by HOSPICE Casa Sperantei
distance_verbose: 20 km, 18 km, 10 km, 6 km, 4 km, 2 km, 0.9 km
description: “Run YOU for Them” is a running event organized by HOSPICE Casa Speranței in Brașov to support the organization’s work. Previous editions have featured races for different ability levels, from short races for children and beginners to distances of 20 km. The 2027 event is scheduled for July 11 in the Aleea Tiberiu Brediceanu area.
course_highlights: Located in the Aleea Tiberiu Brediceanu area of Brașov
Previous editions offered distances from 900 m to 20 km
Charity event organized by HOSPICE Casa Speranței
additional: Previous editions have included races of 900 m, 2 km, 4 km, 6 km, 10 km, 18 km, and 20 km.

name: Kordícky Extrém
location: Kordíky okr. B. Bystrica, Kordíky okr. B. Bystrica, Obecný úrad
organizer: Marathon Banska Bystrica, s.r.o., ON-POINT o.z.
description: Kordícky Extrém is a challenging mountain run through the picturesque surroundings of Kordíky in the Banská Bystrica District. The course is designed for runners seeking extreme challenges in nature, with significant elevation gain and technical sections. The event is part of the Marathon Tour series and offers a unique running experience in beautiful mountain scenery. The organizers welcome all runners who want to test their endurance and courage on this extreme terrain.

name: Mesciské pancaky
location: Mestisko, okres Svidník, Mestisko, okres Svidník, futbalové ihrisko
description: Mesciské Pancakes is a running event in Mestisko, Svidník District, offering 5 km and 10 km routes for men and women with no age restrictions. The route runs mostly on asphalt, with sections across grass and a dirt road, providing runners with varied terrain. The race starts at the football field in Mestisko. Registration is available online or at the event venue.

name: Behaj lesmi Veľká Fatra
description: Behaj lesmi Veľká Fatra is a trail race in Veľká Fatra National Park, offering runners unforgettable views of the Low Tatras, forest singletracks, and special forest roads. The routes pass through the UNESCO site of Vlkolínec and also include a cable car and Sidorovo. The race is part of the international UTMB Index Races, where runners earn points based on their performance and the length of the course. Three courses of varying distances and elevation gains are available, catering to runners of different levels.

name: Maraton Bate Toaca
description: Maraton Bate Toaca is an annual mountain race held in the Durău area, NT, and is part of the Carpathian Circuit. The event offers two main courses: the 18 km Cursa Dochia, with approximately 1,500 m of elevation gain, and the 31 km Cursa Bate Toaca, with approximately 2,700 m of elevation gain. The courses pass through spectacular scenery, including Cabana Dochia, Vf. Lespezi, and Vf. Toaca, offering runners an authentic and challenging mountain experience. The organizers provide a friendly atmosphere and good logistics for participants.

name: BUILA TRAIL RACE Discover Oltenia de sub munte!
description: Buila Trail Race 2026 is a mountain running event organized by the Sport fără Limite Vâlcea Association, promoting the beauty of Buila-Vânturarița National Park. The event takes place in the village of Bărbătești, Vâlcea, and offers a variety of races for all ages and fitness levels. Participants can choose from children’s races, cross-country races, and mountain courses of 11, 18, and 36 km, all featuring spectacular scenery and authentic mountain challenges.

name: BURDUF CHALLENGE Alergăm pentru brânză și colibe!
description: Burduf Challenge is a mountain running event held in Râu Sadului, Sibiu. The event features three races on scenic subalpine routes with significant elevation changes, for adults as well as children and teenagers. Participation supports the Țara Colibelor project through a donation included in the entry fee, and after the race runners are invited to a brunch featuring local products. The event promotes ecotourism and the preservation of mountain cultural heritage in the Cindrel and Lotrului Mountains area.

name: FUTABUDA a Dunakanyarban
description: A FUTABUDA a Dunakanyarban egy önköltséges, nonprofit futóverseny, amely 10 órakor kerül megrendezésre Dunabogdányban. A verseny két távon kínál kihívást: 6,1 km 205 méter szintkülönbséggel és 14 km 356 méter szintkülönbséggel. A futók egyedi, fém befutóérmet kapnak, és a legjobbak korosztályonként és abszolút kategóriában is díjazásban részesülnek. A verseny része az Ötpróba sorozatnak, de attól független, és a nevezés helyszíni módosítási lehetőséget is biztosít. A létszám limitált, maximum 200 fő indulhat.

name: Bančanská desiatka
description: The Bančanská Ten is a traditional running race in the village of Banské, in Vranov nad Topľou District, held in front of the Cultural Centre in Banské. This popular sporting event has a long history and attracts a record number of participants each year. The race is known for its challenging uphill course and beautiful surroundings, and is organized by Športový klub Banské. In addition to the main race, uphill time trials and other accompanying events are held.
course_highlights: Uphill race in the village of Banské – Mláčky
Traditional start in front of the Cultural Centre in Banské
Challenging course profile, with a new course record of 14:35 min
additional: The event is organized by Športový klub Banské, which has a long tradition dating back to 1985. It is held regularly, and in 2025 the 30th edition of the Bančanská 10/5 will take place. The event also includes the JANTEX Banské–Mláčky uphill time trials, which have their own history and categories. The race includes 10 km and a 5 km relay; registration is available online or on site. There is also a varied accompanying programme, including a bouncy castle and performances.

name: YOUNG RUN Nestlé
location: Prievidza, Prievidza, Námestie J. C. Hronského
description: YOUNG RUN Nestlé is a running event in Prievidza featuring 21 km, 10 km and 5 km races. Competitors are divided into categories by age and gender, and relay events are also available for children. The races start at J. C. Hronský Square, with different start times for each distance. The organizers are YOUNG RUN, Nestlé and the City of Prievidza, providing a quality sporting experience for all age groups.

name: Ipelský Beh
location: Lučenec - Kalonda, Lučenec - Kalonda, hrádza na Ipli
description: Ipelský Beh is a running event held in Lučenec–Kalonda, on the embankment of the Ipeľ River. The course runs mostly over grass and includes a 100-metre section of disused railway track. The race is open to various age categories for men, women and youth, and also includes Nordic walking. The organizers are the town of Lučenec, the municipality of Kalonda and OZ-Novohrad, who warmly invite runners of all levels to take part in this traditional event.

name: Boogie To The Van 8k fun run
GAJA-VÖLGY TRAIL
description: A Gaja-völgy Trail egy természetközeli terepfutó esemény, amely Fehérvárcsurgó Károlyi-kastély környékén kerül megrendezésre. A verseny a Gaja-völgy és a Bakonyalja festői tájain vezet, ahol a résztvevők élvezhetik a változatos erdei ösvényeket és a gyönyörű kilátásokat. A rendezvényt a Gaja-völgy Egyesület szervezi, amely egész évben aktív túrákat és sportprogramokat kínál a természet szerelmeseinek. A verseny ideális választás mindazoknak, akik szeretnének egy egészséges, aktív napot eltölteni a szabadban, miközben felfedezik a környék természeti értékeit.
course_highlights: Változatos erdei terep a Gaja-völgyben
Gyönyörű kilátópontok és természeti látnivalók
Károlyi-kastély környéke és a Bakonyalja természeti környezete
additional: A Gaja-völgy Egyesület egész évben szervez gyalogos és kerékpáros túrákat, teljesítménytúrákat és vezetett túrákat. A túravezetők jól ismerik a környéket, és segítenek a biztonságos, természetbarát túrázásban. A rendezvényekről hírlevélben lehet értesülni, és a Facebook csoportban megoszthatók a túraélmények.

name: GULYATERELŐ FUTÓVERSENY
location: Tápiógyörgye Falumúzeum, Béke utca 2, Tápiógyörgye, Hungary

name: Dobra Run a Dobrá dvojka
location: Domaša, okr. Vranov nad Topľou, Domaša, okr. Vranov nad Topľou, RO Domaša - Dobrá
description: Dobra Run and Dobrá dvojka is a running event in Domaša, Vranov nad Topľou District, offering 7 km and 2 km courses. The race is suitable for various age categories of men and women, including children. It is organized by Matore s.r.o. Humenné and BAMM Bratislava. Participants can look forward to a pleasant atmosphere and the chance to compete in different age groups. Registration is available online or on site until the participant limit is reached.

name: Night city run Piešťany
description: Piešťany Night City RUN is a traditional night race held at Námestie Slobody in Piešťany. Runners can take part in the 10 km race, which runs through the city and offers the unique atmosphere of a night run under the auspices of the City of Piešťany. The event is open to various age categories, and all participants receive a commemorative medal. Electronic timing is provided during the race, and the award ceremony takes place in the evening after the run.

name: Extrém maratón Košice – Furča
location: Košice - Furča, Košice - Furča, pred SBD III, Furčianska 60
description: The Košice–Furča Extreme Marathon is a challenging running race organized by the O5 Furča Košice Running Club. The race takes place in the pleasant surroundings of Furča, where runners can enjoy the course challenges and the atmosphere of a traditional marathon. It is intended for endurance runners seeking a more extreme experience over the marathon distance. The organizers provide quality conditions and support for all participants.

name: Beh na Krivošťanku
location: Baffone Family Restaurant, Krivošťany, Strážske, Slovakia
description: The Run to Krivošťanka is a traditional race held in the picturesque surroundings of Strážske and Krivošťany. The race offers a chance to enjoy a sporting experience in nature in a family-friendly atmosphere. The organizers welcome runners of all ages and abilities who want to enjoy a great day of running.

name: Bucovina Ultra Rocks
description: Bucovina Ultra Rocks by UTMB invites you to explore the wild heart of the Eastern Carpathians, one of Europe’s last authentic wilderness areas. With six races ranging from a fast 15 km run to a 114 km challenge, the routes cross rocky ridges, UNESCO-protected old-growth forests, medieval sheepfolds, and impressive natural landscapes such as Moara Dracului Gorge and Pietrele Doamnei. Expect steep climbs, technical trails, and authentic mountain conditions, with every kilometre offering a unique experience in the European wilderness.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://bucovina.utmb.world/discover/event-schedule): 2027-07-24 — "H2: SATURDAY - 24.07.27" (was estimated 2027-08-01)

name: Cer Night trail
description: Cer Night Trail is a night race held on Mount Cer, known for its beautiful natural scenery and challenging trails. The race brings together trail-running enthusiasts who enjoy running through forests and mountain terrain beneath the starry sky. The event is part of the Cer Trail race series, which promotes community, perseverance, and a love of nature. Cer Night Trail gives runners the opportunity to experience the magic of night trail running in the unique setting of Mount Cer.
course_highlights: A night race through the forests and mountain terrain of Mount Cer
Challenging trails with natural obstacles and beautiful views
A sense of community and support among runners
additional: Cer Night Trail is part of the Cer Trail race series, which also includes Cer Winter Trail and Cer Ultra Trail. The race is a member of the UTMB and ITRA communities. The Instagram profile promotes the values of community, support, and runners’ strength, especially that of women. Photos and videos from previous races are available on the Instagram profile.

name: MONORERDEI FUTÓFESZTIVÁL
description: A Monorierdei Futófesztivál egy barátságos és családias futóverseny, amelyet minden évben Monorierdőn, a Makkos Parkban rendeznek meg. A versenyzők több táv közül választhatnak, és a pálya a rajt és cél helyszínén, a Makkos Parkban található. A rendezvény különlegessége az élőzenés frissítőpont, ahol a "The Little Pea" zenekar kétszer is energizálja a futókat. A verseny célja a sport és a mozgás örömének népszerűsítése, mindenkit szeretettel várnak a futótársak közé.

name: Beh na chatu pod Chlebom, mem. J. Morgoša
location: Turany okr. Martin, Turany okr. Martin, Turany - Šútovo – Zajacová
organizer: BS TATRAN Turany, LK NÁDEJ Turany
description: The Run to the Chata pod Chlebom, J. Morgoš Memorial, is a mountain running race held in the areas of Turany, Šútovo and Zajacová. The course is 3.1 km long, with an elevation gain of 680 metres, and follows mountain roads and trails. The race is part of the 2025 Turiec Running League and is open to various age categories for men and women. It is organised by BS TATRAN Turany, the town of Turany and LK NÁDEJ Turany. The race offers a challenge for runners who enjoy demanding mountain terrain.

name: SEMIMARATON TARA DE PIATRĂ
description: The Țara de Piatră Half Marathon is a running race held in the Avram Iancu area, Câmpeni, Alba, Romania. Participants can choose from three races of different distances, running along routes through the Apuseni Mountains’ historic and natural landscapes, imbued with the spirit of their ancestors. The start is scheduled for 8:00, and transport to the starting line is provided by coach. Race kits can be picked up on Saturday and Sunday morning before the start. The event offers an authentic and energizing experience for runners of all levels.

name: CSERNYE TRAIL
description: A Csernye Trail egy terepfutó verseny, amely 2026-ban immár hatodik alkalommal kerül megrendezésre Bakonycsernyén. A versenyzők a sportpálya melletti rajthelyről indulva választhatnak különböző távok közül, melyek változatos terepen, erdőn és dombokon vezetnek. A szervezők kiváló lebonyolítást és kellemes futóélményt ígérnek, miközben a résztvevők gyönyörködhetnek a Bakony természeti szépségeiben. A verseny családbarát, kezdők és haladók számára egyaránt ajánlott.

name: ORFŰI TÓ – SHOW FUTÁS
description: Az Orfűi Tó-Show Futás a Melitta Szabadidő Sportegyesület hagyományos futóversenye, amely az Orfűi tó és strand nagyparkoló környékén kerül megrendezésre. A verseny során a Pécsi tavat egyszer vagy kétszer kell megkerülni közúton, az óra járásával megegyező irányban, nem a sétányon. A futóverseny családbarát esemény, ahol a részvétel mindenki saját felelősségére történik, és a versenyzők között nem csak profik, hanem amatőrök is egyaránt indulhatnak. A rendezvény a Barta Textilház támogatásával valósul meg, és a futók számára értékes jutalmakat biztosít, nem csak az időeredmények alapján.

name: TATAI MINIMARATON ÉS FÉLMARATON - Tata, Váralja út 13,5-21km. eredmények
Bear Foot Poľana
description: BEAR FOOT POĽANA 2026 is a mountain race set in the wild and unique Poľana Mountains, the highest and best-preserved volcano in Central Europe. The race offers two main courses: 24 km with over 1,300 metres of cumulative elevation gain, and 10 km with over 600 metres of elevation gain. The route passes through popular hiking spots such as Bystrô Waterfall, the Kaľamárka Celtic hillfort, and the summit of Predná Poľana. Runners can enjoy the beauty of deep forests, mountain streams, and pastures. The race is part of the Slovak Skyrunning Association league and is limited to 150 runners per course.

name: Porubska 11-ka
location: Porúbka okr. Bardejov, Porúbka okr. Bardejov, Porúbka
description: Porúbska 11-ka is a running race held in the village of Porúbka in Bardejov District. It features gently rolling, hilly to flat terrain at an elevation of 196 m. The course passes through the Carpathian region, which offers a combination of flat stretches and hills, ideal for runners looking for an enjoyable run in nature. The race is organized by the municipality of Porúbka and is part of local sporting activities with a tradition and community spirit. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes an active lifestyle in the region.

name: Island Gladiator Slovakia
location: Lednické Rovne, Medné, Lednické Rovne, Medné, Medné
description: Island Gladiator Slovakia is an OCR race that will test your strength, endurance, and determination in Slovakia’s authentic natural surroundings. The course runs through meadows, forests, streams, and hills, with a variety of technical sections and obstacles such as walls, crawling, pulling, balancing, and carrying loads. The race is open to men and women, from beginners to experienced athletes, with a time limit of 3 hours. Every participant receives an official T-shirt, a medal, a race pack, and electronic timing. Island Gladiator is not just a competition, but a challenge to overcome yourself and become a stronger gladiator.

name: LATERAL Mures 24H ~ 2026
description: Lateral Mures 24H is an endurance sports event organized by the Mureș Runners Association, held in the heart of nature on the Cornești Plateau in Târgu Mureș. The competition includes 24-hour MTB and trail-running events, both individual and team, as well as a 12-hour running race and a one-lap 10.5 km race. The course is an approximately 10.5 km loop with 215 m of elevation gain, mostly through forest, clearly marked during the day and with reflective signs at night. The event promotes team spirit, endurance, and a passion for exercising in nature.

name: Tura Licuricilor ~ 2026
description: The 11th edition of Tura Licuricilor is a running event held in Franz Joseph Park in Timișoara, starting at 20:30. The event is part of the Alergotura series, which promotes running as a lifestyle and the local sports community. Participants can enjoy a pleasant outdoor run in an urban natural setting, ideal for runners of all levels. The organizers provide support and motivation for taking up running and encourage community involvement.

name: Mogoșa Everesting
organizer: Asociația Club Sportiv de Alergare Montană Maramureș
description: Mogoșa Everesting is a mountain running competition held at Lake Mogoșa, Maramureș, Romania. Participants can compete individually or in teams, completing laps on the mountain course to reach a total elevation gain equivalent to an Everesting. The event is organized by the Maramureș Mountain Running Sports Club Association and offers a challenging, community-oriented experience, with categories for juniors and teams. Entry fees are affordable, and registration is open until places are filled.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://mogosaeveresting.ro/): 2027-07-31 — "31 Iulie 2027" (was estimated 2027-08-07)

name: Night Challenge Fruška Gora 2026
location: Restoran Na Vencu, Fruška Gora, Serbia
description: The Night Challenge on Fruška Gora is a sports and recreational event for hikers, runners, and nature lovers. It takes place on three courses of varying lengths: Fan Hiking (7 km), Hobby Trail (11 km), and Sport Trail (19 km). The start is at 21:00 by the Na Vencu restaurant, and participants have a time limit of 4 hours and 15 minutes to complete the course, allowing even the slowest participants to finish successfully. The event offers a unique opportunity to enjoy the nature of Fruška Gora at night.

name: 6. NIGHT CHALLENGE FRUŠKA GORA 2026
location: Spomenik Sloboda, Iriški venac, Fruška Gora, Serbia
description: The 6th Night Challenge Fruška Gora 2026 is a night OCR race held in the unspoiled nature of Fruška Gora, starting at the Monument to Freedom, Iriški Venac. Competitors can choose between two courses, 7 km and 13 km, which wind through dense forest and natural obstacles, including unique water obstacles at Ledinačko Lake. The race combines adrenaline-pumping obstacles with beautiful scenery and concludes in a spirit of camaraderie and celebration at the end of the season. The event is part of the Invictus OCR League and is intended for everyone who wants to test their limits and enjoy sport and nature.

name: KERESZTÚRI ÖNTÚLSZÁRNYALÁS FESZTIVÁL
description: A Keresztúri Öntúlszárnyalás Futófesztivál egy családias hangulatú futóverseny, amely a természet közelségét és az öntúlszárnyalás szellemét ötvözi. A verseny a Keresztúri erdőben, Budapest közelében zajlik, és több távon kínál kihívást, beleértve az 5,2 km, 10,5 km, félmaraton, 31,6 km és maraton távokat, valamint a különleges Yes, I can! versenyszámot. Ez az esemény a Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team szervezésében valósul meg, amely 1977 óta támogatja a futás szerelmeseit. A verseny célja, hogy minden résztvevő megtapasztalhassa a sportbarátságot és az önmagukon való túllépés örömét.

name: Klokočovská päťka
location: Obecný úrad, Klokočov, Michalovce District, Slovakia
description: Klokočovská päťka is a traditional running race organized by the municipality of Klokočov in the Michalovce District. This sporting event offers runners the chance to enjoy a pleasant day outdoors while supporting the community. The course passes through the municipality’s picturesque surroundings and is suitable for the general public. The organizers welcome all runners interested in being active and enjoying a sporting experience.
course_highlights: The route passes through the picturesque natural surroundings of Klokočov
The race is suitable for the general public and different age groups
The event promotes community spirit and sport in the region

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 8. kolo
description: The Bratislava 2-Mile Run is a regular running race organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team at the Kuchajda swimming pool complex in Bratislava. The race covers 2 miles (3.218 km), with categories for children, juniors, women, men, and veterans. Registration takes place on site from 9:30, and the start is at 10:00. The competition is part of a race series in which runners earn points toward a travelling cup based on their performances and participation in individual rounds.

name: Malý Kavečianský maratón
location: Kavečany - Košice, Kavečany - Košice, Futbalový štadión
organizer: TJ Mladosť Kavečany a MÚ MČ Košice - Kavečany
description: The Malý Kavečianský Marathon is a running event in Kavečany near Košice, offering 21 km and 7 km races as well as children’s runs. The race starts at the football stadium and is open to a wide range of categories, from children to veterans. It is organised by TJ Mladosť Kavečany together with the Košice-Kavečany Municipal District. The event is suitable for runners of various ages and ability levels, with affordable entry fees and online registration available.

name: Benefičný beh pre Marcelku
description: The Run for Marcelka is a charity running event in Kluknava, offering courses for both children and adults. The main run is 5.5 km long, runs mostly on asphalt, and is suitable for the general public. The event also includes children’s races and Nordic walking, with refreshment stations along the course. The race takes place at the football field in Kluknava, where full facilities are available, including changing rooms, showers, and toilets.
course_highlights: The 5.5 km main run is 95% on asphalt
Refreshments along the course and at the finish (water, fruit, cakes)
Registration and start at the football field in Kluknava
additional: Registration and race-pack collection on race day from 14:30 to 16:30 at the football field. Changing rooms, showers, toilets, and a bag drop are available in the start area. Parking is available by the church, manor house, and kindergarten in Kluknava.

name: JAZZFŐVÁROS-FUTÁS
description: A Jazzfőváros-futás egy hagyományos futóverseny Kecskeméten, a Benkó Zoltán Szabadidőközpontban. A rendezvény családias hangulatban zajlik, és vonzza a futás szerelmeseit a környékről. A verseny ideális alkalom a szabadidős sportolásra, közösségi élményre és a természet közelségének élvezetére.
course_highlights: A verseny a Benkó Zoltán Szabadidőközpont területén zajlik
Kecskemét és környéke természeti szépségei mellett halad
Különböző futótávok és szabadidős futás lehetősége

name: Východniarska
location: Kluknava, parkovisko pred Kaštieľom hotela Biela dáma, čierny rytier – 8.8.2026 o 9:00
description: Východniarska is a mountain ultratrail and long-distance hike for individuals, building on the popular Východniarska stovka. The route runs through the eastern part of the Slovak Ore Mountains, mostly through the Volovské vrchy, and offers a challenging 85 km run with +4200 m of elevation gain. The start is in Kluknava and the finish in Kysak, with a time limit of 22 hours. The event is open to the public to participants aged 18 and over and requires proper registration and payment of the entry fee.

name: Hámorská dvadsiatka
location: Obecný úrad Remetské Hámre, Remetské Hámre, Slovakia
description: Hámorská dvadsiatka is a traditional running race organized by the municipality of Remetské Hámre. Despite the cancellation of the last two editions due to the Covid-19 pandemic, the organizers are looking forward to bringing the event back and welcoming a large turnout of runners. The race takes place in the beautiful natural surroundings of the Vihorlat Mountains, which offer attractive routes for sports enthusiasts.
course_highlights: The route passes through the natural surroundings of the Vihorlat Mountains
Beautiful views and tourist attractions in the area
Organized by the municipality of Remetské Hámre, with a long-standing tradition

name: Rajecký maratón
location: Námestie SNP, Rajec, Žilina District, Slovakia
description: The Rajec Marathon is a traditional running race organized by the Rajec Marathon Club, held in the picturesque surroundings of Rajec and the surrounding area. Runners can expect a challenging course with elevation gain and beautiful natural scenery that will test their endurance and fitness. The event has a friendly, family-oriented atmosphere, reflected in its side events and the hospitality at the finish. In addition to the marathon, a half marathon, relay, cross duathlon, and the popular Rajec Borošovec are also held. The Borošovec is a cross-country classic with more than 200 meters of elevation gain.
course_highlights: A course with more than 200 meters of elevation gain
The Rajec Borošovec cross-country classic, 14.1 km long
Natural scenery in Rajec and the surrounding area
additional: The Rajec Borošovec is part of the events that kick off the running season in the Rajec Valley. After the races, participants are served goulash and homemade cakes. The Rajec Borošovec course is dry and fast, with possible obstacles such as fallen trees. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere and also attracts younger runners and juniors.

name: Rajecký In-line polmaratón
location: Námestie SNP, Rajec, Žilina District, Slovakia
description: The Rajecký In-line Half Marathon is a competitive inline skating race held in Rajec at SNP Square. The course runs from Rajec to the village of Čičmany and back, with the finish at the marathon turnaround point in Čičmany. Skaters must wear a helmet throughout the course and use the rented timing chips, which must be returned at the finish. The organizer provides refreshments, changing rooms and showers, as well as free transport back to Rajec for inline skaters. The final finishing straight is reserved for runners, so participants must follow the organizer’s rules.

name: Rajecká štafeta
location: Námestie SNP, Rajec, Žilina District, Slovakia
description: The Rajec Relay is a running event organized by Maratón klub Rajec, held at SNP Square in Rajec. It is a relay race that is part of the Rajec Marathon and gives athletes the opportunity to compete in teams. The organizer provides race bibs, timekeeping, and full support for participants during the race. The event is suitable for runners of various levels and promotes community spirit and enthusiasm for sport in the region.

name: Rajecký detský beh
location: Námestie SNP, Rajec, Žilina District, Slovakia
description: The Rajecký Children’s Run is a running event organized by Maratón klub Rajec, held at SNP Square in Rajec. It is aimed at children and underage runners, with an emphasis on safety and responsibility: a parent or legal guardian must sign for them to participate. The event is part of a wider running program in Rajec and gives young runners the opportunity to experience the atmosphere of a race in a pleasant urban setting.
course_highlights: The race takes place at SNP Square in Rajec
For children and underage runners
Safety is supported by a parent or legal guardian’s signature
additional: Children and underage participants must bring a signed declaration from a parent or legal guardian. Participation will not be permitted without it.

name: Retezat Mountain Run ~ 2026
description: Retezat Mountain Run is a mountain running competition held in the Retezat Mountains, with routes climbing to the summit of Mount Retezat. The event offers four races of varying difficulty and distance, from the 8.5 km Easy Run to a nearly 40 km Marathon with over 3,300 m of elevation gain. The routes cross wild landscapes, with aid stations in hard-to-reach areas, and the event is organized with the help of dedicated volunteers and mountain authorities. The event continues the tradition of the Retezat Marathon, with a new team and a long-term plan for continuity.

name: ALERG ÎN DUMBRAVĂ
description: Alerg în Dumbravă is a social, sporting, and charitable event that promotes outdoor running and a healthy lifestyle. It takes place in Homu Forest, north of the village of Glogoveanu, Dâmbovița County. The event features marathon, half-marathon, and cross-country races dedicated to the memory of local personalities, offering an outdoor experience on accessible trails and dirt roads. Recreational activities such as Latin dancing and a campfire add to the welcoming community atmosphere. Now in its seventh edition, the long-running event also supports an important social cause by helping Mia’s Children Association.

name: 44. Kanjiža Running & Swimming Festival
distance_verbose: 13 km, 10 km, 4 km, 3000 metara, 2.6 km, 1.4 km, 0.9 km, 0.57 km, 0.2 km
description: The running and swimming festival in Kanjiža brings competitors together on the banks of the Tisa, with a program that combines road running and open-water swimming. The swimming events take place at the beach, with disciplines for different ages and experience levels, from short distances to a 3,000-meter race. Welcome to a day of sports by the river, for competitors and fans of active recreation.
course_highlights: Swimming events take place at the beach on the banks of the Tisa.
The swimming program includes distances from 25 to 3,000 meters.
The festival also includes road running in Kanjiža.

name: SZUFLA FUTÓFESZTIVÁL
description: A SZUFLA Futófesztivál egy családias hangulatú, több távon teljesíthető futóverseny Szigethalmon, a festői Tököli Parkerdőben. A versenyen kezdők és ultrafutók egyaránt megtalálják a kihívást, 5 km-től egészen 52 km-es távig, valamint váltóverseny is várja a csapatokat. A rendezvényen a futás mellett számos kísérőprogram is színesíti a napot, így a család minden tagja jól érezheti magát. A verseny hagyományosan augusztus első hétvégéjén kerül megrendezésre, és a résztvevők chip-es időméréssel mérik teljesítményüket.
course_highlights: Tököli Parkerdőben kijelölt 6,178 km-es körpálya 30 méter szintemelkedéssel
Váltóverseny 52 km-es távon, 2-4 fős csapatokkal
Gyermekfutamok és fogyatékkal élők futása a versenyközpont előtti aszfaltozott útvonalon
additional: A verseny napján 7:00-kor kezdődik a helyszíni nevezés. Az időmérés chip rendszerrel történik, melynek letéti díja 2000 Ft. A chip leadása után a letéti díj visszajár, de felajánlható jótékony célra a Fogyatékosok Napközi Otthonának támogatására. A versenyen tilos a résztvevők kísérése bármilyen módon. A frissítőpontok 3 km-enként vannak, megnövelt kínálattal. A verseny 15:00-kor zár, ez a szintidő is egyben. A rendezvényen egész nap ingyenes programok várják a gyerekeket (arcfestés, csillámtetoválás, kreatív sarok, ugrálóvár). Ebédjegyek vásárolhatók paprikás krumpli és palacsinta fogyasztására.

name: RossbRUNn Trail
location: Lókút Sportközpont, Bem utca, Lókút, Hungary
distance_verbose: 56 km, Maraton, 28 km, 14 km, 7 km, 1500 meter, 1 km, 0.5 km

name: Beh na Kráľovu studňu
location: Lenartov, okr. Bardejov, Lenartov, okr. Bardejov, Motorest Javorina Lenartov
description: The Run to Kráľova studňa is a traditional uphill race held in the picturesque village of Lenartov, near the historic Kráľova studňa, a meeting place of three kings. The course winds through beautiful countryside and offers a unique mountain-running experience, rich in history and scenic views. The event is part of the local running league and attracts runners from across the region. The organizers create a friendly atmosphere and welcome all participants, regardless of ability.

name: Maratonul Nordului Teioasa Trail
description: The Maratonul Nordului Teioasa Trail is a trail-running race held in northern Romania, offering participants an authentic experience amid spectacular scenery. The event promotes health, community, and adventure, bringing together passionate runners in a remarkable natural setting. The routes are designed to showcase the beauty of the area and the spirit of northern Romania.

name: Serbia EPIC STARA PLANINA #5
location: Hotel Stara Planina, Jabučko Ravnište, Stara Planina, Serbia
description: Serbia EPIC STARA PLANINA is a sporting event that brings runners together on the trails of Stara Planina mountain. The races are held as part of the Škoda Serbia Epic series and include trail races of different distances, with a time limit of 3 hours. The start and finish are at Hotel Stara Planina, and participants collect their race packets on site. This event promotes health, sport, and a family-friendly atmosphere in a beautiful natural setting.
course_highlights: 15 km and 6 km courses
Start and finish at Hotel Stara Planina
The race time limit is 3 hours
additional: Race packets must be collected in person during the designated hours and are not mailed. Race packets can be collected the day before the race at Hotel Stara Planina and on race day at the start/finish. Race packets are collected at Hotel Stara Planina; they are not mailed. The time limit for the races is 3 hours.

name: Ultra Race Romania
description: Ultra Race Romania is a unique long-distance running race covering 250 km over 6 stages, in a self-sufficient format, exploring the unspoiled wilderness, culture, and history of the Siriu area in Buzău. Participants will tackle a challenging route through the Carpathian Mountains, with legendary scenery and places steeped in local stories and mysteries. After the race, runners are invited to stay for two days to discover Romania’s traditions, cuisine, and famous tourist attractions, such as Peleș Castle and Bran Castle. The event focuses on the experience of a lifetime, lasting friendships, and the joy of being part of this extraordinary adventure.

name: Chminianskonovovesský beh
location: Chminianska Nová Ves, okr. Prešov, Chminianska Nová Ves, okr. Prešov, futbalové ihrisko OŠK Chminianska Nová Ves
organizer: ThLic. Mgr. Pavol Uličný a obec Chminianska Nova Ves
description: The Chminianskonovovesský Run is a traditional running race organized by the municipality of Chminianska Nová Ves and ThLic. Mgr. Pavol Uličný. The race takes place at the OŠK Chminianska Nová Ves football pitch in the Prešov District and offers categories for different age groups of men, women, and youth. It is a community sporting event that promotes an active lifestyle and enthusiasm for sport in the region.

name: Runica Nevoľné
location: Nevoľné, okr. Žiar nad Hronom, Nevoľné, okr. Žiar nad Hronom, futbalové ihrisko
organizer: Marathon Banska Bystrica, s.r.o., ON-POINT o.z.
description: Runica Nevoľné is a running event held at the football field in Nevoľné, Žiar nad Hronom District. The race offers a unique experience in the heart of Slovakia, where runners can enjoy a welcoming atmosphere and well-organized event. The course is suitable for runners of various levels, and the event is part of the Marathon Tour running series. The organizers welcome all runners looking to enjoy a sporting event in a beautiful setting.

name: Štafetový beh 345 km od Tatier k Dunaju Jasná – Bratislava
location: Demänovská dolina, Demänovská dolina, Jasná, Demänovská dolina
description: The Relay Run from the Tatras to the Danube is the largest relay race in Slovakia, covering a distance of 345 km. Teams of 6 or 9 to 12 members start in Jasná in the Low Tatras and run nonstop through day and night, finishing on the Danube embankment in Bratislava. The course is mostly paved, with approximately 3,990 metres of total ascent and 4,870 metres of descent. Runners complete 36 legs of varying length and difficulty; in a 12-member team, each member runs three legs. The race is a test of team spirit and endurance in Slovakia’s beautiful surroundings.

name: Bobija Trail
description: Bobija Trail is a mountain trail race on Bobija, near Tornik, for runners who want to experience forest trails and a climb through the natural landscapes of western Serbia. Previous editions offered several distances, including 9, 15, and 26 km, giving runners of different experience levels a choice. The routes cross challenging mountain terrain, and the race is organized by West Serbia Trails.
course_highlights: Mountain forest trails on Bobija
15 km route with around 650 m of total elevation gain
Several race distances, including 9 and 26 km
additional: Previous editions had the race base at the elementary school in a village on Bobija.

name: SÁRKÁNYFUTÁS
organizer: Tatai Tömegsport és Tájfutó Honvéd Sportegyesület
description: A Sárkányfutás egy izgalmas futóverseny, amelyet a Tatai Tömegsport és Tájfutó Honvéd Sportegyesület szervez. A verseny terepfutás jellegű, változatos és kihívásokkal teli útvonalon zajlik, amely a természet közelségét és a sport élményét ötvözi. A rendezvény barátságos hangulatú, minden korosztály számára nyitott, és a futók közösségi élményét is erősíti. A verseny helyszíne Súr, Magyarország, és a szervezők nagy hangsúlyt fektetnek a gördülékeny lebonyolításra és a résztvevők elégedettségére.

name: Jazerný maratón
location: Košice - sídlisko Nad Jazerom, Košice - sídlisko Nad Jazerom, splav Jazero 0-tý km /Jenisejská ul./Košice
description: The Jazerný Marathon is a running challenge held in Košice, in the Nad Jazerom neighbourhood, offering distances from 5 to 42 km. The race follows a 2.5 km stretch along the Hornád River embankment, with a high-quality asphalt surface and minimal elevation gain, making it suitable for runners of varying levels. The event has a 15-year tradition and is ideal for those looking for a fast and enjoyable run in nature close to the city. The organisers welcome all runners who want to test themselves over different distances.

name: Cestou Grófa Júliusa Andrássyho
location: Trebišov, Trebišov, priestor pri Mestskom kultúrnom stredisku
description: The Run Along the Route of Count Július Andrássy takes place in Trebišov near the Municipal Cultural Centre and offers various categories, including running, a summer walk, cycling, Nordic walking, and a virtual race. The start is scheduled for 16:15 for children and 16:25 for the main category. The event is suitable for all age groups, including children up to 7 years old and older children up to 13 years old. The organizer, Ing. Michal Majcher, ensures a pleasant atmosphere and well-organized races.

name: GLS NIGHT CROS CHALLENGE Start la muzeul în aer liber din Dumbrava Sibiului
description: GLS Night Cross Challenge is a night running race with a 10-year tradition in Sibiu, held in Dumbrava Sibiului. The event offers a unique outdoor running experience on specially prepared trails, surrounded by nature, promoting a healthy and active lifestyle. Participants can enjoy a friendly yet challenging atmosphere, ideal for amateurs and athletes of all levels. The organizers emphasize pushing personal limits and the joy of running together as a community.

name: GLS Night Cross Challenge ~ 2026
description: Night Cross Challenge powered by GLS is Romania’s most beautiful night cross-country race, reaching its 12th edition in 2026. The event takes place at the Dumbrava Sibiului Open-Air Museum, offering participants a unique running experience on marked routes after dark. Races are available for adults over distances of 4.5 km and 9 km, as well as children over distances of 500 m, 1,000 m, and 1,300 m. The competition is open to all age groups from 5 to 75 years, with prizes for the winners of the open category in the 9 km race.

name: KESZTHELYI KILOMÉTEREK
description: A Keszthelyi Kilométerek egy hagyományos futóverseny a Balaton partján, amely a Festetics-kastély hátsó parkjában kerül megrendezésre. A versenyen több táv közül választhatnak a résztvevők, 3 km-től egészen a félmaratonig, egyéniben és váltóban is. Emellett gyermek futamok is várják a legkisebbeket, korcsoportonként különböző távokon. A rendezvény családias hangulatú, és a Balaton-parti környezet különleges élményt nyújt a futóknak.

name: Night Run Liptovský Mikuláš
description: Night Run Liptovský Mikuláš is an evening running event that invites participants to experience the city on a night run. The event takes place in Liptovský Mikuláš, with the start and event hub located at Námestie osloboditeľov. The 2027 edition is scheduled for August 21.

name: Rusínska 100 a 66
description: Rusínska 100 and 66 is a late-summer ultrarun and long-distance walk starting and finishing in the town of Stropkov. The routes lead through the Ondava Highlands in Zemplín County and continue into Šariš County via the town of Svidník, crossing a region of Rusyn villages and following the border with Poland. The R100 route partly passes through the Eastern Carpathians Protected Landscape Area. The event is part of the Slovak Ultratrail League, is certified by ITRA, and is included in the ITRA National League. It is organized by o.z. Klub bežcov Stropkov, which provides a warm welcome and high-quality organization.

name: Hradný gaštanový beh Modrý Kameň
location: Modrý Kameň, Modrý Kameň, park pred vstupom do Hradu Modrý Kameň
organizer: Mesto Modrý Kameň v spolupráci s občianskym združením Bežci VK
description: The Modrý Kameň Castle Chestnut Run is a running event held in the park in front of the entrance to Modrý Kameň Castle. The race offers various categories, including a 5 km hobby race for children and juniors, a 10 km main race for adults, and 5 km Nordic walking. The course runs along paved roads, meadows, and forest and field paths, offering a varied and enjoyable running experience. The event is organized by the Town of Modrý Kameň in cooperation with the Bežci VK civic association. The children’s race starts at 10:00 and the adults’ race at 11:00.

name: Čachtický polmaratón
location: Čachtice okr. Nové Mesto n. Váhom, Čachtice okr. Nové Mesto n. Váhom, námestie
description: The Čachtice Half Marathon is a traditional half-marathon race held in the village of Čachtice. The course runs mostly on paved roads through the streets of Čachtice and into Višňové and Hrachovište, with a short section on a forest road. The route is gently undulating, with a maximum elevation gain of up to 90 metres. The start is in the square in Čachtice, and the finish is at the grounds of the Čachtice Elementary School. Refreshment stations are provided at several points along the course.

name: Forbaský beh pomoci
location: Forbasy, okres Stará Ľubovňa, Forbasy, okres Stará Ľubovňa, areál Ščava
description: The Forbasy Charity Run is a charity race held at the Ščava grounds in Forbasy, in the Stará Ľubovňa district. The event has a voluntary entry fee and supports aid and solidarity. Runners can enjoy a pleasant atmosphere while contributing to a good cause. The organizer is Valer Kuffa, who is available to provide information and support to participants.

name: Lukačovská 5
location: Lukačovce, okr. Humenné, Lukačovce, okr. Humenné, Futbalové ihrisko
description: Lukačovská 5 is a running race held on the football pitch in Lukačovce, Humenné District. The event offers a 5 km main race and children’s races, with categories for men, women, and a non-competitive Nordic Walking category. The organizer is the Municipality of Lukačovce, which provides a welcoming atmosphere and high-quality race organization. The children’s races start at 10:00 and the main race begins at 11:00.

name: Harhovská desiatka
location: Spišský Hrhov, Spišský Hrhov, pred Obecným úradom
description: Harhovská desiatka is a running event in Spišský Hrhov, offering a 10 km course and a shorter 3.5 km course for recreational and beginner runners. The races are divided into several age categories for men and women, including a special category for residents of Spišský Hrhov. The event is organized by the municipality of Spišský Hrhov, and the start is in front of the Municipal Office. The entry fee is paid at registration and is €10 for the 10 km course and €5 for the 3.5 km course.

name: Brezovský letný beh
location: Rimavské Brezovo, Rimavské Brezovo, Športové ihrisko
description: The Brezov Health Run is a traditional running race in the village of Brezov, Bardejov District. Its route runs along asphalt, field, and forest roads. The race is open to men and women, including participants aged 15 and under and those over 15. The organizers offer two entry categories, with a large or small package, making it possible to take part in this sporting event in pleasant surroundings near the Municipal Office in Brezov. The race is suitable for runners of various ages and ability levels.

name: Behaj lesmi Čičmany
description: Behaj lesmi Čičmany is a running race set in the picturesque Slovak folk village of Čičmany. The course winds through the Strážov Mountains, surrounded by beautiful scenery, unspoiled forests, and expansive meadows. The race is part of the Behaj lesmi series and is included in the UTMB Index Races, giving it international recognition and ranking. Choose from several distances: a long 20 km run with 718 m of elevation gain, the intermediate 11 km Lesnícka course with 380 m of elevation gain, or a short 5 km course. The event also features a special Conti Speed Section, where the top runners can win valuable prizes.

name: 2X2 Race
location: Lacul Bâlea, Transfăgărășan, Sibiu County, Romania
description: 2X2 Race is an extremely technical and challenging mountain ultramarathon, held entirely above 2,000 m in the Făgăraș Mountains, Romania. The main 45 km course, with 4,200 m of elevation gain, passes over Romania’s two highest peaks, Moldoveanu and Negoiu. Two other races, X1 Race (26 km, 2,400 m elevation gain) and X2 Race (18 km, 1,900 m elevation gain), are also highly technical and intense, and intended for runners with mountain experience. Participation is limited and subject to experience requirements to ensure competitors’ safety given the high physical and mental demands.

name: Via Transilvanica Maraton
description: Via Transilvanica Marathon 2026 is a sporting event that celebrates Romania’s nature and unique heritage, held along the Via Transilvanica route. The marathon offers a challenge of 39.3 km with an elevation gain of 1,292 m, crossing forest roads, villages, and panoramic landscapes. Participants enjoy a friendly atmosphere, with well-organized checkpoints and hydration stations, as well as activities for children. The event is organized by the Țășuleasa Social Association, which promotes volunteering and respect for nature.

name: CROS DONATON
location: Muzeul Etnografic al Transilvaniei, Cluj-Napoca, Cluj County, Romania

name: Tara Extreme Skymarathon – 5. kolo Nacionalne serije u planinskom trčanju
description: Tara Extreme Skymarathon is a challenging mountain running race held on the beautiful and demanding trails of Tara National Park. The race is part of the National Mountain Running Series and brings together competitors who want to test their physical and mental limits on demanding terrain with significant elevation gain. The start and finish are in Mitrovac, the traditional location for this event. During the race, participants can enjoy spectacular views and Tara’s wild natural scenery.
course_highlights: Trails with significant elevation gain of up to 3150 meters
The beautiful, wild nature of Tara National Park
Three different courses: SkyTrail (10 km), SkyRace (24 km), SkyMarathon (44 km)
additional: The race takes place in Mitrovac, with the start and finish at the same location. There are three courses with different distances and elevation gains: SkyTrail (10 km, 700D+), SkyRace (24 km, 1700D+), SkyMarathon (44 km, 3150D+). The race is known for its difficulty and for testing competitors’ limits. The organizers thank the competitors, volunteers, and sponsors for their support.

name: Tara Extreme Skychallange
organizer: Udruženje Tara Ultra i PK Tara
description: Tara Extreme SkyChallenge is a unique skyrunning race held in the heart of Tara National Park, starting and finishing at the Mountain Lodge in Rastište. The race features three different courses that are technically demanding and physically challenging, intended for experienced mountain runners. Sports and recreational activities for all ages are also organized as part of the event, making it appealing to a wider audience. The courses are certified according to ISF, ITRA and UTMB standards, and the race is part of the PSS National Mountain Running Series.

name: Minimaratón
location: Banská Bystrica, Banská Bystrica, Atletický štadión na Štiavničkách
organizer: Marathon Banska Bystrica, s.r.o., ON-POINT OZ, Minimaratón OZ
description: The Mini Marathon is a unique running event exclusively for families with children, held at the Štiavničky athletics stadium in Banská Bystrica. The event offers different age categories, from the youngest runners to older children, including mothers with strollers. The course is adapted to each age group, with 400 m and 200 m circuits. Alongside the sporting experience, there is an accompanying program with activities for children and meetups with athletes. Every participant receives a commemorative race bib, a medal, and refreshments after finishing.

name: Beh na boso Tatry
location: Veľká Lomnica, Veľká Lomnica, Golfový rezort Black Stork
description: Beh na boso Tatry is a running event in the beautiful surroundings of the Black Stork Golf Resort in Veľká Lomnica. Participants can choose between non-competitive runs for children and adults and a competitive 5 km run. The course runs across mown grass, paths and pebbles, giving it a cross-country character. The event is suitable for all age groups and offers a pleasant atmosphere in the nature of the Tatras. The organizer, OZ Beh na boso Tatry, ensures the event runs smoothly.

name: Underdogs
description: Underdogs - The Backyard Ultra is a unique endurance race set in the beautiful landscape of Brebu, Dâmbovița County, Romania. Participants run repeated 6.8 km loops, with a start every hour, until only one competitor remains in the race. This competition tests runners’ physical and mental limits, offering an intense, community-focused experience where every step is a challenge and a story of resilience. Founded on Lazarus Lake’s concept, the race brings together ultra-running enthusiasts in an adventurous setting built on mutual support.

name: MOVE SZOMBATHELY SUNSET RUN
description: A MOVE Szombathely Sunset Run egy egyedülálló esti és éjszakai futóverseny Szombathely főterén, amely gyermekeknek és amatőr futóknak egyaránt kínál lehetőséget a részvételre. A verseny különleges hangulatát a naplemente és a város központjának atmoszférája adja, így egy kellemes és motiváló futóélményt nyújt. A rendezvény célja, hogy minden korosztály számára elérhetővé tegye a futást, miközben közösségi élményt is biztosít.

name: BUDAI NIGHT TRAIL
location: Telki Sportcsarnok, Kamilla utca 1–3, Telki, Hungary
description: A BUDAI NIGHT TRAIL egy éjszakai terepfutó verseny Telkiben, amely változatos távokat kínál a résztvevőknek. A verseny útvonala jól jelzett, szalagokkal és táblákkal van ellátva, és a futók kézzel festett, Magyarországon készült fém befutóérmet kapnak. A pályán frissítők, egészségügyi biztosítás és egyéb kényelmi szolgáltatások állnak rendelkezésre, így a versenyzők biztonságban és támogatva érezhetik magukat. A rendezvény hagyományosan nagy tapasztalattal szervezett, barátságos és családias hangulatú esemény.
course_highlights: 35,5 km táv 1114 m szintemelkedéssel
Jól jelzett útvonal szalagokkal és táblákkal
Kézzel festett, Magyarországon készült fém befutóérem
additional: Rajt és cél a Telki Sportcsarnoknál, Kamilla u. 1 - 3. Rajtcsomag átvételi idők távonként eltérőek. A pályán frissítők: csokoládé, gumicukor, sajt, aszalt és friss gyümölcsök, izotóniás ital és sótabletta. A verseny alatt egészségügyi biztosítás, női higiéniai termékek, csomagmegőrzés és zuhanyzási lehetőség biztosított. A célban meleg étel (vegán, gluténmentes, vegetáriánus, húsos) és befutósör (alkoholmentes és alkoholmentes gyümölcsös) választható. A versenyfotók ingyenesen letölthetők. Saját tányér hozatala szükséges.

name: SUHANJ!6
location: Margitszigeti Atlétikai Centrum, Margaret Island, Budapest, Hungary
description: A SUHANJ! 6 egy jótékonysági futóverseny, amely a fogyatékossággal élők támogatását szolgálja. A verseny 6 órás időtartamban zajlik, ahol egyénileg vagy csapatban kell a lehető legtöbb kört teljesíteni a Margitsziget sík, akadálymentes, 3,5 km-es körpályáján. A rendezvény éjszaka, éjfélkor kezdődik, és garantált a napfelkelte látványa. A verseny mellett éjfél előtt mozgássérült sportolók handbike versenye és egy éjszakai félmaraton is zajlik. A versenyközpont a Margitszigeti Atlétikai Centrum, ahol öltöző, zuhanyzó és frissítőpontok állnak a futók rendelkezésére.
course_highlights: 3,5 km hosszú, teljesen sík, akadálymentes körpálya Margitszigeten
2500 méter aszfaltos út a Margitsziget középső útján, 400 méter rekortán pálya a MAC-on
Éjszakai futás, rajt éjfélkor, napfelkelte a pályán
additional: A versenyen nincs helyszíni nevezés, de korlátozott számban lehetőség van késői nevezésre jótékony futóként, arany színű rajtszámmal CHARITY RUNNER felirattal. A csapatok 2-10 fősek lehetnek, váltás korlátlan alkalommal, akár körönként is. A versenyen fejlámpa/testlámpa használata kötelező pirkadatig. Rajtszámfelvétel több napos, személyesen vagy meghatalmazott útján a SUHANJ! Fitnessben (Budapest 13. kerület). A versenyközpontban öltöző, zuhanyzó, WC és csomagmegőrző áll rendelkezésre. A frissítőpontokon saját pohár vagy kulacs használata javasolt. A verseny után reggeli és jótékonysági tombola várja a résztvevőket.

name: TÖRÖKBÁLINTI HENDIKEP
description: A Törökbálinti Hendikep futóverseny rajtja és célja a törökbálinti Dióskertben van. A pálya négy körből áll, de a résztvevők kevesebb kört is teljesíthetnek, így saját vállalásukhoz igazíthatják a távot. A verseny barátságos, közösségi alkalmat kínál a futáshoz a Dióskert környezetében.
course_highlights: Négykörös pálya, amelyből kevesebb kör is teljesíthető.
Rajt és cél a törökbálinti Dióskertben.
A körös formátum lehetőséget ad a táv egyéni megválasztására.

name: Prešov Half Marathon
description: The Prešov Half Marathon is a road running event in the centre of Prešov, with the start and event facilities on Hlavná Street. The half-marathon course runs through the city, and its certified loop gives runners the chance to discover the city in a sporting atmosphere. The event also typically includes shorter races and a children’s run.
course_highlights: Urban course in the historic centre of Prešov
Half-marathon distance of 21.1 km on a certified loop
Start and finish in the Hlavná Street area
additional: In previous editions, the programme also included a 10 km race, a shorter race and a children’s mini-marathon.

name: Beh vďaky Senica – Prietrž – pamätník SNP u Rehušov
location: Pamätník SNP u Rehušov, Prietrž, Senica District, Trnava Region, Slovakia

name: OSLEA RUN
description: Oslea Run is a mountain running competition held in the Retezat and Vâlcan Mountains, in the area of the Oslea, Paltina, and Piatra Iorgovanului massifs. Organized by Clubul Alpin Valea Jiului, the event continues the local tradition of mountain running, offering four daytime races that showcase spectacular trails in the heart of nature, at the meeting point of Retezat and Domogled–Valea Cernei National Parks. Participants enjoy an authentic outdoor experience, with challenging routes and impressive scenery. The event also includes a children’s race, as well as related social and cultural activities.

name: Oslea Run ~ 2026
description: Oslea Run is a mountain running competition held in the Retezat and Vâlcan Mountains, around the Oslea, Paltina, and Piatra Iorgovanului massifs, organized by Clubul Alpin Valea Jiului. The event continues the area's tradition of mountain running, offering four daytime races that showcase spectacular routes amid nature, where Retezat and Domogled-Valea Cernei National Parks meet. Participants enjoy an authentic outdoor experience, with prizes, race kits, and related activities such as tastings and socializing.

name: Aventura în Vrancea Sălbatică
location: Putna-Vrancea Natural Park, Vrancea County, Romania

name: Iskra Avala Night Trail
description: Iskra Avala Night Trail is a night trail race held on Mount Avala. The start is at 20:30 in front of the Avala Tower, and runners will enjoy the unique atmosphere of a night-time adventure, with headlamps required. In addition to the race, a race village with food, drinks and music will be set up in the start and finish area. The race is open to runners, walkers and Nordic walkers, with prizes for the top finishers in the men’s and women’s categories at both distances.

name: Dunavske Čarolije 2026
description: Dunavske Čarolije is a unique event in Čortanovci combining running, cycling, orienteering, water jumping, hiking, films, music, and volleyball. This festival of sport and entertainment brings together participants of all ages and offers a variety of activities on the banks of the Danube. The atmosphere is friendly and family-oriented, with a rich program running throughout the day. Everyone is invited to join and enjoy the charms of the Danube and the sporting challenges.

name: NYAKVÁGÓ MARATON
distance_verbose: Maraton, 22 km, 14 km, 7 km, 3000 meter, 0.4 km
description: A Nyakvágó Maraton egy kemény terepfutó verseny Ballószögön, amely különböző távokon kínál kihívást a futóknak és terepkerékpárosoknak. A verseny változatos útvonalakon halad, mezőgazdasági földutakon, erdei szakaszokon és salakos futópályán, ahol a természet védelme kiemelten fontos. A résztvevők több frissítőpontot találnak a pályán, és a versenyzők korcsoportok szerint is díjazásban részesülnek. A rendezvény családbarát, gyerekfutam is van, amely az egészséges életmódra nevelést szolgálja.
course_highlights: Változatos terep: mezőgazdasági földutak, erdei ösvények, salakos futópálya
Frissítőpontok 4-5 kilométerenként vízzel, gyümölccsel és szőlőcukorral
Gyerekfutam egészséges életmódra neveléssel, díjazással
additional: A terepkerékpár versenyen bukósisak viselése kötelező. A versenyen kötelező felszerelés a nevezéskor megadott mobiltelefon, valamint javasolt kulacs vagy víztartály, pohár nélkül zajlik a frissítés. Póló rendelés lehetséges augusztus 19-ig, amit a verseny napján lehet átvenni. Gyerekfutam 400 méteren helyszíni regisztrációval, díjazással.

name: UFO ÓCSA FUTÁS
description: Az UFÓ Ócsa Futás egy népszerű városi futóverseny, amely Ócsa városában, az Egressy Gábor Szabadidőközpont környékén kerül megrendezésre. A verseny több távon kínál kihívást, köztük 10,5 km-es és 21 km-es futamokat, amelyek a város nevezetességein vezetnek keresztül. A verseny egyedi chipes időméréssel zajlik, és a helyezéseket a bruttó idő alapján rangsorolják. A rendezvény családias hangulatú, korhatár megkötésekkel, és korlátozott indulói létszámmal várja a futókat.

name: Draždiak Run
location: Bratislava - Petržalka, Bratislava - Petržalka, Veľký Draždiak (Pláž pri bufete Barracuda).
description: Draždiak Run is a running event held in Bratislava, in the Veľký Draždiak area of Petržalka. Runners can expect courses along gravel and hiking trails, suitable for different age groups and ability levels. The event includes children’s races, 5 km races for adults, Nordic walking, and a family run with a dog. It is organized by Športová Nadácia Kotrmelec, which provides a welcoming atmosphere and high-quality organization.

name: Beh pod Sninským kameňom
location: Snina, Snina, Rekreačná oblasť Sninske rybníky - OMW Snina
description: The Run beneath Sninský kameň is a running event in the Sninské rybníky recreational area in Snina, offering races for children and adults. The courses are on asphalt and dirt roads, while the children’s categories cover distances from 50 to 600 metres depending on age. The main category starts at 16:30 and is divided into men’s and women’s age groups. The event is organised by BehajmeSpolu o.z. in cooperation with the city of Snina. The entry fee is €15 for online registration and €20 on the day.

name: Vrancea Montană Run
description: Vrancea Montană Run is a mountain running event held in the Vrancea Mountains, in the commune of Păulești, offering an authentic experience in nature for runners of all levels. The race features two main events: an 11 km cross-country race with approximately 350 m of elevation gain and a 21 km half marathon with 550 m of elevation gain. Both take place on varied, unpaved routes combining forest roads, trails, and rugged terrain. The event is organized by the Vrancea Montană Association with support from Păulești City Hall, and promotes respect for the wilderness and fair play among competitors. Participants also contribute to a worthy cause by supporting wildlife rehabilitation in Romania.

name: Maratonul Olteniei
description: Maratonul Olteniei is a multi-sport event featuring running, MTB, and Hyathlon Sprint, held in Zăvoi Park in Râmnicu Vâlcea. The event promotes team spirit and the joy of being together, emphasizing the connections between participants and their shared motivation. It is a celebration of sport and nature, with a strong tradition and a dedicated community. Participants enjoy varied courses and a friendly atmosphere that encourages performance and socializing.

name: Avala noćna trail 2026
description: Iskra Avala Night Trail is a night trail race held on the plateau in front of the Avala Tower in Belgrade. The race starts at 20:30 and offers a unique nighttime experience on Mount Avala, with a race village for entertainment before, during, and after the race. Participants can choose between two distances, 6 km and 10 km, and a headlamp is required. The race is open to runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers, with prizes for the top male and female finishers in both distances.

name: EMU 6 DAYS RACE / GOMU 6 DAYS WORLD CHAMPIONSHIP
description: Az EMU 6 Napos Verseny, más néven a GOMU 6 Napos Világbajnokság, a világ egyik legrangosabb többnapos ultramaraton eseménye, amely Balatonfüreden kerül megrendezésre. A verseny során a résztvevők hat napon keresztül futnak, megmérettetve állóképességüket és kitartásukat. A verseny hagyományosan a többnapos ultrafutás csúcspontja, ahol világrekordok is születtek. A versenyzők egyedülálló kihívás előtt állnak, amely a fizikai és mentális erőnlétet egyaránt próbára teszi.

name: Z Ľubotína na hrad Plaveč
location: Ľubotín, Ľubotín, Polyfunkčný dom Ľubotín (budova za obecným úradom)
description: The Run from Ľubotín to Plaveč Castle is a traditional race that starts in the village of Ľubotín, by the Multifunctional Building. The race offers categories for men, women, juniors, Nordic walking, and a 4 km hobby run. The main race starts at 17:30, and the children’s categories begin at 16:30. The organizers are the municipalities of Ľubotín and Plaveč, which welcome runners of all ages and abilities. The race is ideal for anyone looking to run in beautiful surroundings, with the finish at Plaveč Castle.

name: Șopa Forest Race ~ 2027
location: Șopa Forest, Șelimbăr, Sibiu County, Romania

name: SÜMEG TRAIL
description: A Sümeg Trail egy hagyományos futóverseny, amely már ötödik éve vonzza a futás szerelmeseit Sümeg városába. A verseny négy különböző távon kínál kihívást, melyeket a résztvevők a város különleges és szép környezetében teljesíthetnek. A rendezvényhez számos sportprogram és egészségügyi szűrőprogram is kapcsolódik, így a futók és a sportkedvelők egyaránt élvezhetik a napot. A verseny helyszíne a Kisfaludy tér, és a programok között jóga, meditáció és helyi táncosok előadásai is szerepelnek, ami egyedülálló hangulatot teremt.
course_highlights: Négyféle táv: édes, csemege, csipős és erős megmérettetések
A verseny a város különleges és szép pályáján zajlik
Színes sportprogramok és egészségügyi szűrések a verseny napján
additional: A verseny napján jógaórák, hangtál meditáció és helyi táncosok produkciói is színesítik a programot. Egészségügyi szűrések (vérnyomás-, vércukormérés, testtömeg mérés) is elérhetők a résztvevők számára.

name: Beh Novoveskou Hutou
location: Novoveská Huta, Spišská Nová Ves, Slovakia
organizer: Športový Klub ROHALS a Mesto Spišská Nová Ves

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: muži nad 60 a ženy nad 50 rokov - 3 €

price_tiers.distance: Dorast a beh pre zdravie 5 km

description: Sports Club Rohals warmly invites you to the 16th edition of the Run Through Novoveská Huta, taking place in Novoveská Huta. Adults can take on a new 12.2 km course to Vojtechova samota and back, the same for women and men. A 5 km course is also available for those who prefer a shorter distance. Children and young runners will compete on shorter courses through the streets of Huta, grouped by age category. After the race, participants can refuel with goulash; children can enjoy a small theatre performance, and adults will be entertained by the band 3násť ciest.
course_highlights: The new adult course goes to Vojtechova samota (Šadroň) and back
The adult course is 12.2 km and is the same for women and men
Short courses for children through the streets of Novoveská Huta, grouped by age category
additional: Registration for school-age participants is from 11:30 to 12:45, and for juniors and adults until 14:45. Participants may start in only one category. Goulash will be provided after the race; children can enjoy a small theatre performance, and adults will be entertained by the band 3násť ciest. Adult categories compete for points in the Spišská Nová Ves District Running League. 12.2 km and 5 km courses, categories for different age groups, registration on the day of the event, activities for children and adults.

name: Marathon Chopok
description: Marathon Chopok is a challenging mountain run in the beautiful surroundings of the Low Tatras, testing your abilities on a variety of surfaces and terrain. There are two main courses: the 43 km SkyMarathon Chopok, with 2,600 m of elevation gain, and the shorter 21 km Sky Race Jasná Trail, with 1,400 m of elevation gain. Relay entries are also available for the long course. The route runs along both the southern and northern sides of Chopok, including the main ridge, and offers beautiful views and varied terrain.

name: Kokava Trail
description: Kokava Trail is a certified trail race starting and finishing in Kokava nad Rimavicou, with routes through the Veporské vrchy and Stolické vrchy mountain ranges. There are two distances: the main course is 78 km with +3330 m of elevation gain and an 18-hour time limit; the shorter Pasiečky Trail is 23 km with +1200 m of elevation gain and a 7-hour time limit. The varied route consists of 45% meadow sections, 45% forest trails and 10% asphalt. It has no difficult technical sections, but includes several steeper descents and climbs. Runners can make use of six aid stations. Mandatory equipment includes a thermal blanket, headlamp, mobile phone with an active SIM card, GPS device, reflective vest and sufficient fluids. Winners in the Men, Women, Men 50+ and Women 50+ categories will receive medals and prizes during the awards ceremony at the cultural centre.

name: Prešov Running Series 3. kolo
description: Prešov Running Series Round 3 is part of a series of running events held in Prešov throughout 2026. The event is open to all ages and fitness levels, from beginners to professionals. The courses are designed to bring the community together, promote a healthy lifestyle, and make exercise enjoyable. The entry fee includes timing, a medal, refreshments, and an accompanying program. Children who are members of Prešov Running Team can run for free.

name: 6 hodinovka pod Šarišským hradom
location: Veľký Šariš okr. Prešov, Veľký Šariš okr. Prešov, Ul. Doliny
description: The 6-Hour Run Under Šariš Castle is an endurance running event held in Veľký Šariš, Prešov District. The race is open to individuals and relay teams, with categories divided by age and gender. The entry fee is the same for all runners, and the event offers the chance to test your endurance in a six-hour run in the beautiful surroundings below the castle. The organizers, Gejza Sabanoš and Ondrej Fedor, ensure the event runs smoothly.

name: Ozorovská dvanastka
location: Malé Ozorovce, Malé Ozorovce, Parkovisko pred KD
description: Ozorovská Twelve is a running race held in Malé Ozorovce, offering courses for both children and adults. The race is organized by OZ Zorovčan in cooperation with the municipality of Veľké Ozorovce. Participants can compete in the 6 km and 12 km races, with categories by age and gender. The children’s race starts at 9:00, and the adults’ race at 10:00. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant atmosphere near the cultural center.

name: Horský kros Gerlach
location: Gerlachov okr. Poprad, Gerlachov okr. Poprad, Gerlachov od pomníka ( Prezentácia: Obecný úrad Gerlachov )
description: Horský kros Gerlach is a traditional mountain uphill race that starts in the village of Gerlachov and runs through the Velická Valley to the Sliezsky dom mountain hotel. The course is 8,400 metres long with an elevation gain of 879 metres, and runners tackle a rocky trail and sections of asphalt road. The event is suited to runners who enjoy challenging mountain terrain and beautiful views of the High Tatras. The programme also includes children’s races, and runners can purchase an entry with original Horský kros Gerlach socks.

name: Beh za Tatry
location: Štrbské Pleso, Vysoké Tatry, Štrbské Pleso, Vysoké Tatry, pod vyhliadkovou vežou Tatras Tower
organizer: Barbora a Slavomír Ogurčákovci v spolupráci s občianskym združením Žiť Tatry
description: Beh za Tatry is a running event held in the picturesque setting of Štrbské Pleso in the High Tatras, below the Tatras Tower observation tower. The races offer a start for children at 14:00 and for adults at 16:00, with the course running on natural surfaces along the lakeshore and cross-country ski trails. Categories are divided by age and gender, allowing runners of various age groups to take part. The organizers are Barbora and Slavomír Ogurčák, in cooperation with the Žiť Tatry civic association, who ensure a welcoming atmosphere and high-quality organization.

name: Veľatský lesný beh
description: The Veľaty Forest Run is a traditional running event organized by the civic association OZ Stopa in the village of Veľaty. The race takes place at the FK Veľaty sports field and offers courses of various lengths for men and women aged 15 and over, while children’s races are held directly on the football pitch. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, voluntary donations in place of an entry fee, and refreshments. Volunteers support runners throughout the day, and times are recorded by timekeepers, followed by the announcement of the winners and the presentation of prizes.

name: Telekom Night run
distance_verbose: 50 km, Maratón, 16 km, 11.6 km, 10 km, 5 km, 3.2 km

name: CugiRace
location: Poiana cu Goruni, Cugir, Jud. Alba
description: CugiRace is a mountain running competition held in Poiana cu Goruni, Cugir, offering events for all fitness levels: an ultramarathon, half marathon, 10 km cross-country race, and children’s race. The courses are varied, with significant elevation changes, offering a challenging and scenic experience in the Cugir Mountains. The event promotes outdoor exercise and a healthy lifestyle, welcoming both experienced runners and those looking to make the transition to ultramarathons. The atmosphere is friendly, supported by careful organization and dedicated volunteers.

name: StruguRUN
description: StruguRUN is a unique running competition set among the vineyards and historic scenery of Odobești, Vrancea. The event offers three races for all levels: the Half Marathon, the Cross-Country Race, and the Popular Race, each following spectacular routes through vineyards and forests and along the Milcov River. Participants can enjoy an authentic experience that combines sport with nature and local traditions in a friendly, energizing atmosphere.

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 9. kolo
description: The Beh 2 míle Bratislava is a regular 2-mile running race organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team at the Kuchajda swimming complex in Bratislava. The race is open to the general public, including children, juniors, women, men, and veterans, who are divided into categories. Registration takes place on-site by the volleyball court from 9:30, with the start at 10:00. The race is part of a series in which runners earn points toward the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team Traveling Cup based on their performance and age.

name: Dukelský beh mieru
location: Svidník, Svidník, Štart: Dukliansky priesmyk, Cieľ: pešia zóna Svidník
description: The Dukla Run for Peace is one of the oldest and most significant running events in Slovakia, held every year on the first Sunday in September. The route runs from Dukla to the centre of Svidník and is 19 kilometres long, descending from 479 m above sea level at the start to 244 m above sea level at the finish. Runners follow a historic route associated with the Carpathian-Dukla Operation, commemorating the victims and the struggle for peace in 1944–1945. The event has a rich history and strong emotional significance, bringing together competitive runners and amateurs.

name: Sighișoara 10K
organizer: Asociația Părinților din „Clubul Sportiv Școlar” Sighișoara
description: Sighișoara 10K is a running race offering a unique experience through the heart of the medieval citadel of Sighișoara, combining sport with the discovery of the city’s historical treasures. The event includes 10K and 5K races, a children’s race, and an Up Stairs challenge, and is open to all age groups and fitness levels. Participants can enjoy a vibrant, energetic course, with cash prizes and a raffle for all runners. The race is held in memory of Dr. Stelian Larga, a cardiologist and citizen actively involved in the city’s sporting and cultural life.

name: CIUCAȘ X3 Scriem povestea. Împreună clădim tradiție.
organizer: Clubul de Turism și Alpinism Ciucaș Ploiești
description: Ciucaș X3 is a mountain running event organized by the Ciucaș Ploiești Tourism and Mountaineering Club, promoting outdoor activity and mountain sports. A range of races, from a short vertical race to an ultramarathon, take place in the Ciucaș Mountains, offering challenges for amateurs, professionals, and children. The event has a history spanning more than 16 editions and supports the sustainable development of the local community. Participants can experience spectacular mountain scenery and varied routes in a friendly atmosphere with professional organization.

name: Vlasina 2026
description: The Vlasina Triathlon of Self-Transcendence is a traditional race held at the beautiful Vlasina Lake near Vladičin Han. Participants can choose from the Olympic, Sprint, Super Sprint, Super Kid, and Mini Kid triathlons, tailored to different ages and competition levels. The race is known for its atmosphere of self-transcendence and the support provided by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team, which promotes sport and spirituality. Each competitor receives a race number, a certificate, and a finisher’s medal.

name: European Masters Off Road Championships
description: The 2026 European Masters Off-Road Running Championships in Râșnov bring together masters athletes from across Europe to compete in the heart of the Carpathian Mountains. The event takes place in the historic town of Râșnov, offering a technical trail-running course combined with Transylvania’s rich cultural heritage. This competition is a unique opportunity for masters athletes to test their skills on challenging and scenic terrain.

name: XI. Moonlight Run
description: A XI. Moonlight Run egy hangulatos futóverseny Szob városában, amely kerül megrendezésre. A verseny résztvevői időmérést, rajtszámot és egyedi befutóérmet kapnak. A pályán és a célban frissítés biztosított, a célban pedig hagyományos zsíroskenyér hagymával várja a futókat. A rendezvény orvosi felügyelet mellett zajlik, és a szervezők a részvétel élményét helyezik előtérbe.

name: ATOMFUTÁS
description: Az ATOMfutás egy hagyományos, családbarát futóverseny Paks városában, amely változatos távokat kínál a résztvevőknek a gyermekektől a hosszabb távokat kedvelőkig. A verseny helyszíne az ASE sportcsarnok mellett található, és a futók mellett színes programok, ugrálóvárak, sportjátékok és gasztronómiai élmények várják a családokat. A rendezvényt az Atomerőmű Sportegyesület szervezi, és a verseny fővédnöke dr. Kovács Antal olimpiai bajnok. A versenyzők több táv közül választhatnak, és a futók saját felelősségükre indulnak a versenyen.
course_highlights: Változatos távok: 600 m, 2000 m, 3000 m, 7 km, 14 km, 21 km, 30 km
Váltópontok a 30 km-es váltóversenyeken, többféle váltási lehetőséggel
Záróbusz követi a mezőnyt 8 km/óra sebességgel a hosszabb távokon
