additional: A verseny napján helyszíni nevezés is lehetséges személyesen. A hosszabb távokon záróbusz követi a mezőnyt 8 km/óra sebességgel, aki ezt nem tudja tartani, a buszra száll. A BrutálATOM versenyen több rajtidőpont és táv közül választhatnak a résztvevők, köztük gyerek és felnőtt kategóriák. A versenyközpont a Paksi ASE Sportcsarnok mellett található, ahol a rajtszámok átvétele is zajlik.

name: MOONLIGHT RUN
description: A MOONLIGHT RUN egy különleges éjszakai futóverseny Szob városában, amely kerül megrendezésre. A verseny rajtja és célja a Szent László templomnál található, és a résztvevők egyedi befutóérmet kapnak. A rendezvény során frissítés és orvosi felügyelet biztosított, a célban pedig hagyományos zsíroskenyér hagymával várja a futókat. A verseny szervezője a Proathlon Bt., a helyi önkormányzatok támogatásával.

name: 36. BorsodChem Bódva-völgyi Maraton
description: A 36. BorsodChem Bódva-völgyi Maraton egy változatos távú futóverseny, amely különböző egyéni és váltó kategóriákat kínál. A rendezvény helyszíne Edelény, és a verseny során chipes időmérés biztosítja a pontos eredményeket. A versenyzők számára digitális oklevél és egyéni befutóvideó is elérhető a célba érkezés után. A szervezők modern technikai eszközökkel, például LED versenyórával és online eredményközvetítéssel támogatják a verseny lebonyolítását.
course_highlights: Változatos távok: 500 m-től maratonig, egyéni és váltó kategóriák
Chipes időmérés RFID vagy HuTag technológiával
Online eredménylista és egyéni befutóvideó a célban
additional: A versenyen helyszíni regisztráció is biztosított. A rajtszámokhoz biztosítótű jár, és választható chip típus: rajtszámra ragasztható vagy bokapántos. Az esemény alatt kommentátor segíti a versenyzőket, és igény esetén online közvetítés is elérhető. A fizetés SimplePay kártyás lehetőséggel történik, felhasználói fiók szükséges hozzá.

name: BRUTÁLATOM
description: A BrutálATOM egy kihívásokkal teli terepfutó verseny Paks városában, amelyet az Atomerőmű Sportegyesület rendez. A verseny több távon kínál lehetőséget a futóknak, köztük gyerekeknek és felnőtteknek, változatos nehézségi szintekkel. A verseny célja a sport és közösségi élmény ötvözése, amelyet a Paksi Atomerőmű támogat. A rendezvény családbarát, és a résztvevők saját felelősségükre indulnak a versenyen.
course_highlights: BrutálATOM kölyök 1,5-2 km, 6-11 éveseknek
BrutálATOM light 4-4,5 km, 12 éves kortól
BrutálATOM classic 8-9 km, 16 éves kortól
additional: A versenyközpont a Paksi ASE Sportcsarnok mellett található, ahol a rajtszámok átvétele is történik. A verseny napján több bemelegítő időpont is van, és az eredményhirdetés 18:00-kor lesz. A nevezés online történik, de helyszíni fizetés is lehetséges a verseny napján 14:00-tól. A versenyen a rajtszám viselése kötelező, és a versenyzők saját felelősségükre indulnak.

name: SZŐLŐSKÖR
distance_verbose: 50 km, 36 km, 18 km, 9 km, 4.5 km, 1.2 km

name: III. Pannonhalma Decem Futás 5 / 10
description: A III. Pannonhalma Decem Futás egy barátságos és közösségi futóverseny, amely 5 és 10 kilométeres távokon várja a futókat a Porta Látogatóközpont környékén. A rendezvény célja, hogy minden korosztály számára élvezetes és motiváló mozgási lehetőséget biztosítson, miközben a gyönyörű pannonhalmi tájat is felfedezhetik a résztvevők. A verseny családias hangulatú, és alkalmat ad a sportbarátok találkozására és közös mozgásra.
course_highlights: Gyönyörű pannonhalmi táj és történelmi környezet
5 és 10 km-es távok, változatos útvonalakkal
Közösségi és családbarát hangulat
additional: Chipes időmérés.

name: Nočný beh mestom Lučenec
description: The Night Run Through Lučenec is a night race along the illuminated streets of Lučenec, covering a distance of 4.5 km. The event is open to the general public, including juniors and adults, with categories by age and gender. It is organized by the City of Lučenec and OZ Novohrad and takes place near the Synagogue, with electronic timing and chip technology. The start is scheduled for 19:30. Participants can expect a commemorative medal, a race number, refreshments, and an accompanying program.

name: Školáčik detský beh
description: Školáčik Children’s Run is a running event for children of various age groups, held in Lučenec near the synagogue. It is organized by the City of Lučenec and OZ Novohrad. The race is open to boys and girls aged 3 to 15 inclusive, including children with disabilities. The entry fee is symbolic and encourages children to take part in sports activities in the pleasant surroundings of the city.

name: Beh okolo Lysej
location: Lysá pod Makytou okr. Púchov, Lysá pod Makytou okr. Púchov, pri kultúrnom dome
description: Beh okolo Lysej is a traditional running race in the village of Lysá pod Makytou, offering various categories for children, juniors, women, and men by age. The race takes place by the cultural centre and is organised by Bežecký klub Lysá pod Makytou. The children’s start is at 11:00, categories E, women, and juniors start at 12:30, and men start at 13:00. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes an active lifestyle in the region.

name: Behaj lesmi Topoľčianky
description: Behaj lesmi Topoľčianky is a night trail race in the beautiful wine-growing region of Topoľčianky. Runners will enjoy routes passing the Château Topoľčianky and Hrušov Castle, with forest paths and an atmosphere beneath the stars. The race is part of the Behaj lesmi series and is included in the international UTMB Index, adding to its prestige. There are two main distances: 11 km and 22 km. The course also features the Conti Speed Section, a timed segment with a valuable prize.

name: Marina Liptov RUN
location: Bobrovník, okres Liptovský Mikuláš, Bobrovník, okres Liptovský Mikuláš, Marina Liptov
organizer: Olympijský klub Liptova a rezort Marina Liptov
description: Marina Liptov RUN is a sports and leisure event set in the beautiful surroundings of the Marina Liptov resort near Liptovská Mara. This unique run combines nature with quality services in harmony with the four elements—fire, water, earth, and air. Runners can enjoy a peaceful and inspiring setting with views of the surrounding countryside and the chance to relax at the resort after the race. Marina Liptov is an ideal destination for athletes and families looking for an outdoor experience.

name: Lemešanská bežecká liga 3. Jesenné kolo
organizer: Obec Lemešany, Športová komisia obce Lemešany
description: The Lemešany Running League – 3rd Autumn Round is a running competition held in the village of Lemešany, in the beautiful surroundings of the Garden of Movement. The race is open to all age groups and ability levels, offering a pleasant atmosphere and the chance to enjoy sports outdoors. It is organised by the Garden of Movement, which provides quality facilities for sport and recreation.

name: Beh pre Labky jesenný špeciál
location: Košice, Košice, Košice - časť Kavečany, chata Hrešná
organizer: Únia vzájomnej pomoci ľudí a psov
description: The Run for Paws Autumn Special is a running event in Kavečany, Košice, near Hrešná Cottage, organised by the Union for Mutual Assistance of People and Dogs (UVP). The race is open to various categories, including women, men, children, and runners with dogs, including shelter dogs. The 5 km course offers a pleasant autumn atmosphere surrounded by nature. Registration is available online at a discounted price and on site for a higher fee. The event supports dog adoption and brings runners and animals together in a friendly setting.

name: Night run Michalovce
organizer: Mesto Michalovce, TAZS Michalovce, MSKS Michalovce, Fitko Michalovce, R M s.r.o.
description: Night Run Michalovce is a night running race held at Námestie osloboditeľov in Michalovce. The race offers three distances: 10 km, 5 km, and 3 km, suitable for different age groups and performance levels. The adult race starts at 19:00, and the children’s races begin at 17:00. The organizers are Mesto Michalovce, TAZS Michalovce, MSKS Michalovce, Fitko Michalovce, and R M s.r.o. The race is suitable for the general public looking to enjoy a sporting atmosphere in the city at night.

name: Woodrocks Trail Run
description: Woodrocks Trail Run is a mountain running event held in the village of Petriș, offering three storybook courses for runners of all levels. The 6 km Green Course is ideal for beginners, with shady trails and gentle hills. The 15 km Blue Course offers an exhilarating experience with moderate climbs, while the 35 km Pink Course is a thrilling adventure with 1,600 metres of elevation gain over rugged terrain and scenic ridgelines. The event celebrates the joy of running in nature and supports environmental education through the EcoStuff Romania Association.

name: Maratonul Dragomirnei
description: The Dragomirna Marathon is an annual competition held in the Dragomirna Beech Forest Nature Reserve in Suceava. It offers a unique running experience in nature, combining scenic landscapes with a friendly atmosphere and professional organization. The event includes several races, from a full marathon to a half marathon and a cross-country race, catering to both experienced and amateur runners. Participants receive race kits and prizes, while the organizers promote an active community committed to supporting sport and the environment.

name: AIUD GREEN RUN by DP World
organizer: DP World, Primăria și Consiliul Local Aiud, Asociația Dr. Brendus Gyula Egyesület
description: Aiud Green Run by DP World is a sporting event that promotes a healthy, eco-friendly lifestyle, giving participants the opportunity to run scenic routes surrounded by nature and authentic Transylvanian landscapes. The event includes a 21 km half marathon, an 8 km race, and a 2 km family run, suitable for all experience levels. The routes are designed to challenge and inspire runners while offering a friendly atmosphere and a memorable experience in the municipality of Aiud. The start is near Aiud Fortress, and the event is organized in partnership with Aiud City Hall and the Dr. Brendus Gyula Egyesulet Association.

name: ORADEA RUN FEST
description: Oradea Run Fest returns for its second edition on September 12 in Piața Unirii, Oradea. The event promises an experience full of energy, movement and good cheer, bringing together people passionate about sport, health and community. The organizers are preparing a spectacular edition with surprises and special moments for participants.

name: Bukovački maraton 2026
description: The Bukovac Marathon – Long Course is a challenging mountain race held on Fruška Gora, starting and finishing in Bukovac. The course is 47.8 km long, with 1,350 metres of ascent and 1,350 metres of descent. It is well maintained and marked with red-and-white hiking blazes, and passes significant sites including the Novo Hopovo, Staro Hopovo, Grgeteg, Krušedol and Velika Remeta monasteries, as well as Branko’s Grave and monument. The race is intended for experienced hikers and runners who want to experience the natural surroundings and cultural heritage of Fruška Gora.

name: Kis-Balaton RUN 2026
distance_verbose: 35 km, Félmaraton, 10 km, 6 km, 3000 meter, 1.4 km, 0.7 km
description: A Kis-Balaton Kör Futóverseny egy országos meghirdetésű, egyre népszerűbb futóverseny Zalakaroson, amelyet a Zalakarosi Futrinkák szerveznek. A verseny több távon zajlik, köztük egy 35 km-es egyéni és váltó futam, félmaraton, valamint gyermek és családi futóversenyek. A rendezvény két napos, és a versenyzőknek saját poharat vagy kulacsot kell hozniuk, mivel a verseny pohármentes. A rajt és cél a Karos Korzóban van, és a program gazdag, több eredményhirdetéssel és különböző rajtidőpontokkal.
course_highlights: 35 km-es SZABADICS Kis-Balaton kör egyéni és váltó futam
Karos Spa félmaraton táv
Gyermek és családi futóversenyek 700 m, 1400 m és 2800 m távokon
additional: A verseny pohármentes, ezért a résztvevőknek saját soft cupot vagy kulacsot kell hozniuk a frissítőpontokhoz. A rajtszám átvétel több időpontban lehetséges a Karos Korzóban, a versenyszám rajtidőpontját megelőző 15 percig. A szervezők fenntartják a program- és időpontváltoztatás jogát.

name: Beh Ždaňou
location: Ždaňa, okr. Košice okolie, Ždaňa, okr. Košice okolie, Obecný úrad
description: Beh Ždaňou is a running event in the village of Ždaňa in the Košice-okolie District, offering courses for various age groups and ability levels. The races cover 2.5 km and 5 km, with categories divided by age and gender. The event is suitable for the general public, including children, adults, and seniors. The organizers welcome all runners who want to enjoy a sporting day in the pleasant surroundings of the village.

name: Beh okolo Spišského hradu
location: Spišské Podhradie, Spišské Podhradie, Pred MsÚ
description: The Run Around Spiš Castle is a traditional running race in Spišské Podhradie, featuring a mix of asphalt and compacted dirt roads with grassy sections. The course passes around the historic Spiš Castle and is suitable for various age groups, including children and adults. The event is organized by the Town of Spišské Podhradie, which ensures a welcoming atmosphere and high-quality race organization. Registration is available online or on site, and residents of Spišské Podhradie can enter for free.

name: Râșnov Medieval Run  ~ 2026
location: centrul orașului Râșnov, Râșnov, Brașov County, Romania
description: Râșnov Medieval Run is a running race held in the center of Râșnov, combining medieval spirit with a passion for running. The event offers participants a unique experience, with clear participation requirements, including presenting a medical certificate and wearing the race bib throughout the race. The start is scheduled for the morning, and the organizers provide facilities such as timing, first aid, and a dedicated start and finish area. It is a competition suitable for runners of all levels who want to enjoy a special atmosphere and the picturesque scenery of Râșnov.
course_highlights: Route through the center of Râșnov
Unique medieval atmosphere
Timing and first-aid facilities provided
additional: Participants must bring an identity document when collecting their race kit. They must present a medical certificate or accept responsibility for their physical fitness. The race bib must be worn on the front of the shirt throughout the race, from start to finish. Participants must present identification and a medical certificate, and wear their race bib visibly. Registration is online, with on-site registration also possible while places remain.

name: Rombat Trail Run
description: Rombat Trail Run is a mountain running race that invites over 600 nature lovers to take part in the spectacular natural landscape of the Ghinzii and Codrișor forests. The event offers an authentic trail-running experience, combining athletic challenge with the beauty of the surrounding environment. Organized by Runners Club, this competition is for running enthusiasts who want to enjoy nature and test their limits in a friendly, professional setting.

name: Zăvoi Trail Comana
description: Zăvoi Trail Comana is a sporting event for trail running and mountain biking enthusiasts, held in the heart of Comana Natural Park, a protected area with impressive biodiversity. The event is organized by the Plogging for Romania Association, which promotes sport and environmental protection through plogging activities. The routes offer an authentic nature-exploration experience, combining sporting challenges with awareness of the importance of protecting the local ecosystem. Participants can choose between mountain bike and trail running races, each featuring spectacular and accessible routes.

name: Baia Mare Half Marathon
organizer: Maramureș Runners, Rotary Club Baia Mare
description: The Baia Mare Half Marathon is an annual sporting event that brings together runners from across the country to celebrate movement, community, and an active lifestyle. The main race is the 21 km half marathon, held on an urban course consisting of 6 loops of 3.5 km each, for participants over the age of 15. The event also includes relay races, a 7 km cross-country race, a 3 km fun run, children’s races, and a special AutiSmile race dedicated to people with autism. The organizers emphasize health, community, and environmental protection, planting trees for every kilometer run.

name: Malý Pieninský maratón – mem. Bohuša Ježíka
location: Červený Kláštor okr. Kežmarok, Červený Kláštor okr. Kežmarok, Kúpele Smerdžonka
organizer: Malý pieninský maratón – memoriál Bohuša Ježíka
description: The Malý Pieninský Marathon – Bohuš Ježík Memorial is a running event in Červený Kláštor, offering an 18 km course with 163 metres of elevation gain. The route runs through the Dunajec River Gorge, with half the surface paved and half forest trail. The start is scheduled for 10:00. The entry fee includes a medal, a gift, a race number, refreshments along the course and at the finish, lunch, and a raffle. In addition to the main race, a non-competitive 9+9 km relay is also available.

A futónap családbarát esemény, amely kezdőknek és haladóknak egyaránt kínál távokat, a 2,3 km-es Start Futamtól a félmaratonig és váltóversenyig. A verseny útvonala nagyrészt a vízpart mellett halad, így a résztvevők élvezhetik a kora őszi napsütést és a Balaton hangulatát. A rajtcsomagban prémium technikai póló és egyedi befutóérem várja a futókat, a frissítés pedig környezetbarát módon, pohármentesen történik.

name: BAKONYALJA FUTÁS
description: A Bakonyalja Futás egy terepfutó verseny, amely Tárkány és Ászár között zajlik. A rendezvényt a Tatai Tömegsport és Tájfutó Honvéd Sportegyesület szervezi, amely több szakosztályban kínál sporteseményeket, köztük terepfutó versenyeket is. A futás a természet közelségét és a változatos terepet kínálja a résztvevőknek, ideális választás a természetet kedvelő futók számára. A verseny hagyományosan a régióban zajlik, és a sportegyesület aktív közösségi életének része.
course_highlights: Terepfutás a Bakonyalja régióban
Változatos, természetközeli útvonal Tárkány és Ászár között

name: DOMB42X (2.)
distance_verbose: 84 km, Maraton, Félmaraton, 14 km, 7 km, 3000 meter, 0.8 km, 0.4 km
description: A DOMB42X egy különleges futóverseny Kecskemét legmagasabb pontján, a Benkó-dombon, ahol a résztvevők többször is megkerülik a dombot, így teljesítve különböző távokat a félmaratontól az ultramaratonig. A verseny egyedi jellege a folyamatos emelkedőkben és lejtőkben rejlik, amely a síkvidéki futók számára igazi kihívást jelent. A rendezvény családbarát, a kísérők számára ingyenes belépést biztosítanak, és a helyszínen számos szabadidős program várja őket. A versenyzőknek kijelző mutatja a megtett körök számát, így könnyebb a tájékozódás a pályán. Ez a futóesemény egy vertikális lázadás a síkvidék ellen, amely egyedülálló élményt nyújt minden résztvevőnek.
course_highlights: Kecskemét legmagasabb pontja, a 49 méter magas Benkó-domb
1 kör hossza kb. 1 km, a maratoni távon több mint 2000 méter szintemelkedés
Kijelző mutatja a megtett körök számát minden kör végén
additional: A versenyen korhatár van: 3 km távon 11 év felett, 7 km távon 14 év felett, 14 km távon 16 év felett. Létszámkorlát van mindhárom távon (3 km: 95 fő, 7 km: 95 fő, 14 km: 40 fő). A versenyzők befutóérmet kapnak, és a nemek szerint az első három helyezettet díjazzák. A rajtidők különbözőek: 14 km 11:50, 7 km 15:00, 3 km 16:20. A verseny szintideje is meg van határozva távonként.

name: Runway Run 2026
location: Budapest Ferenc Liszt International Airport, Budapest, Hungary

name: Big Bear's Ultra
description: Big Bear's Ultra is a challenging ultra-trail race around the city of Žilina, offering a unique running experience in nature with beautiful views of the surrounding landscape. The race takes place near the Považské Museum and Budatín Castle and features various distances that test runners’ endurance and determination. The course runs through hills and mountain areas with significant elevation gain, making the event a challenge for experienced runners. The organizers emphasize an eco-friendly approach and participant safety.

name: Oktoberfest Run Nitra 2026: Half Marathon
description: Oktoberfest Run Nitra 2026: The Half Marathon is a certified half marathon with World Athletics international status, held in Nitra’s historic centre at Svätopluk Square. The event brings together sport, community and charity, offering runners a unique experience in an Oktoberfest atmosphere. Alongside the half marathon, the festival also features relays, family and senior runs, charity runs and children’s races. The organisers emphasise a healthy lifestyle, inclusion and community cooperation in the region.

name: Kopaničiarska 10-tka
location: Myjava, Myjava, pred MsÚ v Myjave
organizer: TJ Spartak Myjava Atletický oddiel a mesto Myjava
description: Kopaničiarska 10-tka is a running race in Myjava offering a 10 km course for men and women, with shorter options for women and the Buď - fit category. The race takes place in front of the Municipal Office in Myjava and is organized by TJ Spartak Myjava Athletics Club and the town of Myjava. The main race starts at 13:00, while primary school boys and girls start at 10:00. The race is suitable for a wide range of ages, including age-based categories and special categories for Buď fit and children.

name: Dobšinská desiatka
location: Dobšiná okr.Rožňava, Dobšiná okr.Rožňava, Dobšiná, Lanyiho Huta
description: Dobšinská desiatka is a traditional running race organized by the ŠK Dobšiná civic association. It takes place in the picturesque setting of Lányiho Huta in Dobšiná. The race features a varied course combining forest roads and asphalt, suitable for runners in different categories, including Nordic walking. The event also includes activities such as an autograph session with Slovak Olympians and family activities, creating a pleasant atmosphere for all participants.

name: Kapušianska 5-ka
description: Kapušianska 5-ka is a running race held in Kapušany Park in the village of Kapušany. The race is open to various age groups, including juniors, adults, and veterans. It is an enjoyable sporting event that promotes an active lifestyle and community sports. The event is organized by the municipality of Kapušany, which also provides support and contact information for participants.

name: Letné športové hry pracovníkov U.S.STEEL
location: Košice, Košice, vstupný areál USS Košice Šaca
description: The U. S. Steel Košice Summer Sports Games are a traditional event that has been held for 34 years, giving employees the opportunity to compete in a variety of sports. The games include athletics, badminton, bowling, tennis, football, table tennis, beach volleyball, cycling, chess and darts. The event is for U. S. Steel Košice employees and promotes sportsmanship and team spirit in the pleasant surroundings of the USS Košice Šaca complex. Golf tournaments and other sporting activities are also organized alongside the competitions.

name: Generali Trail Hubkovou
description: Generali Trail Hubkovou is a running race in Humenné organized by Bežecký klub Humenné with support from the city and local sponsors. The race takes place in the square by the Municipal Cultural Centre and offers categories for men, women, juniors, and children. The main race starts at 13:00, and the children’s categories begin at 11:00. Participants can choose from several entry packages, which include a medal, a promotional pack, a raffle, refreshments, and a technical T-shirt. The race is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant atmosphere, with refreshments along the course.

name: Șiria Vertical Loop
description: Șiria Vertical Loop 2h is a short-duration mountain running competition for both amateurs and professionals, promoting the tourist heritage of Arad County, especially Șiria Fortress. The race follows a vertical-race course, with a 2.5 km loop and approximately 240 m of elevation gain per loop. The race lasts 2 hours. Participants must complete at least one full loop to be considered finishers. The race is known for its difficulty and the mental challenge it involves. The event is part of the A.T.I.A. Trail Trilogy and is included in the ITRA National League.

name: Gușterița Trail Run
description: Gușterița Trail Run (GTR) is a mountain running race held in Gușterița Forest in Sibiu, offering accessible and varied routes for runners of all levels, from beginners to professionals. The routes cross a rich natural area, with dirt trails and spruce forests, offering an authentic trail-running experience close to the city. The event promotes both competition and community, bringing together mountain running enthusiasts in a spectacular natural setting. GTR is an ideal opportunity to push your limits and enjoy nature in the company of other runners.

name: Mogoșa Race
description: Mogoșa Race is an annual mountain running competition held in September, starting at Domeniul Mogoșa in Baia Sprie, Maramureș. The event offers a variety of courses, from 4 km for all participants, to an accessible and engaging 11 km route, and a 21 km half marathon for experienced runners, featuring demanding climbs and technical descents. The race promotes an active lifestyle and the discovery of the natural beauty of the Mogoșa area in a vibrant, community atmosphere. It is organized by the Baia Mare în Mișcare Association, which supports physical activity and health in the community.

name: OMU MARATHON by Transilvania 100
description: OMU Marathon by Transilvania 100 is a challenging mountain race held in the Bucegi Mountains, finishing at the iconic Bran Castle. The main marathon covers 41 km with nearly 3,000 meters of elevation gain, traversing windswept plateaus, dark forests, and ancient trails up to Vf Omu at 2,505 meters. The event also features two shorter races, SCARA Skyrace (24 km, 1,800 m climb) and POARTA Cross (11 km, 420 m climb), all offering breathtaking Transylvanian scenery and professional support from the experienced Transylvania 100 team. The race takes place in early October, promising a memorable late-summer mountain adventure.

name: Radmilovac Trail
description: Radmilovac Trail is a unique race held in the green natural oasis of Radmilovac, not far from Belgrade. The race takes runners through orchards, vineyards, and fishponds, offering beautiful natural scenery and a pleasant atmosphere. In addition to the standard 5 km and 10 km races, there is a special academic category for PhDs and doctoral candidates, aimed at promoting a healthy lifestyle. The event is organized by the Faculty of Agriculture in Zemun and AGRIF runners, and is known for its generous race pack and prizes for the top competitors.

name: Soko Čovka trail
description: Soko Čovka Trail is a mountain race held in Lazarevac, Županjac. It is organized by the VIS Mountaineering Club and gives participants the opportunity to enjoy the natural beauty of central Serbia on challenging trails. The race brings together nature and sports enthusiasts, offering a unique atmosphere and a well-organized event.
course_highlights: The race takes place in the natural surroundings of Lazarevac and Županjac
Mountain terrain with challenging climbs and descents
Views of central Serbia and the surrounding landscapes

name: 6. Liget élményfutás 7 / 3.5
description: A 6. Liget Élményfutás egy különleges futóesemény Budapest Városligetében, ahol a 3,5 és 7 kilométeres távokon családok és barátok együtt élvezhetik a sport örömeit és a több mint 20 akadály izgalmát. A futás nem a versenyről, hanem az élményről szól, ahol a mosoly és a közös kaland a legfontosabb. A résztvevőket egyedi befutóérem és befutócsomag várja, így garantált a felejthetetlen nap. A rendezvény ideális mind kezdőknek, mind tapasztalt futóknak, akik szeretnének egy vidám, közösségi élményben részt venni a Városliget varázslatos környezetében.

name: FESTÉK BÁZIS JÁNOSHÁZAI FÉLMARATON
description: A FESTÉK BÁZIS Jánosházai Félmaraton egy jó hangulatú, jól szervezett futóverseny, amelyet amatőrök és profik egyaránt élvezhetnek. A verseny biztonságos, forgalomtól elzárt útvonalakon zajlik, és minden célba érő résztvevő befutó érmet kap, valamint meglepetés befutó csomagot. A rendezvényen pontos időmérés, frissítés 5 km-enként, valamint online képgaléria is rendelkezésre áll. A verseny végén a szervezők helyben készített marhapörkölttel kedveskednek a nevezőknek, így a futás után a közösségi élmény is garantált.

name: Bešeňovský charitatívny beh pre MAPENZI
organizer: Občianske združenie MAPENZI by Generation of love, Obec Bešeňov
description: The Bešeňov Charity Run for MAPENZI is a running event organized by the MAPENZI by Generation of Love civic association and the municipality of Bešeňov. The races take place at the football field in Bešeňov and include 10 km and 5 km categories, children’s races, and a recreational 2 km run. The children’s races start at 15:00 and the main race at 16:00. The event is charitable in nature and suitable for the general public, including people of various age groups.

name: Olšavský pohár – Memoriál Júliusa Kažimíra
location: Ruskov okr. Košice okolie, Ruskov okr. Košice okolie, pred Obecným úradom
organizer: Obec Ruskov and Dobrovoľný hasičský zbor Ruskov
description: The Olšavský Cup – Július Kažimír Memorial is a running race held in the village of Ruskov in the Košice-okolie District. The race offers two main courses of 16.8 km and 9.7 km, with the start in front of the Municipal Office. Men, women, and children can compete in various age categories. The event is organized by the municipality of Ruskov and the Ruskov Volunteer Fire Brigade in cooperation with neighboring municipalities. The race is suitable for the general public, including seniors and children, who can enter for free.

name: Oradea City Running Day
description: Oradea City Running Day is an annual sporting event held in Oradea, offering running races for all ages and fitness levels. The courses include a half marathon, a corporate relay, a 10.5 km race, and a popular 5 km run, all held on an urban route marked with blue arrows that passes through notable areas of the city. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and team spirit, especially through the relay race dedicated to company employees. Participants receive race kits with an electronic chip and have access to refreshment points along the route.

name: Crosul Companiilor
description: The Crosul Companiilor powered by Emerson is the largest team-building event in Cluj-Napoca, bringing together employees from various companies for a race through the city streets. The event promotes team spirit and health through sport, offering participants an enjoyable and dynamic experience. The course is designed to be accessible and motivating, encouraging people to take part in teams and support their colleagues. The organizers, Runners Club, provide a friendly and professional atmosphere, with official partners and dedicated support.

name: 10. Zrenjaninski polumaraton
description: The Zrenjanin Half Marathon is a traditional race held in Zrenjanin since 2016 and is known as one of the best-organized half marathons in Serbia. The course is 21.1 km long, flat and circular, and passes through the city’s most beautiful areas, including the 4. jul and Ruža Šulman neighborhoods, with the start in front of City Hall. In addition to the half marathon, the event offers 7 km and 14 km races, Nordic walking, and a 3 x 7 km relay, welcoming runners of different abilities and ages. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and a sense of community, and runners become part of the story of a city known for its big heart and generous hosts.

name: Beh Tokajskými vinicami
location: Oddychové centrum, Čerhov, Trebišov District, Slovakia
description: The Run Through the Tokaj Vineyards is a traditional running race held in the village of Čerhov in the Trebišov District. The course winds through the picturesque Tokaj vineyards, offering beautiful natural scenery and a pleasant setting for runners of all ages. The event is suitable for both amateur and experienced runners who want to enjoy a day of sport outdoors and discover the unique Tokaj region. It is organized by the municipality of Čerhov, which ensures a welcoming atmosphere and high-quality organization.
course_highlights: The course passes through the Tokaj vineyards, with beautiful views
Natural surroundings with moderate elevation gain
A combination of paved and forest roads
additional: The event takes place at the Recreation Centre in Čerhov. A course map is available on the municipality’s website. No specific start times or wave assignments are provided. Registration information is available on a separate page. No entry fees or race categories are listed.

name: CURSA IMPOSIBILĂ
description: The Impossible Race is a unique virtual event in which participants reach the finish line one hour before the time they started. It is not a competitive race, but a personal and collective challenge held throughout 2026. Participants can choose from multiple sports and routes, including running, walking, cycling, rollerblading, swimming, and water sports, with a range of distances, some even thousands of kilometers long. The event emphasizes community spirit and supporting causes, and awards a finisher medal to everyone who completes the challenge.

name: Masterprint Tihany Cross Terepfutás és Nordic Walking 5 / 10 / 20 / 30
description: A Masterprint Tihany Cross terepfutó és freestyle nordic walking verseny a festői Tihanyi-félszigeten kerül megrendezésre, változatos távokkal 5, 10, 20 és 30 km-en. A verseny útvonala gyönyörű őszi levendulamezőkön és dombos, erdei ösvényeken halad, amelyeket piros jelölőszalagok jelölnek. A rendezvény családbarát, gyermekfutamokkal és váltóversennyel is várja a résztvevőket. A versenyközpont a Belső-tó partján található, ahol a frissítőpontok és a célterület is jól felszerelt. A versenyzők számára professzionális technikai futópóló is rendelhető.

name: TÖRÖKBÁLINTI HENDIKEP
description: A Törökbálinti Hendikep barátságos, körözős futóverseny a törökbálinti Dióskertben, ahol mindenki a saját tempójában teljesítheti a választott távot. Négy körből áll össze a félmaratoni táv, de rövidebb távra is be lehet nevezni. A futókat a célban almával, meleg teával és forralt borral várják.
course_highlights: Körpályás útvonal a törökbálinti Dióskertben.
Négy kör teljesítésével érhető el a félmaratoni táv.
Rövidebb táv is választható.
additional: A részvétel önkéntes hozzájárulással támogatja a verseny költségeit.

name: BUCI FUTÁS
location: Soroksár Sportcsarnok, Sportcsarnok utca 2, Soroksár, Budapest, Hungary

name: BÜK–CSEPREG FÉLMARATON
distance_verbose: Félmaraton, 11 km, 7 km, 1.8 km, 0.6 km, 0.4 km

name: ULTRA MÁRTÉLY
location: Bodnár Bertalan Természet- és Környezetvédelmi Oktatóközpont, Mártély, Hungary

name: Horský beh Pačanským chotárom
location: Pača, okr. Rožňava, Pača, okr. Rožňava, pred Kultúrnym domom
description: Pačanský Chotár Mountain Run is a running event in the village of Pača, offering two main courses: a more challenging 13.5 km main race with 492 m of elevation gain and a shorter 6.3 km hobby run with 203 m of elevation gain. The routes combine paved and forest roads, with beautiful views and refreshment stations along the way. Runners start and finish in front of the cultural centre in Pača, and the organizers provide route navigation and marking. The event is suitable for both experienced and recreational runners and offers a sporting atmosphere with refreshments and a raffle.

name: Rybnícka 10-ka a 5-ka
location: Rybník, okr. Levice, Rybník, okr. Levice, futbalový štadión
organizer: Obec Rybník, ZŠ s MŠ Rybník
description: Rybník 10K and 5K is a running event held at the football stadium in the village of Rybník, Levice District. Races are held over two distances—5 km and 10 km—with various age categories for men and women. The children’s race starts at 9:00, and the adults’ race at 11:00. The event is suitable for the general public, including secondary school students and seniors, who receive discounted entry fees. The organizers provide a welcoming atmosphere and quality facilities for runners.

name: Behaj lesmi Devín
description: Behaj lesmi Devín is a unique trail race near Bratislava, offering a route with views of the confluence of the Danube and Morava rivers and Devínska Kobyla. The trails follow the historic Amber Road and pass through blooming wild garlic avenues, making the run an unforgettable experience. The race is part of the Behaj lesmi series and is listed as a UTMB Index Race, providing an international points ranking. You can compete on the short 12 km route or the 22 km half marathon. Both routes feature a marked Conti Speed Section, with a valuable prize up for grabs.

name: S Ankou za život
description: The Run with Anka for Life is a charity event held in Košice near St. Elisabeth Cathedral. The entry fee is a voluntary contribution, and all proceeds from entry fees go to the Oáza - Hope for a New Life facility. The event is organized by the Anka Kolesárová Pastoral Centre in Vysoká nad Uhom. Runners can combine a sporting challenge with supporting a good cause.

name: Hutčanská 5 s vierou – beh srdcom i telom
description: The Run with Heart and Soul in Nižná Hutka is an annual running event offering a 5 km course for experienced runners and a fun 500 m route for the youngest participants. Alongside the sporting experience, the program includes a spiritual reflection, refreshments, a panel discussion, and music. The event creates a welcoming community atmosphere and encourages both competition and the joy of running.

name: Semimaraton Porolissum
organizer: ASOCIATIA CLUBUL SPORTIV TODO RUN ZALĂU
description: Porolissum Half Marathon is an annual mountain race held in the heart of history, in the area around the Porolissum Roman Camp in Moigrad, Sălaj County. The event offers three distinct races: the 23 km Half Marathon, the 12 km Salamander Race, and the 1.6 km Fortifications Tour, welcoming runners of all levels. The routes combine the challenge of mountain running with spectacular scenery and historical features, making them ideal for nature and history enthusiasts. The organizers provide a complete experience, with hydration stations, timing, and an awards ceremony.

name: ASCOTID Trail Race
organizer: ASCOTID (Asociația Copiilor și Tinerilor Diabetici - Mureș)
description: ASCOTID Trail Race is an annual off-road running competition held in the Cornești Plateau area of Târgu Mureș. The event promotes physical activity for all age groups and was initiated by the Association of Children and Young People with Diabetes Mureș (ASCOTID). The routes include a half marathon, 10 km and 5 km races, as well as races for children and families, offering an accessible yet challenging experience due to the elevation changes. Participants can enjoy beautiful natural surroundings and a friendly atmosphere, with a focus on social and health goals.

name: „Alerg Pentru Tine” Trail Run
description: Alerg Pentru Tine Trail Run is a charity sporting event held in the picturesque forests of Bucovina, near Sucevița. The event supports palliative care patients at Sf. Luca Sucevița and Sf. Mc. Zenovie Dr. Suceava hospitals, bringing joy and fulfilling the dreams of those going through difficult times. Participants can choose from three moderately difficult races, suitable for both experienced and less experienced runners, and are encouraged to run with heart and determination for a noble cause. The courses offer spectacular views of the Sucevița Valley and the local monastery, and the atmosphere is one of solidarity and community support.

name: ALBA IULIA CITY RACE Aleargă în cealaltă capitală!
description: Alba Iulia City Race is a major athletic event held in the heart of the Alba Carolina Citadel, giving participants the opportunity to run through a remarkable historic setting. The competition includes several races, from a half marathon and a 10 km cross-country race to fun runs and children’s races, promoting a healthy lifestyle and a community of runners. The event is a running festival, combining a passion for sport with exploration and recognition of local values. The organizers emphasize a complete experience, with personalized race kits, hydration stations, electronic timing, and attractive prizes.

name: POROLISSUM TRAIL
description: Porolissum Half Marathon is a mountain running event held in Moigrad, Sălaj County. The main 23 km course offers a spectacular experience, starting and finishing at the heart of history, the Porolissum Roman Fort. The event also includes 12 km and 1.6 km races, for both advanced runners and enthusiasts of nature and history. The organizers offer a friendly yet challenging atmosphere, with race kits available for pickup in the days leading up to the event and on race day.

name: TRASCĂU TRAIL RUN
description: Trascău Trail Run is a mountain race offering three events: marathon, half marathon, and cross-country, set amid the scenic landscapes around Rimetea, Alba. Participants will explore the natural beauty of the Trascău Mountains on routes featuring challenging climbs, forests, gorges, and spectacular viewpoints. The event focuses on the experience of running in nature, with courses that combine physical challenge, storybook scenery, and local heritage. The organizers provide hydration and aid stations, medals for those who finish within the time limit, and prizes for the top competitors.

name: RUN FOR LIFE
location: Dumbrava Vlăsiei, Snagov, Ilfov County, Romania

name: Župska vinska trka 2026
description: The Župa Wine Run is a unique sporting and wine event held in the beautiful landscape of Župa, a renowned wine region in central Serbia. The race brings together wine and sports enthusiasts on a course that passes vineyards, mountains, and cultural and historical landmarks such as the medieval town of Koznik. Participants enjoy tastings at aid stations and receive an official T-shirt, a finisher’s medal, and other souvenirs. The event promotes the region’s rich traditions and natural beauty. The race starts at 12:00, and race packs can be collected until 11:00.

name: ESZTERGOM FÉLMARATON
description: Az Esztergom Félmaraton egy barátságos és változatos terepű futóverseny, amely Esztergom városának történelmi és természeti szépségeit mutatja be. A verseny központja a Szent István téren található, és a futók a Várhegy, Víziváros és a dunaparti kerékpárút útvonalán haladnak. A távok között szerepel a félmaraton, harmad- és hatodmaraton, valamint váltóverseny is, így mindenki megtalálhatja a számára megfelelő kihívást. A rendezvény családbarát, gyermekfutamokkal és ajándékokkal várja a legkisebbeket is.
course_highlights: Változatos útvonal Esztergom történelmi városrészein és a dunaparti kerékpárúton
Vegyes útburkolat: kockakő és aszfalt, emelkedőkkel és lejtőkkel
Váltóverseny a Bazilika előtti rajt/célzónában
additional: Gyermekfutamok ingyenesek, előzetes regisztráció szükséges e-mailben vagy a helyszínen. Váltóverseny esetén az első futó egyéni félmaraton résztvevő is lehet. Létszámlimit van a távokon. ECO nevezés póló nélkül, régi éremmel választható. Szintidők: első kör 55 perc, második kör 1 óra 53 perc, félmaraton 2 óra 55 perc.

name: Wink-Intretech KapuvárRun 2026
description: A Wink-Intretech KapuvárRun 2026 futóversenyt ötödik alkalommal rendezik meg Kapuváron, az Eszterházi parkban. A verseny teljesen sík, városi utcákon zajlik, és évről évre egyre több hazai és külföldi futót vonz. A rendezvény célja a közösségi élmény és a mozgás örömének megosztása, ahol a jó hangulat és az összetartozás áll a középpontban. A befutó után is folytatódik az élmény, díjazásokkal és egy nagy rendezvénysátorral, ahol a szurkolók kényelmesen biztathatják a futókat.

name: BERLIN MARATON
description: A BMW BERLIN-MARATHON a világ egyik legnagyobb és legnépszerűbb maratonversenye, amely Berlinben kerül megrendezésre. A verseny híres a rekorddöntő, rendkívül sík pályájáról, amely a város legszebb nevezetességein vezet keresztül. A rendezvény nemcsak a profi futók, hanem a futás szerelmesei számára is különleges élményt nyújt, köszönhetően a sokszínűségnek és a város egyedülálló energiájának. A verseny része az Abbott World Marathon Majors sorozatnak, és a résztvevők számos lehetőség közül választhatnak, beleértve a jótékonysági futást, inline görkorcsolyázást és a Generali 5K futamot is.

name: SRI CHINMOY FUTÓFESZTIVÁL
description: A Sri Chinmoy Futófesztivál egy hagyományos futóverseny Győrben, amely változatos távokat kínál az amatőr és profi futók számára egyaránt. A verseny helyszíne a Püspökerdő, ahol egyéni és csapat távokon is lehet indulni, többek között 5 km, 15 km, félmaraton, maraton és ultramaraton távokon. A rendezvény célja, hogy minden résztvevő túlszárnyalja önmagát, miközben élvezheti a természet közelségét és a futás örömét. A verseny családias hangulatú, és mindenkit szeretettel várnak, aki szeretne egy kihívásokkal teli, ugyanakkor barátságos futóeseményen részt venni.
course_highlights: Természetközeli futópálya a Püspökerdőben
Változatos távok 5 km-től 50 km-ig, egyéni és csapat kategóriákban
Kihívást jelentő terep, amely alkalmas maraton és ultramaraton teljesítésére
additional: A versenyen egyéni és csapat kategóriákban is lehet indulni. A rajt reggel 8 órakor van. A versenyzők többféle táv közül választhatnak, így mindenki megtalálhatja a számára megfelelő kihívást. A korábbi versenykiírásokban minimaraton, 15 km-es, félmaratoni, maratoni és ultratávok, valamint csapatversenyek is szerepeltek.

name: Fut a Börs
location: Budaörs Városi Uszoda, Hársfa utca 6, Budaörs, Hungary

name: II. Kerületi Kaptató
location: Gyarmati Dezső Swimming Pool, Máriaremetei út 224, Budapest II. kerület, Hungary

name: Mariatálsky štvanec
description: Mariatálsky štvanec is a traditional running race set in the beautiful surroundings of the Little Carpathians, offering a range of events for recreational and competitive runners. The event takes place in the village of Marianka, with a family-friendly atmosphere, and culminates in a beautiful sunset. You can compete in the 6 km, 10 km, and 15 km categories, in three-person teams over 3×6 km, or in the children’s Beh Záhoráčik races. The start and finish are at the football pitch, and the race is governed by the rules of the Slovak Athletic Federation.

name: MTBIKER Kylof Ľubietová
location: Ľubietová, okr. Banská Bystrica, Ľubietová, okr. Banská Bystrica, OÚ Ľubietová
description: MTHIKER Kylof Ľubietová is a running race that combines history, nature and a great atmosphere in the picturesque heart of Slovakia. There are three race distances: a 4.3 km hobby run for beginners and young runners aged 13 and over, a 10 km main race for competitive and recreational runners, and an 850 m children’s race for children aged 6 to 12. The course features climbs and beautiful views of the Low Tatras. Runners can compete for cash prizes and valuable awards. After the finish, participants can enjoy traditional granadír and an original medal that is part of the Marathon Tour.

name: Gréta Run
location: Liptovská .Sielnica okres L. Mikuláš, Liptovská .Sielnica okres L. Mikuláš, 8,7 km štart z Kvačianskej doliny (ústie) , 15 km štart z Koliby Gréta
description: Gréta Run is a traditional running race set in the scenic surroundings of Kvačianska Valley and Liptovská Sielnica, offering routes of various lengths for children and adults. The race follows the yellow hiking trail and the embankment, finishing at Koliba Gréta, where refreshments and a cultural programme await participants. The event also includes a rich programme of activities for families and children. The organizer, the Liptov Olympic Club, provides high-quality technical and medical services.

name: Šamorínska bežecká liga 2026 – 5. kolo
description: Šamorín Running League 2026 – Round 5 is a running event organized by 3klub Šamorín in cooperation with the town of Šamorín. The races take place in the pleasant surroundings of Pomlé Forest Park in Šamorín and are open to various age groups, from preschool children to adults. The children’s races start at 10:00, and the main race begins at 10:30. The event offers participants the opportunity to take part in the league and enjoy a sporting atmosphere in a community setting.

name: Crosul Arenelor
description: Crosul Arenelor is a unique running event in Bucharest, taking place on a 10-kilometer course between two iconic arenas: the Arcul de Triumf National Stadium and the National Arena. The race runs in one direction, with no turnarounds, along the capital’s most beautiful streets, offering a fast and smooth experience. The event also includes a 2 km Family Run and a wheelchair race, and is open to all running enthusiasts. The organizers focus on creating an energizing atmosphere, with cheer points along the course and a complete race kit for runners.

name: Buzău 21k
description: Buzău 21k is the first half marathon in Buzău County, organized by the Buzău Community Foundation. The event brings the local community together to promote exercise, health, and charity, offering a vibrant running experience in the heart of the city. The route starts at Buzău Athletics Stadium, crosses Crâng Park, and continues along the city’s main boulevards and streets, creating an atmosphere full of energy and joy. Buzău 21k is more than a sporting competition—it is a call for movement and community involvement.

name: Rajac 2026
description: Kosidba on Rajac is a traditional event held since 1892, on the first Sunday after Petrovdan. It brings together mowers dressed in traditional peasant costumes, who compete in hand-mowing grass on prepared plots. In addition to the competition, the program includes an exhibition of mowing tools, folk performances, and cultural and artistic activities, creating a unique atmosphere and preserving folk traditions.

name: JÁSZFÉNYSZARUI FUTÓFESZTIVÁL
distance_verbose: 10.5 km, 4 km, 2 km, 1500 meter, 1 km, 0.6 km, 0.3 km
organizer: Petőfi Sándor Művelődési Ház és Könyvtár Jászfényszaru
description: A VII. Jászfényszarui Futófesztivál egy szabadidős futóesemény, amelyet Jászfényszarún, a Szentcsalád téren rendeznek meg. A verseny több korosztály számára kínál távokat, az óvodásoktól a felnőttekig, aszfaltozott és rövid földutas szakaszokkal. A negyedmaratoni távon chipes időmérés, frissítőpontok és érmek várják a résztvevőket, a verseny ingyenes minden távon. A rendezvény célja a közösségi sportolás és a futás népszerűsítése, emléket állítva Maróti Istvánnak.

name: MAPEI TIHANYI FÉLMARATON (XI.)   .
description: A MAPEI Tihanyi Félmaraton egy hagyományos, 11. alkalommal megrendezett futóverseny Tihanyban, amely változatos távokat kínál a kezdőktől a haladókig. A verseny különlegessége a Balaton-felvidék gyönyörű panorámája és a kihívást jelentő, változatos terep, amely a félsziget legszebb részeit érinti. A félmaraton távját sokan választják első félmaratonjuknak, hiszen a pálya összetétele és a látványos szakaszok felejthetetlen élményt nyújtanak. A rendezvény családbarát, a legkisebbeknek babyrun is van, és minden távon befutóéremmel, frissítéssel, valamint futópólóval várják a résztvevőket.

name: MVM Sopron Félmaraton
location: Városi Stadion, Káposztás u. 4., Sopron, Hungary

name: BADACSONY MARATON
distance_verbose: Maraton, Félmaraton, 11 km, 7 km, 3000 meter, 0.4 km

name: Jarabský polmaratón
location: Jarabá, Brezno District, Banská Bystrica Region, Slovakia
description: The Jarabá Half Marathon is a unique mountain trail race in the Low Tatras, covering 22.1 km. It features a demanding course with climbs, descents, and technical terrain. The race is designed for trail-running and active-outdoor enthusiasts, who can enjoy beautiful views and the atmosphere of a running community ranging from professionals to recreational athletes. The event has been held since 2015 and embodies the spirit of a friendly running get-together: “Go as you can around Jarabá.” In 2025, it is part of the Slovak Skyrunning League, underscoring its quality and challenge.

name: U.S.Steel Family Run – Minimaratón
description: The U. S. Steel Family Run - Mini-Marathon is a running event in Košice and part of the traditional International Peace Marathon. Runners of all ages are welcome, with no age restrictions. The event follows the rules of World Athletics and the Slovak Athletic Federation, and the organizers ensure thorough preparation and organization. The start and finish are on Hlavná Street in Košice, making for an appealing city run.

name: Matúškovský beh
organizer: Občianske združenie DAM Šport Matúškovo a obec Matúškovo

price_tiers.distance: Hlavný beh, Hobby beh, Nordic walking

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: obyvateľ Matúškova, žiak MŠ Matúškovo zadarmo

description: The Matúškovo Run is a running event in the village of Matúškovo, featuring a 12 km main race, a 4 km hobby run and 4 km Nordic walking. The course runs on paved and asphalt roads through the village, consists of 4 km loops and is marked with traffic signs. The event also includes children’s categories with distances varying by age. Participants receive finisher medals, while winners receive cups and certificates. The event takes place in all weather and is limited to 300 runners, excluding children.
course_highlights: The course runs on paved and asphalt roads through the village and is marked with traffic signs
The main race consists of three 4 km loops
Children’s categories offer distances that vary by age
additional: Race-day registration is from 8:00 at the Cultural Centre in Matúškovo. Parking is available around the Cultural Centre. The maximum number of starters is 300 runners, excluding children. All runners who finish receive participant medals. The race takes place in all weather. The route runs on paved and asphalt roads through the village, alongside traffic in one lane separated by traffic signs; it is not certified. Registration and parking are at the Cultural Centre in Matúškovo. The capacity is 300 starters, excluding children.

name: Karpaty Run – Bratislava Trail Run
location: Malokarpatské Námestie 1, Bratislava - Lamač, Bratislava, Slovakia
description: Karpaty Run - Bratislava Trail Run is the largest trail running festival in the Little Carpathians, offering routes of varying lengths and difficulty for runners and hikers. The race takes place in a pleasant natural setting, with an emphasis on protecting nature and promoting a healthy lifestyle. The routes run mainly along forest roads and trails, with minimal asphalt, and are suitable for intermediate to advanced runners. The organizer is the Hojta civic association, which supports sports and ecological values.
course_highlights: Routes are 65% forest road and 33–35% forest trail
Elevation gain ranges from 80 m to 876 m, depending on the route length
Refreshments are available at several points along the route, depending on its length
additional: The start is 700 m from Malokarptské Square in Lamač, with a transfer 20 minutes before the start. There is no time limit for most routes, except for the longest ones, which have a limit of 5 or 7 hours. Refreshment stations are available along the route depending on its length. Refreshments can be purchased at Biely Kríž.

name: Mârzești Trail Run 2026
location: Pădurea Mârzești, Breazu, Iași County, Romania

name: Vâlcea Forest Run 2026
location: Strada Muzeului 3, Bujoreni, Vâlcea County, Romania

name: 140 BPM - 25 aprilie 2026
description: 140 BPM is a running race held in King Michael I Park (Herăstrău) in Bucharest. The event offers routes adapted for all ages, including races for children and adults, over distances of 3 km and 6 km. The routes are designed to be accessible and enjoyable, following the park’s paths and offering a recreational and competitive outdoor experience. Participants can enjoy a friendly atmosphere and facilities dedicated to runners.

name: Crosul Regina Maria
description: Queen Maria Cross is a running event held in Cluj-Napoca, bringing together the local running community for a competition full of energy and sportsmanship. The course starts near the Horia Demian Sports Hall and offers participants an enjoyable experience in a friendly, well-organized atmosphere. The event is supported by official sponsors and partners, helping ensure smooth operations and amenities for runners. It is an excellent opportunity for athletes of all levels to enjoy running outdoors and connect with other enthusiasts.

name: Last Man Standing
description: Last Man Standing is a unique endurance race within Zalău Ultra Trail that tests participants’ physical and mental limits. The format involves repeatedly running a course of approximately 6.7 km, with a start at the top of every hour; participants who do not finish the lap in time are eliminated. The race continues until only one runner remains, making it an extreme challenge of endurance, willpower, and strategy. The event takes place in Poienița Aghireș and is part of the ZUT series, which promotes connection between athletes, the community, and nature.
course_highlights: Approximately 6.7 km course run in successive loops
Starts at the top of every hour, with a time limit of 59 minutes and 30 seconds per loop
Elimination format continues until only one runner remains
additional: Participants must complete each lap in under an hour to continue in the race. The race is extremely demanding, eliminating anyone who is late or withdraws. The organizer recommends careful preparation and strict adherence to the rules for safety and fair play.

name: Veverița Night Run
description: Veverița Night Run is a nighttime mountain running race in Bucovina, held in Vatra Dornei, with two medium-difficulty races over 12 km and 22 km. The routes are mainly on mountain trails, with sections through forest and open meadows, starting and finishing at the base of the Veverița ski slope and reaching Diecilor Peak. The event provides hydration and food stations, as well as medical assistance from the Vatra Dornei Mountain Rescue team. Participants should be prepared for mountain running and bring the equipment needed for nighttime and mountain conditions.
course_highlights: 12 km route with 95% mountain trail and 5% paved road
22 km route entirely on mountain trails, with 1161 m of elevation gain
Start and finish at the base of the Veverița ski slope, with the highest point at Diecilor Peak (1301 m)
additional: Children can register on-site. Participants must have a headlamp with charged and spare batteries, a mobile phone with a charged battery, their race number visible throughout the race, and suitable equipment for adverse weather conditions. Medical assistance is provided by Vatra Dornei Mountain Rescue; no ambulance will be stationed at the start/finish.

name: Harvest Run
description: Harvest Run is a sporting event that promotes running as a way to support health, solidarity, and community. In Vladimirescu, Arad, participants of all ages are invited to take part in a range of races, from the half-marathon to children’s races, in a friendly and inclusive atmosphere. The event supports social causes and encourages an active lifestyle, bringing together runners of all levels to support the local community.
course_highlights: Varied routes: half-marathon 21 km, sprint 10 km, super sport 5 km, family race 1 km, and children’s races
An event for all ages, from children to adults and seniors
A community atmosphere and support for local social causes
additional: The community meets every Tuesday at 18:00 for group training, on a route from Sala Polivalentă Arad to Stadionul Gloria. The event includes the “MAI DEPARTE” project, dedicated to beginners and those who want to adopt a healthy lifestyle. Minimum ages for the races: 18 for the half-marathon, 14 for the sprint, 12 for super sport, no age limit for the family race, and special races for children aged 6 to 12.

name: Serbia Backyard Ultra 2026
description: Serbia Backyard Ultra is an ultrarace with no finish line, held in Pančevo. Runners complete a 6,706-meter loop every hour, aiming to run as many loops as they can while finishing each one within the hour. The last runner to finish a loop wins, and the race is more of a mental challenge than a competition against others. Every personal best is celebrated, and the race is an opportunity to test consistency, perseverance, and mental strength.
course_highlights: A 6,706-meter loop
Each loop must be completed within one hour
A race with no preset distance or finish line
additional: The race venue is Šajka, Kej Radoja Dakića, Pančevo. Runners who cover the longest distance can ring the “record bell” and celebrate their personal best. Registration for the race is closed.

name: Noć na Jezeru 2026
description: Night by the Lake is the third race in the Subotica Friendship League, held at the Great Terrace in Palić. The event features several distances suited to different ages and running levels, including children’s races and 5 km and 10 km races. It brings together runners from the region in a welcoming atmosphere and offers an opportunity to socialize and compete.
course_highlights: 10 km and 5 km courses
Children’s races of 1 km and 0.3 km
Held at the Great Terrace in Palić
additional: The program includes a raffle, a food truck, and a dance workshop.

name: BÉNI WINE FARMATLON
location: Béni Wine Farm, Külső Budai út 312, Cegléd, Hungary

name: PÉCSI EGYETEMI BORBIRTOK DÜLŐFUTÁS
location: Pécsi Egyetemi Borbirtok, Szentmiklós dűlő 1, Pécs, Hungary

name: Medzinárodný maratón mieru
description: The International Peace Marathon in Košice is a traditional running festival held on Hlavná Street. Organized by the Košice Marathon Club, it offers a marathon, half marathon, and other disciplines, with the start and finish located in the city center. The event is known for its long history and high-quality organization, including the Slovak Half Marathon Championships. Runners can expect professional timing and a rich program of accompanying events.

name: Majstrovstvá SR v polmaratóne mužov a žien - MMM 2026
description: The Slovak Republic Championships in the Men’s and Women’s Half Marathon are part of the Košice Peace Marathon, held in Košice. The half-marathon course is fast, with few sharp turns and a favourable elevation profile, allowing runners to achieve excellent times. The start and finish are on Hlavná Street in the city centre, creating a pleasant atmosphere for runners and spectators alike. The event is organised with an emphasis on professional preparation and support for the running community.
course_highlights: A fast course with few sharp turns
A favourable elevation profile suited to fast times
Start and finish on Hlavná Street in Košice
additional: The start of all events is on Hlavná Street, between the DoubleTree by Hilton hotel and the Dargov department store. The MMM relays consist of four runners, with legs of 12 km, 9 km and 12 km. The organiser awards age categories for the marathon and half marathon. Registration is available online only through the official website.

name: Brașov Running Festival
distance_verbose: 12 km, 10 km, 5 km, 3000 metri, 1.2 km, 0.8 km
description: Brașov Running Festival is a top road-running event that brings thousands of runners to Brașov, from amateurs to elite athletes, in an atmosphere full of energy, music, and fun. The festival includes a variety of races, from a 5 km race for beginners and races for children to tRUNsylvania 10K, the only road race in Romania certified with a World Athletics Elite Label. The event takes place on the streets of Brașov’s Tractorul district and offers a complete experience with cheering zones, live performances, and TV broadcasts. It is a celebration of running that combines athletic performance with the joy of community.

name: MARZESTI TRAIL RUN ALEARGĂ, FII PARTE DIN NATURĂ!
description: Mârzeşti Trail Run is an annual cross-country running competition held in the Breazu area, in Rediu commune, Iași County, with the start and finish in front of the forestry ranger station in Mârzeşti Forest. The varied courses include wooded areas, meadows, forest roads and agricultural roads, offering a unique running experience in nature, with flat sections, descents and climbs. The event promotes outdoor sports and supports local social causes, providing an opportunity for running enthusiasts to enjoy themselves and meet. The half-marathon distance and the other races are suitable for different levels of training, and the event includes hydration points and course marshals.

name: UVT Liberty Marathon
description: UVT Liberty Marathon is a running competition held in Timișoara that promotes a healthy lifestyle and the freedom to discover yourself through movement. The event offers races for all levels, from children to experienced runners, with distances ranging from 200 meters to a full 42 km marathon. The UVT Liberty Marathon community is dedicated to supporting and motivating participants to reach their potential and enjoy running in a friendly, energetic setting. The courses are designed to challenge and inspire, and the atmosphere is supportive and free-spirited.

name: SPAR MARATON FUTÓFESZTIVÁL
description: A SPAR Budapest Maraton Fesztivál Magyarország legnagyobb szabadidős sportrendezvénye, amely egy kétnapos futófesztivál Budapesten. A versenyzők gyönyörű és változatos útvonalon, a világörökségi helyszínek mentén futhatnak, miközben élvezhetik a város panorámáját és a lelkes szurkolók hangulatát. Több táv közül választhatnak, az 5 km-től a maraton teljes távjáig, így mindenki megtalálhatja a számára legmegfelelőbb kihívást. A rendezvény egyedi befutóéremmel és futópólóval teszi emlékezetessé a napot.
course_highlights: Világörökségi helyszínek mentén vezető útvonal
Budapest legszebb részeinek panorámája
Számos zenekar és lelkes szurkolók a pálya mentén
additional: A verseny több hullámban indul, a maraton rajtja 9:00-kor van. A rendezvényen számos kísérőprogram, bemelegítés és díjátadó is várja a résztvevőket. A nevezés kizárólag online történik a nevezes.futanet.hu oldalon. A fesztiválon egyedi befutóérem és futópóló jár a résztvevőknek.

name: Javornícka stovka
description: The Javornícka Stovka is a mountain ultramarathon and long-distance hike held in the Javorníky Mountains. Runners cross challenging mountain terrain with several checkpoints and time limits. The event is intended for experienced runners seeking a challenge in beautiful natural surroundings. The start and registration are in Čadca, and the finish is in Lysá pod Makytou. The organizers emphasize safety, mandatory equipment, and medical assistance along the entire route.

name: GARMIN Beh Súľovskými skalami
organizer: SCK CYKLO TOUR Súľov - Hradná a MTBIKER community
description: The GARMIN Run Through the Súľov Rocks is a traditional running race set in the beautiful surroundings of the Súľov Rocks, offering three courses of varying lengths and difficulty. Runners pass through picturesque countryside with views of rock formations and ridge trails, and the courses include refreshment stations. The event is suitable for the general public, including children, who have their own categories and starts. It is organized by the Slovak Cycling Club CYKLO TOUR Súľov - Hradná, which provides thorough preparation and services for participants.

name: Spoznaj Trebišov behom – Night RUN
location: Námestie pod OD Billa, Trebišov, Slovakia
description: Discover Trebišov by Running – Night RUN is a night race in the centre of Trebišov, offering a unique experience of running under the stars. The event is part of the Discover Trebišov by Running series and is organised by Majcher-Production s.r.o. Runners can look forward to a pleasant atmosphere, an urban course and the chance to discover the beauty of Trebišov in a different way than during the day. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes an active lifestyle.
course_highlights: Night race in the centre of Trebišov
Urban course with an atmosphere under the stars
A chance to discover Trebišov from a different perspective

name: Grand Prix – Cabaj-Čápor
location: Cabaj-Čápor, Cabaj-Čápor, neďaleko penziónu Salaš Cabaj, Čáporský les
description: Grand Prix Cabaj-Čápor is a traditional cross-country race in beautiful natural surroundings, held in the village of Cabaj-Čápor, starting near Salaš Cabaj. Runners can choose from several distances, including 10 km, 3 km, and children’s races over 600 m and 1,000 m. The event is ideal for anyone who wants to enjoy the atmosphere of sport outdoors, whether for competition or simply for the joy of movement. Registration is open and participant numbers are limited, so it is best to sign up early.

name: Jesenný beh Michalovčanov
organizer: Mesto Michalovce a Atletický klub Michalovce
description: The Autumn Run of Michalovce Residents is a traditional running race in Michalovce, offering an opportunity for competitors of different age categories. The race takes place at the grounds of 2nd Primary School at J. Švermu 6 and consists of a 400-metre children’s run and a 3-kilometre main race. The event is suitable for families and runners who want to enjoy the autumn atmosphere and take part in sporting activities in pleasant surroundings. The organizers provide refreshments and commemorative items for participants.

name: Beh Myšľou
location: Nižná Myšľa, Nižná Myšľa, Archeoskanzen Nižná Myšľa
description: The Beh Vyšnou Myšľou is a running event organized by the Running Club of the Municipality of Vyšná Myšľa and the Municipality of Vyšná Myšľa. The races take place at the football pitch in the municipality of Vyšná Myšľa, in the Košice-okolie District. The children’s categories start at 14:00 and the adult categories at 16:00. Men and women can compete in various age categories, including a two-person relay over 2 × 3 km. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant atmosphere for running in the municipality.

name: Beh Neporazených
description: Beh neporazených is a charitable running event in Bratislava that supports prevention and assistance for people who have had a stroke. The race takes place at Dvořákovo námestie by River Park and offers courses for various age groups, including children’s races and a special run for stroke patients. Participants can run the 5 km or 10 km course, and the event emphasizes its community and awareness-raising purpose. Proceeds from entry fees go to the Porážka.sk civic association to support patients and their rehabilitation.
course_highlights: Courses run along the Danube embankment in central Bratislava
Children’s races of 100 m, 300 m and 600 m, depending on age
Start and finish at Dvořákovo námestie by River Park
additional: The event has a capacity of 600 participants. Check-in and race number collection for children’s races and stroke patients is from 07:30 to 08:45; for the 5 km and 10 km races, it is from 07:30 to 09:30. Race numbers are non-transferable, and entry fees are non-refundable. Participants can order the official event T-shirt at a discounted price during registration. Proceeds from entry fees, after bank and service fees are deducted, are allocated to the operation of the Porážka.sk civic association.

name: Rozhanovská dvanástka
location: Rozhanovce, Košice-okolie District, Košice Region, Slovakia

name: Hercules Maraton
description: Hercules Marathon is a mountain running event held in the Cerna Valley, Băile Herculane, organized by Alternative Timișoara Sports Club. The race includes Marathon (44 km) and Half Marathon (22 km) events on mountain trails that cross the Cerna Mountains and connect the area's 39 hamlets. This outdoor competition showcases the region's natural beauty and the challenges of mountain terrain.
course_highlights: Mountain trails crossing the Cerna Mountains
Connecting 39 hamlets in the Cerna Valley area
Marathon (44 km) and Half Marathon (22 km) events

name: Crosul „INIMILOR MARI” 2026
location: Parcul Central Simion Bărnuțiu, Cluj-Napoca, Romania

name: Pedale’n Codru ~ 2026
location: DJ572, Băile Lipova, Lipova, Arad County, Romania

name: Trka za život
description: The Race for Life is a charity event in Niš dedicated to supporting women with cancer. It aims to raise awareness of early detection and empower patients. Participants express solidarity and hope through moving together and taking part in educational activities at the finish. The event brings individuals, families, and organizations together in a spirit of community and compassion, combining sport, education, and charitable engagement in an inspiring day.
course_highlights: Start at Niš Fortress, with positive energy and a sense of community
Inspiring messages and educational materials at the checkpoints
A finish area with advice on prevention and support
additional: Each participant starts the race with a symbolic hug of support. The event concludes with a group ceremony and fundraising to help people affected by cancer. At the finish, an educational corner offers advice from doctors, psychologists, and radiologists. The race is a charity initiative by the Budite uz nas association, which provides ongoing support to women with cancer. Participation raises funds for support activities for people affected by cancer, healthcare institutions, and the purchase of equipment and supplements.

name: 41. SPAR Budapest Maraton® Fesztivál
description: A SPAR Budapest Maraton® Fesztivál Magyarország legnagyobb szabadidős sportrendezvénye, amely egy igazi bakancslistás kihívás minden futó számára. A verseny változatos távokon zajlik, a klasszikus maratontól a rövidebb, családbarát futamokig, így mindenki megtalálhatja a számára megfelelő kihívást. A gyönyörű és változatos budapesti útvonalon több ezer futótárs várja a résztvevőket, egy igazi futóünnepet teremtve. A fesztivál két napos, gazdag programokkal és közösségi élményekkel.
course_highlights: Gyönyörű és változatos budapesti útvonal
Több ezer futótárs a futás ünnepén
Különböző távok 5 km-től a klasszikus maratonig
additional: A verseny több rajtidőpontban indul, a fő maraton és páros maraton rajtja 9:00-kor van. A rendezvény két napos, október 10-én és 11-én zajlik, számos kísérőprogrammal és különböző távú futamokkal. A nevezés kizárólag online történik a nevezes.futanet.hu oldalon. A fesztiválon egyedi érembetét és jelvények is elérhetők a résztvevők számára.

name: Beh za zdravie – Kuchajda
description: Run for Health - Kuchajda is a charity running event held at Kuchajda in Bratislava. It combines sport with support for health and the community, aiming to help disadvantaged people and organizations through physical activity. Participants can run, jog at an easy pace, or walk, creating a wonderful atmosphere filled with inspiring stories and solidarity. Run for Health is open to all ages and fitness levels and supports charitable projects with a real impact.

name: Beh ulicami Krompách
location: Krompachy okr. Spišská Nová Ves, Krompachy okr. Spišská Nová Ves, pred budovou mestského úradu
organizer: Mesto Krompachy, Komisia kultúry a športu pri MsZ v Krompachoch
description: The Run Through the Streets of Krompachy is a traditional race in the town of Krompachy, offering categories for children, adolescents, juniors, men and women in various age groups. The race takes place in front of the town hall and is organized by the City of Krompachy and the Culture and Sports Commission of the Krompachy Municipal Council. The start is split, with children’s categories and adolescents starting at 9:30 and adults at 11:00. The entry fee is a symbolic €5, except for schoolchildren, adolescents and runners over 60. The race is suitable for the general public and supports sporting life in the region.

name: Beh do vrchu Banské – Mlačky
organizer: Športový klub Banské a Obecný úrad Banské
description: The Banské–Mláčky uphill run is a traditional mountain race on a 6.4 km course with 326 metres of elevation gain, running from the Cultural Centre in Banské to the summit of Mláčky. The race is part of the Bančanský Cup and the Eastern Slovak Uphill Running League, with categories for men, women, juniors and children. The race starts directly in front of the Cultural Centre and the course runs mainly on asphalt through the village of Banské towards Košice. The organisers are Športový klub Banské and the Banské Municipal Office, which also provide facilities at the Cultural Centre.
course_highlights: 6.4 km asphalt course with 326 m of elevation gain
Climb from the Cultural Centre in Banské to the summit of Mláčky
Part of the Eastern Slovak Uphill Running League and the Bančanský Cup
additional: Race registration opens at 7:30 at the Cultural Centre. Children’s races start at 9:00 and the main race at 11:00. The awards ceremony takes place at 15:45 at the Cultural Centre. Competitors must register at least 30 minutes before the start of their category. Changing rooms and race packs are available for those registered online. Children’s courses are 50, 100, 200, 300, 500 and 800 m long.

name: Beh prvého nádychu
description: The First Breath Run is a charity run in Trnava supporting the Neonatal Department of the University Hospital Trnava. Runners can choose between a 3.9 km or 7.8 km route, with the shorter loop available to complete twice. The event offers a medal, refreshments at the finish, and an accompanying programme including music and dance performances. Its goal is to improve conditions for new mothers and their babies while creating a welcoming community atmosphere.
course_highlights: A 3.9 km loop in Bela IV Park, which can be completed twice
Refreshments and support from the Trnava Slávia basketball players along the route
An accompanying programme with music, a warm-up and a dance performance
additional: Race bib collection from 8:30. The first three men and women in the categories will receive small prizes from partners. An accompanying programme and refreshments are planned after the run. Volunteers over 18 are needed at the start and along the route. Refreshments will be available at the finish.

name: Beh okolo Sidorova
location: Hotel Áčko, Hrabovská cesta 34, Ružomberok, Slovakia
organizer: Bežecký spolok Ruža Ružomberok a Centrum voľného času Elán Ružomberok
