description: Beh okolo Sidorova is a running event in Ružomberok, offering 4.8 km and 13 km routes that follow forest trails and partly run along roads. The event also includes free children’s and school-age races for various age groups. Competitors take part at their own risk, and the organizer does not provide insurance. The event is part of the Liptov Running League and takes place in pleasant surroundings. Race materials can be collected at Hotel Áčko on race day.
course_highlights: The routes follow forest trails and partly run along roads
Children’s and school-age races from 50 m to 1.5 km, with medals for all participants
Cash prizes and prizes in kind for winners in various age groups
additional: Registration and collection of race materials take place at Hotel Áčko on race day from 08:00. Registration closes 15 minutes before the start of the relevant category. On-site registration is available on race day from 08:00 to 09:00 in some categories. The top three in children’s categories 3 and 4, and in the younger and older school-age categories, receive diplomas and medals. Cash prizes are awarded in the overall standings and in the masters categories, provided there are enough competitors. A prize of 30 € is offered for breaking the course record.

name: Bucharest Marathon
description: The Raiffeisen Bank Bucharest Marathon is an iconic sporting event held annually in Bucharest, offering races for runners of all levels. The courses include the full 42 km marathon, the 21 km half marathon, the 10 km race, the popular race, and the 4x relay, all starting in Constitution Square. The event is known for its vibrant atmosphere, community support, and involvement in charitable causes. Participants can experience an urban course that passes major landmarks in the capital, with hydration and support stations along the way.

name: Prešovská hodinovka na tartane
location: Prešov, Prešov, atletický štadión Prešovskej univerzity
organizer: BK ZasRun, Olympijský klub Prešov, AK TJ Slávia Prešovská univerzita
description: The Prešov Tartan Hour is a running race held at the Prešov University athletics stadium in Prešov. The competition is open to various age categories of men and women and offers a unique opportunity to test your endurance and speed on a tartan track. It is organized by BK ZasRun Šarišské Bohdanovce, Olympijský klub Prešov, and AK TJ Slávia Prešovská univerzita. The race is ideal for runners who want to experience a high-quality athletics atmosphere and compete in the pleasant surroundings of a university stadium.

name: Stovka Považím - Považie ultra trail
description: Stovka Považím is a challenging long-distance hike and ultra trail in the beautiful Považie region, intended for experienced ultrarunners and hikers. Each year, it offers an original and extremely demanding course, with Route A forming part of the Czech-Slovak Ultra Trail Cup and the first stage of the Extreme Ultra Trail Combination. The event takes place in Trenčín and the surrounding area, with several routes and luggage transport provided between the start and finish. Participants can sleep in the gym at Predmier Elementary School, adding to the comfort of the competitors.

name: Petrovaradin Fortress NIGHT trail Serbia EPIC 2026
location: Petrovaradin Fortress, Petrovaradin, Novi Sad, Serbia
description: Petrovaradin Fortress NIGHT trail Serbia EPIC is a night race held at Petrovaradin Fortress, known for its historical significance and unique atmosphere. The race offers electronic timing, a fully marked course, and a chip-equipped race bib. Participants receive an official race T-shirt, a finisher’s medal, refreshments at the finish, medical assistance, and other benefits. After the race, a party and concert are held, creating a great sporting and entertainment atmosphere. This race is part of the Serbia EPIC series and is a challenge for all trail-running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Night race at Petrovaradin Fortress
Fully marked course and GPS track for navigation
Refreshment zone at the finish and medical assistance during the race

name: VII. Panoráma Trail 45
description: A Panoráma Trail egy 45 kilométeres terepfutó verseny a Zempléni-hegységben, amely összeköti a Boldogkő, Regéc és Füzér történelmi várakat. A verseny nem az időeredményekről szól, hanem az élményről és a természet közelségéről, ideális futóidőben, októberben kerül megrendezésre. Egyéni és 2-3 fős csapatváltó formában is teljesíthető, minden résztvevő prémium szolgáltatásokat kap, beleértve a várbelépőket és frissítést. A rendezvény célja, hogy a futók egy felejthetetlen utazást éljenek át a természet és történelem határán.
course_highlights: 45 kilométeres táv három történelmi vár érintésével
Változatos, technikás terep a Zempléni-hegység vadregényes erdeiben
Több frissítőpont és váltópont a pálya mentén
additional: Rajtszámátvétel pénteken 17:00-19:00 között Füzérben és szombaton 7:30-8:45 között Boldogkővár versenyközpontban. Egyéni indulók csomagszállítást kérhetnek a rajttól a célig. A rajt Boldogkő várnál van, a cél Füzérben. A váltócsapatok tagjai együtt futhatnak be a célba. A verseny zöld szemléletű, a természet védelme kiemelt szempont.

description: Az Írottkő Hegyi Futóverseny egy különleges terepfutó esemény, amely a Kőszegi-hegység változatos és vadregényes tájain zajlik. A verseny több távon kínál kihívást, a rövidebb 7 km-es bevezető futástól a 102 km-es ultra távig, amely az Alpokalja leghosszabb és legösszetettebb versenye. A futók megismerhetik a természet szépségeit, meredek emelkedőket, erdőket és panorámás csúcsokat, miközben saját határaikat feszegethetik. A verseny nem csak egy megmérettetés, hanem egy élmény, amely összeköti a futókat a természet szeretetével és a közösségi élménnyel.
course_highlights: 102 km-es ultra táv a Kőszegi-hegység leglátványosabb pontjain
Az Írottkő csúcsán mesés panoráma és 780 méter szintemelkedés
Változatos terep: meredek emelkedők, technikás lejtők és sűrű erdők
additional: A verseny "félig önellátó" jellegű, a futóknak saját felszerelésükkel kell felkészülniük, például fejlámpával, esőkabáttal és elegendő folyadékkal. A rendezvény környezettudatos, zero waste programmal, valamint szállásajánlatokkal támogatja a résztvevőket. A versenyen nincs helyezés, hanem a részvétel és a természet élvezete a fő cél, különösen a gyerekek számára szervezett futás esetén.

description: The Podvihorlatský Cross is a running event held at the football field (amphitheatre) in Poruba pod Vihorlatom. The races include starts for children’s categories and the main category. The course runs mainly along field and forest roads, with 30% asphalt surface. The event is organised by Mgr. Ján Podstavský with the support of the Municipality of Poruba pod Vihorlatom. It is part of the Michalovce–Sobrance Running League 2025 and offers categories for various age groups and Nordic walking.

name: Extrém Maratón Oščadnica
location: Oščadnica, Oščadnica, Račatak na Námestí M. Bernáta pri fontáne
organizer: Obec Oščadnica, Klub turistov Oščadnica, extremmaraton.sk
description: Extrém Maratón Oščadnica is a mountain marathon through the picturesque Kysuce countryside, mainly along mountain ridges with beautiful views of Veľká Rača. The 42-kilometre course, with nearly 1,700 metres of elevation gain, will test your endurance, strength and love of the mountains. This is not a race but a recreational running experience that celebrates the joy of movement, friendship and determination. The organisers provide full services, including refreshments, a T-shirt and a post-run get-together.

name: Rozhanovská dvanástka
organizer: Obec Rozhanovce, Občianske združenie KŠK Rozhanovce
description: Rozhanovce Twelve is a running race held at the amphitheatre grounds in Rozhanovce. It offers two main categories—a short 6 km course and a long 12 km course—for both men and women. The race is organised by the Municipality of Rozhanovce and the KŠK Rozhanovce civic association, and is suitable for runners of varying abilities. The children’s races are scheduled to start at 10:45 and the main courses at 11:00.

name: Šurianska desiatka
description: Šurianska desiatka is a running event held in the town of Šurany, with the start and finish in front of the Municipal Office. The course runs along the town’s streets and through part of Nitriansky Hrádok on asphalt roads. The event is open to the general public, including pupils, juniors, recreational runners, and Nordic Walking participants. It is organized by Gymnázium Bernolákova 37, Šurany, and the number of participants is limited in categories A to J. Refreshments and drinks are provided for competitors. Winners receive diplomas, prizes, and cash rewards.

description: The Ondrej Holec Memorial in Poniky is a cross-country race starting and based at the ŠK OPL Poniky football field. The event includes a 10-kilometre main race, a shorter hobby race and children’s races. The courses run through the surrounding area and offer runners of different age categories a chance to take part.
course_highlights: The main course is 10 km long with approximately 290 m of elevation gain.
The main course follows village roads, forest and field paths, and logging roads.
The hobby course is 3.7 km long with approximately 60 m of elevation gain.
additional: The programme also typically includes children’s races, with courses for schoolchildren, preschoolers and the youngest children.

name: Psotkov memorial
description: The Psotkov Memorial is a traditional mountain running race in the heart of the High Tatras, held near Štrbské Pleso. Runners can choose between two challenging courses: BASIC, 25.3 km long with 1,540 m of elevation gain, and EXTREME, 37.9 km long with 2,490 m of elevation gain. The route passes through picturesque mountain scenery, including a climb below the summit of Kriváň, a descent to Tri studničky, a stretch past Jamské pleso and through the Furkotská Valley, and a finish at Chata pod Soliskom. The race is part of the Skyrunner® National Series Slovakia and offers a unique experience of running in challenging mountain terrain.

name: Azuga Trail Race
description: Azuga Trail Race powered by JYSK is an annual mountain running event held in the town of Azuga and the Baiului Mountains, Romania. The event offers passionate runners a unique experience across four spectacular routes with views of the Bucegi, Postăvaru, and Piatra Mare mountains. Participants can enjoy nature, physical and mental challenges, and an atmosphere filled with adrenaline and competitive spirit. It is an opportunity to test your limits and meet people who share your passions.
course_highlights: Four mountain routes with views of the Bucegi, Postăvaru, and Piatra Mare mountains
Routes in the Baiului Mountains, with aid stations offering water, energy drinks, and fruit
Different start locations for the main races and children’s races, including special routes with gondola transport
additional: The race kit includes a personalized bib, personalized products, individual chip timing, aid stations with water and fruit, finisher medals, cash and sports equipment prizes, surprise prize draws, ITRA/UTMB points where applicable, and an official photo and video album. Gondola transport is included for the Family Walk & Run and Urechea Run. Awards ceremony at 17:00, SuperParty on Saturday evening with DJ Cătălin Sănătescu. Routes with significant elevation gain, impressive mountain scenery, a festive atmosphere, and activities for the whole family.

name: Făget Tour
description: Făget Tour GlobalLogic is a running race organized by Runners Club in Cluj-Napoca, offering participants the opportunity to run in nature during one of the most beautiful times of the year. The event includes two main races: a 7 km cross-country race and a 22 km half marathon, held on scenic routes in the Făget area. This competition is a cherished tradition among the local running community, now in its 15th edition, and promises an enjoyable and challenging experience for runners of all levels.
course_highlights: 7 km cross-country route in nature
22 km half marathon with scenic views
Routes marked and supported by Runners Club Cluj-Napoca
additional: The routes are marked, and a GPX file is available for the half marathon. The event is organized by Runners Club, which also offers free group training sessions in Cluj-Napoca. The race has official partners and supporters. The event also includes other trail races and related activities, offering an opportunity to discover the area's natural beauty and take part in a community sporting event.

name: SEMIMARATONUL CRAIOVEI
description: The Craiova Half Marathon is an annual running and fundraising event for community causes, organized by the Romanian Association of Young People with Initiative (A.R.T.I.) in collaboration with SightRunning.ro. The event includes timed half-marathon, 14 km and 7 km races, as well as untimed races and activities for all ages and categories, including people with disabilities and pets. The course is urban, starting and finishing at the Ion Oblemenco Stadium Esplanade in Craiova, and consists of 7 km loops with an elevation gain of 58 m. Participants support charitable projects in education, health and social inclusion.
course_highlights: Urban course starting and finishing at the Ion Oblemenco Stadium Esplanade
7 km loops: 3 for the half marathon, 2 for the 14 km race and 1 for the 7 km race
Hydration stations and medical assistance along the course
additional: Race kits can be collected at Electroputere Mall in the days before the event and on event day at the Ion Oblemenco Stadium Esplanade. The event includes special races for wheelchair users and adaptive sports, as well as untimed races and related activities. Safety measures include law enforcement, volunteers and an ambulance with a doctor along the course.

name: Jesenji planinarski maraton na Fruškoj gori
description: The Autumn Mountain Marathon on Fruška Gora is a traditional sports and recreation event that brings runners together on challenging trails through the beautiful nature of Fruška Gora. The races cover various distances, from ultra-extreme to beginner trails, and are suited to different fitness levels. The event takes place in Popovica near Sremska Kamenica and offers a unique combination of challenge and enjoyment of nature. The organizers also provide transport to the start, as well as extensive support during the race.

name: II. Dél-Balatoni Csillagó Trail
location: Gutman Borpince, Kötcse, Somogy County, Hungary
description: A II. Dél-Balatoni Csillagó Trail egy terepfutó verseny, amely Kötcsén, a Gutman Borpince környékén kerül megrendezésre. A verseny a 313,5 méter magas Csillagó-hegy körül zajlik, amely Somogy megye második legmagasabb pontja. A futamok változatos távokon kínálnak kihívást, a terep 95%-ban természetes, kisebb aszfaltozott és murvás szakaszokkal. A verseny hangulatát a helyi borvidék és a dombos táj teszi különlegessé, így a futók nemcsak sportélményt, hanem tájélményt is kapnak.
course_highlights: 95%-ban terepen, kisebb aszfaltozott és murvás szakaszokkal
Fáncsi-hegy meredek kaptatója az 5 km-es távon
Két frissítőpont a 10,5 km-es távon: Bókavölgy és Csillagó
additional: A versenyközpont 08:00-kor nyit, a rajtszám felvétel és helyszíni nevezés is ekkor kezdődik, de a helyszíni nevezés az adott futam rajtja előtt 10 perccel zár. Az 500 méteres távhoz nem szükséges terepfutó cipő. Kötcsei lakosoknak 30% kedvezmény jár, valamint szezonkedvezmény is elérhető azoknak, akik 2025-ben legalább két RUNTIME eseményen részt vettek.

name: Veresegyház Futónap
description: A Veresegyház Futónap egy családias hangulatú futóverseny, amely Veresegyház Búcsú tér környékén kerül megrendezésre. Több táv közül választhatnak a résztvevők, a mini futamtól a félmaratonig, egyéni és csapatban is lehet indulni. A verseny az Ötpróba program pontgyűjtő állomása is, így a résztvevők pontokat gyűjthetnek és jutalmakat szerezhetnek. A csapatban futás külön kategória, ahol háromfős csapatok versenyeznek, de minden csapattagnak egyénileg kell teljesítenie a távot. A rendezvény barátságos, közösségi esemény, amely a futás örömét és a sportos életmódot népszerűsíti.

name: Várfutás – felnőtt futamok
description: A Várfutás egy hagyományos futóverseny Szigligeten, amely a festői Kisfaludy utcában kerül megrendezésre. A verseny a helyi közösség és a sportbarátok számára kínál lehetőséget a mozgásra és a természet élvezetére. A futamok a Szigligeti Vár környékén zajlanak, így a résztvevők gyönyörű tájakat és történelmi emlékeket is megcsodálhatnak. A rendezvény családias hangulatú, és a helyi önkormányzat támogatásával valósul meg.

Festői kilátás a Balatonra és a környező tájra
Kisfaludy utca indulási helyszín

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 10. kolo
description: The Bratislava 2-Mile Run is a regular running competition over a distance of 2 miles (3.218 km), with categories for children, juniors, women, men, and veterans. The race takes place at Kuchajda in Bratislava and is organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team. The start is traditionally at 10:00, and the event also includes children’s races of approximately 200 meters. The Bratislava 2-Mile Run is part of a series of races held throughout the year, offering runners of various age groups and ability levels an opportunity to compete.

name: Challenge Airport Run
location: Prešov, Prešov, vojenská letecká základna v Prešove
organizer: Prešov Running, v spolupráci s Vojenskou leteckou základňou v Prešove
description: Challenge Airport Run is a unique running experience at the Military Air Base in Prešov, combining sport with the atmosphere of military training. Runners can choose between a 5 km and a 10 km course, with each participant carrying a symbolic weighted backpack, highlighting courage and endurance. The event offers an unforgettable atmosphere among helicopters and military equipment, which is rarely accessible to the public. In addition to the athletic challenge, it is also a tribute to discipline and strength, with a rich accompanying programme and original race packs.

name: Šamorínska bežecká liga 2026 – 6. kolo
organizer: 3klub Šamorín o.z. v spolupráci s mestom Šamorín
description: The Šamorín Running League is a traditional running competition organized by 3klub Šamorín, held in the pleasant surroundings of Pomlé Forest Park in Šamorín. The league offers several rounds with different distances, suitable for the general public and running enthusiasts. Participants can expect high-quality organization and a pleasant atmosphere in and around the amphitheater. The league is part of the region’s active sporting life and promotes a healthy lifestyle.

name: Slaňaki CUP – Beh do vrchu Dubník
location: Zámutov okr. Vranov nad Topľou, Zámutov okr. Vranov nad Topľou, pred Obecným úradom
organizer: Klub otužilcov Vranovské Vydry, Obecný úrad Zámutov, Penzión Kondor Zámutov
description: Slaňaki CUP - Dubník Uphill Race is a traditional uphill race held in Zámutov, Vranov nad Topľou District. The course is 11.2 km long with 600 metres of elevation gain, and the finish is at Slovakia’s highest structure, the Dubník transmitter, at an altitude of 318 metres. The race is part of the Slovak Uphill Running Cup and is open to a broad range of male and female runners of various ages. It is organized by the Vranovské Vydry Winter Swimming Club, Zámutov Municipal Office, and Penzión Kondor Zámutov. The race challenges runners to test their endurance and strength on demanding mountain terrain.

name: Žipovská desiatka
description: The Žipovská desiatka is a traditional running race held in the village of Nižný Žipov, offering runners the chance to test themselves on a 10-kilometre course. The race is organised by the Municipality of Nižný Žipov and is part of the village’s sporting life. The course runs along local roads and streets, allowing runners to experience the atmosphere of the village and its surroundings. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes an active lifestyle.
course_highlights: The route runs along Hlavná Street in Nižný Žipov
A 10 km race with an inline option
The atmosphere of a traditional village sporting event
additional: The event also includes an inline race on the same course. Race results are published on the municipality’s official website. The organiser is the Municipality of Nižný Žipov, which also provides other services and information for participants. In the previous edition, changing rooms were available in the cultural centre.

name: Bež, kto môžeš
description: Bež, kto môžeš is a charity run organized by Oáza Bernátovce, supporting people in extreme hardship and those experiencing homelessness. This running event has attracted many kind-hearted people and has a strong social focus, bringing sport together with support for disadvantaged groups. The run takes place in Košice - Barca and is part of a long-term project supporting socially excluded people. The organizers give the community an opportunity to get involved in helping others through sport and solidarity.
additional: The run is part of the DOMA SI ?! II. project, running from 08/2024 to 06/2027, which helps people facing long-term disadvantage and at risk of poverty and social exclusion.

name: Povlen Trail
description: Povlen Trail is part of the West Serbia Trails series, which connects the mountains, rivers, and valleys of western Serbia through unique trail races. This race gives runners the opportunity to explore unspoiled nature and enjoy the challenges of mountain trails. West Serbia Trails promotes a blend of sport, nature, and community, creating an unforgettable experience for all participants.

name: Kamenica trejl 2026
description: Kamenica Trail 2026 is the first race in the South Trail Series, taking place on October 18, 2026, at the Dabilo recreation area near Niš. The race offers two courses: a long course of 20.7 km with 810 meters of elevation gain and a short course of 5.6 km with 240 meters of elevation gain. Both start and finish at the same location. The routes follow forest trails, gravel roads, and a stretch of asphalt, offering a challenge and beautiful scenery. The event is organized by the Running and Mountaineering Association “Running club Niš.” Participants can expect good organization, refreshments, and prizes.

name: SZÁDVÁR TRAIL
description: A Compressport Szádvár Trail egy izgalmas terepfutó verseny, amely az Aggteleki-karszt vadregényes hegyeit és völgyeit járja be. A futók találkozhatnak erdei szarvasokkal, felfedezhetik a fák között megbújó kolostorromot, megmászhatják Szádvár izzasztó emelkedőjét, élvezhetik az Esztramos-hegy panorámáját, és átfuthatnak a hangulatos bódvaszilasi pincesoron. A verseny októberben, Szögligeten kerül megrendezésre, és valódi kalandot kínál minden kihívást kedvelő futónak.
course_highlights: Aggteleki-karszt vadregényes hegyei és völgyei
Kolostorrom a fák között
Szádvár izzasztó emelkedője és Esztramos-hegy panorámája

name: TÖRÖKBÁLINTI HENDIKEP
description: A Törökbálinti Hendikep futóversenynek a Dióskert ad otthont. A félmaratoni táv négy körből áll, de a résztvevők kevesebb kört is teljesíthetnek. A verseny családias hangulatú, körönkénti önkéntes nevezési díjjal várja a futókat.
course_highlights: A félmaratoni táv négy körből teljesíthető.
Kevesebb kör lefutására is van lehetőség.
A verseny helyszíne a törökbálinti Dióskert.

name: Beh hrebeňom Čergova
location: Kamenica, Sabinov District, Prešov Region, Slovakia
description: The Run Along the Čergov Ridge is the longest mountain race in the Čergov Mountains, intended for nature-running enthusiasts and trained runners. The route starts in the village of Kamenica and passes over the range’s highest peaks, including Minčol, Dvoriská, Solisko, Veľká Javorina, Čergov, Lysá and Sedlo Besná, offering magnificent panoramic views. The course is 32 km long with 1,413 metres of elevation gain, making it a challenging and appealing race for mountain runners. The race starts at Farma Kamenica and finishes at Sedlo Besná, by Hotel Šport Lysá. The organizer provides transport for runners from Drienica to the start and takes their personal belongings to the finish.
course_highlights: The route passes over the highest peaks of the Čergov Mountains, all above 1,000 m
Magnificent panoramic views throughout the race
Forest hiking trails marked in blue and green
additional: A large bus will take runners from the village of Drienica to the village of Kamenica at 7:15 a.m. on race morning. Race-day registration is from 7:00 to 8:30 a.m. at Farma Kamenica. The results ceremony and lunch will be held at Hotel Šport Lysá.

name: Rajecká 12-minútovka
location: School sports field on Lipová Street, Rajec, Žilina District, Slovakia
description: The Rajecká 12-Minute Run is a running competition organized by the Rajec Marathon Club. It takes place on the sports field beside the elementary school on Lipová Street in Rajec. This dynamic timed run challenges participants to cover the greatest possible distance in 12 minutes. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes an active lifestyle in the pleasant surroundings of Rajec.
course_highlights: A 12-minute timed run
Start and finish on the sports field beside the elementary school on Lipová Street
Pleasant urban surroundings in Rajec

name: Beh vinicami Bojničiek a Hlohovca
location: Kultúrny dom, Bojničky, Hlohovec District, Trnava Region, Slovakia
description: The Run through the Vineyards of Bojničky and Hlohovec is a running race organized by Atletický klub Bojničky and the Municipality of Bojničky. The race takes place amid the scenic vineyards around Bojničky and Hlohovec, with categories for men, women, and Nordic walking. The start and finish are by the cultural center in Bojničky, creating a welcoming community atmosphere. The race is suitable for the general public, including students and running enthusiasts of various ages.
course_highlights: The route runs through the vineyards around Bojničky and Hlohovec
Start and finish by the cultural center in Bojničky, near the church
Categories for men, women, and Nordic walking over 6 km
additional: The entry fee can be paid online or on site on race day. The organizers are Atletický klub Bojničky, the Municipality of Bojničky, Ing. Ivan Pavelka, and Ján Šiška. The organizer can also be contacted by phone at 0905 236 204.

name: Ružínska desiatka
location: Jaklovce, Gelnica District, Košice Region, Slovakia
description: Ružínska desiatka is a running race in the village of Jaklovce, offering 10 km and 5 km courses, as well as children’s races. The course is mostly asphalt with a small gravel section, making for a fast and enjoyable run. The race is organized by Športový klub Jaklovce in cooperation with the municipality of Jaklovce and is suitable for the general public, including various age groups. The main race starts at 11:00, and the children’s races start at 10:00.
course_highlights: The course is 90% asphalt and 10% gravel (macadam)
The race takes place in the village of Jaklovce, Gelnica District
Categories include 10 km, 5 km, and children’s races
additional: The children’s races start at 10:00. The organizers are Športový klub Jaklovce o.z. and the municipality of Jaklovce. Contacts: Peter Budinský (0905 527 234), Peter Mitrík (0905 377 836).

name: Viking Challenge Trail
location: Planinarski dom Jedinstvo, Fruška Gora, Serbia
description: Viking Challenge is a race held on Fruška Gora, with courses of varying distances suited to all ages and running levels. Participants can choose from courses ranging from 1 km to 22 km, which are well marked and offer a challenging and exciting adventure in nature. The race is carefully organized, with electronic timing, refreshments at checkpoints, and a post-race meal, all contributing to a pleasant atmosphere and the safety of all participants. The race is known for its friendly atmosphere and the support of volunteers and spectators.
course_highlights: Courses of 1 km, 7 km, 15 km, and 22 km on Fruška Gora
Well-marked courses with electronic timing
Refreshments, a post-race meal, and medical assistance available
additional: Starts are in groups according to registration dates, with no possibility of changing groups; participants receive a medal and a race T-shirt; race photos are available; water, juice, and energy drinks are provided at checkpoints; medical assistance is available in case of injury.

name: Ovčar 2026
description: Kablar Skyrace is a mountain race held in the spectacular Ovčar-Kablar Gorge, starting and finishing in Ovčar Banja. The race is 22.4 km long, with a cumulative elevation gain of 1,600 metres. It includes technically challenging sections, with Kablar’s two summits as distinctive course landmarks. Participants can enjoy varied terrain, including fast forest sections and rocky stretches, as well as beautiful views of the West Morava River and the surrounding mountains. The event is part of the national skyrunning series and awards ITRA points. It is organised by the “Kablar” Mountaineering Society of Čačak under the patronage of the Mountaineering Association of Serbia.
course_highlights: 22.4 km long with 1,600 m of cumulative elevation gain
Technically challenging sections, with rocks as the dominant feature
Views of the West Morava River and surrounding mountains from Kablar’s two summits
additional: The race awards 1 ITRA point and counts toward the Mountaineering Association of Serbia (PSS) national skyrunning series. The start and finish are at the Nature Centre in Ovčar Banja. The course is certified and open to participants with a valid medical examination or a competition licence.

name: Račiansky kros – jeseň
location: Knižková dolina Amphitheater, Rača, Bratislava, Slovakia
description: Račiansky kros – autumn is a traditional running race held in Bratislava, in the Knižková dolina area of Bratislava-Rača. The race gives runners the opportunity to enjoy the autumn atmosphere in the pleasant surroundings of the amphitheatre and nearby area. The organisers, OZ PERUN, ensure thorough preparation and refreshments for participants. The event is suitable for the general public and running enthusiasts of all ages.
course_highlights: Race in the natural surroundings of Knižková dolina
Start and finish at the Bratislava-Rača amphitheatre
Autumn atmosphere and quality refreshments
additional: The registration form and consent of the data subject are available on the website. The organiser is OZ PERUN. IBAN for payments: SK09 8330 0000 0025 0082 7935. The course is 80% forest paths and 20% asphalt. The races are open to men, women and children. Registration is available online and on-site, with a limited number of starting places. The event also includes children’s races and post-race refreshments.

name: T1 Ring kros
location: T1 Ring, Vechec, Vranov nad Topľou District, Slovakia
description: T1 Ring Cross is a running race held at the T1 Ring venue in Vechec, offering 9 km and 4 km courses. The race is divided into age and gender categories and also includes a non-competitive 4 km Nordic Walking event. The children’s start is at 11:00 and the main category starts at 13:00. The race is part of the Michalovce–Sobrance Running League 2025 and offers an enjoyable challenge, with approximately 210 metres of elevation gain on the main course.
course_highlights: 9 km course with approximately 210 m of elevation gain
4 km course for recreational runners and Nordic Walking
Race at the T1 Ring venue in Vechec
additional: Children’s start at 11:00; main category at 13:00. Competitive categories by age and gender. Part of the Michalovce–Sobrance Running League 2025.

name: Košickopolianska desiatka
description: The Košickopolianska Ten is a running race organized in the municipality of Košická Polianka, offering categories for men, women, and children in different age groups. The start is in front of the cultural centre, and the main race begins at 13:00. The event is suitable for the general public and supports community sports in the region.
course_highlights: Start and finish in front of the cultural centre in Košická Polianka
Categories for all age groups, from children to seniors
The race takes place in the pleasant surroundings of Košická Polianka
additional: The children’s races start at 11:00. The organizer is the Municipality of Košická Polianka. Categories are divided by age and gender, including categories for the youngest children from age 0.

name: TIMIȘOARA CITY MARATHON
description: Timișoara City Marathon is a sporting event for both amateurs and experienced runners, held in the heart of Timișoara. The 42.2 km marathon starts in Otelec and finishes in Piața Victoriei, offering a unique experience through the story of Eugeniu de Savoya’s arrival. The half marathon and shorter races offer varied routes through the city’s squares, parks, and historic neighborhoods, showcasing local beauty and heritage. The event also includes associated activities such as workshops, a Pasta Party, and a special anniversary race, “106 pentru POLI.”
course_highlights: The marathon starts outside the city, in Otelec, and finishes in Piața Victoriei
The half marathon combines the squares and parks of the Fabric neighborhood along the banks of the Bega
The shorter races pass through the parks along the Bega Canal and the Fabric neighborhood
additional: Race packs are distributed at the UPT Rectorate in Piața Victoriei. The marathon starts with a bus departure at 06:30 from Piața Victoriei to Otelec. Energy products (bar + gel) are included only for the 42 km and 21 km races. The technical T-shirt and cotton T-shirt can be purchased during registration. Participants can choose from several race categories, as well as workshops and a pasta party.

description: Sninský Cross is a traditional running race in Snina, offering a competition in pleasant surroundings with quality organization. Competitors are provided with race numbers, a changing tent, toilets, and a bag storage facility. The race is held according to the rules of the Slovak Athletics Federation, and category winners receive medals and in-kind prizes. The event has a friendly atmosphere and supports charitable causes.
course_highlights: The route follows a circuit through the town of Snina
Asphalt surface with distance markers every 5 km
A detailed map, elevation profile, and GPX file are available
additional: A changing tent is provided, toilets are available at Hotel Kamei, and bag storage is located by registration. Every participant receives a medal, and refreshments are provided. The winners are announced immediately after all runners have finished, at the venue.

name: Beiuș Running Day
description: Beiuș Running Day is an annual running event offering races for all ages and experience levels, held in the town of Beiuș. The courses include a free children’s race, a 2 km race for beginners and families, a 10 km race for amateur and semi-professional runners, and a 21.1 km half marathon for experienced runners. The event takes place in Mihai Eminescu Park and on the streets of Beiuș, with safe, well-marked courses that offer an enjoyable and competitive experience. Participants receive prizes, medals, and surprises, while the children’s races are organized with special safety and supervision measures.
course_highlights: Forest trails with natural paths and paved streets in Beiuș
A completely safe children’s race on a flat course closed to vehicle traffic
Prizes and medals for all age groups and distances
additional: The Children’s Race starts at 11:30 and is organized by age categories for children aged 4 to 13, on a completely safe course closed to vehicle traffic. Children participate for free, and parents or guardians must be present throughout the race. The adult races start at 11:00 in Mihai Eminescu Park. Prizes are available for podium finishers, and all participants who complete the race receive medals.

name: Hațeg Royal Trail
description: Hațeg Royal Trail is a running event offering a variety of routes around the Hațeg Royal Fortress, combining natural scenery with historical features. Participants can choose between the marathon, half marathon, 12 km cross-country race, 6 km race, children’s race, and family run. All races follow well-marked, technical routes with climbs and descents that challenge both beginners and advanced runners. The event is appreciated for its careful organization, friendly atmosphere, and attractive prizes. Participants are advised to be fit and have suitable sports gear to fully enjoy the experience.
course_highlights: Well-marked, clean routes with technical climbs and descents through hills and forest
Passage through the Hațeg Royal Fortress and natural areas such as Lunca de Jos and the Subcetate meadow
A range of races: marathon, half marathon, 12 km cross-country race, 6 km race, children’s race, and family run
additional: On-site registration is not available, except for the Kids and Family categories, which are limited to 100 places. Participants must have suitable sports gear, and mandatory equipment may be checked at the start and along the route. There is a dedicated race for people with special abilities, “Și eu POT!”.

name: Gledić Ultra trejl 2026
description: Gledić Ultra Trail is a mountain race held in the heart of Serbia, in the Gledić Mountains, offering runners a unique opportunity to experience unspoiled nature across forests, meadows, and mountain ridges. The race offers three courses of different distances and difficulty levels: Lane (12 km), Srna (22 km), and Jelen (ultra, 58 km). All are well-marked and pass through beautiful natural landscapes. This event is not just a race, but also a gathering of people who share a passion for nature and adventure, with a generous race package and support along the course. The start is planned, with time limits suited to the course distances.
course_highlights: Mountain trails through the forests, meadows, and ridges of the Gledić Mountains
Three courses of different distances: 12 km, 22 km, and 58 km, with significant elevation gain
Beautiful viewpoints and authentic natural landscapes
additional: The race package includes a T-shirt with the race logo, a medal, a chip-equipped race bib, aid stations, professional photos, sponsor gifts, and lunch for participants. The courses are marked and secured. The time limit for the longest course is 12 hours, and for the middle-distance course, 6 hours.

name: RUN IASI
description: Run Iași is a running event that brings together students, teachers, and residents of the city of Iași to celebrate movement, education, and civic spirit. The race is a declaration of belonging and solidarity, turning every kilometer into a symbol of an active, healthy community. Participants enjoy an energetic, unifying sporting experience in a vibrant urban setting.
course_highlights: An urban route through the city of Iași
A 10 km race for runners of all levels
A community atmosphere and civic spirit
additional: The event includes 5 km and 10 km races, with online registration, and promotes health, education, and solidarity in Iași

name: Băneasa Forest Run
description: Băneasa Forest Run is a 100% trail run in Băneasa Forest, Bucharest. It started in 2018 and has grown to more than 2,400 participants. The event offers four races: a half marathon, an 11 km cross-country race, a 6 km fast run, and a non-competitive 3 km Family Run, suitable for runners of all levels. The race focuses on the joy of running in nature and spending time with family, and is organized by a team passionate about running. Participants can join group training sessions at different paces, led by coaches, to prepare for race day.
course_highlights: A 100% trail route in Băneasa Forest
A range of races: half marathon, 11 km, 6 km, and 3 km Family Run
Training sessions organized in groups at different paces
additional: Training sessions are organized in groups at different paces and led by coordinators. The Family Run is a non-competitive race for families. The event supports social causes through partnerships with Asociația Magic and Asociația Zi de Bine. The event includes several race categories, route details and participant instructions, as well as support for social causes.

name: BEH 17. NOVEMBRA
location: Žilina, Okres Žilina, Žilinský kraj, Slovakia

name: FUSS EGY NAPOT!
description: A „Fuss egy napot!” egy ultrafutó esemény Kecskeméten, amely a Benkó Zoltán Parkban kerül megrendezésre. A rendezvény célja az egészséges életmód népszerűsítése és a közösségi sportélmény megteremtése. A futók egy nap alatt teljesítenek ultratávot, miközben farsangi hangulat és közös kocogás is várja a résztvevőket. A program családbarát és mindenkit szeretettel vár, aki szeretne aktívan tölteni egy napot a természetben.
course_highlights: Ultrafutás a Benkó Zoltán Parkban
Farsangi hangulat és közös kocogás
Egészséges életmód és közösségi sportélmény
additional: A rendezvény farsangi kocogóval és ultrafutással várja a résztvevőket, családbarát programokkal és közösségi eseményekkel.

name: HALLOWEEN RUN
location: Rottenbiller Park, Budapest X. kerület, Hungary
description: A Halloween Run egy különleges, izgalmas futóesemény Budapest X. kerületében, a Rottenbiller Parkban és a volt Kőbányai Sörgyár területén. A verseny során a résztvevők egy sötét, hátborzongató hangulatú pályán haladnak át, ahol rémalakok, kísértetek és félelmetes effektek teszik próbára a bátorságot és a hidegvért. A futamok között több táv és kategória is választható, a rövid sprinttől a hosszabb, akár 21 km-es körökig. A verseny végén zene és ünneplés várja a bátor résztvevőket, akik végigmentek ezen a különleges élményen.
course_highlights: Útvonal a volt Kőbányai Sörgyár pincerendszerében és a környező parkokban
Sötét, hátborzongató látványvilág és ijesztő meglepetések a pályán
Több táv, köztük 21 km-es, 14 km-es és 7 km-es körök, valamint rövid sprintfutamok
additional: A versenyközpont a Rottenbiller Parkban található, megközelíthető több busz- és villamosjárattal. A helyszínen a nevezés legkésőbb a futam rajtja előtt 45 perccel lehetséges, amennyiben az online nevezés során nem teltek be a létszámkorlátok. A futamok között több időpontban indulnak túrák és sprintfutamok, valamint egyéni és váltó kategóriák is vannak.

name: VASKAPU TRAIL
description: A Vaskapu Trail egy terepfutó verseny Esztergom vadregényes ösvényein, amely három különböző távon kínál kihívást kezdőknek, haladóknak és tapasztalt futóknak egyaránt. A verseny útvonala főként ösvényeken és kijelölt turistaútvonalakon halad, minimális közúti szakaszokkal, így a természet közelségét élvezhetik a résztvevők. A rendezvény helyszíne a Vaskapu Étterem és környéke, ahol a futók gyönyörű panorámák és változatos terepviszonyok között mérhetik össze erejüket. A versenyen ITRA pontok is gyűjthetők, ami különösen vonzó a terepfutók számára.
course_highlights: Három táv: 8 km, 16 km és 24 km, különböző szintemelkedéssel
Futás ösvényeken és kijelölt turistaútvonalakon, minimális közúti szakaszokkal
Lenyűgöző panorámák Esztergom környékén, változatos terepviszonyok
additional: A verseny három különböző távon zajlik: Nekem 8 (8 km, 410 m szintemelkedés), Majális 16 (16 km, 780 m szintemelkedés) és Hideglelés 24 (23,6 km, 1100 m szintemelkedés). A szintidők rendre 1 óra 35 perc, 3 óra és 4 óra 30 perc. A verseny útvonala jól futható emelkedőket, meredek kaptatókat és változatos terepet kínál. A versenyzőknek a KRESZ szabályok betartására kell ügyelniük, a szervezők nem vállalnak felelősséget esetleges balesetekért.

name: Bežecký festival - 26. ročník Memoriálu MUDr. Podmolíka v polmaratóne, Otrokovický maratón a sprievodné preteky
ISTRITA XSCAPE
description: IstritaXscape is a mountain running event organized by the Legendary Sports Sports Club Association, held on the hills, trails, and forest roads around Istrița Hill and the Sărata-Monteoru resort. The routes offer a unique experience, combining nature with the area’s millennia-old history, including Dacian, Roman, and prehistoric traces. Three races are available: Fun Run, Half Marathon, and Marathon, each featuring spectacular scenery and mountain challenges. Participants enjoy a friendly atmosphere and amenities such as refreshment stations and individual timing.
course_highlights: Routes across the hills and trails around Istrița and Sărata-Monteoru
Scenic views of the Monteoru resort and the city of Buzău
Ascents and descents on forest roads and marked trails
additional: Participants receive a race pack with a race number, individual timing, a finisher’s medal, refreshment stations and on-course support, isotonic drinks at the start/finish, results and an electronic certificate, as well as photo and video materials.

name: Feldwar Trail 1 / 5 / 10 / 17 / 23
description: A Feldwar Trail egy barátságos, családias terepfutó verseny Dunaföldvár dombjai között, csodás panorámával és impozáns rajtközponttal az Ispánházban. A versenyen több táv közül választhatnak a futók, a gyerekfutamoktól a 23 km-es távig, ahol a női és férfi kategóriákat külön díjazzák. A pályák javarészt földutakon vezetnek, minimális szilárd burkolattal, így a természet közelségét élvezhetik a résztvevők. A verseny zöld rendezvényként működik, ezért a szervezők kérik a futókat, hogy hozzanak magukkal kulacsot vagy saját poharat a frissítőpontokhoz.
course_highlights: Dunaföldvár dombjai között vezető terepfutó útvonalak
Csodás panoráma a déli Dunakanyarra a Kálváriáról és a Duna menti gerincről
Javarészt földutak, minimális szilárd útburkolat
additional: Helyszíni nevezés 2026.11.08. vasárnap 9:00-10:00 (gyerekeknek 9:45). Chipes időmérés Traxpace rendszerrel, online részeredményekkel. A versenyen maximum 400 fő indulhat, ebből max. 100 ovis és alsós gyerek. A frissítőpontokon nem adnak eldobható poharat, ezért kérik a saját kulacs vagy pohár használatát. A szintidő tájékoztató jellegű, az érmet szintidőn kívül is megkapja a célba érő. Távok: 1, 5, 10, 17, 23 km; frissítõ pontok a különbözõ távokon; chipes idõmérés; lehetőség az instant futásra; gyerekfutamok; nevezés csoportosan vagy egyénileg; díjazás kategóriánként.

name: Beh oslobodenia mesta Strážske
location: Strážske, Michalovce District, Košice Region, Slovakia
description: The Strážske Liberation Run is a traditional running race organized by the town of Strážske in cooperation with the MBO Strážske running club. The event commemorates the liberation of the town each year and attracts runners of various age groups, including youth and adults. The course passes through the town, and competitors are divided into several age and performance categories. The atmosphere is sporting and community-oriented, with prizes for the best runners and a rich tradition approaching its 50th anniversary edition.
course_highlights: Multiple age categories, from preschoolers to adults
Race organized in cooperation with the local MBO Strážske running club
Traditional run commemorating the liberation of the town of Strážske
additional: The run has a long tradition, and its 50th anniversary edition will take place in 2027. After the race, the fastest runners in each category receive awards, and a raffle with valuable prizes is held. More than 300 runners have taken part in the past, including local and international competitors.

description: The Trenčín Running League is a regular running competition in Trenčín and the surrounding area, encouraging runners of all ages to stay active and lead a healthy lifestyle. The 9th round takes place at the football pitch in Trenčianska Turná and features a 7.8 km course with 123 metres of elevation gain. The route runs mainly along paved roads, with some off-road sections, through the village and past natural and cultural landmarks, making it an enjoyable and interesting run. The start is scheduled for 10:00, and participants can make a voluntary donation to support the Special Boarding School in Trenčín.
course_highlights: 7.8 km course with 123 m of elevation gain
80% paved surface, 20% off-road
The route passes through Trenčianska Turná and by the Slovak Double Cross
additional: Registration takes place at the venue from 9:00. The entry fee is paid on site. Runners can make a voluntary donation to the Special Boarding School in Trenčín. Results are announced after the run, followed by a social event. The elevation gain for this course was listed as 123 m in the previous edition.

name: BUCHAREST 21K
description: Bucharest 21k is a running race that invites you to discover Romania’s capital in a unique way: by running. The course is flat, fast, and ideal for setting personal records, passing through green parks and combining old architecture with the city’s modern energy. The event is suitable for both elite runners and enthusiastic amateurs, offering a vibrant, dynamic atmosphere in the heart of Bucharest. It’s the perfect opportunity to explore a lively European city that remains undiscovered by the masses.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course, ideal for personal records
Green parks along the course
A unique blend of old architecture and modern energy
additional: The event is part of the YOLO Events series, which promotes an active, healthy lifestyle. Participants can support charitable causes through personal fundraising pages. The atmosphere is energizing, and the event is open to both elite runners and amateurs. The course includes hydration stations every 5 km and the energetic atmosphere characteristic of Romania’s capital.

name: Tanúhegyek Trail 7 / 21 / 42
description: A Tanúhegyek Trail egy terepfutó verseny, amelyet a Terepfutó Műhely Sportegyesület rendez a Balaton-felvidéki Nemzeti Park egyik legszebb részén. A verseny során 1, 3 vagy 5 tanúhegyet lehet meghódítani, amelyekről káprázatos kilátás nyílik a Balatonra és az őszi színekben pompázó tájra. A rajt és a cél Badacsonytomajban, a Halászkertben található. A legrövidebb, 7 km-es távon kutyás futamot is rendeznek, és a rendezvény jótékonysági célt szolgál, az időmérő chip letéti díját az Ürömi Állatotthon javára lehet felajánlani.
course_highlights: Terepfutás a Balaton-felvidéki Nemzeti Parkban
Kilátás a Balatonra és a színes őszi tájra
Útvonal erdei utakon és jelölt turistaösvényeken
additional: Időmérés elektronikusan, chip segítségével történik, a chip letéti díja 2000 Ft, amely visszajár vagy jótékony célra felajánlható. A verseny útvonalán előre be nem jelentett ellenőrzőpontok lehetnek. A közutakon a forgalom nincs lezárva, ezért a közlekedési szabályok betartása kötelező. A versenyen 12 év felettiek vehetnek részt, 12-18 évesek csak szülői beleegyezéssel.

description: Zemplín Extreme is a running league in eastern Slovakia that offers challenging courses, clear rules, and fast results. Run in the Museum is one of the league’s events and takes place on the grounds of the Zemplín Museum in Michalovce. Runners can enjoy quality courses that count towards the league standings and compete in various categories. The league is suitable for runners looking for serious races with professional organization.
course_highlights: Running courses on the grounds of the Zemplín Museum in Michalovce
Courses that count towards the standings, with clear rules and fast results
Part of a running league in eastern Slovakia
additional: The race is part of a league where points are awarded based on finishing position on the scored course. The schedule, registration, and results load directly from the Racetime platform.

name: Beh na Minčol
location: Višňové, Žilina District, Žilina Region, Slovakia
distance_verbose: 118 km, Maratón, 13.7 km, 11 km, 10 km, 8.3 km, 6 km, 5 km, 4.5 km
description: The Minčol Run is the toughest uphill race in the vicinity of the Višňovská Valley. It follows a marked hiking trail to the summit of Minčol, with beautiful views of the Krivánska and Lúčanská sections of the Malá Fatra. The course is characterized by steep climbs from start to finish, with little chance to rest; the final section often requires a fast walk. The race is organized with an emphasis on thorough preparation and the experience of running in nature. Refreshments and lunch are provided after the finish at the Holý Diel ski resort.
course_highlights: A marked hiking trail with blue waymarks
Steep climbs from the start to the finish
Views of the Krivánska and Lúčanská sections of the Malá Fatra from the summit of Minčol
additional: Race check-in is from 8:30 to 9:30. Results are announced shortly after the last runner finishes, at approximately 12:30. Transport for each runner’s belongings to the results-announcement venue is provided. Refreshments are available on the course at approximately 2 km and at the finish. After the race, lunch (homemade cabbage soup and a drink) is served at the Holý Diel ski resort.

The race takes place in a picturesque setting with forest paths, grassy surfaces, and rolling terrain, offering runners an enjoyable and challenging experience. Various age groups can compete, including children, youth, and adults, and there is also a non-competitive category, Prebehni sa s nami. The start for children and youth is at 11:00, for adults at 13:00, and for Prebehni sa s nami at 12:15.

Rolling terrain
Race in the natural surroundings of Malé pole
additional: Categories are divided by age and gender, including children and youth up to 17 years old. The entry fee can be paid online or on site for an additional charge. Prebehni sa s nami is a non-competitive 3 km category with no age limit.

description: The Run through the Jastrabie Hills is the 3rd edition of the Ján Dobák Memorial, held in the village of Šarišské Jastrabie. The race offers categories for children and adults across various age groups and disciplines, including 10 km and 5 km runs for men and women, as well as Nordic walking. The children’s race starts at 12:30 and the adults’ race at 14:00. The organizers, the Municipality of Šarišské Jastrabie and the Šarišské Jastrabie Primary School and Kindergarten, welcome runners of all ages and abilities.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Jastrabie Hills in the village of Šarišské Jastrabie
Categories for various age groups and disciplines, including Nordic walking
Start at the Šarišské Jastrabie Municipal Office grounds
additional: On-site registration is possible only in exceptional cases, by arrangement with the organizer. Children’s categories, residents of Šarišské Jastrabie, men over 70, and women over 60 can enter for free. A discounted race bundle is available for Z Ľubotína na Hrad Plaveč + Run through the Jastrabie Hills. The event includes 5 km and 10 km courses; registration is available online and on-site, and prices vary by category and registration method. Categories are also offered for children, seniors, and Nordic walking.

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 11. kolo
description: Beh 2 míle Bratislava is a regular 2-mile (3.218 km) running race held at the Kuchajda swimming pool complex in Bratislava. It is organised by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team and is part of a race series with points awarded by men’s and women’s categories. Registration takes place on site by the volleyball court from 9:30, with the race starting at 10:00. The categories are children, juniors, women, men and veterans. Runners can also earn points for improving their times during the year.
course_highlights: 2-mile (3.218 km) course
Registration and start by the volleyball court at the Kuchajda swimming pool complex
Categories for children, juniors, women, men and veterans
additional: Registration takes place on site by the volleyball court from 9:30. Competitors vie for the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team Perpetual Trophy, with points calculated using coefficients based on year of birth. In the event of a tie, the best time decides, followed by shoe size. At the end of the year, the two months with the fewest points are removed (amnesty). Registration is available on site; the event is held in several rounds throughout the year, with each race covering approximately 2 miles (3.218 km).

name: Beh na Husárik
location: Horské hoteli Husárik, Čadca, Žilina, Slovakia
description: The Beh na Husárik is a traditional running race organized by the Kysucký Marathon Club Čadca, the City of Čadca, and the Husárik Mountain Hotel. Held in honor of Students’ Day, the race gives runners the chance to test themselves in beautiful mountain surroundings. The start is always at 11:00, and the race is known for its friendly atmosphere and the Mayor of Čadca’s Cup awarded to the winners. The Beh na Husárik is suitable for the general public interested in sport and nature.
course_highlights: Mountain surroundings around the Husárik Mountain Hotel
Race held in honor of Students’ Day
Mayor of Čadca’s Cup for the winners
additional: Online registration is closed. You can also register on race day for the increased entry fee of 8 EUR. The race takes place on 15 November 2026, with a start at 11:00. Online registration is available; the course is hilly and trail-based. The race is held in Čadca near the Husárik Mountain Hotel.

name: Beh oslobodenia mesta Michalovce
organizer: Mesto Michalovce, Atletický klub Michalovce, ZŠ Pavla Horova Michalovce
description: The Michalovce Liberation Run is a traditional evening race held in the city center of Michalovce. Runners follow city streets over a course of approximately 5.8 km made up of several laps. After finishing, they receive refreshments and a participant medal. The race is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant atmosphere, with the option to register in person on race day.
course_highlights: Evening run through the center of Michalovce
5.8 km course made up of 1,450 m laps
Refreshments and a participant medal after the finish
additional: In-person registration takes place in the lobby of the Town Hall from 16:30 to 17:45. Headlamps are recommended for safety. After finishing, runners return their race number and receive a medal. The results ceremony is at 19:30 in the gymnasium of P. Horov Elementary School No. 8. The course has been shortened to 5.8 km and runs on asphalt and stone surfaces. Registration is available online or in person. The entry fee is €20; a reduced fee applies to online registration by 19.11.2025.

description: The Hoia GlobalLogic Cross-Country Race is a running event held in Cluj-Napoca, offering participants the opportunity to run along the cool trails of Hoia Forest. The event includes several races over distances of 15 km, 7 km and 3 km, as well as a race for families, making it suitable for all ages and fitness levels. The organizers, Runners Club, promote a friendly atmosphere and support the local running community. Participants can enjoy a natural, scenic and healthy setting, away from paved roads.
course_highlights: Route along the cool trails of Hoia Forest
Various distances: 15 km, 7 km, 3 km and a family race
Event held in nature, away from paved roads
additional: The event includes a registration package with a T-shirt and race number. Races are held for all ages, including one dedicated to families. The route follows natural forest trails, offering a running experience in nature. The race starts in the evening, creating a special night-race atmosphere. The participation fee includes a medal, timing and medical assistance. Registration is exclusively online, with entries open until June 13, 2026.

name: CROSUL 15 NOIEMBRIE
description: The 15 November Run is an annual sporting event held in Brașov, commemorating the Anti-Communist Revolt of 15 November 1987 by workers at the Roman Truck Factory. The main event is a 5-kilometre road race along the historic route of the revolt, open to all running enthusiasts. There are also races for children, with distances adapted to their ages, promoting physical activity and team spirit. The event is organized by Brașov City Hall in partnership with the 15 November 1987 Brașov Association and the Together for Movement Sports Club.
course_highlights: A historic 5 km route along the streets associated with the 1987 Brașov Revolt
An urban road route through Brașov, including historic and cultural landmarks
Children’s races from 250 m to 1.2 km, adapted for different age groups
additional: Registration is free and limited to 1,800 participants (1,500 adults and 300 children). Race kits can be collected the day before at the Sport Guru Brașov store between 15:30 and 20:00. The race starts inside the SC Roman industrial park, right outside the former Section 440 of the Truck Factory, where the revolt began. Running on the streets of Brașov, a 5 km route, races for all ages, commemorative event, organized in November 2025
